title: One Behavior, Out of Order: Deterministic Execution and Parallel Simulation of ROS 2 Applications
summary: System-level simulation is widely used to validate robotic applications before hardware deployment. However, Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2), a popular middleware for such applications, uses asynchronous publish-subscribe communication, which can make application behavior depend on scheduling and the platform. The behavior can then vary across runs and machines even with the same inputs. This nondeterminism makes faults hard to reproduce and tests unreliable. In this paper, we first give ROS 2 applications a lightweight coordination scheme in which every component, including event-driven ones, reads its inputs and writes its outputs at predefined time instants. By decoupling computation and communication, the scheme makes an application deterministic, that is, it always has one behavior for given inputs. Tests are thus repeatable, but for large applications they still take a long time. To speed up these tests, we then present an out-of-order parallel simulation algorithm. From the predefined read and write instants, it knows before the run which activations of components depend on which. It starts each activation as soon as those it depends on have finished. Finally, we implement the algorithm in a simulator that runs existing ROS 2 applications without any change to them or to ROS 2. We evaluate the simulator on industrial use cases and synthetic graphs. On the industrial use cases, it is up to 2.6 times faster than synchronous parallel simulation and needs an order of magnitude less memory for messages than asynchronous parallel simulation.

AI.tldr: 为ROS 2应用引入轻量协调机制（所有组件在预定时刻读写），使应用确定化，并据此实现乱序并行仿真算法，在工业用例上比同步并行仿真快至2.6倍、消息内存比异步并行仿真低一个数量级。
AI.motivation: ROS 2异步发布-订阅导致调度与平台相关的非确定性，故障难复现、测试不可靠；即使确定化后，大型应用测试仍耗时过长。
AI.method: 1) 轻量协调方案：每个组件（含事件驱动组件）在预定时间点读取输入、写出输出，将计算与通信解耦以获得确定性；2) 基于预定义读写时刻静态推导组件激活间依赖，实现乱序并行仿真，依赖完成即启动激活；3) 实现仿真器，无需修改现有ROS 2应用或ROS 2本身。
AI.result: 工业用例上比同步并行仿真快至2.6倍，消息内存比异步并行仿真低约一个数量级；并在合成图上完成验证。
AI.conclusion: 确定性协调+依赖感知的乱序并行仿真可在零侵入前提下兼顾可复现性与仿真效率，适合系统级机器人应用验证。

title: Model the Annotation, Not the Noise: Semantic Annotation-Channel Prompt Learning against Noisy Labels
summary: Parameter-efficient prompt learning has become a cornerstone for adapting pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs), yet it remains highly vulnerable to label noise in few-shot Web and retrieval scenarios. Existing noise robust methods typically rely on hard sample selection or deterministic label correction, which discard valuable semantic ambiguity and overlook how observed annotations are actually generated. To bridge this gap, we reformulate noisy prompt learning through the perspective of data generation, proposing SACP, a Semantic-aware Annotation Channel-based Prompt learning framework. Instead of suppressing noise heuristically, SACP decouples latent clean-label prediction from instance-dependent annotation generation. By integrating frozen VLM semantic priors with lightweight visual residuals, SACP constructs a structured annotation channel optimized via generalized expectation-maximization with soft posteriors. Furthermore, a posterior-aware memory is introduced to preserve label uncertainty during test-time inference. Extensive experiments across different synthetic benchmarks and the real-world noisy Food101N dataset demonstrate that SACP achieves state-of-the-art performance against its counterparts in different label noise patterns, especially under severe asymmetric noise.

AI.tldr: SACP 提出语义感知标注通道式提示学习框架，将噪声提示学习重构为"隐清洁标签预测 + 实例相关标注生成"的解耦生成过程，用冻结 VLM 语义先验加轻量视觉残差构建标注通道，并以广义 EM 软后验优化，配合后验感知记忆用于测试时推理。
AI.motivation: 参数高效提示学习在少样本 Web/检索场景下对标签噪声高度脆弱。现有鲁棒方法依赖硬样本筛选或确定性标签纠正，丢弃了有价值的语义模糊性，也忽视了观测标注的实际生成机制，因此需要从数据生成视角重新建模噪声。
AI.method: SACP 将潜在清洁标签预测与实例相关标注生成解耦：在免费冻结的 VLM 语义先验基础上引入轻量视觉残差，构建结构化"标注通道"；通过广义期望最大化（GEM）以软后验进行优化；并设计后验感知记忆模块，在测试时推理中保留标签不确定性。
AI.result: 在多组合成噪声基准与真实噪声数据集 Food101N 上，SACP 在不同噪声模式下均取得与同类方法相比的最优性能，在严重非对称噪声下提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 以生成式视角处理标签噪声优于启发式筛选/纠错，软后验与测试时不确定性记忆是有效的鲁棒提示学习范式；但实验集中于图像分类级基准，未涉及感知、3D 或具身任务。

title: MambaSplit: Severity-Robust and Inference-Efficient Semantic Unmixing of Fluorescence Microscopy Image Data
comment: 28 pages, 15 figures, 23 tables; main paper (8 pages) followed by supplementary material
summary: The number of structures fluorescence microscopy can image in one sample is limited by how few fluorophores can be separated without significant spectral overlap. Semantic unmixing circumvents this limit by imaging two structures in one fluorescent channel and computationally separating the superimposed image into one image per structure. Because pixels rarely identify their structure, unmixing requires both local and long-range spatial context. The relative brightness of the two structures is unknown and can be very uneven, so predictions must remain accurate across mixing severities, from balanced mixtures to ones where a structure is barely visible. Existing methods either process small image patches or add context through auxiliary pathways that slow inference on large images. We present MambaSplit, a hierarchical state-space encoder with a convolutional decoder that captures context across large tiles in linear time and predicts both channels in one deterministic pass. MambaSplit trains either on computationally summed channel images with random mixing ratios, where a lightweight head estimates the unknown ratio and conditions the decoder on it, or on experimentally acquired superpositions. Across five datasets and nine mixing ratios, MambaSplit achieves the highest RI-PSNR, by up to 3.0 dB, in 11 of 15 dataset-severity combinations and ties in one more, while running 5.9x faster than the strongest baseline. On acquired superpositions, fine-tuning a model pretrained on summed inputs matches or exceeds all baselines. Ablations show that accuracy and robustness come mainly from the training recipe: large tiles, mixing ratios sampled across their full range (up to 11 dB over fixed-ratio training), and independently drawn channel crops (3.9 dB on BioSR). The state-space backbone makes large tiles affordable, enabling high-content screening and event-driven smart microscopy.

AI.tldr: MambaSplit：用分层状态空间编码器+卷积解码器，在单通道内对大图块做线性时间语义解混，一次前向同时输出两路结构图，并支持混合比例条件化训练。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微成像中可分辨的荧光团数量受光谱重叠限制。语义解混通过在单一通道中成像两个结构再计算分离来突破限制，但像素本身几乎不能判别归属，需要局部+长程空间上下文；两结构相对亮度未知且可能极不均衡，因此需要在从均衡混合到近乎不可见的全范围混合强度下保持准确；现有方法受限于小图块或依赖辅助路径引入上下文，大图推理慢。
AI.method: MambaSplit 采用分层状态空间（Mamba）编码器捕获大 tile 的上下文且复杂度线性，配卷积解码器，一次确定性前向同时预测双通道。训练有两路：(1) 用计算求和的双通道图像并以随机混合比例合成样本，由轻量头估计未知比例并对解码器做条件化；(2) 直接使用实验采集的叠加图像；可在合成数据预训练后在实测叠加上微调。消融关注训练配方：大 tile、全范围混合比例采样（相对固定比例最高提升 11 dB）、通道裁剪独立采样（BioSR 上 3.9 dB），以及骨干对推理速度的贡献。
AI.result: 在 5 个数据集、9 种混合比例共 15 个组合中，11 个取得最高 RI-PSNR（最高领先 3.0 dB）、另 1 个持平，推理速度比最强基线快 5.9 倍；在实测叠加图上微调后达到或超过所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 主要增益来自训练配方（大 tile、全范围混合比例采样、独立通道裁剪），状态空间骨干使大 tile 计算可负担，从而支持高通量筛选与事件驱动的智能显微成像。属于方法可迁移的领域应用型工作，非具身/3D 核心议题。

title: Latent Space Planning with Sequential Monte Carlo
summary: Planning with learned world models amounts to finding action sequences whose predicted rollouts reach a goal. Sampling-based planners often struggle at longer horizons, while gradient-based methods can become trapped in local minima. Meanwhile, model predictive path integral control (MPPI), a complementary approach, alternates between estimating an expectation under a cost-weighted distribution from samples and updating the plan from this estimate. Its samples, however, are drawn afresh at every iteration from a Gaussian proposal and reach the target distribution only through importance weights. Moreover, a target distribution favoring goal-reaching trajectories can be difficult to define directly, motivating a sequence of intermediate distributions. Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) provides a natural mechanism for evolving such a sequence through importance weighting and resampling. Motivated by this, we formulate latent-space planning as optimization guided by SMC, which moves a population of action sequences while a gradient-based optimizer updates the plan. Inspired by classical planning, we further introduce a PDE-derived cost-to-go that guides the evolution of the sample distribution using the structure of the latent state space. On navigation and manipulation tasks with visual and proprioceptive world models, our formulation outperforms gradient-based planners by $29$ and $50$, sampling-based planners by $35$ and MPPI by $7$ percentage points in average success rate, while succeeding in fewer iterations than gradient-based planners and within 4\% of MPPI.

AI.tldr: 将潜空间世界模型规划表述为以序贯蒙特卡洛(SMC)为引导的优化：用SMC的加权-重采样演化动作序列种群，同时用梯度优化器更新计划，并引入基于PDE推导的cost-to-go，在导航与操作任务上显著超越梯度法与采样法规划器。
AI.motivation: 采样规划器在长时域上表现差，梯度规划器易陷入局部极小；MPPI每轮从高斯提议重新采样、仅靠重要性权重逼近目标分布，且目标分布难以直接定义，因此需要一串中间分布来渐进过渡。
AI.method: 把潜空间规划写成SMC引导的优化：维护动作序列种群，迭代进行重要性加权与重采样，并行地由梯度优化器更新计划（plan）；并借鉴经典规划，提出由PDE推导的cost-to-go，利用潜状态空间的几何结构引导样本分布演化。
AI.result: 在视觉与本体感知世界模型的导航和操作任务上，平均成功率较梯度规划器分别高29和50个百分点、较采样规划器高35个百分点、较MPPI高7个百分点；迭代次数少于梯度规划器，且在MPPI的4%以内。
AI.conclusion: 将SMC与梯度优化结合并用PDE cost-to-go提供结构先验，是缓解世界模型长时域规划中局部极小与启发式样本问题的有效框架，且在样本效率上接近MPPI。

title: Forehead ROI Localization under Real-World Imaging Degradations via Cross-View Pseudo-Labeling
comment: 9 pages, submitted and accepted to the 2027 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision Workshops (WACVW)
summary: Forehead region-of-interest (ROI) localization is important for forehead-creases biometrics, particularly when the lower face is occluded. However, localization remains challenging under varying image quality, pose, and illumination. We propose Confidence and Consistency Guided Pseudo-Labeling (CCGP), which adapts Grounding DINO using unlabeled facial images filtered by detection confidence and geometric consistency between original and horizontally flipped views, without modifying the detector architecture or loss. We evaluate CCGP on five external datasets and 350 images spanning seven imaging conditions. CCGP achieves the highest mean intersection over union (mIoU) on four of five external datasets, improving from 0.415 to 0.580 on RMFRD compared with supervised Grounding DINO. On the quality-stratified subset, the largest gains occur under blur (0.487 to 0.719) and low contrast (0.615 to 0.710). CCGP also outperforms conventional self-training on RMFRD (0.580 versus 0.551 mIoU). Despite a slight in-domain performance gap (0.861 vs. 0.866 mIoU) and challenges with off-angle poses, CCGP improves cross-dataset localization under challenging imaging conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出置信度与一致性引导的伪标签方法（CCGP），在免改检测器结构的前提下用无标注人脸图像自适应 Grounding DINO，实现额头 ROI 定位的跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 额头 ROI 定位对下半脸遮挡情形下的额纹生物特征识别至关重要，但在图像质量、姿态、光照变化下极易失效；现有监督式检测器跨数据集迁移能力差。
AI.method: 教师-学生式自训练：以 Detection Confidence 过滤伪标签，并用原图与水平翻转视图之间的几何一致性做双重筛选，再用筛选后的伪标签微调 Grounding DINO；不改动检测器结构与损失函数。
AI.result: 在 5 个外部数据集和覆盖 7 种成像条件的 350 张图像上评估，5 个数据集中 4 个取得最高 mIoU；RMFRD 上由 0.415 提升至 0.580（监督 Grounding DINO 基线），优于常规自训练（0.551）；按质量分层时模糊（0.487→0.719）与低对比度（0.615→0.710）增益最大；域内性能略降（0.861 vs. 0.866），离轴姿态仍存困难。
AI.conclusion: 基于置信度+几何一致性的伪标签筛选可有效提升跨域、退化成像条件下的 ROI 定位鲁棒性，代价是少量域内性能损失；对极端姿态的改善有限。

title: SCATR-ITS: a scalable transformer for large-area individual tree segmentation from LiDAR point clouds
summary: Individual tree segmentation (ITS) from LiDAR point clouds is one of the most widely studied segmentation tasks in forestry. Although deep learning methods define the state of the art on the majority of ITS benchmarks, their high computational complexity and long runtime currently prevent their adoption in large-scale operational workflows. In this work, we present SCATR-ITS, a scalable transformer model specifically designed for efficient ITS over large geographical areas. Based on the ForestFormer3D framework, SCATR-ITS transitions to superpoint-level processing to accelerate inference, with the superpoints constructed from learned embeddings. The architecture incorporates size-aware superpoint-level postprocessing, a dynamic query count module to handle high variation in forest structure, and a maximal input stride designed to minimize prediction redundancy. SCATR-ITS achieves accuracy on par with the state of the art on the FGI-EMIT and FOR-InstanceV2 datasets with an up to 8.5$\times$ higher inference speed. In addition, SCATR-ITS has a significantly lower GPU VRAM footprint during both training and inference, and exhibits excellent zero-shot generalization across multiple datasets. To demonstrate large-area ITS capabilities, SCATR-ITS is applied to a 142 km$^2$ region of Finnish national laser scanning data where it achieves an average throughput of 13.8 min/km$^2$, $\sim$18.6$\times$ faster than ForestFormer3D and approaching the speed of the unsupervised watershed algorithm, which it vastly outperforms in accuracy and segment quality. Overall, SCATR-ITS delivers state-of-the-art accuracy at speeds where operational-scale adoption becomes viable, paving the way toward countrywide deployment. The source code for SCATR-ITS and pretrained weights are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SCATR-ITS 是基于 ForestFormer3D 的可扩展 Transformer 单木分割模型，改用由学习嵌入构建的超点级处理，并加入尺寸感知后处理、动态查询数与最大输入步幅设计，在保持 SOTA 精度的同时将推理速度提升至 8.5×，并在 142 km² 芬兰国家激光扫描数据上实现 13.8 min/km² 的大范围作业吞吐。
AI.motivation: 深度学习单木分割（ITS）虽在多数基准上达到 SOTA，但计算复杂度高、推理耗时长，难以进入大规模实际作业流程，因此需要兼顾精度与效率的可扩展方案。
AI.method: 在 ForestFormer3D 框架基础上转向超点级处理：超点由学习到的嵌入构建；引入尺寸感知的超点级后处理、动态查询计数模块以应对森林结构高变异性，以及最大化输入步幅以减少预测冗余。
AI.result: 在 FGI-EMIT 和 FOR-InstanceV2 上精度与 SOTA 持平，推理速度最高提升 8.5×；训练与推理 GPU 显存占用显著降低；多数据集零样本泛化良好；在 142 km² 芬兰国家级激光扫描数据上达 13.8 min/km²，较 ForestFormer3D 快约 18.6×，接近无监督分水岭算法的速度但精度与分割质量大幅领先。
AI.conclusion: SCATR-ITS 以 SOTA 精度实现了可实际部署的推理速度，为大范围乃至全国尺度的单木分割铺平道路，代码与预训练权重已开源。

title: Decomposing images in a PRISM: A Single-Source Multi-View Framework for Image Representation
summary: Multi-view learning has shown that combining complementary views can improve predictive performance, yet many datasets provide a single raw source of information. How can multiple useful views be constructed from one source? We propose PRISM (Plural Representations of Images via Structural Maps), a framework that transforms an image into representations with distinct inductive biases through explicit structural maps, together with a protocol for measuring what each view contributes. We evaluate PRISM-HD, a hand-designed instantiation of PRISM in which the constructed views are summarized through representation-specific descriptors, on three artistic and four non-artistic image datasets. Analyses at a fixed feature budget show that the gains of the structural views are not explained by feature dimensionality alone. PRISM-HD by itself outperforms WND-CHARM on all seven datasets. Moreover, PRISM-HD and Fisher Vector provide complementary predictive signals: their equal-weight combination improves over the better individual representation by 5--8 percentage points on the artistic datasets. When combined with fine-tuned deep networks through a fixed parameter-free fusion rule, the PRISM-based representation improves performance on four of seven datasets and leaves it statistically unchanged on the remaining three, indicating that the constructed views provide predictive signals that are complementary to learned deep representations.

title: SparseHPS: A Unified Model for Human Pose and Shape across Depth Cameras and LiDARs
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Recovering 3D human pose and shape from point clouds is central to motion capture, robotics and self-driving vehicles, because depth cameras and LiDARs sense a person directly in metric 3D and work under any lighting. However, current approaches are each tailored to one sensor type: point density differs by more than ten times between devices, public datasets are labeled with incompatible body models, and LiDAR approaches need long input sequences to offset sparse scans. In this work, we present SparseHPS, a novel sensor-agnostic network that recovers SMPL-X pose, shape and global translation from a human point cloud with one set of weights, for single frames and streams alike. Specifically, SparseHPS encodes the cloud with a LitePT backbone over sparse voxels, represents every joint by a learnable query decoded with one common head, localizes the body by voting over voxels, and draws temporal context from a causal memory of tokens from the seven preceding frames. A single model is trained on ten datasets that mix rendered clouds with real depth-camera and LiDAR captures, all converted to one body model. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art results on the SLOPER4D and FreeMotion LiDAR benchmarks, where SparseHPS lowers the root-relative joint error by 22% and 11%, respectively, compared with the strongest prior method, which needs 32 frames. On real Azure Kinect captures of held-out HuMMan subjects, SparseHPS attains a joint error of 34.7 mm. Moreover, the current frame alone already yields the bulk of this accuracy.

AI.tldr: SparseHPS：传感器无关的单套权重网络，从人体点云（单帧或流）恢复SMPL-X姿态、形状与全局平移，稀疏体素LitePT骨干+可学习关节查询+体素投票定位+7帧因果记忆，10个数据集统一训练，SLOPER4D/FreeMotion上根相对关节误差降22%/11%。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体姿态/形状恢复方法彼此绑定单一传感器：点密度跨设备差十倍以上，公开数据集标注的人体模型不一致，LiDAR方法需长序列弥补稀疏扫描。作者希望用一套权重同时适配深度相机与LiDAR、单帧与流式输入。
AI.method: 在稀疏体素上以LitePT骨干编码点云；用可学习query表示每个关节并通过共享解码头解码；通过对体素投票定位人体（全局平移）；从先前7帧token的因果记忆获取时序上下文；将10个数据集的渲染点云与真实深度相机/LiDAR采集统一转为同一人体模型后联合训练。
AI.result: SLOPER4D与FreeMotion LiDAR基准上达SOTA，根相对关节误差分别较需32帧的最强先前方法降低22%与11%；在未见HuMMan受试者的真实Azure Kinect采集上关节误差34.7 mm，且仅用当前帧即可获得大部分精度。
AI.conclusion: 该文实现了首个（文中声称）跨传感器、跨单帧/流的统一人体点云HPS模型，表明体素骨干+query解码+因果记忆的设计在稀疏LiDAR与深度相机下均有效，时序记忆带来增益但非必需。

title: INCISE: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation of Surgical Videos
summary: Surgical video analysis requires video object segmentation (VOS), yet existing methods are commonly based on pretrained model fine-tuning using a large number of expert labels. In-context segmentation (ICS) offers the promise of bypassing this high cost by segmenting a target video using a few annotated references, which are the sole source of surgical knowledge for a frozen model. However, existing ICS methods tend to draw such references at random, which concentrate on a few views that dominate a surgical video and can miss other objects of interest (e.g., transient instruments and small structures). To address these challenges, we propose INCISE, a training-free ICS framework for surgical videos. INCISE selects unlabeled frames from multiple surgical videos that jointly cover the local appearances of a target video, and then segments the target video using these references. With only 1.7% of training frames selected and annotated as references and no target video frame labeled, INCISE obtains 67.2% mean mIoU and outperforms the best SOTA fine-tuned method by 9.2 points. We hope INCISE can help establish ICS as a practical alternative to fine-tuning in surgical video analysis and other domains with a costly labeling burden.

AI.tldr: INCISE: 免训练的手术视频in-context分割框架，通过跨视频智能选取覆盖目标视频局部外观的参考帧，仅需1.7%训练帧标注即在手术视频VOS上达67.2% mIoU
AI.motivation: 手术视频VOS依赖大量专家标注做微调，成本极高；现有in-context分割（ICS）方法随机选取参考帧，导致参考集中于少数主导视角，遗漏瞬态器械与小结构等目标物体
AI.method: 免训练ICS框架INCISE：从多个手术视频中选取无标注帧，使其联合覆盖目标视频的局部外观（local appearance coverage），用少量已标注参考帧驱动冻结模型完成目标视频分割，目标视频帧零标注
AI.result: 仅用1.7%训练帧作参考、目标视频零标注条件下，获得67.2%平均mIoU，超越最佳SOTA微调方法9.2个点
AI.conclusion: 验证免训练in-context分割可实用地替代手术视频分析中的微调范式，并有望推广到其他标注负担沉重的领域

title: FORTH: Grounding Tactile VLA Execution via Forward-Only Proxy-Control Pairing
comment: The code and models are open-sourced at this https URL
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are widely credited with force control, operating on the unverified assumption that proxy loss minimization implies physical force grounding. In this work, we demonstrate that this assumption breaks down at three core deployment levels: frozen visual backbones discard contact geometry, downstream losses mask token-level gradient alignment, and discrete indicators trigger optimization collapse. To address these disconnections, we present FORTH, a forward-only measurement harness and execution framework that explicitly pairs the optimization objective at each level with its physical control observable. FORTH incorporates three grounded pillars: a layer-local, forward-only tactile encoder that preserves spatial contact geometry without backpropagation, a token-parallel zeroth-order adapter enabling activation-space updates, and SlipGuard, a continuous tactile verification gate that fires on incipient slip. On an elasto-plastic structural shell, FORTH's closed-loop gate peaks at 29 times lower grip force than a monotone reflex ramp, preventing structural crush where the baseline leaves permanent deformation. Furthermore, FORTH matches state-of-the-art execution performance with a 97.6% average success rate across three evaluated LIBERO suites, while reducing peak activation memory by 7.12 times compared to a backpropagated step on the same backbone. Enhanced perception enables deeper physical intelligence.

AI.tldr: FORTH是一个前向传播测量与执行框架，通过层级化物理可观测量对齐VLA优化目标：无反向传播的局部触觉编码器保留接触几何、token并行零阶适配器实现激活空间更新、SlipGuard连续触觉门控触发初期滑移。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略宣称具备力控制能力，但建立在一个未经证实的假设上：代理损失最小化即意味着物理力接地。作者指出该假设在三个部署层面失效——冻结视觉骨干丢弃接触几何、下游损失掩盖token级梯度对齐、离散指标导致优化崩溃。
AI.method: FORTH为纯前向测量与执行框架，三大支柱：(1) 层局部、仅前向的触觉编码器，无需反向传播即保留空间接触几何；(2) token并行零阶适配器，在激活空间直接更新参数；(3) SlipGuard，基于连续触觉信号的验证门控，在初期滑移时触发。每层优化目标与对应物理控制可观测量显式配对。
AI.result: 在弹塑性结构外壳任务上，闭环门控峰值夹持力比单调反射斜坡低29倍，避免基线造成的永久形变压溃；在三个LIBERO套件上平均成功率97.6%，达SOTA水平，同时峰值激活内存比同骨干反向传播步骤降低7.12倍。
AI.conclusion: 代理损失最小化并不等价于物理力接地，唯有将各层优化目标与物理可观测量显式对齐才能获得真正的物理智能；增强感知可带来更深的物理理解。

title: MomentMem: Memorizing Key Moments for Robot Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering visual information that is no longer observable, such as the original location of an object. Existing approaches typically rely on full observation histories, which become redundant over long horizons, or text summaries, which may omit precise visual details. We study visual moment memory, the ability to retain such details from key moments for subsequent manipulation. To support this study, we introduce VMBench, a suite of long-horizon manipulation tasks requiring memory of spatial locations, visual appearances, and their associations. We further propose MomentMem, a hierarchical architecture in which a VLM-based memorizer selects keyframes and an executor predicts actions conditioned on the selected memories. This separation enables us to evaluate memory selection alongside closed-loop task success and to study memorizer generalization independently of the executor. On VMBench, MomentMem achieves 49.9% average success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 31.7 percentage points. Moreover, we find that the memorizer transfers well to unseen appearances zero-shot. It can also adapt to an unseen task with only a few memory annotations, reaching 43.7% success, close to the 44.3% obtained with full memory supervision. Further experiments show competitive performance on RMBench and improvements in real-robot manipulation. These results highlight the value of retaining sparse visual evidence for memory-dependent manipulation. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出VMBench长程操作基准与MomentMem分层架构：VLM记忆器选取关键帧，执行器基于稀疏视觉记忆预测动作，在VMBench上平均成功率49.9%，超越最强基线31.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作常需回忆已不可观测的视觉信息（如物体原始位置）。现有方法依赖完整观测历史（长时序下冗余）或文本摘要（丢失精确视觉细节），缺乏对"视觉时刻记忆"的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建VMBench长程操作任务集，要求记忆空间位置、视觉外观及其关联；提出MomentMem分层架构，由基于VLM的记忆器选择关键帧，执行器以选定记忆为条件预测动作，从而可分别评估记忆选择质量与闭环任务成功率，并独立研究记忆器泛化性。
AI.result: VMBench上平均成功率49.9%，超最强基线31.7个百分点；记忆器零样本迁移至未见外观；仅用少量记忆标注即可适应新任务，达43.7%，接近全监督的44.3%；在RMBench上具竞争力，并在真机操作中取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 保留稀疏视觉证据对依赖记忆的操作任务具有显著价值；记忆选择与动作执行解耦的架构设计兼具性能与可分析性。

title: ConRef: Auditing Reference Reliability in 2D/3D Registration Benchmarks
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 1 table; includes 4 pages of supplementary material
summary: Purpose: Accurate 2D/3D registration is crucial for image-guided orthopedic interventions, enabling the alignment of preoperative 3D anatomy with intraoperative X-ray observations for surgical navigation. Public benchmarks have facilitated the development and evaluation of increasingly accurate registration methods. However, as registration errors approach the uncertainty of benchmark reference poses, measured performance may be limited by reference inaccuracies rather than algorithmic errors alone. Methods: We propose Consensus Reference (ConRef), a multi-view framework for auditing reference poses in existing X-ray/computed tomography (CT) registration benchmarks. By jointly exploiting multiple X-ray observations, ConRef estimates an additional reference pose, quantifies its uncertainty, and identifies potential X-ray outliers. We validate the framework using independent anatomical evidence and a newly acquired X-ray/cone-beam CT (CBCT) phantom dataset with bead-based reference poses. Results: On our BeadPhant dataset, ConRef differed from independent bead-based references by 0.08-0.12 mm, while discrepancies with original references reached 2.06 mm on the Femur dataset. It also flagged 22 DeepFluoro X-rays as potential outliers. On Femur F5, reference choice changed the submillimeter success conclusions of the same registrations. Conclusion: Our findings demonstrate that reference discrepancies can influence the evaluation of high-accuracy 2D/3D registration methods. By providing an additional, independently validated reference and identifying potential inconsistencies, ConRef enables systematic auditing of existing benchmarks and supports more reliable evaluation of registration error.

AI.tldr: 提出 ConRef 多视角一致性参考位姿审计框架，用于检验 X 光/CT 2D/3D 配准基准中参考位姿的可靠性，量化参考不确定度并识别异常 X 光片。
AI.motivation: 公开基准推动了 2D/3D 配准精度提升，但当配准误差接近参考位姿自身的不确定度时，评测结果可能被参考标注误差而非算法误差所限制，缺乏对参考位姿的系统性审计手段。
AI.method: ConRef 联合利用多张 X 光观测，额外估计一个独立的参考位姿并给出其不确定度，同时检测潜在的 X 光离群视图；用解剖学独立证据和新建的珠标（bead-based）X 光/CBCT 体模数据集 BeadPhant 验证。
AI.result: 在 BeadPhant 上，ConRef 与独立珠标参考仅差 0.08–0.12 mm；而 Femur 数据集上与原参考偏差达 2.06 mm；在 DeepFluoro 中标记出 22 张潜在离群 X 光片；Femur F5 上参考选择会改变同一批配准的亚毫米成功结论。
AI.conclusion: 参考位姿的差异足以影响高精度 2D/3D 配准方法的评测结论，ConRef 提供了可独立验证的附加参考与一致性标记，从而支持对现有基准进行系统审计与更可靠的误差评估。

title: Search-Informed MPPI for Kinodynamic Motion Planning via Monte Carlo Tree Expansion
comment: 24 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. Project page with videos: this https URL
summary: Kinodynamic motion planning in large-scale, cluttered environments remains challenging, as dynamically feasible, collision-free trajectories must be computed efficiently over long horizons. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) can strategically explore long-horizon alternatives but faces large branching factors in continuous control spaces and often relies on random default-policy rollouts, whereas Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) efficiently optimizes local trajectories yet remains susceptible to obstacle-induced local minima. To overcome these challenges, we propose Search-Informed MPPI (SI-MPPI), a unified framework that embeds MPPI trajectory optimization within MCTS-based tree search. The core concept is to fuse the expansion and default-policy simulation stages of MCTS into a single MPPI expansion stage guided by structured intermediate targets, termed baits. During each expansion, an adaptive bait-handling rule retains geometrically valid baits as local targets for GPU-batched MPPI optimizations that generate dynamically feasible candidate motion segments. Feasibility gating then checks these candidates for collision safety and sufficient progress, and top-$k$ selection admits the lowest-cost accepted candidates as tree edges, yielding sparse, directed tree growth; thereafter, effective sample size (ESS)-guided adaptation warm-starts subsequent expansions, while cost-based backpropagation updates tree statistics. Extensive simulations across four large-scale, cluttered 2D occupancy-grid maps demonstrate that SI-MPPI consistently produces the smallest search trees and smoothest angular control profiles compared with three kinodynamic baselines, while maintaining competitive planning times and path lengths. Ablation results further highlight the importance of GPU batching, adaptive bait handling, and retaining multiple expansion candidates for planning efficiency and robustness.

AI.tldr: SI-MPPI将MPPI轨迹优化嵌入MCTS搜索：把MCTS的扩展与默认策略仿真合并为单一MPPI扩展阶段，以结构化中间目标（baits）引导GPU批量MPPI生成动力学可行候选段，经可行性门控与top-k筛选形成稀疏有向树，并用ESS引导热启动与代价反向传播。
AI.motivation: 大规模杂乱环境中的动力学约束运动规划需在长时域上高效求解。MCTS能战略性探索长时域备选方案，但在连续控制空间中分支因子过大且依赖随机默认策略rollout；MPPI擅长局部轨迹优化但易陷入障碍物导致的局部极小。
AI.method: 统一框架：MPPI扩展替代MCTS的expansion+default-policy simulation；自适应bait处理规则保留几何有效bait作为局部目标；GPU批量MPPI生成动力学可行候选；可行性门控检查碰撞安全性与进度；top-k接受最低代价候选作为树边，形成稀疏有向树；ESS引导的热启动用于后续扩展；基于代价的反向传播更新树统计量。
AI.result: 在4个大规模杂乱2D占据栅格地图上与3个kinodynamic基线对比，SI-MPPI一致产生最小搜索树与最平滑角控制曲线，规划时间与路径长度具竞争力。消融显示GPU批处理、自适应bait处理和多候选保留对效率与鲁棒性重要。
AI.conclusion: 将MPPI局部优化与MCTS长时域搜索以bait为中介耦合，可显著压缩搜索树并改善控制平滑性，是采样式运动规划的一种有效混合范式；但验证限于2D仿真地图，尚缺真实机器人/高维系统实证。

title: TacHOI: Contact-Aware Object Reconstruction and Tracking for Egocentric Videos
summary: Egocentric videos offer a scalable source of human demonstrations for robot learning. However, recovering metric object geometry and motion from monocular video is hindered by scale-depth ambiguity and hand-induced occlusion, while image-derived contact and shape priors alone cannot uniquely determine metric scale. We introduce TacHOI, a training-free framework that integrates tactile contact with monocular vision for joint hand-object reconstruction and tracking, without requiring object templates or depth sensors. Starting from pretrained visual estimates, TacHOI uses tactile contact to constrain object depth relative to the estimated hand, while spatially separated contacts on a metrically calibrated hand provide a physical ruler for object extent. It incorporates these constraints into a joint optimization of hand poses, object trajectories, and anisotropic object scale alongside visual alignment. Across 100 ARCTIC and HO3D sequences with synthesized tactile observations, TacHOI achieves the lowest median ADD-S* among the evaluated baselines, reducing error from 15.6 to 3.6 cm on ARCTIC and achieving 2.8 cm on HO3D. Additional experiments on OpenTouch demonstrate its applicability to measured tactile observations.

AI.tldr: TacHOI: 无训练的触觉+单目视觉联合优化框架，重建并追踪手-物体姿态与各向异性尺度，无需物体模板或深度传感器。
AI.motivation: 自视角视频是机器人学习的可扩展人类演示来源，但单目恢复度量几何受尺度-深度歧义和手部遮挡阻碍；仅靠图像先验（接触、形状）无法唯一确定米制尺度。
AI.method: 在预训练视觉估计基础上，用触觉接触约束物体相对手部的深度；利用经度量标定的手部上空间分离的接触点作为"物理标尺"确定物体尺寸；将这些约束与视觉对齐共同纳入手姿、物体轨迹、各向异性尺度的联合优化。
AI.result: 在100个ARCTIC与HO3D序列（合成触觉）上取得最低中位ADD-S*，ARCTIC误差由15.6cm降至3.6cm，HO3D为2.8cm；OpenTouch实测触觉实验亦验证适用性。
AI.conclusion: 触觉接触可有效消解单目尺度歧义，无需模板/深度传感器即可实现度量级手-物体重建与追踪。

title: FACET: A Data-Efficient Regional Parametric Head Model
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications (SA Technical Communications '26)
summary: Production face pipelines need parametric head models that are expressive, FACS-controllable, and buildable on a small, fixed pool of identities. More training identities would always help, but high-quality registered head scans are expensive to capture; when scaling the data is not an option, the remaining lever is architecture. We present FACET, a parametric head model that makes the most of a fixed identity pool through architectural locality rather than more scans, and makes three contributions, each isolated against a matched global-PCA ablation on our own topology, training set, and normalization. (1) A regional identity decomposition into 16 anatomical regions bypasses the N-1 rank ceiling of a global PCA, driving held-out neutral-fit error from a 1.95 mm floor down to 0.23 mm on the same training identities. (2) A learned FACS action-unit expression model with per-identity neural personalization not only stays FACS-controllable but beats a properly-regularized global expression PCA at every component count -- refuting the argument that FACS is too overcomplete to fit. (3) A dedicated neck/shoulder region reduces pose leakage into the pose-invariant upper face during unposing. Together, these show that architectural locality is the effective lever for a production head model under a fixed identity budget.

AI.tldr: FACET提出一种参数化头部模型，在固定身份池下通过“架构局部性”而非扩充数据提升表达力：16区解剖分区身份分解、带逐身份神经个性化的可学习FACS AU表情模型、独立颈肩区域，均相对匹配的全局PCA消融验证。
AI.motivation: 生产级面部管线需要可FACS驱动、可在小规模固定身份集上构建的参数化头部模型；高质量配准头扫昂贵、扩容不现实，因此把优化杠杆放在架构设计上。
AI.method: 在与自身拓扑、训练集、归一化匹配的全局PCA消融对照下做三项隔离贡献：(1)将身份空间分解为16个解剖区域，突破全局PCA的N-1秩上限；(2)可学习FACS动作单元表情模型，配逐身份神经个性化；(3)独立颈部/肩部区域，抑制去姿态时姿态泄漏到姿态不变的上半脸。
AI.result: 同一训练身份下，留出中性拟合误差由全局PCA的1.95 mm下限降至0.23 mm；FACS表达模型在每个成分数上均优于正则化良好的全局表情PCA；颈肩分区减少上半脸姿态泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 在固定身份预算下，架构局部性是生产级头部模型的有效杠杆，可在不增加扫描数据的情况下同时获得高精度拟合、FACS可控性与去姿态鲁棒性。

title: What Helps Language-Model Agents Review Violent Video? A Controlled Comparison with a Human Evidence Reference
comment: 17 pages, 1 figure, 12 tables. Code: this https URL ; project page: this https URL
summary: Systems that flag violent video for a human operator can now be built from language models without training, by combining perception models and letting a language model decide. We ask how the observations of the perception models should reach the decision, and which evidence matters. On the XD-Violence test set (799 clips) we fix one set of perception agents (video description, object detection, sound tagging, speech recognition and speech tagging) and one reasoning model, and compare three interfaces: messages between agents, a typed evidence graph explored with tools, and flat text read in one pass; and a single audio-visual model given the raw clip. Two annotators provide a human reference that records the decision, the incident segments and whether they relied on sight, sound or speech. Flat text matches the single model (F1 0.967 against 0.968), while the graph agent and message passing are less accurate; a variant of the graph agent developed on a separate set did not close the gap, and both graph summaries and multi-turn tool use lowered accuracy. These results hold with reworded prompts and with a larger reasoning model, except that the larger model weakens message passing enough for the graph agent to beat it. Sound events improve F1 by +0.012 [+0.004, +0.021], in line with the annotators, who used sound or speech on most violent clips. Citations of stored observations are faithful, changing about half of the decisions when removed, but no more so with the graph than with flat text, and the agent pipeline costs about 3 times the GPU time of the single model. We also report two artefacts of vision-language describers that mislead pipelines built on them.

AI.tldr: 该论文在XD-Violence上固定感知代理与推理模型，比较消息传递、类型化证据图与扁平文本三种接口以及单一音视频模型，发现扁平文本与单模型性能相当，结构化接口反而更差。
AI.motivation: 用免训练的语言模型编排多个感知模型构建暴力视频检测系统已成可能，但尚不清楚感知观测应以何种形式传递给决策模型，以及哪些证据真正影响判断。
AI.method: 在XD-Violence测试集（799片段）上固定五个感知代理（视频描述、目标检测、声音标签、语音识别、语音标注）与一个推理模型，对比三种接口：代理间消息传递、工具探索的类型化证据图、单次读取的扁平文本；并与直接输入原始片段的单一音视频模型对比。另设两名标注者提供人类参照，记录决策、事件片段及依据模态（视觉/声音/语音）。做了改写提示、更大推理模型、消融声音事件与移除引用观测等实验。
AI.result: 扁平文本与单模型持平（F1 0.967 vs 0.968），证据图代理与消息传递均更差；在另一集合上开发的图代理变体未缩小差距，图摘要与多轮工具调用均降低精度。改写提示与大推理模型下结论基本成立，仅大模型使消息传递弱化到低于图代理。声音事件带来+0.012[+0.004,+0.021]的F1提升，与标注者多数依赖声音或语音一致。引用观测忠实（移除后约半数决策翻转），但图接口并不优于扁平文本；代理流水线GPU耗时约为单模型的3倍。另报告了视觉语言描述器的两类误导性伪影。
AI.conclusion: 结构化证据组织（图、多轮工具调用）并未带来收益，简单的一次性文本上下文已是强基线；多模态代理流水线应以单模型加扁平文本为对照，并警惕描述器伪影与约3倍的推理成本。

title: Tracktail: Multi-View 3D Point Tracking without Depth Input
summary: We introduce Tracktail, a novel architecture designed to efficiently track query points in 3D from multiple calibrated views without any depth input. Our architecture separates the task as a per-camera video encoding of features and a per-query decoder. Notably, camera cross-attention is only performed across queries in the decoder, allowing for efficient inference (7 FPS and less than 4 GB memory for 10 views and 100 query points). We further introduce a per-camera scene scale computed from camera geometry, which allows us to normalize inputs and predictions appropriately across a vast variety of dataset scales. We train on a synthetic Multi-View Kubric dataset as well as a novel Multi-View Point Odyssey benchmark dataset, which consists of synthetic renders of humans and animals across 499 frames. Tracktail achieves state-of-the-art results on the Panoptic Studio, DexYCB, and Multi-View Kubric benchmarks, outperforming methods that rely on estimated depth. Tracktail also demonstrates a strong ability to maintain accurate tracking over longer ranges compared to existing methods. Our code, data, and weights are publicly available: this https URL

AI.tldr: Tracktail: 无需深度输入的多视角3D查询点跟踪架构，将任务分解为逐相机视频特征编码与逐查询解码器，仅在解码器中跨查询做相机交叉注意力，并提出基于相机几何的逐相机场景尺度归一化，在Panoptic Studio、DexYCB、Multi-View Kubric上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多视角点跟踪方法依赖估计深度，效率低且跨数据集尺度泛化差；作者希望在无深度输入条件下高效、长时程地跟踪3D查询点。
AI.method: 架构解耦为逐相机视频特征编码器 + 逐查询解码器，相机交叉注意力仅在解码器内跨查询进行以降低推理成本（10视图100查询点约7 FPS、<4GB显存）；引入由相机几何计算的逐相机场景尺度，用于输入与预测的归一化。训练使用合成Multi-View Kubric数据集及新提出的Multi-View Point Odyssey基准（499帧人体与动物合成渲染）。
AI.result: 在Panoptic Studio、DexYCB、Multi-View Kubric上达到SOTA，超过依赖估计深度的方法；长时程跟踪精度保持优于现有方法；代码、数据与权重已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明无需深度输入的多视角架构即可高效准确地完成3D点跟踪，并对数据集尺度具备良好泛化能力，可作为机器人操作与场景理解中的点级跟踪基础组件。

title: CADENCE:Temporally Coherent Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery that Preserves Expressive Hand Motion
summary: Whole-body SMPL-X estimators recover body, hand, and face meshes from single images, but applied frame by frame to video they produce jittery motion. Smoothing the output removes the jitter at a cost that body-only benchmarks do not measure: a temporal filter strong enough to steady the torso also flattens the fast finger strokes that carry meaning in sign language and gesture. We present CADENCE, a whole-body SMPL-X system for monocular video designed around this trade-off. A per-frame estimator built on a shared C-RADIOv4 encoder, with a high-resolution hand pathway that reuses the same encoder on hand crops, produces each frame's estimate. An offline temporal refiner then filters the SMPL-X rotation sequence: attention along the kinematic tree selects, for every joint and every frame, a mixture of learned zero-phase filters, so the torso is smoothed while fast finger strokes pass through. On 3DPW, the refiner reduces acceleration error from 17.4 to 5.4 mm/s2 while lowering PA-MPJPE from 41.9 to 40.2 mm; generic smoothers applied to the same predictions reach 6.2 to 7.7 mm/s2. On SignAvatars/How2Sign sign-language sequences, the refiner has the lowest hand jitter among the compared smoothers while keeping a hand-speed peak amplitude of 0.98, against 0.35 for a SmoothNet retrained on the full SMPL-X vector. The per-frame estimator also obtains the lowest full-body mesh error (25.7 mm) and hand joint error (8.3 mm) among the compared methods on EHF.

AI.tldr: CADENCE：单目视频全身SMPL-X重建系统，共享C-RADIOv4编码器的逐帧估计器+高分辨率手部通路，配合基于运动树注意力的零相位滤波器混合离线时序精化，在平滑躯干的同时保留快速手指动作。
AI.motivation: 逐帧全身SMPL-X估计器用于视频时产生抖动；强时序平滑虽能稳住躯干，却会抹平手语/手势中承载语义的快速手指笔画，而仅身体基准无法衡量这一代价。
AI.method: 逐帧估计器：共享C-RADIOv4编码器，并用手部裁剪图复用同一编码器构建高分辨率手部通路。离线时序精化器：沿运动学树做注意力，为每个关节、每帧选取一组学习得到的零相位滤波器的混合权重，实现关节自适应的平滑强度。
AI.result: 3DPW上加速度误差17.4→5.4 mm/s²，PA-MPJPE 41.9→40.2 mm（通用平滑器为6.2–7.7 mm/s²）；SignAvatars/How2Sign上手部抖动最低，手速峰值幅度0.98，对比SmoothNet（全身向量重训）仅0.35；EHF上全身网格误差25.7 mm、手关节误差8.3 mm，均为最优。
AI.conclusion: 关节级自适应零相位滤波混合可有效解耦"躯干平滑"与"手指动作保真"的矛盾，表明时序后处理需以细粒度关节结构为条件而非全身统一滤波。

title: Spatial Query Execution as Verifiable Rewards for Multi-step Spatial Reasoning
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) remain unreliable on spatial reasoning problems that require composing grounded relations across multiple objects. Yet, scaling reasoning supervision is challenging since human-annotated visual datasets often rely on fixed relational annotations and coarse object localization, making it difficult to obtain precise intermediate reasoning states across diverse spatial configurations and complexities. We introduce FARON (Fully Automated Reasoning Over spatial relatioNs), a framework that executes spatial queries to provide both execution-grounded reasoning supervision and verifiable outcome rewards. Rather than relying on existing annotated data, FARON constructs synthetic 2D and 3D scenes with explicit geometries, enabling configurable object arrangements, spatial relations, and multi-step compositions. Deterministic query execution yields intermediate sets and final answers, providing precise supervision without manual relation annotation. Our pipeline converts intermediate states into natural-language reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while the execution-derived answers provide verifiable rewards for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Controlled experiments show that trace-based SFT improves multi-step spatial reasoning over final-answer supervision and that subsequent group relative policy optimization (GRPO) provides further gains. The resulting models also demonstrate transfer across external spatial reasoning benchmarks and multiple LVLM backbones without benchmark-specific fine-tuning. These results show the potential of using spatial query execution as a unified, flexible source of reasoning supervision and verifiable outcome rewards for multimodal spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: FARON 提出用"空间查询执行"自动生成多步空间推理监督：在显式几何的合成2D/3D场景中确定性执行空间查询，将中间状态转为自然语言推理链用于SFT，并用执行答案作为RLVR的可验证奖励。
AI.motivation: LVLM在多物体、需组合接地关系的空间推理上仍不可靠，而扩展推理监督受限于人工标注数据的固定关系标注与粗糙目标定位，难以获得精确的中间推理状态。
AI.method: 构建具备显式几何的合成2D/3D场景，可配置物体布局、空间关系与多步组合；确定性查询执行产出中间结果集合与最终答案；中间状态转写为自然语言推理轨迹用于SFT，执行答案用于GRPO式RLVR训练。
AI.result: 受控实验显示基于推理轨迹的SFT优于仅用最终答案监督，后续GRPO继续带来增益；模型可零额外微调迁移到外部空间推理基准与多种LVLM主干。
AI.conclusion: 空间查询执行可作为统一、可扩展的推理监督与可验证奖励来源，用于多模态空间推理训练；主要贡献在数据/训练范式层面而非机器人系统。

title: Memorization and Generalization in Generative Models: A Perspective From Energy-based Modeling and Associative Memory
comment: A thesis that discusses the coexistence of memorization and generalization in generative models
summary: Generative models now write working code, produce realistic images, and hold long conversations, yet the mechanisms behind their intelligence still evade our understanding. This thesis explores that puzzle through Associative Memory (AM), in which patterns are stored as energy minima and retrieved through attractor dynamics. Beyond their capacity, AMs form new minima known as spurious states, long regarded as a failure of memory. We argue that this failure is where creativity begins, and that memorization and generalization can coexist as outcomes of one retrieval process. First, we show that diffusion models behave as AMs. With little data, a diffusion model forms a distinct basin of attraction around each training sample. As the data grows, these basins shrink, and spurious states emerge as attractors that blend stored samples yet match none of them. They are the first signs of generative capability. We characterize this transition by measuring the volume, energy, and curvature of these basins across datasets and architectures, including Stable Diffusion. We then turn to language and move beyond the energy-based view of AM. We show that uniform-state discrete diffusion models are AMs capable of retrieving unseen data, with basins of attraction that arise from conditional likelihood maximization alone. As the training set grows, basins around training examples contract while basins around unseen examples expand, until corrupted test sentences are recovered as reliably as training ones. Conditional entropy exposes this coexistence within a single sequence and cheaply diagnoses where a model lies along the transition. Together, these results suggest that AM is a general principle defined by basins of attraction, and that memorization and generalization can coexist within one model. AM thus offers a framework for asking when a generative model recalls and when it creates.

AI.tldr: 该论文（学位论文）将联想记忆（AM）作为统一框架，论证生成模型的记忆与泛化共存于同一检索过程：扩散模型在数据稀少时围绕每个训练样本形成吸引域，数据增多后吸引域收缩并涌现混合样本的"伪态"，即生成能力的起点；语言侧则证明均匀态离散扩散模型仅凭条件似然最大化即可形成可检索未见数据的吸引域，并用条件熵廉价诊断模型所处阶段。
AI.motivation: 生成模型能写代码、生成逼真图像、长时间对话，但其智能机制仍不清楚；同时联想记忆中的"伪态"长期被视为记忆失败。作者希望把"失败"重新解释为创造力起点，并解释记忆与泛化如何在同一机制下共存。
AI.method: 以能量极小值与吸引子动力学刻画AM。第一部分：分析扩散模型的吸引域结构，跨数据集与架构（含Stable Diffusion）测量吸引域的体量、能量与曲率，刻画从样本专属盆地到伪态涌现的相变。第二部分：在语言域放弃能量视角，证明均匀态离散扩散模型是能检索未见数据的AM，其吸引域仅由条件似然最大化产生；引入条件熵作为单序列层面的诊断指标。
AI.result: 观测到随训练集增大，训练样本周围吸引域收缩、未见样本周围吸引域扩张，直到被损坏的测试句子可像训练句一样被可靠恢复；伪态作为混合存储样本却不对应任何样本的吸引子，是生成能力的首个信号；条件熵能低成本定位模型处于记忆—泛化过渡中的位置。
AI.conclusion: AM是一个以吸引域为定义的一般原则，记忆与泛化可在单一模型中并存；该框架为判断生成模型何时"回忆"、何时"创造"提供理论工具。

title: Acoustic Markers of Engagement in Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder and Their Caregivers
comment: Preprints allowed for IEEE paper submissions under review
summary: Characterizing user engagement is essential for developing effective human-computer interaction (HCI) applications, particularly for children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Because home-based HCI naturally involves caregivers as conversational facilitators, analyzing both child and caregiver vocalizations can provide critical insights into characterizing interaction dynamics. Using a dataset of home-based socially assistive robot (SAR) interventions, this work demonstrates how child and caregiver vocalization patterns can model engagement in HCI contexts. We employed linear mixed-effects models (LMMs) with child and caregiver acoustic data to identify acoustic features that significantly differentiated engagement from disengagement. The results demonstrated that children and caregivers share three significant acoustic markers of engagement: mean Alpha Ratio (AlphaRatio), mean Harmonics-to-Noise Ratio (HNR), and mean Spectral Slope 500-1500 (SlopeV500-1500). This reflects cleaner and smoother vocalizations during engagement across both groups. Furthermore, we evaluated a State x Group interaction model to compare the magnitudes of standardized state-dependent differences between children and caregivers. The results indicated that children exhibit significantly greater state-related variation than caregivers in three acoustic features: AlphaRatio, HNR, and SlopeV500-1500.

AI.tldr: 利用家庭社交辅助机器人干预数据集，通过线性混合效应模型分析儿童（ASD）与照护者的声学特征，发现二者共享Alpha Ratio、HNR、Spectrum Slope 500-1500三个参与度标记，且儿童的状态相关变化幅度显著更大。
AI.motivation: 家庭场景下的HCI干预中，照护者充当对话促进者，因此需要同时刻画儿童与照护者的发声模式来建模参与度，但现有工作多只关注单一侧。
AI.method: 基于家庭SAR干预数据集的儿童与照护者声学特征，构建线性混合效应模型（LMM）区分参与/非参与状态；进一步用State×Group交互模型比较两组标准化状态差异的幅度。
AI.result: AlphaRatio、HNR、SlopeV500-1500在两组均为显著参与度标记，提示参与时发声更清晰平滑；交互模型显示儿童在上述三项特征上的状态相关变化显著大于照护者。
AI.conclusion: 声学特征可作为HCI中参与度的可解释代理指标，双人（儿童+照护者）声学模式有助于刻画家庭干预的交互动态，并为自适应SAR行为设计提供依据。

title: Skill-JEPA: Learning Planner-Aligned Action Spaces for World Models
summary: World models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn from pixels to predict the outcome of actions in a latent space. To reach a goal, a planner samples many candidate action sequences, uses the model to predict where each one leads, and executes the best one. However, standard planners draw their candidates from a Gaussian, while the model has only seen the structured, state-dependent actions of its training data. Its predictions for such candidates are unreliable, and planning fails more often as goals move farther away. We propose Skill-JEPA, which learns an action space aligned with the planner. A variational autoencoder conditioned on the current state encodes short action sequences into latent skills with a standard Gaussian prior, and decodes them back into actions. The world model predicts the effect of skills rather than raw actions, and the planner searches over skills starting from that same Gaussian, so its candidates resemble the model's training data. Skill-JEPA adds a single module, trained end-to-end with the world model, and leaves the planner untouched, with no subgoals, hierarchy, or hand-designed skills. Across three JEPA world models and four benchmarks, average success on goals 80 steps away rises from 42% with raw actions to 62%; the gains grow with goal distance and hold across four planners. On AntMaze, a quadruped locomotion task, success on goals two maze cells away rises from 0.4% to 38%. This suggests that part of the difficulty of reaching distant goals lies in the action space, and can be removed without changing the planner.

AI.tldr: Skill-JEPA learns a planner-aligned latent skill space (state-conditioned VAE) so JEPA world models predict skill effects and planners search over skills from a Gaussian prior, raising long-horizon goal success from 42% to 62% average and 0.4%→38% on AntMaze.
AI.motivation: JEPA world models are trained on structured, state-dependent actions, yet standard planners sample candidate action sequences from an isotropic Gaussian, producing out-of-distribution candidates whose predicted outcomes are unreliable; planning degrades as goal distance grows.
AI.method: Add a single module: a state-conditioned VAE that encodes short action sequences into latent skills with a standard Gaussian prior and decodes skills back to actions. The world model is retrained (end-to-end with the VAE) to predict skill outcomes instead of raw actions, and the planner searches over skills sampled from the same Gaussian prior, leaving the planner itself unchanged—no subgoals, hierarchy, or hand-designed skills.
AI.result: Across 3 JEPA world models and 4 benchmarks, average success on goals 80 steps away rises from 42% to 62%, with gains increasing with goal distance and consistent across 4 planners; on AntMaze, success on goals two cells away rises from 0.4% to 38%.
AI.conclusion: Part of the difficulty of long-horizon goal reaching stems from a mismatch between the planner's sampling distribution and the world model's action training distribution; aligning the action space resolves much of it without modifying the planner, suggesting action-space design as a cheap, general lever for JEPA-based model-based control.

title: 3D Open-Vocabulary Detection via Visual Alignment and Generative Captions
comment: Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection remains a significant challenge for outdoor scenes, with existing methods often struggling to effectively transfer the rich semantic knowledge from powerful 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into a 3D context. We propose a novel, two-part framework for this task. First, we introduce a direct, object-level distillation method. We generate class-agnostic 3D proposals to source regions from the entire scene, without relying on any manual labels. We leverage a spatially-aware VLM to extract a semantic embedding from each proposal's projected 2D bounding box and supervise our 3D model to predict this embedding on a per-instance basis. Second, to enhance zero-shot capability and inject domain-specific information, we employ a powerful Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as an image captioner to generate rich textual captions for each of these proposals. These captions are integrated into the training objective to directly align the 3D features with these rich semantics, creating a composite loss that combines direct feature distillation with caption-based semantic enrichment. Our experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, establishing a new state of the art in 3D open-vocabulary detection on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段开放词汇3D检测框架：一是无标注、类无关3D提案上的对象级直接蒸馏，用空间感知VLM对投影2D框提取语义嵌入并按实例监督3D特征预测；二是用MLLM为提案生成文本描述，将3D特征与精细语义对齐，形成"特征蒸馏+描述监督"的复合损失。在Waymo和nuScenes上取得开放词汇3D检测SOTA。
AI.motivation: 室外场景开放词汇3D检测中，2D视觉语言模型（VLM）的丰富语义知识难以有效迁移到3D空间；同时需要注入领域特定信息以增强零样本能力。
AI.method: 1) 生成类无关3D提案（无需人工标签）覆盖全场景；2) 空间感知VLM对每个提案的投影2D框提取对象级语义嵌入，监督3D模型逐实例回归该嵌入（直接特征蒸馏）；3) MLLM作为图像描述器为提案生成文本caption，将3D特征与文本语义直接对齐；4) 组合特征蒸馏损失与caption语义增强损失为复合训练目标。
AI.result: 实验验证了方法有效性，在Waymo Open Dataset与nuScenes上达到开放词汇3D检测的新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 对象级VLM蒸馏结合MLLM caption语义对齐，可在无需人工标签的设定下有效将2D语义迁移至3D，显著提升室外开放词汇3D检测性能。

title: Scoliosis5K: Multimodal Gait Analysis via Clip-Conditioned RGB-Silhouette Fusion
comment: 11 pages (8-page main paper and 3-page supplementary material), 3 figures, 12 tables
summary: Color walking video records body boundary motion alongside clothing folds, surface appearance, and recording-environment cues. To examine what an explicit binary silhouette contributes to participant-level classification of scoliosis-related gait when a classifier already observes the paired color sequence, we construct Scoliosis5K, a multi-site collection of 4,998 corridor-walking sequences across 3,010 participant identifiers in which RGB person crops, binary silhouettes, and two-dimensional poses share each recording identifier and frame index. Our architecture uses each patch's pixel deviation from its clip mean to weight two low-rank query and value updates inside a pretrained RGB encoder, fusing the resulting video representation with a silhouette transformer sequence and regional kernel ridge scores extracted from one native-resolution RGB frame per window. Across 988 participants in five participant-disjoint cross-validation folds and three training seeds, the complete system reaches 83.77% accuracy and 79.91% macro-averaged F1, compared with 83.27% accuracy and 79.56% macro-F1 when the video RGB encoder remains frozen under identical inputs. Zeroing the silhouette vector at fixed weights shifts overall accuracy by only 0.10 percentage points while raising positive-category recall from 68.52% to 77.78% and lowering recall for both remaining categories. Macro-averaged AUROC is 0.950 across the cohort and 0.879 among participant pairs matched on acquisition site and recording-count group.

AI.tldr: 构建Scoliosis5K多站点步态数据集（4,998序列/3,010人，RGB裁剪+二值轮廓+2D姿态对齐），提出以patch相对片段均值的像素偏差调制预训练RGB编码器低秩Q/V更新的视频分类方法，并与轮廓Transformer及区域核岭回归分数融合；5折跨受试者验证达83.77%准确率、79.91%宏F1、宏AUROC 0.950。
AI.motivation: 探究在分类器已观察配对彩色视频序列的条件下，显式二值轮廓对脊柱侧弯相关步态受试者级分类的增量贡献；同时弥补现有数据缺少RGB/轮廓/姿态在同一录制标识与帧索引下对齐的多站点步态资源。
AI.method: Scoliosis5K数据集构建（RGB人裁剪、二值轮廓、2D姿态共享录制ID与帧索引）；在预训练RGB编码器内，用每个patch相对clip均值的像素偏差加权两组低秩query/value增量更新；所得视频表征与轮廓Transformer序列、以及每个窗口一帧原生分辨率RGB上提取的区域核岭回归分数融合；以冻结RGB编码器作对照，并以置零轮廓向量作消融。
AI.result: 在988名受试者、5个受试者不相交折、3个随机种子下，完整系统准确率83.77%、宏F1 79.91%；冻结视频RGB编码器为83.27%/79.56%。固定权重下将轮廓向量置零，总体准确率仅变化0.10个百分点，但阳性类召回由68.52%升至77.78%，其余两类召回下降。宏AUROC全集0.950，按采集站点与录制次数分组匹配的受试者对间为0.879。
AI.conclusion: 在强RGB视频基线之上，二值轮廓带来的总体增益有限且主要体现在类别召回再分配而非精度提升，说明轮廓的边际信息价值依赖于融合权重与类别平衡策略；方法层面的可迁移启示是对低秩适配施加由前景/运动偏差导出的空间加权，而非直接拼接轮廓通道。

title: LoCo-WAM: Test-Time Training as Long Context for World-Action Models
summary: World-action models guide robot actions by predicting what happens next, but typically condition on a short observation history. Extending this history increases computation at every decision and can require a separately trained model. We introduce LoCo-WAM, which learns from the outcomes of its actions through test-time training while keeping the same short history length. It uses newly observed frames to update a low-rank adapter in the video expert, whose adapted predictions guide subsequent actions. The updates accumulate within each episode and are reset between episodes, allowing past observations to influence decisions after they leave the input window. LoCo-WAM thus learns from a longer stream of experience without expert action labels, additional data or meta-training. Experiments on two world-action models show improved task success across four simulation benchmarks. On RoboCasa GR-1, a model with 2.4,s of history matches one trained with 9.6,s, while a model with 4.8,s exceeds it by 4.8 percentage points. Our analysis shows that the updates improve prediction of upcoming frames, affect the action mainly through adaptation of the imagined future, and have an increasing effect on actions as the episode unfolds.

AI.tldr: LoCo-WAM 用测试时训练(TTT)在推理阶段用新观测帧更新视频专家中的低秩适配器，使世界-动作模型在保持短历史输入的前提下利用更长经验流，无需动作标签或额外数据。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型通常只条件于短观测历史；延长历史会增加每步计算开销，且往往需要单独训练模型。目标是让模型在不扩大输入窗口、不增加训练数据的情况下，从更长经验流中受益。
AI.method: 在每个 episode 内，用新观测到的帧对视频专家中的低秩适配器（LoRA 式）做测试时更新；更新在 episode 内累积、episode 间重置，使已离开输入窗口的过去观测仍能影响决策；适配后的预测用于引导后续动作；直接用动作后预测帧与真实观测的一致性作为自监督信号，无需专家动作标签或元训练。
AI.result: 在两种世界-动作模型、四个仿真基准上任务成功率提升。RoboCasa GR-1 上，2.4s 历史的模型追平 9.6s 历史训练模型；4.8s 历史模型超出后者 4.8 个百分点。分析表明更新改善了未来帧预测，动作改变主要经由“想象未来”的适配实现，且对动作的影响随 episode 推进而增大。
AI.conclusion: 推理时低秩适配可作为“记忆扩展”的轻量替代方案，让世界-动作模型低成本地利用长程经验；验证限于仿真，缺乏真机部署与效率/稳定性（漂移、累积误差）的充分度量化。

title: Coherent Moment Propagation: Epistemic Uncertainty for Pre-trained Robot Policies
summary: Flow matching policies underpin the state-of-the-art in robot learning, with impressive results ranging from long-horizon planning to dexterous manipulation. However, they provide no measure of whether their predicted commands can be trusted, particularly in novel situations outside their training set. Epistemic uncertainty reflects uncertainty about the model's weights and quantifies this ignorance, but calculating it at inference time from a flow matching policy is not trivial. Actions are produced by an ODE solver, requiring uncertainty to be propagated through the entire integration process. BayesDiff addresses this problem for diffusion models by propagating the mean and variance of the state through the denoising chain under a last-layer Laplace posterior approximation, but it severely underestimates the epistemic uncertainty. In this paper we: i) prove that, for flow matching and diffusion ODEs, BayesDiff's total variance decays at rate $O(1/T)$ as the number of Euler steps $T$ used by the solver increases; ii) introduce Coherent Moment Propagation (CoMP), two recursions inspired by the extended and unscented Kalman filters that fix this problem by carrying the cross-covariance between state and weights; and iii) widen the last-layer posterior with observation embeddings the policy already computes, improving uncertainty estimates without retraining for CoMP and several test-time estimators alike. We demonstrate these benefits on three manipulation benchmarks with applications in failure detection and demonstration selection for fine-tuning, where CoMP corrects BayesDiff's variance collapse while matching or outperforming several uncertainty estimators.

AI.tldr: 本文指出 BayesDiff 在 flow matching / diffusion ODE 下会严重低估认知不确定性，证明其总方差随 Euler 步数 T 以 O(1/T) 衰减；提出 Coherent Moment Propagation (CoMP)，借鉴扩展与无迹卡尔曼滤波的两条递推，携带状态-权重交叉协方差以正确传播不确定性；并用策略已有的观测嵌入扩展末层后验。
AI.motivation: Flow matching 策略在机器人学习（长程规划、灵巧操作）中达到 SOTA，但不提供预测动作的可信度度量，尤其在训练分布外的新情境。基于权重的认知不确定性可量化这种"无知"，然而动作由 ODE 求解器积分产生，需将不确定性传播穿过整个积分过程。现有 BayesDiff 虽将此问题化为去噪链上的均值-方差传播，但严重低估认知不确定性（方差坍塌），需要理论诊断与修正。
AI.method: (i) 理论分析：证明对 flow matching 与 diffusion ODE，BayesDiff 的总方差随 Euler 步数 T 以 O(1/T) 速率衰减；(ii) 提出 CoMP（Coherent Moment Propagation），两条受扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）与无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）启发的递推，显式携带状态与权重的交叉协方差，从而在积分过程中保持方差不坍塌；(iii) 用策略已计算的观测嵌入拓宽末层 Laplace 后验，提升不确定性估计，且 CoMP 与多种测试时估计器均无需重训练。
AI.result: 在三个操作（manipulation）基准上，结合失败检测与微调演示数据筛选两项下游任务评估：CoMP 修正了 BayesDiff 的方差坍塌，同时匹配或优于多种不确定性估计器。
AI.conclusion: 在 flow matching 策略上做认知不确定性传播必须保留状态-权重交叉协方差，否则方差会随积分步数系统性退化；CoMP 提供了原理正确且无需重训练的测试时不确定性估计方案，可用于失败检测与数据筛选。

title: Staleness Deadlines for Motion Plans during Onboard Reasoning
summary: Language models may enable general autonomy in robot planning, but onboard their reasoning can run for most of a minute while the robot and nearby pedestrians keep moving. The robot must then decide how long to follow a plan that the pending answer may overturn. Here we present staleness deadlines, which hand that decision to the robot's clock. Calibrated prediction regions for pedestrians and deviation tubes for the robot set the deadline. When the language model answers, a graph planner rebuilds the route, which the robot adopts only after it passes the same clearance check against walls and predicted pedestrians. Exact binomial tests determine which prespecified budget-selection policies keep close calls, wrong decisions and late arrivals below their targets at each inference profile. Candidate policies either fix one budget or set each query's budget from how long the robot can continue its plan before it must brake. We study corridor signs that close routes and delivery requests whose destination the language model must infer. In 81,000 simulated missions with recorded Qwen3-4B answers, full reasoning cuts wrong decisions about twentyfold, and tracking until the deadline cuts late arrivals by up to 64%. The robot never collides while it moves, although pedestrians who never yield still walk into the stopped robot in 23% of offline and 32% of live missions. On a Jetson AGX Orin under perception load, short budgets fail the wrong-decision target, and full reasoning the lateness target. Between these extremes, a fixed-budget policy passes for corridor signs and per-query policies pass for deliveries. Live Orin runs match offline replay on all three losses in 24 of the 32 missions where either run records a loss. The deadline turns slower reasoning into measurable mission outcomes, which let designers test how much reasoning each inference profile can support.

AI.tldr: 提出"staleness deadlines"：用行人预测区域与机器人偏差管设定语言模型推理结果的截止时刻，机器人在截止前沿用答案重建路径，并仅在通过同一安全间隙检查后采纳；在81,000次仿真任务与Jetson AGX Orin真机运行中验证不同算力预算策略的失败率权衡。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可为机器人规划提供通用自主性，但机载推理常耗时近一分钟，期间机器人与行人均在移动；机器人需决定在等待可能推翻当前计划的答案时，还应继续执行旧计划多久。现有工作缺少把"推理延迟"显式量化为任务级安全/时效后果的机制。
AI.method: 1) 以标定的行人预测区域（prediction regions）和机器人偏差管（deviation tubes）确定staleness deadline；2) LM答复到达后由图规划器重建路线，仅在通过与墙壁及预测行人的相同间隙检查后才被采纳；3) 用精确二项检验评估预设预算选择策略（固定预算 vs. 依据机器人可保持当前计划至必须刹车的时长设定的逐查询预算）是否将close calls、错误决策与迟到率控制在目标内；4) 任务为走廊指示牌导致的路线封闭与需LM推断目的地的配送请求，使用Qwen3-4B记录答案做81,000次仿真，并在Jetson AGX Orin感知负载下做真机运行与离线重放对比。
AI.result: 完整推理将错误决策减少约20倍；跟踪至截止时刻将迟到率最多降低64%。机器人移动过程中从未发生碰撞；但从不避让的行人仍会撞上静止机器人（离线23%、真机32%的任务）。Orin上短预算无法满足错误决策目标，完整推理无法满足迟到目标；介于两者之间的固定预算策略对走廊指示牌通过，逐查询策略对配送通过。在32次任一运行记录损失的场景中，有24次真机与离线重放的三项损失一致。
AI.conclusion: staleness deadline把推理速度转化为可测的任务级结果，使设计者能针对每种推理配置检验其可支撑的推理量；但结论基于单一4B模型、两处场景与仿真+有限真机验证，策略选择需按任务类型与硬件算力重新标定。

title: FlowScope: 3D Scene Flow Pretraining Improves Surgical Robot Policies
summary: Imitation learning for surgical robots is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. Meanwhile, many robot-assisted procedures are recorded as stereo video, yet policies cannot learn from them directly; clinical video carries no action labels. We present FlowScope, which pretrains a surgical policy network on unlabeled clinical video by forecasting scene flow, the metric 3D motion of scene points, with labels computed by off-the-shelf stereo depth and optical flow models. We pretrain the trunk of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) on a dataset of 1,149 clinical procedures (1.35M clips) and discard the flow head afterward, so the deployed policy is a standard ACT with no added inference cost. On a real surgical robotic system, FlowScope raises needle pickup success from 54% to 90% and first-handover success on needle regrasp from 4% to 52% (full task: 2% to 14%) over training from scratch (n=50 trials each), and retains its gains with a generative flow-matching action head. Ablations indicate that metric 3D motion is the strongest pretraining signal among those tested; kinematics, 2D tracks, depth alone, and scale-free 3D flow, each paired with kinematics, yield smaller or no gains. Representation analyses suggest that scene-flow pretraining encodes metric needle depth more accurately, that kinematics pretraining increases reliance on the robot state, and that needle-depth probes follow the ordering of real-robot success where offline validation error does not.

AI.tldr: FlowScope用无标注临床立体视频预训练ACT主干：以现成深度+光流模型计算场景流（度量3D运动）作为自监督标签，预训练1,149例手术、1.35M片段，丢弃流预测头后即为标准ACT；实机上将穿针抓取成功率54%→90%，再抓取首次交接4%→52%（完整任务2%→14%）。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人模仿学习受限于示教采集成本；大量机器人辅助手术录像为立体视频但无动作标签，无法直接用于策略学习，因此需要一种可从无标注临床视频中提取有效监督信号的预训练方法。
AI.method: 用现成立体深度与光流模型计算场景流（场景点的度量3D运动）作为伪标签，在1,149例临床手术、135万视频片段上预训练Action Chunking Transformer（ACT）主干，预训练后丢弃flow head，部署策略仍为标准ACT、无额外推理开销；对比消融包括运动学、2D轨迹、单目深度、无尺度3D流等信号，并替换为生成式flow-matching动作头验证通用性，辅以表征探针分析。
AI.result: 真实手术机器人系统上（每项n=50次试验），穿针抓取成功率由54%提升至90%；穿针再抓取的首次交接成功率由4%升至52%，完整任务由2%升至14%；增益在flow-matching动作头下依然保持。消融显示度量3D运动是最强预训练信号，其余信号增益较小或无增益；表征分析表明场景流预训练更准确编码针的度量深度，运动学预训练增加对机器人状态的依赖，且针深探针精度与真机成功率排序一致，而离线验证误差不能反映该排序。
AI.conclusion: 度量3D场景流是从无标注临床视频中进行手术机器人策略预训练的高效自监督目标，可在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升真机操作性能，并可作为评估预训练质量的表征指标参考。

title: SonoAtlasWorld: Anatomy-Grounded Ultrasound World Models for Wide-Range Scanning
comment: Interactive video demonstrations are available at: this https URL
summary: Learning robotic ultrasound policies requires interactive environments for scalable data generation and repeatable evaluation, while exploration on real patients is limited by acquisition costs and safety constraints. Generative world models offer an alternative, but image history and probe actions alone do not ensure anatomical consistency across wide-range scans and changing acoustic windows. We introduce SonoAtlasWorld, an ultrasound world model built on anatomy as state. A persistent 3D anatomical asset extracted from computed tomography (CT) anchors each scan to a specific anatomy. Probe actions determine anatomical and acoustic visibility conditions for a causal ultrasound generator trained on clinical videos. Our three-stage pipeline combines anatomy-conditioned pretraining, causal conversion and long-rollout alignment. Inference optimizations achieve pose-to-ultrasound throughput of 81.2 FPS. To evaluate anatomical control beyond image similarity, we introduce the Action-Following Index (AFI), which measures normalized reconstruction gain over a static-prefix baseline. On 40 held-out 3D volumes, SonoAtlasWorld achieves liver and macro-organ AFI of 0.428 and 0.262, compared with at most 0.117 and 0.038 for the tested action- and geometry-conditioned methods. Long-rollout alignment reduces brightness drift by 3.46x at the end of 40 repeated scan cycles. SonoAtlasWorld also generates offline policy-training demonstrations and supports anatomically grounded closed-loop evaluation. Scaling the generated training data improves key-plane acquisition success from 48.2% to 81.2% on unseen anatomies in simulation, demonstrating its utility for robotic ultrasound policy learning.

AI.tldr: SonoAtlasWorld以解剖结构为状态构建超声世界模型：用CT提取的持久3D解剖资产锚定扫描，由探头动作决定解剖/声学可见性，驱动因果超声生成器；含解剖条件预训练、因果转换、长rollout对齐三阶段，81.2 FPS，并提出AFI指标衡量解剖控制。
AI.motivation: 真实患者上的机器人超声探索受采集成本与安全约束限制，需要可扩展的交互式环境；仅用图像历史+探头动作的生成式世界模型无法在大范围扫描与变化声窗下保持解剖一致性。
AI.method: 以从CT提取的持久3D解剖资产作为世界状态；探头位姿决定解剖与声学可见性条件，条件化因果超声生成器（基于临床视频训练）。三阶段管线：解剖条件预训练→因果转换→长rollout对齐；并做推理加速。新指标AFI以静态前缀基线衡量的归一化重建增益评估动作遵循。
AI.result: 推理81.2 FPS；40个留出3D体上肝脏/宏观器官AFI为0.428/0.262（对比方法≤0.117/0.038）；长rollout对齐使40个扫描周期末亮度漂移降低3.46×；生成数据规模放大使未见解剖上关键平面获取成功率48.2%→81.2%（仿真）。
AI.conclusion: 解剖态世界模型可提供解剖可控、长时稳定的超声仿真，支持离线策略训练与解剖接地的闭环评估，并随数据扩展提升机器人超声策略学习效果。

title: Effectiveness of Synthetic Defects for Anomaly Detection in Industrial Small Load Carriers
summary: Recent industrial anomaly detection methods use procedural noise to generate synthetic training defects. Their effectiveness in real-world settings and the impact of different noise generation methods have not been sufficiently investigated. We evaluate the effectiveness of training using synthetic defects for both supervised and unsupervised methods, the impact of different noise generation methods, and the differences in detection performance between benchmark datasets and a real-world small load carrier (SLC) dataset. Trained on synthetic defects only, a supervised classifier reaches 0.65 AUROC on real SLC defects, while three unsupervised methods using the same kind of noise (Perlin) reach 0.87--0.90. Except for SuperSimpleNet, which fails with the foreground-confined fractal Brownian motion (fBm) recipe, models trained with the custom recipe or with nine other noise types do not differ reliably from those trained with Perlin noise. Finally, results with synthetic defects on benchmark datasets do not carry over to the SLC dataset, possibly because the synthetic defects differ too much from the real ones (a larger angle in feature space). These results call for caution when training models on synthetic defect images.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了用程序化噪声合成缺陷进行训练的工业异常检测方法在真实场景下的有效性，发现监督分类器在真实小载荷载具（SLC）数据上仅达0.65 AUROC，而无监督方法（Perlin噪声）可达0.87–0.90；不同噪声生成方式间无可靠差异；基准数据集上的合成缺陷结果无法迁移到真实SLC数据。
AI.motivation: 近年工业异常检测大量依赖程序化噪声生成的合成缺陷做训练，但其在真实场景中的有效性、不同噪声生成方法的影响均缺乏充分验证，作者希望厘清合成缺陷训练的实际价值与局限。
AI.method: 在真实小载荷载具（SLC）数据集与标准基准上，对比监督与无监督方法仅用合成缺陷训练的表现；比较Perlin噪声与另九种噪声类型及自定义噪声配方（含前景约束fBm）的影响；并在特征空间中分析合成缺陷与真实缺陷的差异。
AI.result: 仅用合成缺陷训练：监督分类器在真实SLC缺陷上0.65 AUROC，三种无监督方法（Perlin）达0.87–0.90；除SuperSimpleNet在前景约束fBm配方下失效外，其他噪声类型与Perlin训练结果无可靠差异；基准数据集上的合成缺陷结果不能迁移到SLC，可能因合成缺陷与真实缺陷在特征空间角度差异过大。
AI.conclusion: 合成缺陷图像训练需谨慎：噪声类型选择影响有限，关键瓶颈是合成缺陷与真实缺陷的分布差距，基准上的结论难以推广到真实工业场景。

title: Your Judge Inherits Your Prompt: In-Context Label Bias in an LLM-as-Judge Is Directional, Not Symmetric
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Published in the Proceedings of the 9th BlackboxNLP Workshop: Analyzing and Interpreting Neural Networks for NLP (2026)
summary: LLM-as-judge has become a standard way to score open-ended model outputs, yet the judge is itself a frozen language model steered by a few in-context examples, and such models are known to absorb the label balance of their demonstrations rather than treat them as neutral illustrations. We ask whether this label bias reaches an LLM judge used inside a multimodal (video question answering) evaluation pipeline, and what form it takes. Using a fully frozen generator-judge pipeline, we hold the generated answers fixed and vary only the Yes/No balance of the judge's few-shot examples across four demonstration sets. Each verdict is validated against a two-annotator human consensus on 200 examples per dataset. The judge's acceptance rate stays close to human consensus when its examples are balanced or skewed toward rejection, but jumps sharply (by about 30 points on NExT-QA and 20 on MSVD-QA, with a strongly one-sided error profile) when the examples are skewed toward acceptance; the opposite skew produces no matching drop. The bias is therefore one-directional within the tested range of label ratios. A separate five-draw analysis shows that results from a single example draw are unreliable, varying by up to 18 points, more than any difference between prompting conditions. We conclude that demonstration label bias in an LLM judge is a directional, inflation-only failure mode that can fabricate apparent benchmark gains but not losses, and that it is cheaply avoided by balancing the judge's examples and reporting results averaged over several draws.

AI.tldr: 在完全冻结的生成-评判流水线中，仅改变LLM评判器少量示例的Yes/No标签比例（四个示例集），发现标签偏置是单向的：偏向“接受”时评判通过率虚高（NExT-QA约+30点、MSVD-QA约+20点），偏向“拒绝”时无对应下降；单次抽样波动可达18点。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-judge已成为开放式输出评分的标准手段，但评判器本身是受少量in-context示例引导的冻结语言模型，已知会吸收示例的标签分布。作者想检验这种标签偏置是否会渗入多模态（视频问答）评测流水线，以及以何种形式出现。
AI.method: 固定生成答案，仅改变评判器few-shot示例的Yes/No比例（四个示例集）；每个判定与200例/数据集的双标注者人类共识对照；另做五次独立抽样分析以量化示例抽取带来的方差。
AI.result: 示例均衡或偏向拒绝时，评判器接受率接近人类共识；偏向接受时接受率骤升（NExT-QA约30点，MSVD-QA约20点），且错误分布高度单向。相反方向的偏斜不产生对应下降。单次抽样结果可差18点，超过任何提示条件间的差异。
AI.conclusion: 评判器示例标签偏置是一种方向性、只抬高不压低的失效模式，可凭空制造基准提升而不能制造损失；通过均衡评判器示例并对多次抽样结果取平均即可低成本规避。

title: TouchBench: Can Vision-Language Models Feel Invisible Physical Properties?
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for embodied perception and reasoning, yet their physical understanding is largely evaluated on questions answerable from images. Many properties critical to manipulation, such as an opaque bottle's fill level or an object's compliance, may only be revealed through touch. We introduce TouchBench, an egocentric vision-language-tactile benchmark that distinguishes visually answerable questions (Tier A) from those involving properties hidden from the camera (Tier B). It pairs head-mounted video with synchronized 137-channel whole-hand tactile sensing, comprising 900 clips from five participants across 11 tasks, with 900 absolute and 4,102 relative questions. Four state-of-the-art VLMs average 66.4% accuracy on Tier A relative questions but only 49.8% on Tier B, near chance (50%). To bridge this gap, we propose Tactile-as-Prompt (TaP), which presents 34 interpretable tactile statistics as text, enabling VLMs to reason with touch without a learned tactile encoder. TaP raises zero-shot Tier B relative accuracy to 62.9% and reaches 73.1% after leave-one-user-out fine-tuning, outperforming video alone (67.4%) and a learned tactile-token encoder (67.3%). The gains extend to unseen objects and users. On a separate 20-hour in-the-wild corpus, tactile text improves fine-tuned contact-question accuracy from 67.1% to 75.5%. These results highlight the limits of vision-only physical reasoning and establish language as an effective interface for tactile perception.

AI.tldr: TouchBench：首个自我中心视-语-触基准，区分"视觉可答"(Tier A)与"触觉专用"(Tier B)问题；并提出把34维可解释触觉统计量作为文本提示(TaP)注入VLM，零样本Tier B相对问题达62.9%，留一用户微调后73.1%，超过纯视频(67.4%)与学习式触觉token编码器(67.3%)。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM具身感知评测几乎都基于图像可回答的问题，但操作所需的关键属性（不透明瓶内液位、物体软硬/顺应性）只能靠触摸获得；缺少量化"视觉盲区"并给出可行补救方案的基准。
AI.method: (1) 构建TouchBench：头戴视频+同步137通道全手触觉，900段片段、5名被试、11个任务，900绝对+4102相对问题，按是否视觉可答分Tier A/B；(2) 提出Tactile-as-Prompt(TaP)，将34个可解释触觉统计量序列化为文本，使VLM无需学习触觉编码器即可推理；(3) 与纯视频、学习式tactile-token编码器对比，并做留一用户微调、新物体/新用户泛化测试；(4) 额外在20小时野外数据上验证触觉文本对接触问题的增益。
AI.result: 四个SOTA VLM平均：Tier A相对问题66.4%，Tier B仅49.8%（≈随机50%）。TaP零样本Tier B达62.9%，留一用户微调后73.1%，优于纯视频67.4%与学习式触觉token 67.3%，并泛化到未见物体与用户；野外20小时语料上接触问题从67.1%提升至75.5%。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了纯视觉物理推理的瓶颈，并证明"语言"可作为触觉感知的有效接口：低维可解释触觉文本即可显著提升隐蔽属性推理，且无需专门触觉编码器。

title: Perceive Once, Escalate on Demand: Handing Off Visual KV Memory from Small to Large VLMs
summary: An embodied agent cannot afford a large vision-language model (VLM) at every step of a long video, so a cascade runs a small VLM continuously and escalates only uncertain decisions to a large one. Each escalation, however, forces the large model to re-encode a history the small model has already perceived, and this dominates its cost. We present Baton, which hands the large model the small model's visual memory, its key-value (KV) cache over the history. Baton rests on one finding: the large model needs a usable memory, not a faithful copy of its own. A map trained to reproduce the large model's cache matches it most closely, yet brings no gain over the small model alone. Baton instead distills a per-layer linear map, without labels, from the large model's own answers, with the large model encoding only the current frame. Interventions on the map trace the gain to one direction, carried by the middle third of the large model's layers. On RoboMME, Baton beats the small model alone, a pruned or shortened re-watch, and a text memory; as the escalation channel of a cascade it matches re-watching to within about one point at 28-47% less compute, and 8x less per escalation at 64 frames. Its gain grows with the large model, from 8B to 32B, tracks the large model's headroom across eight model pairs from four families, and transfers zero-shot to OpenEQA.

AI.tldr: Baton将小VLM的KV cache通过无标签蒸馏的逐层线性映射交给大VLM作为"视觉记忆"，避免级联升级时大模型重编码历史，在RoboMME上以约28-47%更少算力匹配重看效果。
AI.motivation: 长视频具身智能体无法每步运行大VLM，级联方案中小VLM连续运行、仅将不确定决策升级给大VLM；但每次升级都要求大模型重编码小模型已感知的历史，成为主要开销。
AI.method: 发现大模型只需"可用记忆"而非忠实复制自身cache（MAP完美复现却无增益）；据此设计Baton：以大模型自身回答为监督、无标签蒸馏一个逐层线性映射，将小模型KV cache转为大模型可用记忆，大模型只需编码当前帧。通过干预实验定位增益来自中间三分之一层的单一方向。
AI.result: RoboMME上优于小模型单独、剪枝/缩短重看及文本记忆；作为级联升级通道，在差距约1点内匹配重看且省28-47%算力，64帧时每次升级算力省8倍；增益随大模型规模（8B→32B）增长，在四个家族八个模型对上跟随大模型headroom，并零样本迁移至OpenEQA。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型KV cache蒸馏可作为高效级联升级机制，为具身长时视频推理提供低成本、可扩展的记忆传递方案。

title: What Does a Zoom Actually Add? Decomposing Fine-Grained Perception Failures in Vision-Language Models
comment: 27 pages, 17 figures, 19 tables. Code and per-sample outputs: this https URL
summary: Zooming into a region often turns a wrong answer from a vision-language model (VLM) into a right one, and a growing literature takes this as evidence that the model lacked the pixels. But a zoom changes several things at once. It removes the surrounding context, re-tokenizes, at a higher density, pixels the model has already seen, and, if the first pass was downsampled, exposes detail the model never received. We separate these factors for each failure. Holding the first pass fixed, we vary only the second look and assign every failure to the cheapest one that fixes it: reusing cached tokens, isolating the region, re-tokenizing the seen pixels, or acquiring new ones. The study covers 2,753 zoom-rescued failures of Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL and InternVL3 on V*, ZoomBench and TextVQA, at first-pass budgets from 17x fewer pixels than the source to native resolution. First, most rescued failures did not lack the pixels: upsampling the pixels the model had already seen fixes 47-73% of them even at 17x downsampling, against 1-3% for a random region. Second, the first-pass budget decides how often new pixels are needed: depending on the benchmark, new pixels are required for 23-50% of the rescues at 17x and for 12-23% at 4x. The missing-pixel reading and the accounts that dispute it thus hold at different budgets. Third, the useful magnification is large and differs between objects and text: seen pixels fix more failures up to 6-12x their first-pass size per side on objects and saturate by 4x on text, and even native pixels gain from being rendered beyond native resolution. Allowing any magnification, 68-94% of the failures at 17x need no new pixels. These models more often need a better rendering of evidence they already have than new pixels, which motivates re-tokenizing a region before acquiring it.

AI.tldr: 该文对VLM“失败后可被放大修复”的现象做因子分解，指出大多数被修复的失败并非缺像素，而是渲染/重编码问题；首轮分辨率预算决定“新像素”何时必要。
AI.motivation: 文献普遍将“放大区域后答案变对”解读为模型缺少像素信息，但放大同时改变了上下文、token化密度、已见像素的重编码以及是否引入新像素，需将这些因素解耦以检验“缺像素”解释是否成立。
AI.method: 固定首轮推理，仅变化“第二眼”：按成本递增顺序（复用缓存token < 隔离区域 < 对已见像素重token化 < 获取新像素）将每个失败归因于最廉价的可修复手段；在Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3上，于V*、ZoomBench、TextVQA共2,753个放大可救失败样本上实验，首轮预算从源图17×降采样到原生分辨率。
AI.result: 仅对已见像素上采样即可修复47–73%的失败（即使17×降采样下），随机区域仅1–3%；新像素需求随预算变化：17×下需23–50%、4×下12–23%；有效放大倍率大且对象与文本不同（对象6–12×/边仍提升，文本4×饱和），原生像素超分辨率渲染仍有收益；允许任意倍率时17×下68–94%失败无需新像素。
AI.conclusion: VLM的失败更多源于对已有证据的渲染/重token化不足，而非缺像素；“缺像素”与反方解释各在特定预算下成立。实践含义：在采集新像素之前应先对区域重token化（高密度渲染）。

title: A High-Compression Transformer VAE for Efficient and Controllable 3D Medical Image Generation with Diffusion Transformers
summary: Many medical image processing tasks, such as completing missing regions or correcting acquisition artifacts, can be cast as volumetric generation conditioned on observations of the same patient. Diffusion Transformers offer scalable capacity and flexible conditioning for this setting, but they operate on a learned image representation that must preserve fine anatomical and pathological detail while keeping complete three-dimensional volumes tractable. We bring Transformer variational autoencoding and multimodal diffusion together to address this challenge. Trained on BrainTumor-256K, a 249M Transformer VAE encodes and decodes $256^3$ volumes 7.6x faster than a comparably sized CNN trained on the same collection. Their PSNR difference is near zero with training-sized crop inputs, but the Transformer leads by 0.749 dB with full-volume inputs and an unchanged scoring region. Increasing Transformer capacity to 499M improves PSNR across all four brain MRI evaluation sets while retaining 3.8x lower encoding-decoding latency than the CNN. Fast encoding also allows conditions to be constructed dynamically in image space during latent diffusion training. Within the compressed representation, a shared Diffusion Transformer integrates text and spatial references for volumetric synthesis, completion and restoration.
