The brain-trained autoencoder further transfers to non-brain MRI and CT without target-domain fine-tuning, extending its use beyond the anatomy and modality on which it was learned. The framework provides a reusable representation and conditioning interface for efficient, controllable medical image generation. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 用Transformer VAE（在BrainTumor-256K上训练）编码256^3磁共振体数据，速度比同规模CNN快7.6倍，再以共享Diffusion Transformer在潜空间融合文本与空间参考，统一实现体数据合成、补全与修复，并可零微调迁移到非脑MRI与CT。
AI.motivation: 医学体数据生成任务（缺失区域补全、伪影校正）本质是以同一患者观测为条件的体生成；Diffusion Transformer具备可扩展容量与灵活条件控制，但依赖一个既能保留精细解剖/病理细节、又能让完整三维体可处理的学习式图像表示。
AI.method: 1）训练249M参数Transformer VAE（249M），并与同规模CNN VAE对比编解码速度与PSNR（裁剪块 vs 全volume）；2）将容量提升至499M进一步验证；3）快速编码使得潜扩散训练过程中可在图像空间动态构造条件；4）在压缩表示上用共享Diffusion Transformer整合文本与空间参考，覆盖体合成、补全与修复；5）评估跨解剖部位与跨模态（非脑MRI、CT）零微调迁移。
AI.result: Transformer VAE编解码256^3体积较同规模CNN快7.6倍；裁剪块输入PSNR几乎无差，全体积输入在评分区域不变时领先0.749 dB；499M版本在四套脑MRI评测集上均提升PSNR，且编解码延迟仍比CNN低3.8倍；脑部训练的VAE无需目标域微调即可迁移至非脑MRI与CT。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为高效、可控的医学图像生成提供了可复用的表示与条件接口，证明Transformer VAE+多模态潜扩散在大体数据上兼顾效率与保真度，并具备跨解剖与跨模态的可迁移性。

title: RoboCap-10k: A Metrically Accurate Egocentric Dataset for Robot Learning
comment: 24 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Egocentric video is the most scalable source of manipulation data for robot learning, but its difficulty lies in producing high-quality supervision. Existing large corpora lack metric 3D labels or rely on heterogeneous devices, motion-capture labs, or a headset's built-in real-time tracker, whose accuracy is not reported for the released data. We introduce RoboCap-10k: 10,000 curated hours of unscripted manipulation recorded during workers' paid shifts in 11 countries, spanning 18 task families, 200 task types, and 2,000 tasks. Every hour is captured on one device, the RoboCap, a 250 g hat with six synchronized global-shutter cameras and dual IMUs. Online calibration brings every device below 1 px of epipolar error, visual-inertial SLAM yields gravity-aligned 6-DoF head trajectories, and a multi-view hand tracker yields metric cm-precise hand poses. Each episode is annotated with task and sub-task language captions. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: RoboCap-10k：由 250 g 帽式采集设备 RoboCap（6 台同步全局快门相机 + 双 IMU）在 11 国工人班次中采集的 1 万小时无脚本操作自我中心视频数据集，提供度量精确 3D 手部姿态与重力对齐 6-DoF 头部轨迹标注，并附任务/子任务语言描述。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视频是机器人操作学习中最可扩展的数据源，但现有大规模语料缺乏度量 3D 标签，或依赖异构设备、动捕实验室与头显内置实时跟踪器（精度未公开报告），导致监督质量不足。
AI.method: 定制单一硬件 RoboCap（6 路同步全局快门相机 + 双 IMU，在线标定使对极误差 <1 px）；视觉惯性 SLAM 输出重力对齐 6-DoF 头部轨迹；多视角手部跟踪器恢复厘米级度量手部姿态；每条片段标注任务与子任务语言描述。数据覆盖 18 个任务族、200 类任务、2000 个具体任务。
AI.result: 构建 10,000 小时、2000 任务、11 国的真实工作场景操作语料，实现全设备低于 1 px 对极误差、重力对齐头部轨迹与度量级手部位姿，形成具备 3D 度量监督与语言标注的大规模操作数据源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以统一硬件 + 精标定 + 多视角感知管线解决了自我中心操作数据的度量标注瓶颈，可作为机器人学习与手物交互重建的高质量数据基础，但方法层面偏数据/管线，尚缺下游策略学习的实证结果。

title: What Does the Visual Encoder Buy? Visual Information Gain in Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining
summary: Recent scaling studies ask whether vision-language models still need a visual encoder by comparing encoder-free and encoder-based models on the next-token loss of the text in image-text data. This loss can fall without any use of the image, and two runs with the same loss can differ in what they take from it. Visual information gain (VIG) is the loss increase when the image is replaced by a uniform one. It splits exactly into global information, carried by image statistics, and layout information, which shuffling the patches within the image destroys. We apply it to decoders with 158M to 1.04B parameters that read pixel patches through a linear embedding, evaluated every billion tokens up to 40B, and to 19 public checkpoints. In our decoders the image lowers the loss by 3% to 46%, depending on the image type. Global information is present after the first billion tokens. Layout information starts near zero, grows slowly with training and does not grow with model size on five of six image types, and a larger batch reaches the same loss with less of it. With a frozen SigLIP 2 encoder in front of the same decoder the loss is lower only when the arrangement of the image is intact. On shuffled images the losses with and without the encoder agree to within 0.04 nats on five of six image types, so the net advantage of the encoder in the loss is layout information, above all the ability to read text in images. Public encoder-free models at production scale (Gemma 4 12B, NEO, Mono-InternVL) do acquire layout information. On the same documents they have 0.53 to 0.76 nats of it, against 0.65 to 0.82 for recent encoder-based models and 0.04 to 0.07 for our decoders, and their released training stages show it rising. These results agree with the reported parity of the two families when both are trained from scratch and place the reported advantage of a pretrained encoder in layout information.

AI.tldr: 提出"视觉信息增益"(VIG)指标，将图文损失下降分解为全局信息(图像统计)与布局信息(打乱patch即破坏)，用于评估无编码器/有编码器视觉语言模型的真实视觉依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有scaling研究用图文数据上的next-token loss比较无编码器与有编码器VLM，但该损失可在完全不用图像的情况下下降，且相同损失下模型对图像的利用方式可能不同，因此需要区分"是否真的利用了图像"及其利用内容。
AI.method: 定义VIG为将图像替换为均匀图后的损失增量，并精确拆分为全局信息与布局信息两部分；在158M–1.04B参数、线性patch嵌入解码器上每10亿token评测至40B，另评19个公开checkpoint；并对比前置冻结SigLIP 2编码器的同一解码器。
AI.result: 图像使损失降低3%–46%；全局信息在首个10亿token后即出现，布局信息从近零缓慢增长，且在6类图像中5类不随模型规模增长，更大batch以更少布局信息达到同等损失；打乱图像后有无编码器损失差在5/6图像类型上不超过0.04 nats，编码器净优势即在布局信息(尤其读图内文字)；生产级无编码器模型(Gemma 4 12B、NEO、Mono-InternVL)同类文档上有0.53–0.76 nats布局信息，编码器类0.65–0.82，自研解码器仅0.04–0.07。
AI.conclusion: 两族模型从头训练时的性能持平可由此解释，预训练编码器的优势集中在布局信息而非全局图像统计。

title: Tokenize Moments, Not Frames: Tokenizer-Aware Budget Allocation for Training-Free Video LLM Acceleration
summary: Video large language models (LLMs) represent each video with thousands of visual tokens, and training-free accelerators that prune or merge these tokens lose accuracy on long videos. Analyzing frame similarity and the vision tokenizers of 16 open models, we trace this loss to a step before token selection. Under a token budget, the frames of a long video are sampled farther apart than the roughly 2 s over which frames remain similar. The two-frame 3D patches of models such as Qwen-VL then blend two unrelated scenes into each visual token, a double exposure that arises before any pruning or merging. Fixed-size tokenizers such as InternVL's avoid this blend but respond differently to the same reduction. We propose ESSENCE, a training-free method that tokenizes moments, segments within which frames remain similar, rather than frames. Before encoding, a closed-form rule uses the sampling interval and the tokenizer class to set the number of token grids and the dimension to reduce; visual tokens are then released from later LLM layers. Against five recent accelerators on Qwen3-VL, Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5, ESSENCE achieves higher accuracy in 58 of 60 comparisons at matched mean time to first token (TTFT). With 80% of the tokens, it matches the average accuracy of the full Qwen models at $1.6\times$ faster TTFT; on GLM-4.1V, it exceeds the full model by up to 3.4 points. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: ESSENCE：免训练视频LLM加速方法，先按"相似片段(moment)"而非单帧切分视频，用闭式规则依采样间隔与tokenizer类型设定token网格数与降维维度，再跨LLM层释放视觉token，在Qwen/InternVL系列上60项比较中58项优于五个加速器。
AI.motivation: 长视频下token预算迫使帧采样间隔远大于帧间相似时长(~2s)，导致Qwen-VL类两帧3D patch将两个不相关场景混入同一视觉token（"双重曝光"），该退化发生在剪枝/合并之前，故现有免训练加速器精度下降。
AI.method: 分析16个开源模型的帧相似性与视觉tokenizer，提出对"相似片段"而非"帧"进行token化；编码前用闭式规则根据采样间隔与tokenizer类别确定token网格数量与降维维度；视觉token从LLM较后层释放。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL、Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL3.5上与五种加速器对比，等均值TTFT下60项中58项精度更高；保留80%token即达全模型平均精度且TTFT快1.6倍；GLM-4.1V上最高超全模型3.4分。
AI.conclusion: 长视频视觉token退化的根因在token选择之前的tokenizer层面，按片段token化是可插拔、免训练的通用加速范式。

title: SecretAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy Protection against Vision Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can infer private information from shared images, including locations, personally identifiable information (PII), and personal attributes such as age and sex, even from medical images. Adversarial perturbations can protect such information against black-box VLMs, but existing methods overlook image quality and introduce visible artifacts into the images they protect. We present SecretAgent, the first general multi-agent framework that protects image privacy against VLMs while preserving visual fidelity. LLM agents iteratively locate the visual evidence that reveals private information and adapt an invisible perturbation to the target VLM's answers and to an appearance reviewer agent, which rejects any candidate with visible artifacts. We instantiate SecretAgent with two complementary variants: SecretAgent-Gradient optimizes the perturbation through six surrogate encoders for cross-model transferability, and the gradient-free SecretAgent-Tool composes procedural noise and achieves the best perceptual fidelity on three of the five datasets. Experiments on four privacy applications (geolocation, PII, facial, and medical) across five datasets and six VLMs show that SecretAgent preserves image quality substantially better than existing methods while achieving state-of-the-art privacy protection in every application, and that its protection transfers to other VLMs.

AI.tldr: SecretAgent：首个面向视觉语言模型的黑盒图像隐私保护多智能体框架，用LLM智能体迭代定位泄漏隐私的视觉证据，并由"外观审查智能体"拒绝可见伪影，从而在保持图像视觉保真度的同时注入不可见对抗扰动。
AI.motivation: VLM可从共享图像推断位置、PII、年龄性别等隐私信息（甚至医学图像），但现有对抗扰动防护方法只追求攻击有效性，忽视图像质量，会在图上留下可见伪影，破坏可用性。
AI.method: 提出多智能体框架 SecretAgent：LLM智能体迭代定位揭示隐私的视觉证据区域，并自适应生成不可见扰动，同时接受外观审查智能体（appearance reviewer）把关，剔除有可见伪影的候选。两个变体：SecretAgent-Gradient 通过六个代理编码器优化扰动以提升跨模型迁移性；无梯度的 SecretAgent-Tool 组合程序化噪声，在5个数据集中的3个上取得最佳感知保真度。
AI.result: 在4类隐私应用（地理位置、PII、人脸、医学）与5个数据集、6个VLM上评测：SecretAgent在保持图像质量方面显著优于现有方法，在每类应用中均达到SOTA隐私保护效果，且保护可迁移到其他VLM。
AI.conclusion: 隐私保护与视觉保真并非必须取舍：智能体化的扰动搜索与审查闭环可同时实现强保护与高质量图像；方法具备跨模型迁移性，可推广到多类隐私场景。

title: Looking Right Is Not Being Right: Evaluating the Geometry of Agent-Built 3D Scenes
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Project: this https URL
summary: Vision-language agents can reconstruct rooms from video as editable 3D scenes, but convincing renders do not establish geometric accuracy. We introduce a scan-referenced evaluation and use controlled experiments to study reconstruction accuracy, the role of geometric inputs, and agents' ability to verify and correct their scenes. Our geometric score measures surface, depth, and furniture placement agreement with laser scans of 30 real rooms on a 0-100 scale. The strongest tested agent, GPT-6 Astra, scores 51.4 from video alone, while a dense reconstruction from the same video scores 75.9. Given the point cloud used for that reconstruction, Astra produces an editable scene that scores within three points of it. Agents also inherit input errors: rescaling the supplied geometry changes scene scale almost proportionally. During revision, viewing renders improves appearance more consistently than geometry. Logs of their tool calls show that agents repeatedly measure their inputs but rarely compare them with the scenes they build. To provide this missing check, we introduce a geometric error report that compares each saved scene with the agent's input points and lists the largest discrepancies. Without new geometric evidence, the report raises the revision gains of GPT-6.1 Terra and Sol by 3.9 and 5.5 points over concurrent controls.

AI.tldr: 提出以激光扫描为参照的几何评分（0-100，衡量表面、深度、家具放置）评估视觉语言智能体从视频重建可编辑3D房间的几何准确性，并分析几何输入的作用、误差继承及智能体自检与修正能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言智能体能从视频重建可编辑3D场景，但"渲染好看"不等于几何准确，且缺乏与真实扫描对齐的定量评估手段，也缺乏智能体在重建流程中自我验证与纠错的机制研究。
AI.method: 在30个真实房间上以激光扫描为参照构建几何评分基准；设计控制实验：(1) 仅视频 vs. 稠密重建点云作为输入的对比；(2) 对输入几何缩放以检验误差继承；(3) 分析修订阶段查看渲染对表观/几何的不同增益；(4) 统计工具调用日志中"测量输入"与"对比输出"的行为分布；(5) 提出几何误差报告，将保存场景与输入点云对比并列出最大偏差，作为缺失的自检环节。
AI.result: 最强智能体GPT-6 Astra仅凭视频得分51.4，而同视频的稠密重建为75.9；给定该重建点云时Astra可达其3分以内。输入误差被继承（重缩放使场景尺度近比例变化）。修订时查看渲染对表观改善更稳定、对几何改善有限；日志显示智能体反复测量输入却很少与自建场景比对。无新增几何证据时，误差报告使GPT-6.1 Terra与Sol相对并发对照分别提升3.9与5.5分。
AI.conclusion: 现有视觉语言智能体的3D房间重建几何精度显著低于稠密重建基线，且严重依赖输入几何质量；当前智能体缺乏有效的几何自检行为，轻量的几何误差报告即可带来可测量的修正增益。该基准为扫描参照式评估提供了可复用的范式。

title: Analysis of Multi-Client Inference Techniques for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are a new class of machine learning model for generalizable robot control. While they enable robots to perform complex tasks in unseen environments, serving VLAs leaves hardware idle between inference passes and under-utilized during inference. Serving multiple clients at once can improve utilization, but fundamental multi-client techniques such as batching and co-execution have not been characterized for VLAs. We therefore characterize the trade-offs these known techniques impose across latency, throughput, power, and hardware utilization. Our findings inform trade-offs and challenges for future multi-VLA serving systems.

AI.tldr: 对VLA模型多客户端服务中批处理（batching）与共执行（co-execution）在延迟、吞吐、功耗、硬件利用率上的权衡进行系统性刻画。
AI.motivation: VLA推理服务存在硬件空闲与利用率低的问题，而批处理、共执行等经典多客户端技术对VLA的适用性尚未被刻画。
AI.method: 面向多VLA服务场景，实测并刻画批处理与共执行两类多客户端技术的性能特征，覆盖延迟、吞吐、功耗与硬件利用率四个维度。
AI.result: 给出上述技术在VLA负载下的权衡曲线与瓶颈分析，但摘要未报告具体数值或加速比。
AI.conclusion: 为未来多VLA服务系统设计提供权衡依据与挑战清单；属于系统/测量类工作，缺少方法与新机制的实证增益。

title: Serial Dependence Emerges from Optimizing Vision for Noise Robustness
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 1 table. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Human visual perception is dynamically shaped by the recent past, a phenomenon known as serial dependence. Mechanistic models show that a residual memory trace can generate this dependency, yet its functional purpose (why the visual system should carry information forward in time at all) remains debated. We tested the hypothesis that serial dependence emerges as a normative consequence of optimizing vision for robustness against sensory noise. We trained recurrent autoencoders (a CNN encoder, a ConvGRU memory module, and a CNN decoder) to reconstruct natural videos corrupted by Gaussian noise, with no objective referring to perceptual history. Models that used their temporal memory achieved lower reconstruction error than memory-free counterparts, and this advantage widened as training noise increased, indicating that integrating past context is an adaptive denoising strategy. Probing the trained models with Gabor and dot sequences, we found that memory gave rise to serial dependence spontaneously: an attractive bias toward previous orientations and a spatial "continuity field" toward recently seen locations, both strengthening with training noise. Across temporal delays, the model's serial dependence was strongest for the immediately preceding stimulus and decayed monotonically. This profile quantitatively matched human orientation judgments, including an independent public dataset, once a known response-autocorrelation confound was controlled: an apparent non-monotonicity in one dataset reflected this measurement artifact rather than a genuine model-human mismatch. These findings suggest that serial dependence need not be an idiosyncratic quirk but can arise as a byproduct of optimizing for noise robustness, offering a normative account of perceptual history-dependence that complements existing mechanistic explanations and links behavior to an underlying computational objective.

AI.tldr: 训练带ConvGRU记忆模块的循环自编码器去重建含高斯噪声的自然视频，无需任何指向知觉历史的损失，模型自发涌现出序列依赖（对前一向导的吸引性偏差、空间"连续性场"、随延迟单调衰减），且随训练噪声增大而增强，并与人类朝向判断数据定量吻合。
AI.motivation: 序列依赖（serial dependence）的机制解释已存在（残余记忆痕迹），但其功能意义——视觉系统为何要把信息跨时间携带——仍有争议。作者提出规范性假设：序列依赖是视觉系统为对抗感觉噪声、优化鲁棒性而产生的必然副产品。
AI.method: 构建循环自编码器（CNN编码器 + ConvGRU记忆模块 + CNN解码器），仅以重建被高斯噪声污染的自然视频为目标训练，损失中不含任何知觉历史项；比较有/无记忆模型的重建误差并随噪声水平变化；再用Gabor与点序列探针测试记忆是否产生序列依赖，分析延迟曲线，并与人类朝向判断数据（含独立公开数据集）对比，控制反应自相关混淆。
AI.result: 有记忆模型重建误差更低，且优势随训练噪声增大而扩大，说明整合过去上下文是自适应去噪策略。探针显示序列依赖自发出现：对前一朝向的吸引性偏差、对近期位置的连续性场，均随噪声增强；跨延迟呈对紧邻刺激最强、单调衰减。控制反应自相关混淆后，该延迟剖面与人类（含独立公开数据集）定量匹配，某数据集的表观非单调性实为测量伪影。
AI.conclusion: 序列依赖并非视觉系统的怪癖，而可为噪声鲁棒性优化的副产品，提供了与机制解释互补的规范性账户，将行为与底层计算目标联系起来。

title: Mechanistic Analysis of Unified Proximity-Tactile Observation by a Capacitive Fingertip Array Constrained by a Metal Phalanx
comment: Mechanistic analysis with electrostatic FEM; no bench force map. 14 figures
summary: A capacitive fingertip array on a metal phalanx under thin silicone skin senses centimetre-scale conductive targets by fringing fields and contact force by dielectric compression. Electrode-to-body parasitics exceed the useful proximity increment by one to three orders of magnitude, and crosstalk and time-division-multiplexing (TDM) settling prevent identifying the capacitance-to-digital converter (CDC) reading with the electrode-target capacitance. The array is modelled as a multi-conductor system (sensing electrodes, driven-shield nodes, phalanx ground and an external target). The CDC measurand follows from the Maxwell capacitance matrix, with each inactive termination in the observation operator. Three mechanisms are examined: driven-shield hiding of shield-branch current and gain/phase-mismatch leakage; distinct far- and near-field operators; and TDM settling as a frame-rate limit set by shield load. A single layer used for both proximity and force reads Delta C = Delta C_force + Delta C_dielectric(epsilon_target), so its force map cannot be material-independent. A dual-array stack is analysed: the outer array is grounded as a Faraday screen during contact, and the inner array reads silicone-gap compression. FEM simulations give a monotonic, nonlinear contact response (4.6 fF at 0.05 mm to 370 fF at 0.5 mm on a 1.08 pF base), a nylon-versus-metal difference of at most 0.3 fF at exported-matrix resolution (not mesh-converged), mutual-term cancellation under driven-shield readout, and about 1 fF crosstalk on the coarse mesh. In proximity mode, electrode-shield coupling of 1.47 pF makes 10^{-3}-10^{-4} mismatch a quantitative gate: a 15.9 fF increment at 5 mm equals the leakage at |epsilon_A| ~ 10^{-2}. Force map, mechanical crosstalk and all bench quantities remain unvalidated; the equations and FEM evidence are a baseline for prototype calibration, not measured performance claims.

AI.tldr: 该文以多导体麦克斯韦电容矩阵建模金属指骨上的电容触觉阵列，分析驱动屏蔽、近/远场算子与TDM整定三类机制，并提出双层阵列结构以解耦接近与接触力测量。
AI.motivation: 电容式指尖传感器中，电极-人体寄生电容比目标产生的有效增量大1–3个数量级，串扰与TDM整定使CDC读数无法直接等同于电极-目标电容；同时单层结构与材料相关的介电变化耦合，导致力估计无法做到材料无关。
AI.method: 将阵列视为多导体系统（传感电极、驱动屏蔽节点、指骨地、外部目标），由麦克斯韦电容矩阵导出CDC观测算子并显式纳入各非活动端接；用FEM仿真分析驱动屏蔽抑制与增益/相位失配泄漏、远/近场算子的区分、以及屏蔽负载决定的TDM帧率极限；提出外层接地作法拉第屏、内层读硅胶间隙压缩的双阵列叠层方案。
AI.result: FEM给出单调非线性接触响应（1.08 pF基线下，0.05 mm处4.6 fF至0.5 mm处370 fF）；尼龙与金属目标差异≤0.3 fF（未网格收敛）；驱动屏蔽读取下互项相消，粗网格串扰约1 fF。接近模式下电极-屏蔽耦合1.47 pF，10⁻³–10⁻⁴的失配成为定量门槛，5 mm处15.9 fF增量在|ε_A|≈10⁻²时与泄漏相当。
AI.conclusion: 作者明确界定该工作为解析与仿真基线，用于原型标定；力映射、机械串扰及全部台架指标尚未实验验证，不构成实测性能结论。

title: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. We address this with an on-policy self-distillation framework that turns past-future video pairs into a natural self-supervised signal without extra annotations or LLM supervision. Second, they treat the whole future clip as equally valuable, although most of it is irrelevant context information. We address this by defining a foresight score, from which we obtain a contrastive privilege advantage that drives the model to learn the most valuable future information. Since the score is intractable, we optimize a tractable lower-bound surrogate that interpolates this advantage, computed between the true and a random reference future, with a teacher-student distillation advantage; together, they amplify decision-relevant content information and suppress irrelevant context information. We call the resulting framework Future-OPSD. On open-ended prediction and closed-ended planning, Future-OPSD improves base models by up to 14.2 and 15.9 points without compromising general video understanding. Code will be available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 Future-OPSD，用 on-policy 自蒸馏把"过去-未来"视频对变成自监督信号，并用可解的对比特权优势（前瞻分数的下界代理）筛选高价值未来信息，在开放式预测与闭环规划上分别提升最高 14.2 / 15.9 分。
AI.motivation: 现有视频前瞻推理方法有两点不足：(1) 依赖人工标注或外部大模型监督，难以规模化；(2) 把整段未来视频视为同等重要，而其中大部分是无关上下文。
AI.method: on-policy self-distillation 框架，以过去-未来视频对作为自监督信号；定义 foresight score 导出对比式 privilege advantage；由于该分数不可直接计算，优化其可解下界代理——在真实未来与随机参考未来之间计算的优势，并与教师-学生蒸馏优势做插值，从而放大决策相关内容、抑制无关上下文。
AI.result: 在开放式预测任务上较基座模型最高提升 14.2 分，闭环规划任务上最高提升 15.9 分，且不损害通用视频理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外标注或 LLM 监督的自蒸馏 + 可解优势代理，是提升 VLM 视频前瞻推理的有效途径，代码将开源。

title: A Novel Dataset and Framework for Schenkerian Optical Music Recognition
summary: Music theory enables performers, composers, and listeners to engage more deeply with music. Schenkerian analysis (SchA) is a particularly illustrative and widely used approach for modeling tonal structure, organizing music into hierarchical layers of harmonic and voice-leading relationships. Despite its importance in pedagogy and scholarship, producing well-formatted Schenkerian graphs remains difficult. A typical workflow might involve writing the Schenkerian analysis on paper, and then manually, painstakingly, entering each symbol by hand into music software, exporting to vector graphics, and manually refining layouts in graphical editors. Existing optical music recognition (OMR) systems for handwritten common western music notation (CWMN) can be leveraged for their ability to recognize small-scale symbols common to those in SchA. However, CWMN OMR models generally fail to recognize large symbols such as phrase slurs, struggle with dense notation, and do not recognize Schenkerian analysis markings. Thus, these models do not extend well to digitizing SchA. This paper introduces a novel framework for optical music recognition of both CWMN and SchA. Our novel contributions include (1) an ensemble model in which each individual model follows a different image-cropping scheme for improved object detection, (2) a topological neural network architecture for notation assembly, where candidate hyperedges attend to one another and perform hierarchical message passing, (3) the first dataset of labeled handwritten SchAs, gathered with novel model integration to the OMR-annotation software, MuNG Studio, and (4) the first algorithm for converting semantic Schenkerian graphs into typeset format.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向手写申克分析(SchA)与常规五线谱的光学音乐识别(OMR)新框架：集成多裁剪策略模型做目标检测、拓扑神经网络做符号装配、首个带标注手写SchA数据集，以及首个将语义申克图转排版的算法。
AI.motivation: 申克分析是建模调性结构的重要层级化方法，但生成格式规范的申克图极其繁琐：手写分析后需逐符号手工录入制谱软件、导出矢量图再人工排版。现有手写CWMN的OMR模型虽能识别小型符号，却难以识别短语连线等大型符号、密集记谱，且完全不含申克专有标记，故无法直接迁移到SchA数字化。
AI.method: 四项贡献：(1) 集成模型，各子模型采用不同图像裁剪方案以提升目标检测鲁棒性；(2) 拓扑神经网络架构做记谱装配，候选超边相互注意力并进行层级消息传递；(3) 首个手写SchA标注数据集，通过将模型集成到MuNG Studio标注软件采集；(4) 首个把语义级申克图转换为排版格式的算法。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；方法上以数据集构建、检测集成、超边层级装配与语义图排版算法为核心产出，面向CWMN与SchA双模态识别场景。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次把SchA数字化拆解为检测—装配—语义排版的可计算流水线，可作为符号级层级结构建模与文档理解（超边注意力装配）的参考，但缺乏定量评测与真实使用证据。

title: Causal Diffusion for Extreme Super-Resolution in Interactive Games
summary: Existing game super-resolution methods typically operate at moderate upscaling factors, struggling to recover fine visual details from extremely low-resolution inputs (e.g., 120p). At such resolutions, super-resolution shifts from reconstructing existing information toward synthesizing missing visual details. While video diffusion models offer powerful generative priors for this challenging task, their dependence on future frames limits their applicability to interactive games. We present CIDER, a causal diffusion framework for extreme game super-resolution that synthesizes high-frequency details from current and past low-resolution frames, guided by G-buffers (depth and motion vectors) to preserve scene structure and temporal consistency. We collect data from two AAA games (Cyberpunk 2077 and Black Myth: Wukong). To reduce inference load, we develop a lightweight latent projection encoder tailored to ultra-low-resolution inputs, fine-tune a decoder (TAE) on our high-resolution outputs, and distill the diffusion model to reach interactive frame rates. Our experiments demonstrate high-fidelity 8$\times$ upscaling from 120p to 960p at around 13 FPS, outperforming state-of-the-art game upscalers in visual quality and showing potential for 16$\times$ magnification.

AI.tldr: CIDER：面向交互式游戏极端超分的因果扩散框架，利用当前与历史低分辨率帧及G-buffer（深度、运动矢量）引导，实现120p→960p的8倍实时超分（约13 FPS）。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏超分方法多在中倍率下工作，难以从极低分辨率（如120p）输入恢复细节；此时任务从"重建已有信息"转为"合成缺失细节"。视频扩散模型虽有强生成先验，但依赖未来帧，无法用于交互式游戏。因此需一种因果、仅依赖当前与历史帧的生成式超分方案。
AI.method: 提出因果扩散框架CIDER：(1) 以当前与过去低分辨率帧为条件，实现无未来帧依赖的因果生成；(2) 引入G-buffer（深度与运动矢量）作为引导以保持场景结构与时序一致性；(3) 设计适配超低分辨率输入的轻量潜空间投影编码器；(4) 在高分辨率输出上微调TAE解码器；(5) 对扩散模型进行蒸馏以达到交互帧率。数据采集自《赛博朋克2077》与《黑神话：悟空》两款3A游戏。
AI.result: 在120p→960p（8×）超分任务上达到约13 FPS，视觉质量优于现有SOTA游戏超分器；实验显示具备拓展至16×放大倍率的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 因果扩散先验结合G-buffer几何引导与编码器/解码器轻量化及蒸馏，可在交互式帧率下实现极端倍率的游戏超分，为实时生成式渲染超分提供可行路径。

title: RoboDyna: A Benchmark for Evaluating Robotic Manipulation under Physically Grounded Dynamics
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Object manipulation in the dynamic real world requires understanding how the environment functions and evolves, and acting accordingly. Existing benchmarks, however, do not adequately address these needs. Physics-oriented benchmarks evaluate predictive fidelity but not closed-loop action. Dynamic robotic manipulation benchmarks often use simplified, physically implausible object motions, limiting evaluation of reasoning and action under realistic dynamics. Evaluation is also typically synchronized, freezing the environment during inference and making computation time irrelevant to task outcomes. To this end, we propose RoboDyna, a benchmark for evaluating the physical understanding and action capabilities of manipulation policies in dynamic scenes. RoboDyna comprises 20 conceptual dynamic tasks spanning five capability categories, with simple objects and minimal scene clutter, under a two-factor difficulty design, and 10 household tasks that instantiate the same capabilities in visually and semantically richer simulated real-world environments. RoboDyna provides 3,500 expert demonstrations, paired synchronous and asynchronous evaluation protocols, metrics for task success and partial completion, and interactive tools for human baseline evaluation. Evaluating vision-language-action models and a world-action model across 5.4K episodes, we find that all policies achieve success rates below 20%, revealing substantial limitations in dynamic manipulation. The world-action model captures simple physical dynamics but struggles with complex interactions, and its prediction fidelity does not consistently align with task success. Sync-async comparisons show that inference latency flips 5-12% of episode outcomes while changing average success rates by at most 3%. Human baselines substantially outperform all policies under matched conditions. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: RoboDyna是一个面向动态场景操作策略的基准，含20个概念性动态任务（5类能力、两因素难度）与10个家庭任务，提供3500条专家演示、同步/异步评估协议与部分完成度指标；VLA与世界-动作模型成功率均<20%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准不足：物理类基准只评预测保真度而不评闭环动作；动态机器人基准使用简化、物理上不合理的物体运动，难以评估真实动态下的推理与行动；且评估多为同步式（推理时冻结环境），使计算延迟与任务结果脱钩，忽略了真实部署中的时延影响。
AI.method: 构建RoboDyna：20个概念性动态任务覆盖5类能力类别，对象简单、场景杂乱度低，采用两因素难度设计；另设10个家庭任务，在视觉与语义更丰富的仿真真实环境中实例化相同能力。提供3500条专家演示、配对的同步与异步评估协议、任务成功率与部分完成度指标，以及供人类基线评估的交互工具。共评估5.4K条episode的VLA模型与一个世界-动作模型。
AI.result: 所有策略成功率均低于20%；世界-动作模型能捕捉简单物理动态但在复杂交互上表现不佳，其预测保真度与任务成功并不一致；同步-异步对比显示推理时延会翻转5-12%的episode结果，但平均成功率变化至多3%；匹配条件下人类基线显著优于所有策略。
AI.conclusion: RoboDyna揭示了现有VLA/世界-动作模型在动态操作上的实质性短板，并提出时延应作为评估的一等要素；预测保真度不能替代闭环任务成功率，后续策略需针对真实动态交互与异步部署条件改进。

title: RoboPRO: A Perturbation-Resilient and Obstacle-Aware Benchmark for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Object manipulation in the real world requires robotic policies to be robust to contextual perturbations and capable of safe planning in cluttered scenes. However, the majority of existing robotics benchmarks contain clean tabletop environments with success rate as the sole metric, leaving two critical deployment questions unanswered: does the policy manipulate safely under real conditions and what does lead to its failure? To this end, we present RoboPRO, a Robotics benchmark for Perturbation-Resilient and Obstacle-aware planning, which unifies various axes of robustness in manipulation. RoboPRO comprises 80 diverse bimanual atomic and compositional tasks across four furnished indoor environments, with a total of 16,000 demonstrations and 5.6K diverse language instructions. The scenes are populated with different numbers of distractors (non-targets), ranging from clean, involving only target objects, to densely populated to impose both visual and operational clutter. Moreover, we propose two safety-aware event metrics to determine unsafe contact between the robot and the environment or distractors. Our evaluation protocol consists of a per-factor analysis of three key perturbations, namely visual, linguistic, and object-level, with different levels of distractor densities. We conduct extensive experiments on RoboPRO using state-of-the-art manipulation policies to analyze the impact of visual and operational clutter, perturbations, and instructional diversity. Our findings indicate clutter can drastically reduce success and increase non-target collision, different perturbations have different effects on the performance, and that training data composition affects overall performance. Our findings highlight the key challenges for manipulation in real-world conditions and motivate future research in this domain. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: RoboPRO 是一个面向扰动鲁棒性与避障规划的机器人操作基准，含 80 个双臂任务、4 个家居场景、16000 条演示、5.6K 语言指令，并提出两项安全事件指标评估非目标碰撞。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人基准多为干净桌面环境且只用成功率作指标，无法回答"真实条件下是否安全"以及"失败原因是什么"两个部署关键问题。
AI.method: 构建分级干扰物密度（从干净到密集杂乱）的 4 类室内场景，覆盖视觉、语言、物体三个扰动轴；定义两项安全感知事件指标度量机器人与环境/干扰物的不安全接触；用 SOTA 操作策略做逐因素分析与消融。
AI.result: 杂乱度会显著降低成功率并增加非目标碰撞；不同扰动影响程度不同；训练数据构成影响整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 揭示真实条件下操作的核心挑战，指出该领域未来研究方向；基准本身为评估范式的贡献而非新策略方法。

title: When Perception Collides with Priors: Diagnosing Modal Polarization in Video Understanding Models
comment: 18 pages (main paper with appendix), 11 figures, 8 tables
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong video comprehension, largely benefiting from extensive training on realistic video data. However, when video perception severely conflicts with internal priors or common sense, we identify a critical failure pattern termed Modal Polarization, where models fail to integrate modalities and instead bifurcate into two distinct extremes: Cognitive Inertia, where models rigidly adhere to priors despite contradictory visual evidence, and Perceptual Inertia, where they blindly trust video perception while ignoring logical inconsistencies. To investigate this, we introduce TheaterBench, a benchmark designed to expose Modal Polarization using counter-intuitive scenarios that violate physical laws or common sense - situations rarely encountered in standard training distributions. Extensive experiments reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) models exhibit severe Modal Polarization, and many de-hallucination methods merely rebalance the trade-off between Perceptual and Cognitive Inertia rather than fundamentally resolving the conflict. This work serves as a foundational step for evaluating and enhancing the perceptual-cognitive equilibrium of future video understanding models.

AI.tldr: 提出"模态极化"（Modal Polarization）失效模式：当视频感知与常识先验冲突时，MLLM 分化为"认知惯性"（死守先验）与"感知惯性"（盲信视觉）两个极端；构建 TheaterBench 基准，用违反物理规律的反直觉场景系统暴露该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 在真实视频数据上训练充分，但训练分布中极少出现"视觉证据与内部先验/常识严重矛盾"的情形。作者希望正式刻画并量化这一冲突下的整合失败，而非仅泛泛讨论幻觉。
AI.method: 提出失效分类：两极化为一端的认知惯性与另一端的感知惯性。构建 TheaterBench 基准，采用反物理/反常识的反事实场景（而非标准分布数据）进行诊断式评测，并对当前 SOTA 模型与多种去幻觉方法做对比实验。
AI.result: 实验显示当前 SOTA 模型存在严重模态极化；多数去幻觉方法只是在感知惯性与认知惯性之间重新平衡权衡，并未从根本上解决模态冲突。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为评估与提升未来视频理解模型的"感知—认知均衡"提供了基础性诊断框架；核心贡献在问题定义与评测，而非具体解决方法。

title: Affine-Image Propagation for Tight and Scalable Neural Network Verification
summary: While bound propagation methods are highly effective for certifying neural networks against $\ell_{\infty}$ adversaries, tight and scalable verification for $\ell_{2}$ adversaries remains a significant open challenge. Existing methods incur geometric loss by enclosing preactivation sets in elementwise intervals or axis-aligned ellipsoids, and functional loss by restricting the linear bounds constructed over those domains. Consequently, tight $\ell_{2}$ verification is currently restricted to Lipschitz-regularized networks where these approximations are accurate. In this paper, we introduce affine-image SDP-CROWN, a novel bound propagation method that better approximates preactivation domains using affine-image constraints and jointly optimizes the linear bound to adapt to the resulting domain. To bypass the prohibitive computational cost of dense semidefinite constraints required by the affine-image representation, we replace them with scaled diagonal-dominance conditions, allowing a GPU-accelerated implementation. Our method preserves the bound propagation recursion and can be integrated with branch-and-bound. On five MNIST and CIFAR-10 non-Lipschitz-regularized networks, our method improves verified accuracy over state-of-the-art methods by 17% to 57.5%. With branch-and-bound, these improvements increase to between 27% and 63.5%.

AI.tldr: affine-image SDP-CROWN：用仿射像约束刻画预激活域并联合优化线性界，配合缩放对角占优替代稠密SDP约束，实现紧致可扩展的ℓ2神经网络鲁棒性验证。
AI.motivation: ℓ∞ 有界传播验证已较成熟，但 ℓ2 对抗下的紧致且可扩展验证仍是开放难题：现有方法用逐元素区间或轴对齐椭球包络预激活集带来几何损失，且线性界与域不匹配造成函数损失，导致紧致 ℓ2 验证只能局限于 Lipschitz 正则化网络。
AI.method: 提出 affine-image SDP-CROWN：以仿射像（affine-image）约束表示预激活域，并联合优化线性界以适配该域；为规避仿射像表示所需稠密半正定约束的高计算代价，改用缩放对角占优（scaled diagonal-dominance）条件近似，支持 GPU 加速实现；保留有界传播递推结构，可与分支定界（BaB）结合。
AI.result: 在 5 个 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 非 Lipschitz 正则化网络上，验证精度较 SOTA 提升 17%–57.5%；结合分支定界后提升达 27%–63.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过放松 L2 域包络与线性界联合优化，显著缩小了 ℓ2 验证的几何与函数近似损失，使紧致 ℓ2 验证不再依赖 Lipschitz 正则化，并保持可扩展性与 BaB 兼容性。

title: ViewDreamer: A Robot World Model beyond Fixed Camera Setups
comment: 29 pages, 13 figures, 21 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Video generation models are increasingly important for robot learning, yet most generate each camera view separately or tile all views in a fixed layout. Robot demonstrations, however, are captured by synchronized cameras whose number, placement, and order vary across embodiments. We present ViewDreamer, a single world model that handles variable sets of cameras by disentangling per-view generation from cross-view interaction. Each view follows the generation path of a pretrained single-view model, and views interact only through shared slot tokens. We stabilize multi-view training with a curriculum that gradually increases the number of views. Cross-View Slot Agreement uses visual foundation models to group geometrically and semantically similar regions across views into shared slots. On RoboView-Bench, which covers one to four cameras, ViewDreamer achieves the best generation quality among the models evaluated and improves cross-view consistency over independent per-view generation. These gains carry over to our world-action model (WAM) and action-conditioned world model (AC-WM). Our WAM outperforms the FastWAM-Joint baseline on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboDojo, and on a real Franka robot. Both variants improve out-of-domain generalization to various camera settings and scenes.

AI.tldr: ViewDreamer：把多相机的逐视图生成与跨视图交互解耦的单世界模型，用共享 slot token 处理可变相机集合，并以视角数量课程稳定训练。
AI.motivation: 机器人示教由数量、位姿和顺序各异的同步相机采集，而现有视频生成模型要么逐视角独立生成（缺乏跨视角一致性），要么按固定布局拼贴多视角（无法适配可变相机集合），难以泛化到不同具身与相机配置。
AI.method: 每个视图沿用预训练单视图模型的生成路径，视图间仅通过共享 slot token 交互；提出 Cross-View Slot Agreement，借助视觉基础模型把跨视图几何与语义相近的区域分组成共享 slot；并用逐步增加视图数的课程学习稳定多视图训练。模型可同时支撑 world-action model（WAM）与 action-conditioned world model（AC-WM）。
AI.result: 在覆盖 1–4 相机的 RoboView-Bench 上取得所评估模型中最佳生成质量，跨视图一致性优于独立逐视图生成；增益可迁移到 WAM 与 AC-WM；WAM 在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboDojo 以及真实 Franka 机器人上超过 FastWAM-Joint 基线；两种变体均提升对各类相机设置与场景的域外泛化。
AI.conclusion: 以"解耦逐视图生成 + slot token 跨视图交互"的结构设计即可原生支持可变相机集合，兼顾生成质量、跨视图一致性与域外泛化，是面向机器人学习的实用世界模型方案。

title: GeoCloak: Defending Against Geolocation Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models via Perceptual Image Editing
summary: Multimodal large language models can infer sensitive geographic information from ordinary images by combining visual, textual, architectural, and environmental cues. This capability creates a privacy risk: users may reveal fine-grained location information even when explicit metadata such as GPS tags has been removed. We study this problem as geolocation inference in multimodal language models and present GeoCloak, a cue-aware perceptual editing framework for reducing location leakage from shared images. GeoCloak uses an accessible multimodal model as a proxy to identify geolocation-relevant cues, localizes high-impact regions through object grounding, and applies localized semantic edits designed to disrupt downstream geolocation predictions while preserving the overall scene content. Experiments on street-level image datasets show that GeoCloak substantially reduces administrative-level geolocation accuracy across multiple multimodal models, while maintaining automatic perceptual-quality scores closer to those of the original images than pixel-level perturbation baselines. These results suggest that cue-level semantic editing is a promising direction for reasoning-based visual privacy, while also highlighting open challenges in deployment cost, semantic plausibility, and adaptive evaluation.

AI.tldr: GeoCloak：用代理多模态模型定位图像中与地理位置相关的线索区域，做局部语义编辑以降低下游模型的行政区级地理定位准确率，同时保持场景内容与感知质量。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型可融合视觉、文本、建筑与环境线索从普通图像推断细粒度地理位置，即使用户已移除GPS等元数据仍会泄露隐私，需要在不破坏图像可用性的前提下抑制位置推断。
AI.method: 以可获取的多模态模型作为代理识别地理定位相关线索，通过object grounding定位高影响区域，再施加局部语义编辑（而非像素级扰动）破坏下游地理定位预测，并保持整体场景内容。
AI.result: 在街景级数据集上，GeoCloak对多个多模态模型显著降低行政区级定位准确率，且自动感知质量指标比像素级扰动基线更接近原图。
AI.conclusion: 线索级语义编辑是"基于推理的视觉隐私保护"的有希望方向；在部署成本、语义合理性与自适应评测方面仍存挑战。

title: Geo-Force: A Theory of Force Sensing from Object Geometry
summary: Robots need contact forces to handle delicate objects, but tactile sensors are fragile and hard to integrate, whereas depth sensors, such as RGB-D cameras, are widely available. A virtual touch sensor that keeps the sensing surface of a tactile sensor but replaces its electronics with a touch signal predicted from the target object's geometry, as measured by a depth sensor, could close this gap, yet it is unclear what such a virtual sensor computes and when its output can be trusted. We give a formal answer. We define the Geometric Force as the force on each taxel of a virtual touch sensor, computed in three steps: rendering the surface to be touched as seen from the virtual sensor, predicting the touch signal with a touch map, learned or simulated, and estimating the force from that signal. We prove three properties of the Geometric Force. First, its force vectors only rotate under a change of coordinate frame. Second, it vanishes when the rendered surface does not touch the virtual sensor. Third, it is stable: its error grows at most linearly with the errors of the three steps for Lipschitz maps. The rendering error, in turn, depends on how well the surface is sampled or reconstructed and how accurately the sensor is placed. We then show a fundamental limit: geometry does not reveal the object's stiffness, so no touch map can predict touch exactly for objects of the same shape and different stiffness. Under an elastic contact model, all object-specific knowledge resides in the touch map. From these results, we derive requirements on the depth sensor and the objects, design rules, and the conditions under which such a virtual sensor fails.

AI.tldr: 提出"虚拟触觉传感器"的"几何力"(Geometric Force)形式化定义：以深度传感器测得的目标几何替代触觉电子硬件，经渲染、touch map预测、力估计三步计算每taxel受力，并证明其坐标系旋转等变、无接触时为零、以及误差随三步误差Lipschitz线性增长的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 真实触觉传感器脆弱、集成困难，而RGB-D等深度传感器普及；希望用深度感知的几何预测触觉信号来构建虚拟触觉传感器，但缺乏对其计算内容与可信条件的理论刻画。
AI.method: 将Geometric Force定义为三步：从虚拟传感器视角渲染待接触表面→用可学习或仿真的touch map预测触觉信号→由信号估计力；随后证明三条性质（坐标变换下力矢量仅旋转；未接触时为零；对Lipschitz映射误差至多线性增长），并分析渲染误差对表面采样/重建与传感器位姿精度的依赖。
AI.result: 给出三条性质的形式化证明；揭示几何无法反映刚度这一根本极限——同形状不同刚度物体不存在精确的touch map；在弹性接触模型下所有物体特异知识集中于touch map。
AI.conclusion: 由理论结果推导出对深度传感器与被操作物体的要求、虚拟传感器设计规则，以及其失效条件。

title: SceneRuler: Measuring Physical Quantities in Video via Minimal Sufficient Reconstruction
summary: Many questions about videos ask for a number, such as how tall a person is, how far a cart travels, or how fast a ball leaves a ramp. We study this task, quantitative physical reasoning from video, where the inputs are a video, a question, and a prior of known facts such as object sizes, speeds, and distances from the camera to named objects. End-to-end video-language models lack an explicit metric scale and physical consistency, and their errors cannot be inspected. We present SceneRuler, which instead recovers a measurable physical scene and answers with that scene as evidence. Its central principle, Minimal Sufficient Reconstruction, builds, for each question, only the smallest scene that suffices to measure the asked quantity, and tests sufficiency on measurements rather than assuming it. The scene is written as a program whose structure a vision-language model writes and whose magnitudes are left to measurement. Physics-guided Fitting measures them through physical motion laws, so that gravity itself can anchor the metric scale, and marks every parameter, and the read-out of the asked quantity, as determined or undetermined. Each question receives a read-out and an answer. The read-out is the asked quantity evaluated on the scene, and it is empty when the scene does not fix that quantity. The answer is always given by a model that takes the scene as evidence. We evaluate on QuantiPhy and also apply the method to 27 in-the-wild videos that we collected, which have no ground-truth answers. On its validation split, the final answer reaches a mean relative accuracy of 0.709 against 0.624 for the strongest baseline, and the reconstruction determines the asked quantity on 47 of 158 questions, where the final answer reaches 0.781. Because every intermediate quantity is explicit, each answer can be traced to the objects, scale, and motion behind it.

AI.tldr: SceneRuler 将视频中的定量物理推理转化为"最小充分重建"：视觉语言模型只写场景程序的结构，量值由物理运动定律（以重力锚定米制尺度）拟合测得，再以该可测量场景为证据作答，实现可追溯的数值回答。
AI.motivation: 视频问答常需数值（高度、距离、速度），但端到端视频语言模型缺乏显式米制尺度与物理一致性，且错误不可检查。作者希望让回答建立在可测量、可审计的物理场景之上，并避免为每个问题做过度重建。
AI.method: 1) Minimal Sufficient Reconstruction：对每个问题只构建足以测量所问量的最小场景，并在测量层面检验充分性而非假定。2) 场景写成程序：VLM 负责结构，量值留给测量。3) Physics-guided Fitting：借助物理运动定律拟合参数，使重力为米制尺度提供锚点；对每个参数及目标量读数标注"已确定/未确定"。4) 每问输出 read-out（在场景上求值的量，不充分时为空）与 answer（以场景为证据的模型给出）。
AI.result: 在 QuantiPhy 验证集上，最终答案平均相对精度 0.709（最强基线 0.624）；158 个问题中有 47 个场景能确定所问量，在此子集上答案达 0.781。另在自采 27 个无真值野外视频上做了应用性测试。
AI.conclusion: 以"可测量场景"为中间证据的范式在定量视频推理上优于端到端基线，且每个中间量显式化，答案可追溯到物体、尺度与运动；局限是仅约 30% 问题能由重建确定目标量，其余依赖模型推断。

title: PonderPounce-WM: When Does Predicting the Future Help Context-Dependent Robot Control?
summary: How does future prediction affect context-dependent robot control? We introduce PonderPounce-WM, extending PonderPounce with three future tokens supervised to predict visual-feature changes. Its pretrained MLLM, Ponder, integrates history and demonstrations into continuous cognition for the action model, Pounce. We investigate token ordering and delivery to distinguish predictive supervision from direct future conditioning. On RoboMME, cognition-first ordering with cognition-only delivery improves success from 60.83% to 67.42%. With the same ordering, direct future-token delivery yields 64.00% success. Probes show increased future information in cognition while the tested past-event attributes remain largely decodable. Across four real-robot tasks, PonderPounce-WM achieves 67.44% mean success under asynchronous execution, compared with 60.98% for PonderPounce. These results suggest that future prediction can improve context-dependent control through auxiliary supervision without delivering future tokens to the action model.

AI.tldr: PonderPounce-WM extends PonderPounce by adding three future tokens supervised to predict visual-feature changes; ablation shows predictive supervision (cognition-only delivery, cognition-first ordering) helps most, reaching 67.42% on RoboMME vs 60.83% baseline and 67.44% mean over four real-robot tasks.
AI.motivation: Prior work (PonderPounce) feeds MLLM-derived continuous cognition to an action model, but it is unclear whether future prediction truly helps context-dependent robot control, and whether gains come from auxiliary supervision or merely from conditioning the policy on explicit future tokens.
AI.method: Add three future tokens to the Ponder MLLM, supervised to predict visual-feature changes (latent world-model style). Systematically vary token ordering (cognition-first vs. others) and delivery (cognition-only vs. direct future-token delivery) to disentangle auxiliary supervision from future conditioning. Use linear probes on cognition representations to measure future information and retention of past-event attributes.
AI.result: RoboMME: cognition-first ordering with cognition-only delivery improves success 60.83% -> 67.42%; with same ordering direct future-token delivery gives 64.00%. Probes show increased future information in cognition while past-event attributes remain largely decodable. Four real-robot tasks: 67.44% mean success under asynchronous execution vs 60.98% for PonderPounce.
AI.conclusion: Future prediction improves context-dependent control primarily as auxiliary representation supervision rather than by exposing future tokens to the action model; direct future-token delivery is less effective, and cognition retains past-event information while gaining predictive content.

title: S2D-Splat: Static-First Gaussian Reconstruction of Dynamic Driving Scenes with Layer-Wise Feature Guidance
summary: Moving objects introduce cross-frame inconsistencies that complicate camera estimation and static geometry recovery in driving scenes. Recent feed-forward Gaussian methods explicitly separate static and dynamic primitives, but often estimate camera parameters and geometry from shared features that jointly encode both components, leaving static reconstruction susceptible to dynamic interference. To address this challenge, we propose S2D-Splat, a feed-forward framework for static-first Gaussian reconstruction with layer-wise feature guidance. Our framework separates static and dynamic features before camera and geometry estimation, enabling the static branch to recover camera parameters and static 3D Gaussians with reduced dynamic interference. Intermediate static features are cached at each layer and reused as fixed conditioning at corresponding layers of the dynamic branch. This asymmetric information flow preserves the established static representations while providing stable geometric context for reconstructing dynamic 3D Gaussians. An instance-level motion decoder further queries the fused static and dynamic representations to estimate object trajectories, supporting motion-aligned Gaussian fusion and temporal interpolation. Experiments on Waymo and zero-shot evaluations on nuScenes and the MM-AU accident dataset demonstrate that S2D-Splat outperforms existing approaches on most evaluated metrics and generalizes to highly dynamic, pre-collision driving scenarios.

AI.tldr: S2D-Splat：前馈静态优先高斯重建框架，先在特征层显式分离动静，静态分支估相机与静态高斯，动态分支以上层静态特征为固定条件重建动态高斯，实例级运动解码器回归轨迹。
AI.motivation: 驾驶场景中运动物体造成跨帧不一致，现有前馈高斯方法用共享特征联合估计相机与几何，静态重建受动态干扰。
AI.method: 对称特征分离+非对称信息流：逐层缓存静态中间特征并作为动态分支对应层的固定条件；静态分支独立完成相机估计与静态3D高斯；实例级运动解码器查询融合表示估计目标轨迹，支持运动对齐高斯融合与时间插值。
AI.result: Waymo 上多数指标优于现有方法；nuScenes 与 MM-AU 事故数据集零样本评估同样领先，并泛化到高动态预碰撞场景。
AI.conclusion: 动静特征解耦加静态特征层间复用，是抑制动态干扰、稳定前馈静态重建与相机估计的有效设计。

title: FoRe: A Force-Guided Framework for Autonomous Grasp Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in grasp-based manipulation, yet reliable recovery from local grasping failures remains challenging. Specifically, in pick-and-place tasks, policies may continue transport after a failed grasp instead of retrying, potentially reflecting overreliance on proprioceptive cues for stage progression and limited retry supervision. Existing recovery approaches typically rely on deployment-time guidance or demonstration augmentation. We introduce Force-guided Recovery (FoRe), a framework for autonomous recovery from local grasping failures. Using force feedback, FoRe partitions demonstrations into approach-grasp and transport-placement stages to train separate policies. To supplement limited retry supervision, FoRe then initializes a dedicated retry policy from the approach-grasp policy and refines it through local reinforcement learning (RL) from post-failure states. To avoid inappropriate stage progression, a controller combines force feedback with grasp-command status at inference to coordinate the stage policies, detect grasp failures, and invoke the retry policy. We also construct LIBERO-SUCTION, a force-augmented suction manipulation benchmark adapted from LIBERO, with complete demonstration trajectories for policy training. FoRe consistently improves task success rates for VLA-Adapter and $\pi_{0.5}$ on LIBERO-SUCTION, LIBERO, and real-world tasks. On LIBERO-SUCTION, average absolute gains are 18.4% and 6.5%, respectively. The corresponding real-world absolute gains are 25.0% and 21.7%. FoRe also remains effective with only one demonstration per task on both simulation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: FoRe利用力反馈将示范切分为approach-grasp与transport-placement两阶段分别训练策略，并以approach-grasp策略初始化专用重试策略、在后失败状态做局部RL微调；推理时用力反馈+夹爪指令状态协调阶段切换、检测抓取失败并触发重试。构建力增强的LIBERO-SUCTION基准，在LIBERO-SUCTION/LIBERO/真实任务上分别提升VLA-Adapter与π0.5成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA在抓取式操作上表现良好，但抓取失败后的自主恢复仍困难：策略常因过度依赖本体感觉推进阶段而在抓取失败后继续搬运，且重试监督信号稀缺。现有恢复方法依赖部署时引导或示范增广，缺少从失败状态直接学习的机制。
AI.method: 1) 用力反馈(力/接触信号)将示范分割为approach-grasp与transport-placement两阶段，训练两套阶段策略；2) 以approach-grasp策略初始化retry策略，并从抓取失败后的状态出发做局部强化学习精化，弥补重试示范不足；3) 推理时由控制器融合力反馈与grasp-command状态，判定阶段推进、检测抓取失败并调用retry策略；4) 构建基于LIBERO的力增强吸盘操作基准LIBERO-SUCTION及完整示范轨迹。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-SUCTION、LIBERO与真实任务上一致提升VLA-Adapter和π0.5的成功率：LIBERO-SUCTION平均绝对增益18.4%（VLA-Adapter）与6.5%（π0.5），真实世界对应增益25.0%与21.7%；两个仿真基准上每任务仅1条示范时仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模力反馈下的阶段切换与失败检测，并用局部RL从失败状态训练专用重试策略，是提升VLA抓取失败恢复能力的有效且数据高效的方案，且具备sim-to-real迁移效果；同时提供了可复用的力增强基准。

title: Many Plans at Once: Diverse Top-Quality Planning in Continuous Time
summary: Planners for physical systems usually return a single trajectory, which leaves no alternative when an unmodeled constraint invalidates the chosen route or downstream preferences change. A set of plans computed in advance provides ready-made alternatives and warm-starts for fast adaptation, but only if the plans are both low-cost and mutually distinct. Discrete planning addresses this with top-quality and diverse planning, but these ideas do not transfer to continuous time, where every valid trajectory has infinitely many valid near-copies, and existing trajectory planners converge to one or a few solutions. We present Many Plans at Once (MPAO), which treats every plan it finds as a reason to search elsewhere: it samples untrained neural networks whose outputs meet the boundary conditions by construction, trains corrections shared by networks from the same distribution, stores every validated plan, and adapts its sampling to what it has found, which makes it anytime. We define the goal by bringing the cost bound of top-quality planning and the distinctness threshold of diverse planning to continuous time. Under equal budgets against five baselines, MPAO is the only method that solves all 40 instances across four domains. On contact-rich manipulation, it is the only method with plans within 25% of the best known cost on one task, and returns about ten times as many such plans as the strongest baseline on the other two.

AI.tldr: MPAO：连续时间"多解规划"，结合top-quality cost bound与diverse planning区分度阈值，通过采样满足边界条件的未训练网络并训练共享修正，贪婪保存所有验证轨迹并自适应采样，可在等预算下于4个域全部40个实例求解。
AI.motivation: 物理系统规划器通常只返回单条轨迹，当建模外约束使该路线失效或下游偏好改变时无备选；预先计算的低成本且相互区分的多方案可提供备选与热启动。离散规划中的top-quality/diverse planning思想难以迁移到连续时间——连续轨迹存在无限多个近似副本，现有轨迹规划器只会收敛到一两个解。
AI.method: 将每个已找到的plan视为"去别处搜索"的理由：采样输出按构造满足边界条件的未训练神经网络；对同分布网络共享训练修正项；存储每条通过验证的plan；根据已发现结果自适应调整采样分布（anytime）。目标形式化为将top-quality planning的cost bound与diverse planning的distinctness threshold引入连续时间。
AI.result: 等预算对比5个基线，MPAO是唯一在4个域40个实例全部求解的方法；接触丰富操作任务上，唯一在其中一个任务给出成本在已知最优25%以内的方案，另两个任务上产出的此类方案数量约为最强基线的10倍。
AI.conclusion: 低成本、互相区分的连续时间多轨迹规划是可行且有效的，可作为备选方案与热启动用于快速适应；未训练网络采样+共享修正+自适应采样是有效实现路径。

title: Real-Time On-Drone Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection for Wilderness Search and Rescue
summary: Wilderness search-and-rescue (WSAR) teams use uncrewed aerial systems (UASs) to survey terrain for indicators of missing persons that are rare, blend into the background, or lack thermal signatures. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) provides rich spectral information, but its high data volume challenges real-time on-drone processing. We present SABL, an edge-computing pipeline for on-drone Spectral Anomaly-Based Localization. SABL integrates hyperspectral streaming with exponentially moving Reed-Xiaoli (ERX) anomaly detection and DBSCAN spatial filtering to group pixel-level anomalies into candidate search regions. SABL is evaluated on data collected during a 10-day deployment with Quinhagak Search and Rescue (QSAR) in remote Alaska. It processes hyperspectral scanlines at 5.67-5.73 ms per line, meeting the camera's 10-ms acquisition interval; DBSCAN requires only 6.5-12.5 ms per 100-line update for filtering. SABL achieves approximately 56% and 99% object-level precision on QSAR-selected search indicators across two scenes, with corresponding recall of 55% and 29%, providing significant background filtering while identifying difficult-to-see anomalous search indicators.

AI.tldr: SABL：面向无人机野外搜救的星上高光谱异常检测流水线，用指数滑动Reed-Xiaoli(ERX)异常检测+DBSCAN空间聚类，将像素级异常聚合为候选搜索区域，在阿拉斯加10天实地部署中实现每行5.7ms的实时处理。
AI.motivation: 野外搜救中失踪者目标罕见、与背景高度相似、缺乏热特征，RGB/热成像难以发现；高光谱成像光谱信息丰富但数据量大，难以机载实时处理，因此需要一套边缘端流式检测与定位方案。
AI.method: 构建边缘计算流水线SABL：高光谱流式采集 → 指数移动更新协方差/均值的Reed-Xiaoli(ERX)异常检测（降低计算与存储开销）→ DBSCAN对像素级异常做空间聚类，输出线级更新、对象级候选搜索区域。
AI.result: 单行处理5.67–5.73 ms，满足相机10 ms采集周期；DBSCAN每100行更新仅需6.5–12.5 ms。在两个场景中得到约56%与99%的对象级精度，召回55%与29%，显著滤除背景同时识别出难以目视发现的异常指标。
AI.conclusion: 异常检测+空间聚类的轻量组合足以在高光谱无人机平台上实现实时机载搜救目标定位，并在真实搜救队的实地部署中得到验证，具备工程落地可行性。

title: ReactDrive: Self-Reactive Driving World Model
summary: The world evolves through the dynamics of its constituent entities and their interactions, with changes in one entity influencing the behavior of others. To simulate this evolution under different actions, interactive world models need to capture the resulting agent responses as part of the world's own dynamics. In autonomous driving, errors in modeling these responses can misrepresent maneuver safety and undermine the reliability of generated videos used for policy evaluation and learning. To formalize this intrinsic requirement for driving world model, we define self-reactivity as the capability to model agent responses from observed history and a specified ego action, and generate visual futures that reflect those responses without prescribed future agent trajectories. To realize this capability, we introduce ReactDrive, a driving world model that jointly learns agent dynamics and visual generation through a shared agent state representation. Within this framework, dynamics supervision grounds a reactive dynamics prior in observed agent states, while the video objective jointly optimizes the self-reactivity and visual realism. Experiments show improved agent responses, ego controllability, and video quality, a 96.0% preference for agent reactivity in human comparisons across five baselines, and better downstream planning through augmentation with generated videos. We hope this work encourages the community to recognize self-reactivityas a foundational capability for developing and evaluating interactive world models. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出驾驶世界模型的"自反应性"(self-reactivity)定义与ReactDrive，通过共享智能体状态表示联合学习智能体动力学与视频生成，仅给定自车动作即可生成反映其他智能体响应的未来视频。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型应在给定自车动作时捕获其他智能体的反应（世界自身的动力学），而现有驾驶视频生成常依赖预设的未来智能体轨迹，导致对机动安全性的误判，削弱生成视频用于策略评估与学习的可靠性。
AI.method: 定义self-reactivity能力并构建ReactDrive：单一共享的智能体状态表示同时驱动动力学分支与视觉生成分支；以观测到的智能体状态对动力学进行监督，形成反应性动力学先验，视频目标联合优化自反应性与视觉真实感，无预设未来智能体轨迹。
AI.result: 智能体响应、自车可控性与视频质量均有提升；五个基线的人工对比中智能体反应性偏好率达96.0%；用生成视频做数据增广后下游规划性能改善。
AI.conclusion: 自反应性应被视为交互式世界模型的基础能力，用于开发与评估驾驶世界模型；为世界模型提供无需未来轨迹标注的可控反应式生成范式。

title: TSIR: Ray-Traced Triangle Splats for Inverse Rendering
summary: Inverse rendering enables realistic relighting for visual effects and augmented reality. However, overlapping Gaussian primitives complicate surface recovery and require costly multi-layer traversal and compositing for light transport. We propose TSIR, a two-stage inverse rendering method that reconstructs relightable triangle splats from multi-view images. The first stage prepares opaque triangle splats with learnable vertex shading normals. The second stage directly traces these surfaces to estimate materials through Monte Carlo integration of direct illumination and indirect reflections, reducing reliance on multi-layer compositing. Anti-aliasing improves rendering quality while maintaining efficiency. Experiments demonstrate higher relighting quality than the evaluated baselines and more efficient anti-aliasing than supersampling.

AI.tldr: TSIR: 两阶段逆渲染，从多视图图像重建可重光照的三角形splat，第二阶段直接对表面进行光线追踪，用蒙特卡洛积分估计直接光照与间接反射下的材质，减少多层合成开销，并用抗锯齿提升质量。
AI.motivation: 高斯primitive相互重叠导致表面恢复困难，光传输需要昂贵的多层遍历与合成；需要一种能直接追踪表面、提升重光照质量与效率的逆渲染方案。
AI.method: 两阶段：(1) 构建带可学习顶点着色法线的不透明三角形splat；(2) 直接对这些表面做光线追踪，通过直接光照与间接反射的蒙特卡洛积分估计材质；加入抗锯齿以提升渲染质量并保持效率。
AI.result: 实验显示重光照质量优于所评估基线，抗锯齿比超采样更高效。
AI.conclusion: 以不透明三角形splat替代重叠高斯、结合路径追踪式材质估计，是一种有效且高效的逆渲染与重光照流程。

title: RoboColiseum: Co-evolution of Simulation, Evaluation, and Models
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. The first eight authors contributed equally. Maoqing Yao and Qian Wang are the corresponding authors
summary: Simulation-based evaluation of embodied models requires calibrated interactions, diverse tasks, and explicit execution constraints. We present RoboColiseum, a platform combining system identification, composable physics and rendering, and multidimensional benchmarking. Recorded-command replay characterizes robot dynamics and object interactions, while a shared interface connects rigid and deformable simulation to rendering. Across 22 paired real--simulation robot--task configurations, task scores have a reported Pearson correlation of 0.9686. Eight evaluation tracks span instruction following, spatial reasoning, general manipulation, robustness, dexterous manipulation, precision manipulation, whole-body coordination, and execution across robot embodiments. Budget-aware scoring combines task progress, resource use, and completion rewards. We report 12 selected Season~I policies and all 11 systems on the public Season~II leaderboard, comprising eight Agent systems and three VLA policies. Agent2Act connects language models to robot-control execution; the VLA study uses mixed-task supervised fine-tuning. The results reveal substantial variation across tracks within each evaluation category. RoboColiseum connects simulation development with capability-oriented evaluation and provides a foundation for extending robot interactions and model assessment.

AI.tldr: RoboColiseum：整合系统辨识（记录指令回放）、刚柔体组合物理与渲染、多维评分（预算感知）的具身模型仿真评测平台，22 组真实-仿真配对任务 Pearson 相关 0.9686，八条评测赛道与两季排行榜。
AI.motivation: 具身模型评测缺乏可校准交互、多样任务与显式执行约束；现有仿真基准与真实机器人表现脱节，且评测维度单一（只看成功率，忽视资源与效率）。
AI.method: 用记录指令回放做机器人动力学与物体交互的系统辨识；统一接口连接刚体/柔体仿真与渲染，支持可组合物理与渲染；构建八条赛道（指令跟随、空间推理、通用操作、鲁棒性、灵巧操作、精细操作、全身协调、跨本体执行），采用预算感知评分融合任务进度、资源消耗与完成奖励；接入 Agent2Act（语言模型到控制执行）与混合任务 SFT 的 VLA 策略参与评测。
AI.result: 22 组配对真实-仿真配置下任务分数 Pearson 相关 0.9686，显示较高仿真-真实对齐；报告 Season I 12 个策略与 Season II 排行榜 11 个系统（8 个 Agent 系统、3 个 VLA 策略），各评测类别内部赛道间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: RoboColiseum 将仿真建设与能力导向评测打通，为扩展机器人交互与模型评估提供基础，但核心贡献在基准/平台层面，方法学新意有限。

title: BeyondEgo: Learning to Act Beyond Egocentric Perception via Humanoid Ego-Exo Foresight
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinating whole-body motion to perform manipulation tasks in complex environments. Yet egocentric vision-language-action (VLA) policies can miss critical body--scene relationships, and action imitation alone provides no explicit supervision for future scene evolution. We propose BeyondEgo to extend VLA perception in space and time. Spatially, we encode a synchronized exocentric view with frozen DINOv3 and concatenate the resulting tokens with egocentric VLM tokens to condition the action expert. Temporally, we use future observations from both views as privileged supervision for a residual adapter on task-conditioned VLM features. A foresight expert regresses DINOv3 representations of both views 0.6s ahead. At deployment, the foresight expert is discarded and the 4.2M-parameter adapter is retained. We also introduce HELM, to our knowledge, the first closed-loop humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark with synchronized egocentric and exocentric views across five whole-body this http URL HELM, BeyondEgo improves success from 48.0% to 92.0% in distribution and from 23.5% to 65.0% on 200 held-out scenes with layout, asset, material, and lighting shifts. Ablations show that dual-view DINOv3 foresight yields the best transfer results.

AI.tldr: BeyondEgo 通过引入同步外视角视觉与未来观测的"预见"监督，扩展 egocentric VLA 的时空感知，用于人形全身移动操作，在 HELM 基准上将成功率从 48%→92%（同分布）与 23.5%→65%（分布外）。
AI.motivation: 人形 loco-manipulation 需全身协同，但纯自我中心 VLA 易缺失关键的躯体—场景关系；仅做动作模仿缺乏对未来场景演化的显式监督。
AI.method: 空间上：用冻结 DINOv3 编码同步外视角（exocentric）图像，token 与 egocentric VLM token 拼接后作为动作 expert 的条件；时间上：将双视角未来观测作为特权监督，训练一个位于任务条件化 VLM 特征上的残差 adapter，由 foresight expert 回归 0.6s 后的双视角 DINOv3 表征；部署时丢弃 foresight expert，仅保留 4.2M 参数 adapter。另提出 HELM 闭环人形 loco-manipulation 基准（含同步第一/第三人称视角）。
AI.result: HELM 上成功率由 48.0%→92.0%（同分布），在 200 个含布局/资产/材质/光照变化的留出场景上由 23.5%→65.0%；消融显示双视角 DINOv3 预见监督迁移效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 以低成本（4.2M 可训练参数、部署时无需未来帧与外视角编码器以外的额外模块）为 VLA 增加空间与时间感知先验，显著提升人形全身操作的鲁棒性与泛化性。

title: A Learning-Enhanced Control Scheme for Aerial Manipulator Under Composite Disturbances
summary: Achieving high-precision dynamic tracking in aerial manipulators remains fundamentally challenging due to strong coupling effects and external disturbances. Existing approaches are typically limited to compensating first-order coupling term, leaving higher-order nonlinearities unaddressed. Building upon the philosophy of learning-for-control, this paper proposes a composite control scheme that combines learning-based approximation with observer-based compensation in a complementary manner. Based on the polynomial decomposition theorem, the unknown high-order term is decomposed into a shared constant basis matrix, a state-related polynomial matrix, and a task-related parameter vector. A bilevel optimization formula is first established to extract the task-invariant shared information, enabling efficient knowledge reuse across different operation conditions. By leveraging the learned shared basis, an adaptive law is designed to update the task-dependent parameter vector online. Furthermore, an observer is introduced to compensate for the inevitable approximation residual and external disturbances. The resulting framework leads to a concurrent attainment of the stable transient response and high-precision steady-state tracking performance. Extensive real-world experiments on an aerial manipulator across four representative scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出学习+观测器的复合控制：用多项式分解定理把未知高阶耦合项拆为共享常数基矩阵、状态相关多项式矩阵和任务相关参数向量，双层优化离线学共享基，自适应律在线更新参数，观测器补偿残差与扰动，空中机械臂四场景实机实验验证。
AI.motivation: 空中机械臂动态跟踪受强耦合与外扰影响；现有方法仅补偿一阶耦合项，高阶非线性未处理，且不同工况下知识无法复用。
AI.method: 基于多项式分解定理的参数化建模 + 双层优化提取任务不变共享基 + 在线自适应律更新任务相关参数 + 观测器补偿近似残差与外部扰动，构成学习与控制互补的复合框架。
AI.result: 在空中机械臂四个代表性场景的实机实验中验证了有效性与鲁棒性，兼顾稳定瞬态响应与高精度稳态跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 将学习式近似与观测器补偿结构化结合，可解决高阶耦合补偿与跨任务知识复用问题，为空中操作提供可迁移的复合控制范式。

title: Towards Text-Mask Consistency in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Vision-language models for medical image segmentation often produce masks that conflict with the accompanying text, especially under multi-site/multi-lesion descriptions. We trace this failure to two factors: (i) highly templated and repetitive clinical language causes one-to-one hard contrastive learning to yield numerous false negatives, weakening cross-modal alignment; and (ii) predominantly vision-driven, one-way cross-attention lacks a language-dominant, spatially aware pathway, hindering effective injection of textual semantics into the spatial visual domain. To this end, we propose Consistency-enhanced Two-stage Segmentation (C2Seg). In the pretraining stage, Cluster-aware Contrastive Learning uses a frozen strong baseline to construct an intra-batch text similarity matrix as soft labels, thereby alleviating false negative conflicts and producing more discriminative visual representations. In the fusion stage, we introduce a Bidirectional Complementary Attention Module, where each modality dominates attention along its own path, fostering deep interaction and structural consistency between visual and textual representations. In order to enhance the expressive power of multimodal features, we further adopt KAN-based Attention Gating. Without updating the language encoder, our approach significantly improves text-mask consistency and segmentation accuracy on four public medical imaging datasets. The source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: C2Seg：医学图文分割中，用聚类感知对比学习（以冻结强基线构造批内文本相似度软标签）缓解模板化文本导致的假负样本，并用双向互补注意力（各模态主导自身路径）+KAN注意力门控增强跨模态融合，在四个公开医学数据集上显著提升文本-掩码一致性与分割精度，且不更新语言编码器。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉-语言分割模型生成的掩码常与文本描述冲突，尤其在多部位/多病灶描述下。作者归因于两点：(i) 高度模板化、重复的临床语言使一对一的硬对比学习产生大量假负样本，削弱跨模态对齐；(ii) 以视觉为主导的单向交叉注意力缺少语言主导且具备空间感知的通路，难以将文本语义有效注入空间视觉域。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。预训练阶段：Cluster-aware Contrastive Learning，用冻结的强基线模型构建批内文本相似度矩阵作为软标签，替代一对一硬负样本，产出更具判别性的视觉表征。融合阶段：Bidirectional Complementary Attention Module，每个模态在各自路径上主导注意力，实现视觉与文本表征的深度交互与结构一致性；并引入基于KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold Network）的注意力门控以增强多模态特征表达力。语言编码器保持冻结。
AI.result: 在四个公开医学影像数据集上，文本-掩码一致性与分割精度均显著提升，且无需更新语言编码器；源代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: C2Seg通过软标签聚类对比学习抑制假负样本冲突，并以双向互补注意力实现语言主导的空间语义注入，为医学图文分割中的跨模态一致性问题提供了有效且轻量的方案。

title: A Continuous Relaxation of Quantization-Aware Training
summary: Quantization is a critical piece of the deployment pipeline in the era of large generative models. Low-bit quantization, particularly 2-bits or sub-2-bits, is a notoriously difficult problem, particularly when using a channelwise quantization scheme which has been shown as a leading candidate for hardware-efficiency. The key challenges with low-bit quantization range from limited quantization levels to saddle points or flat regions in the loss surface. In this paper, we look at the problem of flat quantization loss surfaces through a lens of dynamically changing bitwidth. Unlike existing techniques which either change the bit-precision abruptly or keep it fixed, we propose to gradually alter the bitwidth as the model trains. To this end, we propose RelaxQAT, a continuous relaxation of the QAT process. We also provide simple theoretical and empirical insights behind why RelaxQAT helps the QAT performance. Our extensive experiments demonstrate up to 6.3% average accuracy gains on vision and up to 7.7% better average accuracy on natural language tasks, compared to the leading QAT methods.

AI.tldr: RelaxQAT提出在量化感知训练中连续/渐进地改变位宽，以缓解低比特（2-bit及以下）逐通道量化中的平坦损失面问题，在视觉和NLP任务上平均精度分别提升至多6.3%和7.7%。
AI.motivation: 大生成模型部署需低比特量化，2-bit及以下逐通道量化极难，受限于量化级数少以及损失曲面存在鞍点/平坦区域；现有方法位精度要么突变要么固定。
AI.method: 将QAT过程做连续松弛：训练过程中逐步（渐进）调整量化位宽而非固定或骤变，从而绕过平坦区域；作者还给出简要理论与实证分析解释其有效性。
AI.result: 视觉任务平均精度最高提升6.3%，自然语言任务最高提升7.7%，优于主流QAT方法。
AI.conclusion: 以动态位宽连续松弛为核心的RelaxQAT是低比特逐通道量化的有效方案，具备实用部署价值与部分理论解释。

title: Learning 3D MRI Representations with Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Learning representations of visual images is a challenging task. It requires extracting abstract patterns from high-dimensional data without explicit supervision. This becomes pronounced with 3D MR imaging due to sparse features, higher dimensional inputs, and smaller datasets. Many state-of-the-art representation learning algorithms successfully rely on transformers and diffusion-based architectures. However, these methods struggle with smaller datasets. In effect, solution methods relax the problem by slicing 3D volumes and solving the problem for 2D medical imaging, resulting in a loss of spatial 3D information. We present R2RG, a representation learning method based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) honing the reconstruction task. Our key insights lie in exploiting architectural biases in 3D CNNs, combined with data-efficient auto-encoding GANs and a composite loss function to enhance reconstruction fidelity and stabilize training. Our experiments on three standard datasets and a locally collected dataset show that R2RG not only achieves superior performance but also generalizes to heterogeneous and smaller datasets. Furthermore, representations learned with R2RG outperform those learned with contrastive-based representation learning methods on Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease classification. Our work demonstrates that reconstruction-based representation learning is a promising direction for 3D medical imaging under limited data availability.

AI.tldr: R2RG：基于3D CNN + 数据高效自编码GAN的3D磁共振影像重建式表征学习方法。
AI.motivation: 3D MRI 表征学习面临特征稀疏、输入维度高、数据集小的问题；Transformer/扩散模型在小数据上表现不佳，常用做法是把3D体数据切成2D切片处理，导致空间信息丢失。
AI.method: 端到端3D CNN编码器-解码器，以GAN框架增强重建任务，利用3D卷积架构先验（inductive bias），配合数据高效的自编码GAN与复合损失函数提升重建保真度并稳定训练；全程使用完整3D体积，不做2D切片。
AI.result: 在三个标准数据集及一个自采数据集上性能优越，并能泛化到异构、更小规模的数据；所学报征在帕金森病与阿尔茨海默病分类上优于对比学习类方法。
AI.conclusion: 在小数据条件下，重建式表征学习是3D医学影像的可行为方向；3D卷积先验结合GAN自编码器可避免2D切片带来的空间信息损失。

title: Rethinking Cross-Sensor Domain Adaptation for Bridge Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
summary: Segmentation models for bridge point clouds lose accuracy when trained on terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) data and applied to mobile laser scanning (MLS) data. This study re-examines the SemanticBridge TLS-to-MLS protocol to determine how sampling density, surface roughness, color, and acquisition viewpoint are expressed in the 8-cm sparse-voxel representation, and how adaptation gains depend on source-model convergence. Using one sparse-convolution U-Net, we combine raw-point statistics with controlled input perturbations and compare adaptive batch normalization, entropy minimization, Mean Teacher, and confidence-filtered self-training under 100- and 300-epoch schedules. TLS and MLS have similar nearest-neighbor spacing after preprocessing (12.08 and 12.02 mm), and a 4-mm perturbation of TLS points changes voxel occupancy by only 4.4%. Color distributions differ systematically, but zeroing color on identical voxels changes target mean intersection over union (mIoU) by only +0.02, and by +0.06 after the color augmentation is scale-corrected. The sensors also observe different portions of the bridge, yielding different class proportions. A 300-epoch source-only model obtains 57.80 mIoU on the paired-bridge protocol. Confidence-filtered self-training improves the 100-epoch baseline, but from a converged model it changes target mIoU by -0.97 (source-selected checkpoints) and -2.44 (final-50-epoch means). Repeated evaluation (standard deviation 0.27-0.64) and seed variation (1.88 across three seeds) are comparable to several method differences. Adaptation results on this benchmark therefore depend on representation scale, source-model convergence, and evaluation variability.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视SemanticBridge的TLS-to-MLS桥梁点云分割迁移协议，量化采样密度、表面粗糙度、颜色与视角在8cm稀疏体素表示中的表达，并比较四种域自适应方法及源模型收敛程度对迁移增益的影响。
AI.motivation: TLS训练的桥梁点云分割模型在MLS数据上精度下降，需厘清域偏移到底体现在哪些属性上，以及文献中域自适应收益为何不稳定——是否为表示尺度、源模型收敛度与评测方差所致。
AI.method: 单一稀疏卷积U-Net骨干；结合原始点云统计与受控输入扰动（4mm抖动、颜色置零、尺度校正的颜色增强）分析8cm体素表示；在100与300 epoch两种调度下比较AdaBN、熵最小化、Mean Teacher与置信度过滤自训练；重复评测与多随机种子评估方差。
AI.result: 预处理后TLS/MLS最近邻间距接近（12.08 vs 12.02 mm），4mm扰动仅改变4.4%体素占用；颜色差异系统性但影响小（mIoU +0.02，尺度校正后+0.06）；300 epoch源模型在配对桥梁协议上达57.80 mIoU；自训练在收敛模型上反而下降（-0.97/-2.44）；重复评测标准差0.27-0.64，种子间波动1.88，与多方法差异量级相当。
AI.conclusion: 该基准上的自适应结论高度依赖表示尺度、源模型收敛度与评测方差；颜色与密度并非主要域偏移源，需重新审视桥梁点云跨平台迁移的评测规程。

title: PACE: Policy Augmentation and Compensation With Explicit Disturbance Estimation for Robust Locomotion
summary: Reinforcement learning has made quadrupedal locomotion remarkably robust. To handle unmodeled dynamics and external disturbances, domain randomization is usually employed to make a policy hedge against every condition it might meet. However, maintaining accurate tracking across varying dynamics and generalizing beyond the sampled range remain challenging. Here we show that explicitly estimating the disturbance and feeding the resulting estimation back into both the policy and the controller can relax this compromise. We introduce Policy Augmentation and Compensation with Explicit disturbance estimation (PACE). The framework lumps payload variations, center-of-mass (CoM) shifts, actuator degradation, and external forces into one joint-space disturbance. A nonlinear observer subsequently recovers this disturbance online without requiring joint acceleration measurements. The disturbance estimation provides feedforward torque compensation as the foundational control pathway and further augments the policy observation to enable disturbance-aware action generation. Considering the learning difficulty of fast-varying contact effects, we further provide an analytical contact estimation approach from joint and inertial measurements, without demanding force sensors. Across eleven simulated dynamics conditions, PACE reduces velocity-tracking error by 18.1% to 57.0% against state-of-the-art baselines, and maintains improved tracking under out-of-distribution (OOD) commands. Notably, in real-world experiments, the deployed real robot carried an 11.5 kg payload, nearly equal to its own mass. It also negotiated unseen 16 cm step-downs and crossed five outdoor terrains. The policy was trained exclusively on flat ground in simulation with at most 3 kg of added mass.

AI.tldr: PACE框架将负载、质心偏移、执行器退化与外力统一为关节空间扰动，用无需关节加速度测量的非线性观测器在线估计，并以观测器输出同时做前馈力矩补偿与策略观测增强；另给出无需力传感器的解析接触估计。仿真11种动力学条件下速度跟踪误差较SOTA降低18.1%–57.0%，并在OOD指令下保持优势；真机携带11.5 kg（近自重）负载、下未知16 cm台阶并穿越5种户外地形，而策略仅在平地仿真中最多加3 kg质量训练。
AI.motivation: 域随机化虽使四足运动鲁棒，但需在"对每种可能条件留余量"上折衷，导致在变化动力学下难以维持精确跟踪，且难以泛化到采样范围之外。作者希望通过显式扰动估计来放松这一折衷。
AI.method: （1）将payload变化、CoM偏移、执行器退化与外力集总为单一关节空间扰动；（2）设计非线性扰动量观测器，在线估计且不需关节加速度测量；（3）估计值双路复用：作为前馈力矩补偿的底层控制通道，并拼接进策略观测以实现扰动感知的动作生成；（4）针对快变接触效应的学习困难，提出基于关节与惯性测量的解析接触估计，免用力传感器。
AI.result: 仿真中11种动力学条件下速度跟踪误差降低18.1%–57.0%（对SOTA基线），OOD指令下跟踪性能仍优；真机上携带11.5 kg负载（约等于自身质量），完成未见过的16 cm下台阶与5种户外地形穿越，训练仅用平地仿真、最多3 kg附加质量。
AI.conclusion: 显式扰动估计＋前馈补偿＋观测增强是缓解域随机化"鲁棒性-精度"折衷的有效途径，并可显著提升对分布外负载与地形的泛化，训练成本低。

title: V2VFusion: Text-Controlled Video-to-Video Diffusion for Degradation-Aware Video Fusion
summary: Video fusion integrates complementary information in multiple source video streams into a single sequence for complete scene perception. Existing methods perform frame-wise fusion and lack unified spatio-temporal modeling across sequences, damaging temporal coherence across sequences. When dealing with degradations, they also ignore temporal dynamics and overload a single network with diverse degradations, leading to limited and imbalanced degradation suppression. To address these issues, we propose V2VFusion, the first unified video-to-video fusion framework that directly generates temporally coherent, high-quality fused videos from degraded multi-source inputs. By reformulating video fusion as a video-to-video conditional generation problem in latent diffusion space, our approach holistically models spatio-temporal dependencies across entire sequences and intrinsically ensures sequence-level consistency. On this basis, a text-guided degradation-conditioned ControlNet bridges high-level textual degradation descriptions with low-level visual priors, enabling interpretable and controllable guidance for structure-preserving fusion beyond purely data-driven conditioning. To handle heterogeneous and compound degradations, a state-modulated degradation-aware hierarchical mixture-of-experts module decouples expert selection into diffusion-state-aware filtering and degradation-aware routing. It prevents unreliable routing and fosters expert specialization to mitigate representation conflicts among diverse degradations. Experiments on infrared-visible, multi-exposure, and multi-focus video fusion tasks and complex degradations validate that V2VFusion surpasses existing methods in fusion quality and temporal stability. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: V2VFusion：首个统一视频到视频融合框架，将视频融合重构为潜扩散空间中的视频到视频条件生成问题，直接由退化多源输入生成时序一致的高质量融合视频，并引入文本引导的退化条件ControlNet与状态调制退化感知分层MoE。
AI.motivation: 现有视频融合方法逐帧融合、缺乏跨序列统一时空建模，破坏时序一致性；面对退化时忽略时间动态、把多种退化塞进单一网络，导致抑制效果有限且不均衡。
AI.method: 将视频融合重构为潜扩散空间中的视频到视频条件生成，整体建模全序列时空依赖以保证序列级一致性；文本引导的退化条件ControlNet将高层文本退化描述与低层视觉先验桥接，实现可解释、可控的结构保持融合；状态调制退化感知分层混合专家（MoE）将专家选择解耦为扩散状态感知过滤与退化感知路由，避免不可靠路由并促进专家专门化。
AI.result: 在红外-可见光、多曝光、多聚焦视频融合任务及复杂退化上，融合质量与时序稳定性均优于现有方法；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 统一视频到视频扩散框架为多源视频融合提供了时序一致且可控退化的新范式，MoE路由解耦设计有效缓解异构退化间的表征冲突。

title: $R^2$: Recognizing and Reducing Redundant Visual Tool Use
summary: Recent studies have shown that visual tools can improve multimodal reasoning. However, the effects of tools vary substantially across samples, and benchmark accuracy alone does not reveal whether tool interactions are beneficial or redundant. We present $R^2$, a framework that recognizes and reduces redundant visual tool use in vision-language models. We first introduce a sample-level Category Analysis of Tool Utility (CAT), which categorizes samples according to whether a model can benefit from tools. This analysis reveals that benchmark scores may obscure a model's tool-use ability. Across seven benchmarks, samples benefiting from tools account for at most 12.44% of each benchmark, while the majority gain little from tool interaction or are even harmed by it. To assess individual calls, we propose the Visual Feedback Dependency (VFD) metric, which compares the likelihood of the same subsequent reasoning under actual and alternative visual feedback without an external evaluator or trajectory regeneration. Redundancy-Aware GRPO (RA-GRPO) combines this dependency signal with a category-conditioned base call cost to assign relative efficiency advantages among correct trajectories, supplementing outcome-based supervision. Across the seven benchmarks, RA-GRPO reduces the mean number of tool calls by 12.39% relative to Vanilla GRPO at comparable benchmark accuracy. Evaluated by tool-utility category, RA-GRPO improves category macro-average accuracy over Vanilla GRPO by 3.35 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出R²框架，用样本级工具效用分类(CAT)揭示基准分数掩盖工具使用能力，用Visual Feedback Dependency(VFD)评估单次调用必要性，并以RA-GRPO在正确轨迹间分配相对效率优势，减少冗余视觉工具调用。
AI.motivation: 多模态推理中视觉工具收益随样本差异极大，基准准确率无法反映工具交互是否真正有益或冗余，缺乏对单次工具调用必要性的细粒度评估与训练信号。
AI.method: CAT：按能否从工具获益对样本分类（受控对比工具可用/不可用）。VFD：对比真实与替代视觉反馈下同一后续推理似然，无需外部评估器或轨迹重生成即可量化依赖。RA-GRPO：将VFD依赖信号与类别条件化的基础调用代价结合，为正确轨迹分配相对效率优势，作为outcome监督的补充。
AI.result: 七个基准上，受益于工具的样本最多仅占12.44%；相对Vanilla GRPO，RA-GRPO在准确率相当下平均减少12.39%工具调用，按工具效用类别的宏平均准确率提升3.35个百分点。
AI.conclusion: VA-VLM工具使用存在大量冗余，显式建模单次调用的视觉反馈依赖并据此做细粒度奖励塑形，可在不牺牲甚至提升分类均衡准确率的前提下显著降低工具调用开销。
