title: Hindsight Forcing: Learning Better History from the Future in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables real-time streaming generation, with each generated chunk serving as historical context for subsequent generation. To avoid the memory explosion of backpropagation through time, previous self-rollout methods typically truncate cross-chunk gradients or detach historical latents. As a result, earlier denoising computations receive no downstream feedback through the generated history on how to synthesize frames that facilitate subsequent generation, leading to visual drift and structural collapse as rollouts extend. To address this limitation, we propose Hindsight Forcing, which allows historical chunks to learn directly from future outcomes by decoupling forward generation from backward credit assignment via a latent straight-through bridge. In the forward pass, each chunk completes a full multi-step rollout to update the KV cache. In the backward pass, the bridge routes gradients from future losses back to a single selected denoising step per historical chunk, training both the context writer and historical denoiser on shared parameters without retaining the full trajectory graph. Remarkably, Hindsight Forcing requires no additional model parameters, architecture modifications, or separate trajectory replay. Extensive experiments on VBench demonstrate that Hindsight Forcing outperforms existing baselines in overall visual quality and dynamic motion, while ablation studies validate the benefit of supervising historical denoising. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Hindsight Forcing: 通过latent straight-through桥接解耦前向生成与反向信用分配，使少步自回归视频扩散的历史chunk能接收未来损失梯度，无需BPTT全图、无需额外参数即可缓解长 rollout 的视觉漂移与结构坍塌。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散用于实时流式生成时，每个chunk作为后续生成的历史上下文。既有self-rollout方法为规避BPTT内存爆炸而截断跨chunk梯度或detach历史latent，导致早期去噪计算得不到下游反馈，rollout变长后出现视觉漂移与结构坍塌。
AI.method: 前向：每个chunk完成完整多步rollout以更新KV cache；反向：借助latent straight-through bridge，将未来损失梯度路由回每个历史chunk中被选定的单个去噪步，从而在共享参数上同时训练context writer与历史denoiser，保留梯度通路但不保留完整轨迹图。无额外参数、无架构改动、无轨迹重放。
AI.result: VBench上在整体视觉质量与动态运动方面优于现有基线；消融实验验证了对历史去噪过程施加监督的收益。
AI.conclusion: 以极低工程/内存代价为流式自回归视频扩散引入跨chunk的时序信用分配，是一种通用、可插拔的训练策略改进。

title: Fooling the Mind Twice: Human Detection of Audiovisual Deepfakes Under Repeated Exposure and Corrective Feedback
summary: Human deepfake detection remains unreliable, and whether reassessment with corrective feedback improves subsequent judgments remains unclear. This study examined differences between initial and repeated deepfake assessments among 110 participants using audiovisual stimuli from the FakeAVCeleb and Deepfake Detection Challenge (DFDC) datasets. Participants evaluated 40 videos from each dataset in phase 1 (PhaseI) and reassessed the same videos in phase 2 (PhaseII) under a procedure combining repeated presentation and corrective feedback. For the FakeAVCeleb dataset, the participants' mean accuracy increased by 4.68 percentage points from 63.30 in PhaseI to 67.98 in PhaseII (t(109)=5.61, p<.001, d_z=0.54). A judgment-level logistic regression with standard errors clustered by participant and video produced a consistent result: beta=0.208, SE=0.040, z=5.23, p<.001, {OR}=1.23. For the DFDC dataset, the participants' mean accuracy increased by 8.64 percentage points from 59.52% in PhaseI to 68.16% in PhaseII (t(109)=7.37, p<.001, d_z=0.70); the logistic model yielded: beta=0.375, SE=0.065, z=5.78, p<.001, {OR}=1.46. Improvements primarily came from fewer false negatives, while false-positive rates remained unchanged. However, judgment reversals occurred in 27.55% of FakeAVCeleb and 32.91% of DFDC assessments, with some initially correct judgments becoming incorrect upon reassessment. Despite the accuracy gains, repeated assessment did not eliminate judgment instability or residual error. Participants also exhibited consistent overconfidence, with mean self-rated confidence exceeding actual accuracy by 11.99 percentage points for FakeAVCeleb and 12.82 percentage points for DFDC across both phases. These findings indicate that repetition with corrective feedback moderately improves deepfake detection but does not fully resolve the limitations of human judgment.

AI.tldr: 该研究让110名被试在两阶段中对FakeAVCeleb与DFDC各40段音视频进行评估，第二阶段引入重复呈现加纠正性反馈，检验深度伪造检测准确率与信心校准的变化。
AI.motivation: 人类深度伪造检测能力不可靠，且重复评估配合纠正性反馈能否改善后续判断尚不清楚。
AI.method: 被试在PhaseI与PhaseII中对同一批视频各评估一次，PhaseII结合重复呈现与纠正性反馈；采用配对t检验与以被试和视频为聚类稳健标准误的判定级logistic回归比较两阶段准确率，并统计判断反转率与自评信心偏差。
AI.result: FakeAVCeleb准确率由63.30%升至67.98%（提升4.68个百分点，t(109)=5.61，p<.001，d_z=0.54；回归β=0.208，OR=1.23）；DFDC由59.52%升至68.16%（提升8.64个百分点，t(109)=7.37，p<.001，d_z=0.70；β=0.375，OR=1.46）。提升主要来自假阴性减少，假阳性率不变；判断反转率分别为27.55%与32.91%；两阶段自评信心平均分别高出实际准确率11.99与12.82个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 重复评估加纠正性反馈仅带来中等幅度提升，未消除判断不稳定与残余错误，过度自信持续存在，人类判断局限难以完全解决。

title: PIU-CR: Physics-Informed Deep Unfolding with SAR-Optical Image Fusion for Cloud Removal
summary: Multi-modal cloud removal exploits complementary optical and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images to restore cloud-degraded remote sensing images. Most existing methods rely on black-box, data-driven architectures with limited interpretability of cross-modal interactions. Although some attempts introduce physical priors into networks, their oversimplified formulations fail to faithfully characterize the underlying physical imaging process and the networks remain loosely coupled with optimization variables. To address these issues, we propose a physics-informed deep unfolding network for cloud removal via optical-SAR image fusion, termed as PIU-CR. We first formulate cloud removal as a physics-informed optimization problem. Specifically, we fundamentally ground the optimization in the physical imaging mechanism of cloud degradation by embedding the atmospheric scattering model into the data fidelity term. Then, the regularization terms establish an explicit cross-modal interaction mechanism, overcoming the single-modal information scarcity and the obscure, uninterpretable interactions in black-box models. They are dedicated to SAR-guided structure and spectral regularization, jointly introducing cross-modal structural feature alignment and coordinated spectral consistency constraints. The resulting optimization problem is then unfolded into a multi-stage neural network with dedicated structure and spectral branches. Each stage corresponds to an explicit optimization iteration step, enabling interpretable and effective reconstruction process. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PIU-CR将去云建模为物理驱动优化问题(嵌入大气散射模型到数据保真项,SAR引导的结构/光谱正则化),再展开为多阶段可解释网络。
AI.motivation: 现有光学-SAR多模态去云方法多为黑盒数据驱动架构,跨模态交互可解释性差;少数引入物理先验的方法公式过于简化,不能忠实刻画成像物理过程,且网络与优化变量耦合松散。
AI.method: 将去云形式化为物理驱动优化问题:数据保真项嵌入大气散射模型以反映云退化成像机理;正则项构建显式跨模态交互机制,含SAR引导的结构正则与光谱正则,联合进行跨模态结构特征对齐与光谱一致性约束。随后将优化问题展开为含结构与光谱双分支的多阶段深度展开网络,每阶段对应一次显式优化迭代。
AI.result: 实验表明所提方法优于现有最先进方法,代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 物理先验+深度展开为多模态遥感去云提供了兼顾可解释性与性能的有效范式。

title: UDA-Restoration: Bridging Unsupervised Domain Adaptation and Multi-Degradation Denoising for Enhanced AV Semantic Segmentation
summary: Autonomous vehicles rely heavily on vision-based perception systems for safe navigation and decision-making. Adverse weather conditions, sensor noise, moving artifacts and illumination changes, however, often degrade the image quality and hence reduce perception performance. This paper introduces a diffusion-guided unsupervised domain adaptation algorithm for autonomous driving environments, namely UDA-Restoration, which is designed to enhance and denoise images. The proposed method follows the paradigm of Noise-Space Domain Adaptation (Noise-DA), which is based on multi-source degradation learning and diffusion-guided adaptation that spans across synthetic and real-world degradations. The framework has been extensively tested and shown to restore image quality and to be robust to unseen degradation scenarios, such as snow, haze, sensor distortions, and more. The quantitative results indicate that Noise-DA outperforms the evaluated self-supervised and unsupervised baselines while matching the best supervised restoration performance. In addition, semantic segmentation experiments show that the performance of downstream perception tasks is directly improved by better image restoration. The outcomes show the promise of unsupervised domain adaptation based on diffusion as a powerful and scalable method for image restoration tasks in autonomous driving systems under various environments.

AI.tldr: UDA-Restoration 提出基于 Noise-Space Domain Adaptation 的扩散引导无监督域适应图像增强与去噪方法，用于自动驾驶恶劣天气/传感器噪声下的图像复原，并提升下游语义分割性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶视觉感知易受雨雪、雾霾、传感器噪声、光照变化等退化影响，导致感知性能下降；现有方法对未见退化场景泛化不足，且缺乏跨合成与真实退化的统一无监督适应框架。
AI.method: 提出 Noise-DA 范式：多源退化学习 + 扩散引导的域适应，在噪声空间中跨合成与真实退化进行对齐；构成 UDA-Restoration 框架，对图像进行增强与去噪，无需配对监督，仅以无监督域适应方式训练。
AI.result: 在雪、雾、传感器畸变等退化及未见场景下恢复图像质量并表现稳健；定量上优于所对比的自监督与无监督基线，并与最佳监督复原方法性能相当；下游语义分割实验显示复原质量提升可直接改善感知任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 扩散驱动的无监督域适应可作为自动驾驶图像复原的可扩展有效方案；但工作聚焦图像复原层面，缺乏闭环感知或规划层面的真实部署验证，对具身/物理 AI 的直接可迁移性有限。

title: EgoSurgHands: An Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Dataset & Benchmark for Open Surgery Training
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code, dataset, and benchmark leaderboard available at this https URL
summary: Surgical skill assessment, AR guidance, and robot learning from demonstration all benefit from 3D tracking of the surgeon's hands, yet no surgical dataset offers real egocentric articulated 3D hand pose. We introduce EgoSurgHands, a benchmark for real-captured egocentric hand pose estimation in open surgery training on synthetic pads. Captured with multi-sensor glasses, it contains 41,909 training hand-instance rows across 55 procedure recordings and 9,476 human-validated evaluation rows across 13 held-out recordings, spanning 13 tasks, 3 glove colors, and 4 trainees from first-year medical student to third-year resident. Each frame carries a multi-sensor stack: intrinsics, hand landmarks with per-hand confidence, timestamps, and eye gaze, plus SLAM extrinsics where SLAM succeeded. Evaluation labels combine sensor-fused pseudo-ground truth, human cross-review of every frame, surgeon adjudication of flagged cases, and an independent multi-view triangulated reference. Alongside the within-corpus, procedure-disjoint split, a leave-one-wearer-out protocol tested unseen trainees. Across eight methods evaluated zero-shot, from MANO-based reconstructors to the two-hand IntagHand and the keypoint-only MediaPipe Hands, egocentric pretraining was associated with stronger transfer on every held-out wearer. WildHands and JointTransformer had 18\% and 40\% lower PA-MPJPE, respectively, than the non-egocentric HaMeR. JointTransformer was the best performing model with an error of 14.95 mm. A substantial surgical domain gap remains, and the widely deployed MediaPipe Hands detected a hand in only 24.1\% of evaluation rows. As a baseline, a 58K-parameter residual corrector (JRN) on frozen backbones reached 10.96-14.85 mm PA-MPJPE on held-out wearers for the two ego-pretrained backbones. We release the dataset and benchmark code at this https URL

AI.tldr: EgoSurgHands：首个真实采集的开放手术训练场景自我中心双手3D姿态基准数据集，含41,909条训练实例/55段录制与9,476条人工校验评测行/13段留出录制，配多传感器眼镜（内外参、带置信度关键点、时间戳、眼动、可用时的SLAM外参），并给出8种零样本方法的系统评测与JRN残差校正基线。
AI.motivation: 手术技能评估、AR引导与机器人示教学习都依赖外科医生手部的3D追踪，但现有手术数据集缺乏真实自我中心（egocentric）的关节化3D手部姿态标注；文档相机视角与第三人称数据也无法捕捉操作者的第一视角手形。
AI.method: 用多传感器眼镜在合成垫上采集开放手术训练数据，覆盖13项任务、3种手套颜色、4名受训者；标签由传感器融合伪真值、逐帧人工交叉复核、外科医生仲裁存疑样本与独立多视角三角化参考共同构成。设置流程不相交划分与"留一佩戴者"（leave-one-wearer-out）跨受训者协议，零样本评测8种方法（MANO类重建器、双手IntagHand、仅关键点MediaPipe Hands），并提出58K参数残差校正器JRN在冻结主干上微调。
AI.result: 自我中心预训练在所有留出佩戴者上均带来更强迁移：WildHands与JointTransformer的PA-MPJPE分别比非自我中心的HaMeR低18%和40%；JointTransformer最优，误差14.95 mm。JRN在两条ego预训练主干上达10.96–14.85 mm PA-MPJPE。仍存在显著手术域差距，常用MediaPipe Hands仅24.1%评测行检出到手。
AI.conclusion: 该基准填补了手术场景真实自我中心3D手部姿态数据的空白，表明ego预训练是跨受训者泛化的关键，轻量残差校正可显著缩小域差距；但手术域差距尚未解决，数据集与基准代码已开源。

title: One state, many questions: Opsis gives a frontier model typed eyes for pathology
comment: 28 pages, 10 figures, 12 tables. Code and data: this https URL
summary: A synoptic pathology report is a checklist of questions with fixed answer sets, many composed from others. Pathology foundation models answer them accurately with one classifier trained with labels for each, and frontier language models, which compose freely, cannot fit a slide of fourteen thousand tiles in their context. On 189 breast report questions, frontier models that read a written description of the slide or look at a thumbnail and tiles of it answer at 0.50 to 0.66, below the majority class at 0.67. A description is written before the question is known, and a look covers a handful of tiles. We present Opsis, which lets the model ask instead: a typed question interface on a frozen pathology encoder. A slide is encoded once, a question names an operator, arguments and candidates given at runtime, and the answer is a probability over the candidates. We build it as a 10 M parameter decoder on frozen Virchow2 tokens (Opsis-S) and inside Qwen3-VL-8B (Opsis-V). Asking Opsis-S, four frontier models answer the breast questions at 0.78 to 0.79, and on 3,797 pan cancer questions asking is 8.6 points above reading. On 995 composite questions that Opsis-S was never trained on, a frontier model composing its answers reaches 0.76, against 0.69 when it looks at the slide and 0.78 for ABMIL trained on each composite. On a pan cancer question set over 10,712 TCGA slides, one Opsis-S decoder matches linear probes trained per question on TITAN and PRISM2 embeddings (average accuracy 0.69 against 0.70 and 0.68). Opsis-S also separates CAMELYON16 metastases without training on that cohort (AUROC 0.86) and localises necrosis from report labels alone (tile AUROC 0.93).

AI.tldr: Opsis 在冻结病理编码器上构建"类型化提问接口"：滑动切片编码一次，问题在运行时指定算子、参数与候选答案，模型输出候选概率分布；用 10M 参数解码器（Opsis-S）或嵌入 Qwen3-VL-8B（Opsis-V）实现，在乳腺/泛癌报告题上显著优于让前沿模型"读描述或看缩略图"的方式。
AI.motivation: 病理结构化报告本质是含组合结构的检查清单，需要自由组合推理；但前沿多模态模型上下文装不下 1.4 万 tile 的切片，只能读文字描述（问题未知时已写好）或看少量 tile，准确率低于多数类基线；专用分类器虽准确但每题需标签、不能组合。
AI.method: 冻结 Virchow2 编码器 + 类型化问题接口：算子 + 运行时参数 + 候选集合，答案为候选上的概率。Opsis-S 为 10M 参数解码器；Opsis-V 将该接口植入 Qwen3-VL-8B。评估含 189 道乳腺题、3797 道泛癌题、995 道未训练的复合题、10712 张 TCGA 切片的泛癌题集，以及 CAMELYON16 迁移与坏死定位。
AI.result: 四款前沿模型调用 Opsis-S 后乳腺题达 0.78–0.79；泛癌题比"读描述"高 8.6 点；未见复合题由前沿模型组合答案达 0.76（看图 0.69，逐题 ABMIL 0.78）；单解码器平均 0.69 与 TITAN/PRISM2 逐题线性探针（0.70/0.68）相当；CAMELYON16 零样本 AUROC 0.86；仅用报告标签定位坏死 tile AUROC 0.93。
AI.conclusion: 以"可组合提问"替代"自由阅读"能弥补冻结编码器与前沿 VLM 在超高分辨率医疗图像上的短板，且单一共享接口可跨多题泛化，无需逐题标签或梯度训练。

title: RemoteEvolver: Expanding Earth Observation Capabilities through Agent Harness Evolution
summary: We are interested in developing a continually self-improving remote sensing agentic system. It should identify and address its capability gaps, retaining the resulting improvements to enhance performance on subsequent tasks. However, existing systems typically rely on fixed toolsets and confine their experience accumulation to re-orchestrating predefined capabilities, constraining both capability expansion and the transfer of improvements across tasks. As the infrastructure for agentic systems, the harness manages tools and workflow knowledge as editable, persistent resources outside the base model. These resources can therefore be updated and reused across tasks without additional post-training. Based on these observations, we propose RemoteEvolver, an external harness for remote sensing agents that drives tool and workflow evolution through execution feedback. With the base model parameters fixed, RemoteEvolver acquires missing specialized tools on demand and distills verified successful execution experience from individual tasks into agent skills that can be reused across tasks. The acquired tools and accumulated skills jointly support planning and execution on subsequent tasks. Experiments on Earth-Bench and OpenEarthAgent-Bench show that RemoteEvolver achieves average accuracy gains of 8.18 and 23.86 percentage points over its initial state when tools are fully available and partially missing. Under the same settings, it also outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by an average of 6.77 and 17.10 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: RemoteEvolver：遥感智能体的外部 harness，通过执行反馈演化工具与工作流，冻结基座参数，按需获取缺失工具并将已验证的成功经验蒸馏为可跨任务复用的 agent skills。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感智能体依赖固定工具集，经验积累仅局限于对预定义能力的重新编排，能力扩展与跨任务迁移受限；而 harness 作为模型外部可编辑、可持久化的资源载体，可在不微调基座的情况下实现持续自我改进。
AI.method: 提出外部 harness 框架 RemoteEvolver：基座模型参数固定，依据执行反馈驱动工具演化（按需获取缺失的遥感专用工具）与工作流演化（把单任务中验证成功的执行经验蒸馏为可复用 skills），二者共同支撑后续任务的规划与执行。
AI.result: 在 Earth-Bench 与 OpenEarthAgent-Bench 上，工具完备与部分缺失两种设定下，分别较初始状态平均提升 8.18 与 23.86 个百分点；同设定下平均领先 SOTA 6.77 与 17.10 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将工具与工作流知识外置为可编辑持久资源，是实现遥感智能体持续自我改进的有效路径，且工具缺失时的增益更大，说明能力缺口驱动的工具获取机制价值显著。

title: Portable Active Recovery under Timed and Position-Dependent Visual Outages
summary: When a camera blackout depends on physical position rather than elapsed time, stable hovering prevents visual recovery and mission completion. On stereo visual-inertial quadrotors without external localization, an exogenous timed blackout and an endogenous position-dependent dark zone appear identical at loss onset yet require opposite responses: hover-and-wait completes 93/96 timed blackouts but 0/96 spatial outages (13 hard failures), whereas blind continuation traverses many spatial zones yet fails heavily during timed blackouts. We formulate visual-outage recovery as a worst-condition active-observability problem and introduce a portable recovery module at the reference interface of an unchanged host controller with zero retraining. Using deployable telemetry alone, the module coordinates visual-loss detection, jerk-limited braking, bounded backward probing, settled rejoining, height-integral trim, and an optional gated prior-map branch. On a preregistered 48-scene benchmark (1,920 flights), our full MPPI configuration reaches 88.5% [81.2, 94.8] worst-condition completion, outperforming development-selected DATT-L1 by +29.2 pp [17.7, 40.6] and exceeding all six external baselines after Bonferroni correction. Attached without retraining to SimpleFlight, the module lifts worst-condition completion by +17.7 pp [7.3, 28.1] to 86.5% (and 90% across 1.0x/1.25x speeds, 0/80 hard failures). Trace diagnostics reveal that survival hinges on visual-inertial re-acquisition asymmetry at vision return -- not blind IMU drift suppression - and uncover a bias-drift map crossover confirmed on 72 held-out EuRoC windows.

AI.tldr: 针对无外部定位的立体视觉-惯性四旋翼，将视觉中断恢复表述为最坏条件主动可观测性问题，在宿主控制器参考接口处插入零重训练的可移植恢复模块，实现93%以上类定时中断与空间暗区两类盲区的最坏条件完成率提升。
AI.motivation: 相机黑屏若由物理位置而非时间决定，悬停等待无法恢复视觉，导致任务失败。外部定时黑屏与内生位置相关暗区在丢失瞬间表现一致却需相反策略，现有控制器缺乏统一应对机制。
AI.method: 将视觉中断恢复建模为最坏条件主动可观测性优化问题；提出模块化恢复流水线：视觉丢失检测、jerk受限制动、有界反向探测、重新稳定汇合、高度积分微调，以及可选门控先验地图分支；以MPPI为规划器，仅用可部署遥测信号，零重训练挂接于未改动的主控制器参考接口。
AI.result: 预注册48场景基准（1920次飞行）下，完整MPPI配置最坏条件完成率88.5% [81.2,94.8]，较开发期选定的DATT-L1高29.2 pp，经Bonferroni校正后优于全部六个外部基线；挂接到SimpleFlight后提升17.7 pp至86.5%（1.0x/1.25x速度下90%，0/80硬失效）。轨迹诊断表明生存关键在于视觉回归时的视觉-惯性重捕获非对称性而非抑制盲区IMU漂移，并在72个留出EuRoC窗口上确认偏差漂移与地图切换现象。
AI.conclusion: 提出统一处理定时与空间视觉 outages 的主动可观测性框架及可即插即用恢复模块，验证了重捕获时序非对称性的核心作用，具备跨平台零重训练迁移能力。

title: A Plan or an Adversarial Example? A Round-Trip Check for Latent World Models
summary: If we optimize an image until a classifier is confident it shows a cat, we may get an adversarial example, not a cat. Planning with a latent world model is a similar search for actions whose predicted future is closest to the goal. Is the result a plan, or an adversarial example of the world model? We show that it can be either. On the released DINO-WM and LeWM, more iterations of the cross-entropy method (CEM) lower the predicted cost but lose up to half of the problems CEM had already solved. The model's own predictions do not reveal these failures. We propose a simple test that executes the plan after every iteration and counts the problems a planner solves and then loses. Unlike an image, a plan comes with its actions, which our round-trip check reads back from the predicted states with a small network, penalizing mismatches. The check reads back the sum of each block of five actions, the part that two consecutive predicted states determine. Without retraining the world model and at only 0.2% to 3.1% more planning time, it improves the widely used planners CEM and MPPI on three released world models, and gains more where planners lose more problems. Without replanning, success rises from 0.39 to 0.76 on Wall with DINO-WM and from 0.56 to 0.94 for MPPI on JEPA-WM. With replanning (MPC), it rises from 0.70 to 0.81 on Cube with LeWM.

AI.tldr: 指出潜空间世界模型规划中CEM迭代会降低预测代价却丢失已解决的问题（即"世界模型的对抗样本"），提出执行式"去而复得"测试与动作-状态往返一致性校验，无需重训即可提升CEM/MPPI成功率。
AI.motivation: 规划器在潜空间世界模型中优化动作使预测未来接近目标，这与在图像上优化分类器使之"确信是猫"的对抗优化同构，可能产出的是世界模型的对抗样本而非可行计划；且模型自身预测无法暴露此类失败，现有工作缺少对"预测代价下降但真实可执行性恶化"的诊断手段。
AI.method: 1）诊断性测试：每轮CEM迭代后执行计划，统计"先解决后丢失"的问题数；2）往返一致性检验：用小型网络从预测状态反解动作（每5个动作之和，即由两个相邻预测状态唯一确定的量），对反解动作与原始动作的失配施加惩罚；3）将该正则项接入CEM与MPPI，世界模型不重训，额外规划开销仅0.2%–3.1%。
AI.result: DINO-WM与LeWM上更多CEM迭代虽降低预测代价，却丢失至多一半已解问题。不加正则时，Wall+DINO-WM成功率0.39→0.76，JEPA-WM上MPPI 0.56→0.94；带重规划的MPC下Cube+LeWM从0.70→0.81，在规划器损失更多的问题上增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型规划与对抗样本问题同源，单看模型内部预测代价不足以评估规划质量；执行反馈构成必要的"外部真值"，轻量往返一致性校验可作为即插即用正则提升现有潜空间规划器。局限在于依赖仿真/可执行环境进行诊断，反解网络的可辨识性与长时域累积误差仍需进一步验证。

title: OpenRing: Deadlock-Free Execution of Any Planner on AGV Floors with One-Way Lanes
summary: Lifelong multi-agent path finding replans routes for automated guided vehicles, but deviations can invalidate a plan. With one-way lanes, a late vehicle or lost planner can close a ring of full segments. We separate how fast the floor runs from whether it keeps running. In OpenRing a planner proposes routes and an order, a local guard commits only moves and route changes that cannot close such a ring, and the order binds for a bounded time. Despite arbitrary proposals or planner loss, no ring closes. With two-place segments, traffic can continue under disturbances; progress is guaranteed once they end, and all vehicles exit if entries also stop. Among rules that reroute only on a proposal, every guard veto is necessary, and a clean plan keeps its crossing orders. The guarantee has a price: no rule that never stores a vehicle in a crossing under arbitrary stops carries more than $B/T_s$ per segment of $B$ places and traversal time $T_s$. With binding orders, three planners deadlock in 80 of 126 runs across eight floors. Inside OpenRing, none of the 126 runs deadlocks. OpenRing's closed-loop throughput rivals or exceeds the best baseline's. Physics simulations show no deadlocks or overlaps.

AI.tldr: OpenRing 将"运行速度"与"持续运行能力"解耦:规划器只提出路径与通行顺序,局部守护器仅批准不会闭合满段环路(死锁环)的移动与改道,顺序仅在有限时间内生效,从而在任意提案或规划器失效下保证无环闭合。
AI.motivation: 终身多智能体路径规划(Lifelong MAPF)需不断重规划,但偏离会破坏原计划;单向车道下,迟到车辆或规划器丢失可能使一圈满段车道闭合成死锁环。作者希望把"运行多快"与"是否持续运行"两类问题分离,获得对扰动鲁棒的运行安全保证。
AI.method: 提出 OpenRing 架构:上层规划器提交路线与顺序提案;下层局部守护器(local guard)只提交不会闭合满段环路的安全移动/改道;通行顺序有界时间内有效。两车位段(two-place segments)设计使扰动期间交通仍可继续。并给出理论结果:仅在提案时改道的规则中每个守护否决都必要;干净计划保持穿越顺序;并给出任何"任意停车下不将车辆存入交叉口"规则的吞吐上界 B/T_s。
AI.result: 理论上:任意提案或规划器丢失下无环闭合;扰动期间可继续通行,扰动结束后保证进展,若入口也停止则所有车辆全部驶出。含绑定顺序时三种规划器在八层 126 次运行中 80 次死锁,而 OpenRing 内 126 次运行零死锁;闭环吞吐量可与最佳基线相当或更优;物理仿真中无死锁、无重叠。
AI.conclusion: 通过将规划(快车道)与运行安全(守护器)解耦,OpenRing 在保持吞吐的同时提供了对规划器失效与扰动的安全性保证,代价是每段吞吐上界 B/T_s 的理论限制。适用于 AGV 仓库等单向车道多车系统。

title: Analyzing Multi-Layer Visual Representations of Large Vision-Language Models for Anomaly Detection
summary: In this paper, we analyze multi-layer visual representations in large vision-language models (LVLMs) and examine the effectiveness of layer-wise features and multi-layer fusion for anomaly detection. Representative LVLMs connect visual encoder features to a language model through a projector. In this design, deep visual encoder features carry high-level semantics and alignment with text representations, whereas shallow and intermediate layers retain information relevant to vision-centric tasks, such as local appearance and fine-grained shape. It is therefore important to choose layer representations and fusion methods according to the nature of the downstream task. Focusing on anomaly detection, we compare layer-wise features and multi-layer fusion across multiple supervision levels and a variety of classifiers, and examine from several perspectives how multi-layer visual representations affect downstream performance. By analyzing the resulting performance differences, we further discuss the contribution of each layer representation to anomaly detection and provide empirical insights into representation selection for vision-centric tasks.

AI.tldr: 分析LVLMs多层视觉表示用于异常检测：比较各层特征与多层融合在不同监督级别和分类器下的效果，给出表示选择的经验性建议。
AI.motivation: LVLM中深层视觉特征偏语义与文本对齐，浅层/中层保留局部外观与细粒度形状等视觉中心信息，下游任务需按任务性质选择层表示与融合方式。
AI.method: 以异常检测为下游任务，对不同监督级别（无监督/弱监督等）和多种分类器下逐层特征与多层融合进行系统性对比实验与多视角分析。
AI.result: 给出各层特征及融合方式在异常检测上的性能差异，并据此讨论各层表示的贡献（摘要未提供具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 多层视觉表示对视觉中心任务影响显著，应依据任务性质选择层与融合策略；为LVLM视觉特征在非语言对齐任务中的复用提供经验性指导。

title: Opto-Electronic Hybrid Reinforcement Learning Based on MZI for Robotic Manipulator Control
summary: Precise motion control for autonomous robots is a core technical enabler for the large-scale deployment of embodied intelligence. In particular, basic manipulation tasks, such as point-to-point reaching and target grasping with robotic manipulators, impose stringent requirements on control accuracy, real-time response, and energy efficiency for edge deployment. As a prevailing end-to-end control paradigm, reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated remarkable capabilities in autonomous learning and generalization for decision-making in continuous action spaces. Nevertheless, constrained by electronic computing architectures, it generally suffers from substantial computing overhead, high inference latency and limited energy efficiency, making low-power edge deployment challenging. Optical computing, benefiting from its high-speed parallelism, offers a promising route to break energy-efficiency bottlenecks; however, research on the integration of optical computing and RL remains at an early stage. In this work, we propose a Mach-Zehnder Interferometer (MZI)-based opto-electronic hybrid RL architecture. We adopted two algorithm structures: Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient combined with Hindsight Experience Replay (DDPG-HER) and Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient combined with HER (TD3-HER). We implemented the key layer linear computation of the spiking neural network (SNN) Actor on an optical MZI chip for the reaching task of a Franka Emika Panda robotic manipulator. The architecture is evaluated in the PyBullet simulation environment. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed architecture achieves an energy efficiency of 1.39 TOPS/W and an inference latency of 120ps while maintaining control accuracy, which provide a feasible pathway toward energy-efficient and precise control for robots.

AI.tldr: 提出基于MZI光芯片的光电混合RL架构，将SNN Actor的关键线性层部署于光学芯片，用于Franka机械臂点到点到达任务，仿真中达到1.39 TOPS/W能效与120ps推理延迟。
AI.motivation: RL端到端控制精度高但电子计算架构算力开销大、推理延迟高、能效低，难以在低功耗边缘端部署；光计算具备高速并行优势，但与RL结合的研究尚处早期。
AI.method: 构建MZI光电子混合RL架构；分别采用DDPG-HER与TD3-HER两种算法结构；将SNN Actor的关键线性计算映射到MZI光芯片上；在PyBullet中对Franka Emika Panda机械臂的reaching任务进行仿真评估。
AI.result: 在保持控制精度的前提下，能效达1.39 TOPS/W，推理延迟120ps；但全部验证仅在PyBullet仿真中完成，无实机实验。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为光计算与强化学习控制的结合提供了一条面向低功耗、高精度机器人控制的可行路径，但缺少实机部署与更复杂操作任务的验证，且未报告与电子基线的详细精度/训练收益对比。

title: Crafting the Difference, Grounding the Evidence: Discriminative Concept Learning for Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition
summary: LLM-generated descriptions enrich zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition but repeat cues shared by confusable actions. Their contextual semantics also lack explicit links to skeleton features. To address these challenges, we propose CRAFT, which couples Concept Refinement and Feature-grounded Tokens. Hard-negative-conditioned generation and contrastive scoring identify concepts that distinguish each action from its closest rivals. Unique-QDPP selects complementary descriptions within each semantic slot and prevents their reuse across slots. This bank supervises learnable concept tokens that read motion and context cues from each skeleton. On fixed NTU-60 and NTU-120 splits, CRAFT improves five baselines spanning four recognition paradigms. ZSL accuracy and GZSL harmonic mean increase on every baseline-split pair, by 5.4 and 5.9 percentage points on average. Random-split experiments extend these gains to three datasets, including PKU-MMD. Code will be released after acceptance.

AI.tldr: CRAFT：用硬负样本条件生成+对比打分精炼LLM概念描述，Unique-QDPP选取互补且不跨槽复用的描述构成概念库，监督可学习概念token从骨架中读取运动与上下文线索，提升零样本骨架动作识别。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的描述能丰富零样本骨架动作识别，但存在两个问题：(1) 描述重复易混淆动作共有线索，缺乏区分性；(2) 上下文语义与骨架特征之间没有显式关联。
AI.method: 提出CRAFT，耦合概念精炼与特征接地token：以硬负样本（最相近动作）为条件驱动LLM生成并做对比打分，筛出能区分该动作与其最近竞争者的概念；用Unique-QDPP在语义槽内选择互补描述并防止跨槽复用；所得概念库监督可学习概念token，从每个骨架中读取运动与上下文线索。
AI.result: 在固定NTU-60/NTU-120划分上，对覆盖四种识别范式的五个baseline均有一致提升，ZSL准确率与GZSL调和均值在每个baseline-split组合上均提高，平均分别+5.4和+5.9个百分点；随机划分实验在三个数据集（含PKU-MMD）上复现增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过硬负样本驱动的概念精炼与QDPP去冗余，并将概念显式接地到骨架特征，可有效改善零样本/广义零样本骨架动作识别，且方法对不同范式baseline具有通用性（代码待接收后开源）。

title: TrajRealm: A Large-Scale Point Tracking Dataset with Diverse Dynamics
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: General-purpose point tracking requires large-scale training data with diverse dynamics, yet existing datasets struggle to combine rich dynamic content, accurate scene geometry, and sufficient scale. We introduce TrajRealm, the first public synthetic point-tracking dataset to reach the ten-million-frame scale, constructed from games and embodied simulations. TrajRealm uses the rich environments and motion systems of modern games to capture diverse targets, activities, and interactions across diverse worlds, while embodied simulations add robot manipulation and indoor navigation data. The dataset provides RGB observations, depth, camera parameters, and persistent 2D and 3D point trajectories. These annotations provide precise, geometrically consistent supervision across foreground objects and static environmental surfaces. We also build TrajRealm-Bench with eight subcategories under Interaction and Locomotion to evaluate tracking across diverse scenes. Benchmark evaluations reveal the strengths and limitations of existing trackers in handling complex motion and maintaining long-term point correspondences. Training on TrajRealm improves the performance of existing tracking methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TrajRealm：首个千万帧级公开合成点跟踪数据集，基于游戏与具身仿真构建，提供RGB、深度、相机参数及持久2D/3D点轨迹，并配套TrajRealm-Bench。
AI.motivation: 通用点跟踪需大规模、动态多样且几何精确的训练数据，现有数据集难以同时兼顾丰富动态内容、准确场景几何与足够规模。
AI.method: 利用现代游戏的丰富环境与运动系统采集多样目标、活动与交互，并结合具身仿真补充机器人操作与室内导航数据；输出RGB、深度、相机参数及跨前景/静态表面的持续2D、3D点轨迹标注；构建含Interaction与Locomotion共八个子类的TrajRealm-Bench。
AI.result: 基准评测揭示现有跟踪器在复杂运动与长期点对应上的优势与不足；在TrajRealm上训练可提升现有方法在合成与真实基准上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 大规模合成点跟踪数据可有效改善几何一致与长时对应监督，为通用点跟踪与下游具身/机器人任务提供数据基础。

title: How Does SAM-3 Adapt? Capacity, Update Geometry, and Domain Transfer
summary: Promptable segmentation foundation models are increasingly used in specialized domains, but it remains unclear how SAM-3 should be fine-tuned when adapting it beyond its original training distribution. We study this question by comparing five adaptation families --LoRA, HiRA, KRAdapter, QuanTA, and Full Fine-Tuning-- across five segmentation datasets spanning medical imaging, remote sensing, and dense material segmentation. Across these datasets, compact parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods often match or approach Full Fine-Tuning in DSC and IoU, suggesting that strong in-domain adaptation does not always require updating the full model. However, this performance cannot be explained by nominal adapter rank or trainable parameter count alone. To investigate why different methods perform similarly, we analyze their update spectra and their behavior under LoveDA Urban/Rural transfer. Our SVD analysis shows that Full Fine-Tuning updates are spectrally compressible. However, successful PEFT methods do not simply recover the same update directions; instead, they often concentrate changes in different components and subspaces. The domain-transfer study further shows that methods with similar in-domain performance can respond differently under distribution shift. Together, these results suggest that SAM-3 adaptation is often capacity-saturated in practice, while competitive fine-tuning arises through method-specific update paths rather than a single low-rank approximation to Full Fine-Tuning.

AI.tldr: 比较五种SAM-3微调方案（LoRA、HiRA、KRAdapter、QuanTA、全参数微调）跨医学影像、遥感、密集材质分割数据集的表现，并用SVD更新谱与LoveDA城/乡迁移分析解释差异。
AI.motivation: SAM-3等可提示分割基础模型正被用于专业领域，但超出原始训练分布时应如何微调尚不清楚；需厘清PEFT与全参数微调的关系及性能来源。
AI.method: 在5个分割数据集上横向对比5类适配方案；以DSC/IoU评估域内性能；对更新矩阵做SVD谱分析刻画可压缩性；并在LoveDA Urban/Rural迁移下考察分布偏移鲁棒性。
AI.result: 紧凑PEFT常可匹敌或接近全参数微调；性能无法由名义秩或可训练参数量解释；全参数微调更新在谱上可压缩，但成功PEFT并不复现同一更新子空间，而是集中于不同成分；域内表现相近的方法在迁移下响应不同。
AI.conclusion: SAM-3适配在实践中常处于容量饱和状态；有竞争力的微调来自方法特有的更新路径，而非对全参数微调的单次低秩逼近。

title: Simulation-Based Testing of RCM-Constrained Robotic Software via Task Manifolds
summary: System-level testing of surgical robots requires generating executable test scenarios that exercise diverse, safety-critical behaviors. However, remote-center-of-motion (RCM) surgical manipulators operate within tightly constrained workspaces governed by coupled task geometry, inverse kinematics, and motor limits. Direct sampling in motor-command or Cartesian spaces frequently wastes testing budgets on physically unfeasible configurations. To address this limitation, we present a manifold-centered testing framework that decouples feasible test-domain construction from downstream test-generation strategies. Candidate inputs are generated directly within this constructed feasible domain and mapped to lower-level joint commands for simulation execution. Offline trajectory safety oracles and a spatial reference grid then evaluate failure yield and coverage. We compare our task-manifold representation against Cartesian XYZ and principal component analysis (PCA) under random testing, systematic traversal, and genetic search strategies. Results demonstrate that the feasible task domain improves test-generation efficiency and enables systematic reference-cell coverage. Crucially, random and genetic search strategies detect a broader spectrum of failure patterns than baseline representations, revealing that complete reference-cell coverage alone does not exhaust intra-cell behavioral dynamics. Furthermore, differential testing between defective and patched controller versions reveals that targeted evolutionary search detects aggregate failure-rate shifts from software repairs. Finally, a cross-platform study on a 7-DoF Kinova Gen3 arm in MoveIt 2 confirms workflow transferability to kinematically redundant manipulators. Together, these findings highlight the necessity of combining feasibility-aware domain modeling with complementary search strategies for systematic testing of robot software.

AI.tldr: 提出"流形中心"手术机器人系统级测试框架：先在可行任务流形上构造可行测试域，再映射到关节指令，配合轨迹安全预言机与空间参考网格评估失效率和覆盖率；与笛卡尔XYZ、PCA基线在随机/系统遍历/遗传搜索下对比。
AI.motivation: RCM手术机械臂受任务几何、逆运动学与电机限位耦合约束，工作空间狭窄；直接在电机指令或笛卡尔空间采样会把测试预算浪费在物理不可行构型上。
AI.method: 构建解耦式测试框架：可行测试域构造与下游测试生成策略分离；在可行域内直接生成候选输入并映射为底层关节指令进行仿真执行；离线轨迹安全预言机+空间参考网格量化失效产出与覆盖率；对比三种表示（任务流形、笛卡尔XYZ、PCA）与三种搜索策略（随机、系统遍历、遗传搜索），并做缺陷版与修复版的差分测试、7-DoF Kinova Gen3 + MoveIt 2 跨平台验证。
AI.result: 可行任务域提升测试生成效率并支持系统性参考网格覆盖；随机与遗传搜索能发现比基线表示更广的失效模式，说明仅达成完整网格覆盖并不能穷尽单元格内行为动力学；定向进化搜索可检出软件修复带来的总体失败率变化；Kinova Gen3/MoveIt 2 上确认流程可迁移到运动冗余机械臂。
AI.conclusion: 可行性感知的域建模须与互补搜索策略结合，才能实现机器人软件的系统化测试；覆盖率高不等于行为充分测试。

title: FM4SAR-Bench 1.0: Towards A Fair Benchmark for Evaluating Foundation Models for SAR Image Interpretation
summary: Foundation models have advanced SAR image interpretation but created a heterogeneous, fragmented model ecosystem. Existing models differ substantially in their input, training data, objectives, architectures, and release policy, yet the field lacks a unified taxonomy and comparative framework. Current evaluations rely primarily on task-specific benchmarks, which are ill-suited to fair comparison among models with fundamentally different input-output formats and task paradigms, and often overlook data transparency, reproducibility, interpretability, and deployment readiness. Limited SAR data accessibility also means high reported performance does not guarantee access to training data, code, or weights, limiting reproduction, benchmarking, and deployment. To address these issues, we propose a systematic taxonomy and hierarchical evaluation framework for SAR-related foundation models: five rating levels, six dimensions, and fine-grained criteria, with separate protocols for VFMs and VLMs. Beyond overall ratings, it yields interpretable multidimensional capability profiles and supports user-defined weighting, so rankings follow user priorities. Utilizing a fixed auxiliary multimodal large language model in combination with human review, we conduct a systematic meta-analysis and multidimensional assessment of 76 VFMs and 40 VLMs. In terms of SAR benchmark task performance under our framework, SAR-native VLMs do not significantly outperform remote sensing VLMs pretrained on mixed multimodal corpora in which SAR is one of several modalities. This lack of clear advantage is largely due to data availability: large-scale, high-quality, public annotated SAR data remain scarce, restricting both model and training-data scale for SAR-native models. The framework provides a structured basis for requirement-aware model selection and remains extensible as new models emerge.

AI.tldr: 提出SAR基础模型的系统分类学与分层评估框架（5等级、6维度、细粒度准则，VFM/VLM分设协议），并借助固定辅助多模态大模型加人工复核，对76个VFM和40个VLM进行元分析与多维评级。
AI.motivation: SAR基础模型生态异构碎片化（输入、训练数据、目标、架构、开放策略各异），缺乏统一分类与可比框架；现有任务特定基准难以公平比较不同输入输出格式的模型，且忽视数据透明度、可复现性、可解释性与部署就绪度；SAR数据可及性差使高报告性能不等于可复现。
AI.method: 构建五级评分、六维度、细粒度准则的分层评估框架，为视觉基础模型（VFM）与视觉语言模型（VLM）分别设计评估协议；支持用户自定义权重以形成需求导向排序；采用固定辅助多模态大语言模型结合人工审核，对76个VFM和40个VLM做系统元分析与多维能力画像。
AI.result: 在框架下的SAR基准任务性能上，SAR原生VLM并未显著优于以SAR为多模态之一的混合语料预训练的遥感VLM；主因是缺乏大规模高质量公开标注SAR数据，限制了SAR原生模型的模型与训练数据规模。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为需求感知的模型选型提供了结构化依据，输出可解释的多维能力画像并具可扩展性，可随新模型出现持续更新；同时揭示了SAR领域数据开放与评测规范化的关键瓶颈。

title: From Acting to Learning: Experience Selection toward Continually Learning Agents
summary: Successful agent interactions provide training data, but success alone does not determine which records a student should learn from. We examine experience selection for a 4B language agent as a component of continual agent learning. Nine selectors are compared across two fixed experience pools, eight initialization seeds, and two sampling seeds, yielding 288 trained students. Each student is evaluated on 128 development task groups with a common executor. With equal global selection freedom, 256 distinct contents, and 768 training presentations, optimizer-aware gradient selection reaches 81.45\% and 73.19\% success in the two pools. Its gains over global random selection are 8.25 and 5.96 percentage points; gains over global high-NLL selection are 4.10 and 4.05 points. All eight initialization-level contrasts are positive against both baselines in each pool. Relaxing coverage constraints improves gradient selection but reduces random-selection performance, showing that the ranking rule and selection space must be considered together. A separately frozen replication on 128 reserved task groups is complete; its equal-source gradient-minus-random and gradient-minus-high-NLL differences are +7.03 and +5.03 points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 研究4B语言智能体持续学习中的“经验选择”问题：在固定经验池、多种子、等全局选择自由度下比较九种选择器（288个学生模型），优化器感知的梯度选择在两组经验池中成功率81.45%/73.19%，显著优于全局随机与高NLL基线，且放松覆盖约束需与排序规则联合考虑。
AI.motivation: 智能体成功交互虽可提供训练数据，但“成功”本身不足以决定应学习哪些记录；需要明确经验筛选机制在持续智能体学习中的作用与最优排序规则。
AI.method: 受控对比实验：9种选择器 × 2个固定经验池 × 8个初始化种子 × 2个采样种子，共训练288个学生模型；在128个开发任务组上用统一执行器评测；控制全局选择自由度（256条不同内容、768次训练呈现）；并做覆盖约束消融与冻结复现（128个保留任务组）。
AI.result: 梯度选择在池1/池2达81.45%/73.19%；较全局随机分别+8.25/+5.96个百分点，较高NLL +4.10/+4.05；8个初始化层级对比在两池对两基线均为正。放松覆盖约束提升梯度选择、却降低随机选择表现。冻结复现中梯度-随机为+7.03、梯度-高NLL为+5.03个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 经验选择的关键在于优化器感知的梯度排序，而非单纯“成功”或高损失信号；排序规则与选择空间（覆盖约束）须协同设计，结论具跨池、跨种子与独立任务集的可复现稳健性。

title: Real-Anchored Complementary Evidence for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Evolving generative models challenge detector generalization, as methods trained on generated examples may rely on generator-specific cues. By contrast, authentic photographs share regularities rooted in physical image formation and acquisition, providing a common reference beyond individual generators. Building on these regularities, we propose Real-Anchored Complementary Evidence (RACE), which learns complementary global and local detection evidence using only authentic training images. First, the global pathway combines frozen and learned representations to assess proximity to authentic references. Next, it incorporates responses to controlled perturbations, complementing static compatibility with representation sensitivity. The local pathway then reconstructs complete trace descriptors, using intermediate features and signed perturbation responses as context while restricting detection evidence to static terminal-residual reconstruction errors. Finally, authentic-image statistics align the global and local scores for fusion, and an independent authentic set calibrates a decision threshold held fixed across test generators. Across six benchmarks, RACE achieves the highest average AUROC of 96.59% among the compared methods, reaching 97.18% on five out-of-domain benchmarks. Together with robustness to image perturbations and variation in authentic-image sources, these results support authentic-image regularities as a transferable basis for detection across diverse generators and image conditions.

AI.tldr: RACE仅用真实图像训练：全局通路结合冻结与学习表示评估与真实参考的接近度并引入扰动敏感性；局部通路以静态终端残差重构误差作为证据；用真实图像统计对齐融合分数并由独立真实集固定阈值，在6个基准上平均AUROC 96.59%，五个域外基准97.18%。
AI.motivation: 生成模型不断演进使基于生成样本训练的检测器易依赖特定生成器的伪迹，泛化性差；真实照片共享由成像与采集物理过程决定的不变性，可作为跨生成器的共同参照。
AI.method: 提出Real-Anchored Complementary Evidence（RACE），仅用真实图像训练。全局通路融合冻结特征与学习表示度量与真实参考的接近度，并纳入受控扰动响应以补充表示敏感性；局部通路以中间特征与带符号扰动响应为上下文重构完整痕迹描述子，但仅用静态终端残差重构误差作为检测证据；最后用真实图像统计对齐全局与局部分数进行融合，并在独立真实集上标定固定决策阈值。
AI.result: 六个基准上平均AUROC 96.59%，为对比方法最高；五个域外基准达97.18%；对图像扰动及真实图像来源变化具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 真实图像固有规律可作为跨生成器、跨成像条件的可迁移检测基础，验证了"以真实为锚"的互补证据框架的有效性与泛化性。

title: PhysForce: Physics-aware Force Control for Interactive Video World Model
summary: Interactive video world models aim to predict how visual environments evolve in response to user interventions, including physically consistent state changes induced by applied forces. Existing methods often represent forces as motion trajectories, which may introduce inappropriate motion priors, causing the model to over-rely on encoded displacement patterns. More fundamentally, the model's internal representations do not reliably localize force-induced state changes, making it difficult to associate applied forces with their resulting physical responses. Also, limited force-annotated data make it difficult to produce physically consistent and temporally stable predictions in unseen scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose PhysForce, a two-stage framework that integrates supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning through three complementary components. During supervised fine-tuning, (1) the Latent Force Intervention Encoder maps force location, direction, and magnitude into the video latent space without exposing future motion; and (2) the Physics Attribution Network associates force interventions with localized changes in the latent state, strengthening the learning of physical responses to applied forces. During reinforcement learning, (3) Physics-Aware Reinforcement Learning uses self-supervised rewards on out-of-distribution videos to improve physical consistency and generalization. Extensive experiments show that PhysForce improves force responsiveness, physical consistency, and generalization, demonstrating its effectiveness for interactive video world models.

AI.tldr: PhysForce：两阶段（SFT+RL）交互式视频世界模型框架，用隐空间力编码器+物理归因网络+物理感知RL，实现力干预下物理一致的视频演化预测。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型将力表示为运动轨迹，引入不恰当运动先验导致过度依赖位移模式；内部表示无法可靠定位力引发的状态变化，难以将施加力与其物理响应关联；力标注数据稀缺，致使未见场景下物理一致性与时间稳定性不足。
AI.method: 三组件两阶段框架：SFT阶段(1)Latent Force Intervention Encoder将力的位置、方向、幅值映射到视频隐空间且不泄露未来运动；(2)Physics Attribution Network将力干预与隐状态局部变化关联，强化物理响应学习；RL阶段(3)Physics-Aware RL在OOD视频上用自监督奖励提升物理一致性与泛化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PhysForce在力响应性、物理一致性与泛化性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 以隐空间力条件化替代轨迹先验、并以归因机制与自监督RL缓解力标注稀缺，是构建可交互、物理一致视频世界模型的可行路线。

title: Mem-X: A Memory-Dependent Cross-Episode Benchmark for Vision-and-Language Navigation
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
summary: Long-term memory enables embodied agents to reuse past observations across tasks. However, existing cross-episode vision-and-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks often leave it unclear whether successful navigation relies on historical memory or current exploration. We introduce Mem-X, a benchmark designed to evaluate memory-dependent cross-episode VLN. Mem-X organizes episodes into sessions in which subsequent instructions refer to objects or routes encountered in earlier episodes. Its three levels evaluate historical-object recall, in-memory localization and episodic indexing, and off-memory relocalization and historical-route reproduction. For the latter two levels, agents receive episode-local poses but no transformations between episode frames, requiring them to establish spatial correspondence with historical memory. Mem-X comprises 2,071 episodes across 710 sessions in 34 scenes, including 1,204 memory-dependent episodes. We also provide MemBridge, a modular baseline that combines semantic scene memory, cross-episode localization, and coarse-to-fine retrieval to support existing VLN agents. Experiments with state-of-the-art VLN methods demonstrate the benefits of MemBridge while revealing substantial room for improvement on memory-dependent navigation. The benchmark and baseline code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Mem-X：面向"记忆依赖型"跨回合视觉语言导航（VLN）的基准，按会话组织回合，分三级评测历史物体回忆、记忆内定位/回合索引、离记忆重定位与历史路线复现；并提出模块化基线 MemBridge。
AI.motivation: 现有跨回合 VLN 基准无法区分成功导航是靠历史记忆还是靠当前探索，导致"长期记忆"能力被高估；需要能强制检验历史依赖的评测设定。
AI.method: 将回合组织为会话，后续指令引用早期回合出现过的物体或路线；三级任务：历史物体回忆、记忆内定位与回合索引、离记忆重定位与历史路线复现。后两级仅给回合内位姿、不给回合间坐标变换，需自建空间对应关系。数据规模 2,071 回合 / 710 会话 / 34 场景，其中 1,204 个记忆依赖回合。基线 MemBridge 采用语义场景记忆 + 跨回合定位 + 由粗到细检索，可挂接现有 VLN 智能体。
AI.result: 在多个 SOTA VLN 方法上验证：加入 MemBridge 带来稳定收益，但在记忆依赖导航上仍存在显著提升空间。
AI.conclusion: Mem-X 提供了更严格的长时记忆评测范式，暴露当前 VLN 智能体在跨回合空间对应与路线复现上的短板；开源基准与基线代码。

title: FedQCal: Quadratic Programming with Dual-Space Calibration for One-Shot Federated Learning
summary: One-shot federated learning must combine heterogeneous client models after a single upload. Different local class distributions make it difficult to decide which client updates to retain. We propose FedQCal, which uses a reference model trained on a small labeled server set to define alignment requirements for aggregation. The key idea is to retain sufficient reference alignment while avoiding unnecessarily large aggregation coefficients. A minimum-norm quadratic program (QP) enforces these requirements. Classification loss on the same server examples selects a merge through two dual variables, so the alignment thresholds need not be prescribed in advance. We prove that the selected coefficients remain exact QP solutions at their induced thresholds. A perturbation bound explains how coefficient norm limits the amplification of projection errors. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and SVHN show gains over one-round FedAvg in most settings. Ablations support reference-guided weighting and coefficient calibration, even with one labeled server image per class.

AI.tldr: FedQCal 用服务器端小样本参考模型定义"对齐要求"，通过最小范数二次规划（QP）选择一次性联邦聚合系数，并由分类损失经两个对偶变量自动确定阈值。
AI.motivation: 单轮（one-shot）联邦学习需在一次上传后合并异质客户端模型，而各客户端本地类别分布不同，导致难以判断哪些更新应当保留。
AI.method: 在少量带标签服务器数据上训练参考模型；最小范数QP约束"保留足够参考对齐"同时抑制系数范数；用参考数据分类损失对两个对偶变量求导/选择，使对齐阈值无需人工预设；理论上证明所选项在其诱导阈值下仍为精确QP解，并给出系数范数对投影误差放大的扰动界。
AI.result: CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN 上多数设置优于单轮 FedAvg；消融验证参考引导加权与系数校准有效，甚至每类仅一张服务器标注图像时仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 以参考对齐约束+对偶校准的形式化方式解决一次性联邦异质聚合系数的选择问题，理论自洽且在小样本服务器监督下有效；但验证限于中小规模图像基准，缺少大规模/真实部署证据。

title: Learning from Incomplete Actions: Interval Motion Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Visual labeling of egocentric demonstrations often leaves contiguous gaps in action supervision. Reliable poses around a gap still provide its net translation and rotation. We use this information to train vision-language-action policies while preserving ordinary flow matching on reliable local actions. A composition objective constrains the aggregate motion of missing-action estimates, combining multiple fixed windows when a gap exceeds the policy horizon. A shared interval branch learns from reliable endpoints and supplies the composition target. On LIBERO with 20% of demonstrations and 70.5% missing actions, the main method achieves 87.9% mean success over three training runs. In one paired comparison with matched observation exposure and training cost, its advantage over masking is 10.5%. On Ego-informed RoboTwin gaps, success is 45.4%, versus 40.3% for masking. On five real-robot tasks, mean success is 59.6%, versus 54.8% for interval flow matching alone and 48.8% for masking.

AI.tldr: 用缺帧动作间隙的可靠端点位姿约束缺失动作估计的聚合运动，在保持局部流匹配的前提下训练VLA策略，并支持超出策略时域的多窗口组合。
AI.motivation: 视觉标注的自中心演示常出现连续的动作监督空隙，导致流匹配策略在缺失段落无梯度或只能被遮蔽。而间隙端点仍提供可靠的净平移与旋转，是可利用的弱监督信号。
AI.method: 对可靠局部动作保留常规流匹配损失；对缺失动作预测引入组合目标（composition objective），约束其聚合位移与端点相对位姿一致；当间隙长于策略时域时，组合多个固定长度窗口；另设共享区间分支从可靠端点学习，提供组合目标。
AI.result: LIBERO上20%演示、70.5%动作缺失时三seed平均成功率87.9%，匹配观察量与训练成本下比masking高10.5%；Ego-informed RoboTwin 45.4% vs masking 40.3%；五个真机任务平均59.6%，对比区间流匹配54.8%、masking 48.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将端点位姿作为结构约束可有效从稀疏/缺口标注中学习VLA策略，优于遮蔽与单纯区间流匹配，并含真机验证；缺乏缺帧比例、任务多样性外的细粒度消融与开源信息。

title: PACE-WM: Parallel World Modeling with Action History for Visual Planning
summary: JEPA-style world models support visual planning by predicting future representations conditioned on future actions. However, similar observations can conceal different motion states, making temporal context essential for interpreting future action effects. We propose PACE-WM, a parallel world model that uses executed-action history to contextualize future prediction and planning. Specifically, PACE-WM maintains a recurrent memory of executed actions and uses this memory to condition a causal Transformer. PACE-WM predicts multiple future representations in parallel without recursive predicted-state feedback within each prediction window. We further introduce Reference-Anchored Minimum Progress (RAMP) for action selection during planning. RAMP scores candidate actions by their predicted goal improvement along direct and split paths relative to a shared reference. Across four visual planning tasks, PACE-WM with RAMP achieves an average success rate of $98\%$ and plans approximately $7$-$9\times$ faster than autoregressive LeWM under matched CEM settings. We also construct four controlled benchmarks to evaluate PACE-WM's capabilities in motion disambiguation, goal-relative motion, and goal adaptation. Project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PACE-WM：以已执行动作历史为记忆条件、用因果 Transformer 并行预测多步未来表征的JEPA式世界模型，并提出RAMP动作选择准则，加速视觉规划。
AI.motivation: 相似观测可能对应不同运动状态，仅凭当前观测难以判断未来动作后果；同时自回归式潜在预测存在误差累积与推理慢的问题。
AI.method: 维护已执行动作的循环记忆以提供时序上下文，并将其作为条件输入因果 Transformer；在每个预测窗口内并行输出多个未来表征，不使用预测状态递归反馈。规划阶段提出Reference-Anchored Minimum Progress (RAMP)，以共享参考点为锚，沿直接路径与拆分路径评估候选动作的预测目标改进量并据此打分。
AI.result: 在四个视觉规划任务上平均成功率约98%，在相同CEM设置下规划速度比自回归LeWM快约7–9倍；另构建四个受控基准，评测运动歧义消解、目标相对运动与目标自适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 动作历史上下文化加上窗口内并行预测，可在不牺牲规划质量的前提下显著提升规划效率，并对观测歧义具有更好的判别能力。

title: Inject, Encode, Navigate: Feature-Wise Time Injection for Rectified Flow with Bidirectional Feature Encoding
summary: Vision-model-based robotic navigation has gained increasing popularity, yet existing approaches still struggle to deliver effective and efficient navigation performance, \textit{e.g.}, diffusion-based policies that require costly iterative denoising. In this work, we propose three improvements to bridge these gaps. First, we adopt a rectified flow framework to reduce the required inference steps to one while achieving comparable or even superior performance. Second, we leverage a bidirectional Mamba-based visual encoder that employs selective state-space modeling to more effectively capture bidirectional temporal dependencies across observation frames, even with longer input sequences. Most importantly, we find that naïvely combining these two components to balance accuracy with inference speed yields no further performance gains or even produces inferior results. Upon extensive analysis, we realized that the root cause lies in the fact that the Hydra-derived temporal context is shared unchanged across all flow timesteps, and timestep information is introduced only within the velocity network. This weak coupling limits the model's ability to adaptively exploit temporal visual features at different flow states. To address this, we propose a feature-wise timestep conditioning design that explicitly conditions the visual embedding on the flow timestep, enabling noise-level-aware trajectory generation, thereby restoring a meaningful gradient pathway and enabling coherent interaction between the rectified flow and the temporal encoder. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms both baseline and competitive methods.

AI.tldr: 将 rectified flow（单步推断）与双向 Mamba 视觉编码器结合用于视觉机器人导航，并指出二者朴素叠加无效，提出特征级 timestep 条件化实现流状态与时间上下文的有效耦合。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉导航策略效率与效果难以兼得：扩散策略需昂贵迭代去噪；且流行的时序编码器（Hydra 派生）时间上下文在所有 flow timestep 上共享不变，仅在速度网络内注入 timestep，导致耦合过弱、无法按不同噪噪水平自适应利用时序视觉特征。
AI.method: (1) 采用 rectified flow 将去噪步数降至 1 步；(2) 使用基于选择性状态空间建模的双向 Mamba 视觉编码器捕捉长序列双向时序依赖；(3) 提出 feature-wise timestep conditioning，在视觉嵌入层面显式以 flow timestep 为条件，使轨迹生成具备噪声水平感知能力，恢复有效梯度通路并实现流与时间编码器的协同交互。
AI.result: 多数据集定量与定性实验表明方法稳定优于基线与竞争方法；并给出“单步流 + 双向 Mamba 朴素组合”性能不升反降的实证分析及根因诊断。
AI.conclusion: 单步 rectified flow 与双向 Mamba 时序编码器并非即插即用，需在特征层面做 timestep 条件化才能真正兼顾精度与推理效率；该设计为高效视觉导航策略提供了可复用的耦合范式。

title: HumanoidPose: Monocular 3D Pose Estimation for Humanoid Robots
summary: As humanoid robots increasingly enter real-world environments, recovering their 3D whole-body pose from monocular imagery is becoming increasingly important for external state perception, motion analysis, and robot learning. However, Humanoid Robot Pose Estimation (HRPE) lies at the intersection of conventional Robot Pose Estimation (RPE) and Human Pose Estimation (HPE), while not being fully addressed by either paradigm: RPE primarily focuses on non-humanoid robots, particularly fixed-base manipulators, whereas HPE is built upon human-specific skeletal topologies, body models, and motion priors. Despite recent progress in humanoid 2D keypoint detection and HPE adaptation, humanoid-native 3D pose recovery remains insufficiently studied, and a dedicated benchmark with suitable training data and evaluation protocols is still lacking. To address this gap, we introduce Humanoids, a benchmark for monocular 3D humanoid robot pose estimation, and propose HumanoidPose, a framework for this task. Humanoids provides synthetic 3D supervision across diverse humanoid embodiments, manually annotated real-world 2D data, and real-world RGB sequences paired with robot states for 3D evaluation on a physical Roban humanoid. HumanoidPose combines human-inspired visual perception with robot articulation modeling and explicit kinematic grounding. Experiments on Humanoids and the DHRP-H1 benchmark demonstrate strong performance in articulation recovery and 3D pose estimation, including zero-shot transfer to real-world 2D and 3D evaluation. Ablation studies further show the contribution of robot-native articulation modeling and explicit kinematic grounding. The dataset and code will be publicly released to support future research in the community.

AI.tldr: 提出单目3D人形机器人姿态估计任务，发布Humanoids基准（合成3D监督+真实2D标注+Roban真机RGB-状态配对），并提出HumanoidPose框架，结合人体启发的视觉感知、机器人关节建模与显式运动学接地。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人进入真实环境后，从单目图像恢复全身3D姿态对外部状态感知、运动分析和机器人学习至关重要；但HRPE处于传统机器人姿态估计（RPE，多为固定基座机械臂）与人体姿态估计（HPE，依赖人体骨架拓扑与体型模型）的交叉空白，人形原生的3D姿态恢复与配套基准仍缺失。
AI.method: 构建Humanoids基准：多形态人形机器人的合成3D监督、手工标注的真实2D数据、以及物理Roban人形机器人的真实RGB序列与机器人状态配对用于3D评估。提出HumanoidPose框架：以人体启发的视觉感知为基础，引入机器人关节articulation建模与显式运动学接地，将2D关键点提升为符合机器人运动学的3D全身姿态。
AI.result: 在Humanoids与DHRP-H1基准上，关节恢复与3D姿态估计均表现强劲，包含向真实2D与3D评估的零样本迁移；消融实验验证了机器人原生articulation建模与显式运动学接地的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了人形机器人单目3D姿态估计的基准与方 法空白，表明引入机器人运动学先验比纯人体HPE适配更有效；数据集与代码将公开。

title: Tripwire: Robot Agents that Program Their Own Interrupts under Human Disturbance
summary: Agent harnesses are turn-based: the agent acts, waits for the result, then reasons. When the action invokes a pretrained robot policy, such as a vision-language-action (VLA) or world action model (WAM), the policy may react continuously to observations, but the agent cannot revisit its decision until the call returns. Meanwhile, a person may step into the robot's path or move the object it is about to grasp. Invoking the agent more often narrows this blind interval, but a reasoning model takes seconds per decision and most control steps need no new one. We propose TRIP, a training-free, event-driven harness in which the agent programs its own interrupts. With each call, the agent writes a tripwire: a lightweight, stateful Python program that runs alongside the policy, can query a compact VLM (for example, to locate a person and measure their distance), and decides whether the call continues or control returns to the agent. When it fires, the harness halts the policy and returns control with the reason; the agent then reassesses, adapts, and continues under a rewritten tripwire. We evaluate TRIP with three VLAs and one WAM on RoboHD, a benchmark of 168 RoboCasa365 scenes in which a simulated person disturbs the robot and any human-robot contact counts as failure. Compared with a turn-based harness using the same agent and tools, TRIP halves the rate of human contact with the strongest policy, raising safety from 61.3% to 81.3%, without sacrificing task success (38.7% vs. 31.0%). Real-robot experiments show that TRIP completes two manipulation tasks under human interference where the turn-based harness and the policy alone largely fail.

AI.tldr: TRIP: 无需训练的事件驱动 harness，让 VLA/WAM 智能体在每次调用时编写"绊线"（轻量有状态 Python 程序）随策略并行运行，可调用小 VLM 感知（如定位并测距行人）以决定何时中断策略、把控制权交回智能体重新决策，将回合制盲区压缩为按需中断。
AI.motivation: 现有 agent harness 是回合制的：智能体动作后等待返回才能重新推理，而调用 VLA/WAM 策略期间策略可能持续执行但智能体无法介入；人类进入路径或移动目标物体时缺乏及时响应。频繁调用 agent 又会因推理耗时数秒而代价过高，且多数控制步无需新决策。
AI.method: 训练无关的事件驱动 harness。每次 agent 调用时生成 tripwire：轻量有状态 Python 监控程序，与策略并行执行，可查询紧凑 VLM（例如定位人员并测距）并判断本次调用继续还是返回控制权；触发时 harness 暂停策略并携带触发原因返回，agent 据此重新评估、调整并重写 tripwire。
AI.result: 在 RoboHD（168 个 RoboCasa365 场景，模拟人员干扰，任何接触即失败）上评测 3 个 VLA 与 1 个 WAM：最强策略下人类接触率减半，安全性由 61.3% 提升至 81.3%，任务成功率未下降（38.7% vs 31.0%）；真机实验在两种操作任务中于人为干扰下完成，而回合制 harness 与纯策略基本失败。
AI.conclusion: 以"智能体自写中断条件"替代固定频率轮询，是提升策略-智能体协同中人机安全性与反应性的有效、免训练路径；但实验规模有限（基准成功率偏低），需更多策略与场景验证。

title: GEG-SAM: Gaze Exploration-Guided Segment Anything Model for Weakly Supervised Polyp Segmentation
summary: Endoscopist gaze offers an unobtrusively acquired record of lesion-oriented visual exploration during routine clinical inspection, providing relevant supervision for tasks. However, existing methods treat fixations as isolated spatial prompts directly associated with the target, overlooking the fact that natural gaze records a continuous visual search process in which fixations are temporally connected, spatially organized, and coupled with the visual content. Interpreting each fixation independently based only on its local visual content overlooks the temporal evolution and spatial organization of the gaze trajectory, whereas modeling relations among fixations alone cannot reveal the visual semantics of the regions they attend to. To this end, we propose the Gaze Exploration-Guided Segment Anything Model (GEG-SAM), a principled weakly supervised framework designed to explicitly exploit structured gaze relations and their corresponding visual cues to modulate SAM for polyp segmentation. Specifically, GEG-SAM captures structured gaze relations by modeling the temporal dynamics and spatial topology of gaze exploration. It then associates these relational representations with fixation-aligned visual context to derive gaze-conditioned tokens, which are further injected into the frozen SAM encoder to modulate its pretrained image features. In this way, GEG-SAM effectively exploits the rich information embedded in gaze exploration to guide SAM toward lesion-oriented segmentation. Extensive experiments on five public polyp segmentation datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, improving the mean Dice by 9.30 percentage points over the strongest weakly supervised baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出GEG-SAM：把内镜医师眼动注视序列建模为含时序动态与空间拓扑的结构化关系，并与注视对齐的视觉上下文结合成gaze-conditioned token注入冻结SAM编码器，实现弱监督息肉分割。
AI.motivation: 现有做法把注视点当作与目标直接关联的孤立空间提示，忽略了自然注视是连续视觉搜索过程——注视在时间上相连、空间上有组织、且与视觉内容耦合；仅看局部视觉内容丢失轨迹演化，仅建模注视间关系又缺乏视觉语义。
AI.method: GEG-SAM弱监督框架：1) 建模注视探索的时序动态与空间拓扑以捕获结构化注视关系；2) 将关系表示与注视对齐的视觉上下文关联，生成gaze-conditioned tokens；3) 把这些token注入冻结的SAM编码器以调制其预训练图像特征，引导分割朝向病灶区域。
AI.result: 在五个公开息肉分割数据集上验证有效性，mean Dice相较最强弱监督基线提升9.30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用注视轨迹的结构化关系与视觉线索来调制基础分割模型，是提升弱监督医学分割的有效范式；但证据限于医学域数据集，缺少通用性与实际部署验证。

title: SCAP: Stochastic Context for Action Expert Pretraining
summary: Single-modality action-expert pretraining controls competition from visual shortcuts before vision--language--action (VLA) adaptation. Yet single-modality pretraining can impair the vision--language interactions needed for subsequent joint prediction. We construct a diagnostic model in which VA or LA pretraining can disable an initially active pathway for joint vision--language modeling. In this model, subsequent training with complete visual and language inputs cannot restore the pathway, even with unlimited adaptation. We therefore introduce Stochastic Context for Action Expert Pretraining (SCAP), a new action-expert pretraining stage that precedes full-input training. During this stage, visual and text tokens are randomly masked before entering the VLM. In this unified diagnostic model, SCAP can preserve the joint vision--language modeling pathway during pretraining and subsequent full-input training. Compared with direct full-input training, it can also reduce reliance on visual shortcuts and increase reliance on language instructions. SCAP consistently improves performance across four different VLA architectures. In real-robot experiments, it achieves 76.67% average success across three instruction-conditioned manipulation tasks, outperforming full-input pretraining by 25 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出动作专家预训练新阶段 SCAP：在预训练中随机掩码视觉与文本 token，构造诊断模型揭示单模态预训练会永久关闭视觉-语言联合建模通路，SCAP 可保留该通路并降低视觉捷径依赖，四个 VLA 架构一致提升，真机三任务平均成功率 76.67%（+25 个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 单模态动作专家预训练能抑制视觉捷径竞争，但会损害后续 VLA 适配所需的视觉-语言交互；作者希望找到一种既抑制捷径又保留联合建模能力的预训练方式。
AI.method: 构建可解释的诊断模型：VA 或 LA 预训练会使初始活跃的联合视觉-语言建模通路失活，且后续全输入训练无法恢复。据此提出 SCAP：在完整输入训练前的动作专家预训练阶段，将视觉与文本 token 随机掩码后再输入 VLM，使动作专家必须依赖部分上下文，从而在该诊断模型中保住联合通路。
AI.result: 诊断模型中 SCAP 在预训练与后续全输入训练中均保留联合视觉-语言通路；相较直接全输入训练，减少视觉捷径依赖、增强语言指令依赖；在四种 VLA 架构上一致提升；真机三任务指令条件操作平均成功率 76.67%，超全输入预训练 25 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 掩码式随机上下文预训练是修复单模态预训练通路坍塌的简洁有效手段，可作为 VLA 训练流程中的前置阶段，兼顾捷径抑制与视觉-语言联合能力。

title: DepthMSA: Combinatorial Training and Budget-Aware Depth Allocation for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: State-of-the-art multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) models rely on large pretrained encoders, yet typically process every modality to its full depth, regardless of its computational cost or predictive contribution. This raises a fundamental question: how should limited computation be allocated across modalities to preserve predictive performance? We reveal a substantial mismatch between the computational cost of modality encoders and the predictive benefit of processing them more deeply, suggesting that different modalities require different encoding depths. However, enabling heterogeneous depths introduces a key challenge: representations extracted at different depths must still be effectively fused. To address this, we propose $\textbf{DepthMSA}$, a budget-aware framework that supports flexible modality depths within a single MSA model. Specifically, we introduce combinatorial anytime training, which supervises the fusion head across all cross-modal depth combinations using a single full-depth encoder pass. At inference, a training-free, cost-aware allocator selects the configuration with the lowest validation-calibrated error under a sample-specific FLOPs budget. On CMU-MOSEI, DepthMSA maintains accuracy within one percentage point of the full-depth model while reducing measured FLOPs by 45\%, or by 82\% with a separately trained skip-enabled variant. When a CLIP visual encoder dominates computation, the allocation shifts toward reducing visual depth, achieving 56\% fewer FLOPs at unchanged accuracy. Compared with ADMN, an adaptive layer-allocation method that trains a controller for each budget, the skip-enabled variant reaches its accuracy with 3.2$\times$ fewer FLOPs and lower latency, without any per-budget training. Our project is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: DepthMSA：预算感知的多模态情感分析框架，按模态分配编码深度，通过组合式 anytime training 单次全深度前向监督所有跨模态深度组合的融合头，推理时用免训练代价感知分配器按样本FLOPs预算选配置。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感分析模型对所有模态都做全深度编码，忽略各模态编码计算成本与预测收益的不匹配；但引入异构深度后，不同深度的表征仍需有效融合。
AI.method: 1) combinatorial anytime training：用一次全深度编码器前向同时监督所有跨模态深度组合下的融合头；2) 推理阶段免训练、代价感知的分配器，依据验证集校准误差，在样本级FLOPs预算下选择误差最低的深度配置；3) 另提供可跳过（skip-enabled）变体，单独训练。
AI.result: CMU-MOSEI上精度与全深度模型相差1个百分点以内，实测FLOPs降低45%（skip变体降低82%）；当CLIP视觉编码器主导计算时，分配转向削减视觉深度，精度不变下FLOPs降低56%；相比ADMN（每种预算训练一个控制器），skip变体以3.2×更少FLOPs和更低延迟达到同等精度，且无需逐预算训练。
AI.conclusion: 模态间计算成本与预测收益存在显著错配，异构编码深度是可行的效率优化方向；组合式 anytime training 使单模型支持任意深度组合的融合，配合免训练分配器可实现样本级自适应计算分配，避免逐预算重复训练。

title: Backbone-Specific LoRA Geometry: Orthogonality, Superposition, and Provenance
summary: Sharing one low-rank adaptation (LoRA) update across pretrained models simplifies deployment. Composition methods typically combine updates from a common backbone, while cross-model transfer transforms updates for a target backbone. The conditions for sharing updates across backbones while preserving accuracy and distinguishing individual contributions remain unclear. Our idea is to use backbone-specific update directions as signatures of their training backbones. We derive a cross-backbone correlation bound from attention symmetries and equivariant LoRA learning under independent, uniform pretrained feature orientations. A local gradient-flow model explains positive mean correlation between independent runs on the same backbone and task. These patterns motivate cosine-based backbone identification and inner-product tests for registered-adapter reuse without coordinate alignment. Experiments on CLIP backbones show that shared sums achieve nearly the same mean accuracy as separate adapters. Cosine scores reliably identify source backbones across the evaluated tasks. Registered adapters remain detectable in sums of adapters from different backbones.

AI.tldr: 该论文将跨骨干LoRA更新的方向视为训练来源的"签名"，从注意力对称性与等变LoRA学习推导跨骨干相关性界，用余弦相似度识别来源骨干、用内积检验实现已注册适配器复用，并在CLIP骨干上验证共享求和的精度损失很小。
AI.motivation: 共享一份LoRA更新可大幅简化多模型部署，但跨骨干共享更新时"能否保持精度"与"能否区分各自贡献"缺乏理论条件与可操作判据，坐标对齐又难以获得。
AI.method: 在独立、均匀预训练特征朝向假设下，由注意力对称性与等变LoRA学习推导跨骨干相关性上界；用局部梯度流模型解释同骨干同任务独立训练的LoRA更新呈正平均相关；据此提出基于余弦相似度的骨干识别与基于内积的注册适配器复用检验，无需坐标对齐。
AI.result: CLIP骨干实验显示共享求和适配器平均精度接近独立适配器；余弦分数在所测任务上可靠识别源骨干；来自不同骨干的适配器在求和后仍可被检测。
AI.conclusion: LoRA更新方向可作为骨干身份签名，为跨骨干适配器共享与归属检测提供理论界与轻量检验工具，但实验限于CLIP视觉-语言骨干，未涉及机器人策略场景。

title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Qwen3-VL for Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at SIMC 2026 (Springer LNEE)
summary: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) requires joint recovery of symbol identity and two-dimensional syntax, so a locally plausible transcription may still be structurally wrong. We study whether a compact vision-language model can be adapted to generate linearized Symbol Label Graphs (SLGs) under limited computing resources. Starting from a 4-bit Qwen3-VL-4B checkpoint, we apply rank-16 Low-Rank Adaptation to the vision, language, attention, and MLP modules and train with instruction-formatted CROHME 2019 examples. We compare this model with an internally implemented ViT-Transformer baseline, a zero-shot Qwen3-VL configuration, and additional internally evaluated alternatives. On the 1,198 valid CROHME test examples, the CROHME-only model obtains 524 exact matches (43.74%) and a corpus BLEU-4 score of 77.67, compared with 4.92% and 43.26 for the task-specific ViT baseline. An ablation that adds 2,000 manually written, formula-guided samples decreases exact match to 42.32%, exposing a domain-alignment issue rather than an automatic benefit from more data. The principal contribution is therefore an evidence-backed, resource-efficient formulation of HMER as multimodal structural generation, together with a controlled data-composition ablation and an analysis of the remaining gap between local token overlap and globally correct structure.

AI.tldr: 用4-bit量化的Qwen3-VL-4B加rank-16 LoRA，在CROHME 2019上微调，把手写数学公式识别表述为生成线性化符号标签图(SLG)的结构化多模态生成任务。
AI.motivation: HMER需同时恢复符号身份与二维语法结构，局部合理的转写可能整体结构错误；同时探索在有限算力下紧凑VLM能否胜任该任务。
AI.method: 从4-bit Qwen3-VL-4B出发，对视觉、语言、注意力与MLP模块施加rank-16 LoRA，用指令格式的CROHME 2019样本训练；对比内部实现的ViT-Transformer基线、zero-shot Qwen3-VL及若干内部变体；并做数据构成消融（额外加入2000条手工撰写、公式引导样本）。
AI.result: CROHME 1198条测试样本上精确匹配524条(43.74%)、语料BLEU-4为77.67；ViT基线仅4.92%与43.26。加入2000条人工样本后精确匹配反降至42.32%，表明存在领域对齐问题而非数据越多越好。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是把HMER作为多模态结构化生成的资源高效建模方案，辅以受控数据构成消融，并指出局部token重叠与全局结构正确性之间仍存在差距。

title: Dem2TA: Beyond Pixels, Towards Perception
summary: Task-oriented image signal processors (ISPs) adapt RAW-to-RGB processing for downstream perception. However, explicit demosaicing is often simplified, kept fixed, or optimized primarily for reconstruction quality, leaving this stage insufficiently integrated into task adaptation. We propose \textbf{Dem2TA}, a framework that incorporates fidelity-supervised demosaicing into the adaptation of the perception pipeline. Starting from a pretrained demosaicing model, we jointly adapt the reconstruction frontend and downstream network using reconstruction and task supervision, together with complementary semantic and task representation alignment. We then freeze the adapted frontend and jointly optimize a lightweight local ISP with the downstream model to refine task-specific rendering without changing the reconstructed linear RGB. Experiments on synthetic RAW detection and box-prompted segmentation demonstrate the effectiveness of representation-guided joint adaptation and subsequent local rendering. Evaluation on a manually verified real-capture dataset further supports transfer beyond synthetic inputs. Compared with TA-ISP on the same adapted foundation, Dem2TA improves detection AP by 0.46 points and segmentation IoU by 1.06 points on synthetic COCO RAW, and segmentation IoU by 0.63 points on real captures.

AI.tldr: Dem2TA将保真监督的去马赛克模型连同下游感知网络联合适配，并在冻结前端后联合优化轻量局部ISP以精修任务相关渲染，在合成与真实RAW上提升检测与分割性能。
AI.motivation: 任务导向ISP中，显式去马赛克常被简化、固定或仅按重建质量优化，未充分融入任务自适应流程。作者希望在保真重建的前提下，让去马赛克前端与下游感知任务协同适配。
AI.method: 从预训练去马赛克模型出发，用重建监督与任务监督联合适配重建前端和下游网络，并加入语义与任务表征对齐；随后冻结适配后的前端，联合优化一个轻量局部ISP与下游模型，在不改变重建线性RGB的条件下精修任务相关渲染。实验覆盖合成RAW目标检测与box-prompted分割，并在人工核验的真实拍摄数据集上验证迁移性。
AI.result: 在相同适配基础模型下，相比TA-ISP，合成COCO RAW上检测AP提升0.46点、分割IoU提升1.06点；真实拍摄数据上分割IoU提升0.63点。
AI.conclusion: 将保真监督去马赛克纳入感知管线适配，并通过表征引导的联合适配与后续局部渲染，可有效提升任务性能并从合成迁移至真实采集输入；但增益幅度较小，且未涉及机器人或具身交互验证。

title: NavTTT: Adaptive Parametric Memory via Hierarchical Test-Time Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) demands that agents accumulate and reason over streaming visual observations throughout long navigation episodes. Existing approaches struggle to maintain long-term history, constrained by the finite context capacity of transformer architectures. To solve the problem, fast-weight test-time training (TTT) provides a mechanism for encoding streaming observations into an evolving parameter state. However, existing TTT does not distinguish informative observations from repetitive visual content, allowing redundant tokens to interfere with the retention of information needed for subsequent decisions. We propose Navigation-Conditioned Test-Time Training (NavTTT), which introduces adaptive memory formation and hierarchical memory integration for vision-and-language navigation. NavTTT leverages global navigation context to prioritize informative visual evidence and integrates language instructions with spatial information to construct spatially grounded memory representations. Episode-local nonlinear fast weights store these representations as Adaptive Parametric Memory (APM), preserving history beyond the visual context for later decisions. To reduce cross-layer coupling in memory formation, NavTTT maintains independent fast-weight memories across multiple decoder depths. This decoupled design prevents errors or biases from spreading across different memory levels. Meanwhile, it enables shared historical information to be independently represented at various levels of abstraction. Experiments demonstrate strong navigation performance on VLN-CE benchmarks and effective instruction following on a real robot.

AI.tldr: NavTTT 将导航条件化的测试时训练（TTT）引入 VLN-CE：用全局导航上下文筛选信息量大的视觉观测，融合语言指令与空间信息构建空间接地记忆，并以跨解码器深度的独立 fast-weight 记忆实现分层自适应参数记忆（APM），在 VLN-CE 基准与真实机器人上验证有效。
AI.motivation: VLN 需要在长回合中累积并推理流式视觉观测，但 Transformer 上下文容量有限，难以维持长期历史。现有 fast-weight TTT 虽可将流式观测编码为演化参数状态，却无法区分有信息量观测与重复视觉内容，冗余 token 会干扰后续决策所需信息的保留。
AI.method: 提出 NavTTT：(1) 利用全局导航上下文进行自适应记忆形成，对有信息量的视觉证据加权；(2) 将语言指令与空间信息结合，构建空间接地的记忆表示；(3) 以回合级非线性 fast weights 存储为自适应参数记忆（APM），把历史保存在视觉上下文之外；(4) 在多个解码器深度维护相互独立的 fast-weight 记忆，减少层间耦合，防止误差/偏置跨层传播，同时让共享历史在不同抽象层级独立表示。
AI.result: 在 VLN-CE 基准上取得较强导航性能，并在真实机器人上展示有效的指令跟随能力。
AI.conclusion: 导航条件化的分层 TTT 记忆是突破 Transformer 上下文瓶颈、实现长时程具身导航记忆的有效途径，且可迁移到真实平台。

title: EAST: Event-Anchored Surface Transport for Event-Based Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Event-supervised Gaussian reconstruction combines the high temporal resolution and wide dynamic range of event cameras with efficient explicit rendering. However, recovering a continuous surface remains difficult: changes in rendered appearance can compensate for depth errors while preserving the predicted brightness changes. We introduce Event-Anchored Surface Transport (EAST), which couples an event-constrained signed distance field to Gaussian rendering. Triangulation-supported candidates anchor the zero set, while normal flow measured from event timing constrains ray-surface intersection depths. Gaussian centers receive bounded corrections from the descriptor difference between the live field and a frozen initial reference. The correction is zero at initialization, yet transmits image gradients to the live field. Experiments on PAEv3D and NeRF Synthetic show improved surface accuracy and reference-view rendering over Gaussian baselines, together with efficient mesh extraction from the learned field.

AI.tldr: EAST 将事件约束的 SDF 与高斯渲染耦合，用事件三角化候选锚定零水平集、用事件法向流约束射线-表面交点深度，并对高斯中心施加有界修正，从而解决事件监督重建中"外观变化掩盖深度误差"的歧义。
AI.motivation: 事件监督高斯重建兼具事件相机的高时间分辨率、宽动态范围与显式渲染的效率，但恢复连续表面困难：渲染外观的变化可以在保持预测亮度变化一致的前提下补偿深度误差，导致几何监督信号存在退化/歧义。
AI.method: 提出 Event-Anchored Surface Transport（EAST）：(1) 事件约束的 SDF 场与高斯渲染耦合；(2) 由三角化支持的候选点锚定 SDF 零集；(3) 由事件时间戳测得的法向流约束光线-表面交点深度；(4) 高斯中心接收来自"实时场与冻结初始参考场"描述子差异的有界修正，该修正初始为零，但可将图像梯度回传至实时场。
AI.result: 在 PAEv3D 与 NeRF Synthetic 上，相较高斯基线提升了表面精度与参考视角渲染质量，并能从学习到的场中高效提取网格。
AI.conclusion: 通过事件锚定零集与法向流深度约束，可在不牺牲渲染效率的前提下缓解深度-外观耦合歧义，获得更准确的连续隐式表面与网格；但评估仅在合成/受控数据集上进行，缺少真实事件数据与泛化性验证。

title: Trailblazer-F: Speculative Action-Flow Inference for Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving world-action models generate planned trajectories through iterative action denoising, with each update depending on the preceding state. This sequential dependency incurs substantial inference latency, limiting timely planning. Speculative inference offers an opportunity to reduce this latency by predicting future denoising states for parallel target evaluation, but requires efficient proposal generation and suitable verification for continuous actions. We present Trailblazer-F, a speculative action-flow inference framework in which a lightweight drafter acts as a trailblazer, charting a candidate denoising path through the compact, structured waypoint space so that the target model can verify multiple steps in parallel and advance with fewer sequential updates. Our method maintains planning quality while keeping the pretrained target model this http URL all 12,146 NAVSIM v1 navtest scenes, Trailblazer-F maintains near-baseline planning performance, with PDMS changes of +0.04 and -0.08 points for SimWAM and DriveWAM, respectively. Paired inference measurements on an NVIDIA L20 GPU yield 2.31x and 1.55x speedups. Real-vehicle experiments on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin further demonstrate 1.96x and 1.37x speedups, together with close qualitative trajectory agreement with native sampling. our code is here this https URL

AI.tldr: Trailblazer-F 提出推测式（speculative）动作流推理框架：用轻量 drafter 在紧凑结构化 waypoint 空间中先行"探路"生成候选去噪路径，目标模型由此可并行验证多步、减少串行更新，从而降低驾驶世界-动作模型的规划延迟。
AI.motivation: 驾驶世界-动作模型通过迭代动作去噪生成轨迹，每步依赖前一状态，串行依赖导致推理延迟高，难以满足实时规划需求。推测式推理可缓解，但连续动作空间中的高效候选生成与验证仍是难点。
AI.method: 轻量 drafter 在紧凑的结构化 waypoint 空间（而非原始连续动作空间）中预测未来去噪状态、生成候选路径；冻结的预训练目标模型对多步候选并行验证，仅保留被接受的前进步骤，从而以更少的串行去噪更新完成规划，保持质量同时不修改目标模型。
AI.result: 在全部 12,146 个 NAVSIM v1 navtest 场景上，SimWAM 与 DriveWAM 的 PDMS 变化分别为 +0.04 与 -0.08 点（近乎持平基线）；NVIDIA L20 上获得 2.31x 与 1.55x 加速；Jetson AGX Orin 实车实验获得 1.96x 与 1.37x 加速，轨迹与原生采样的定性一致性良好。
AI.conclusion: 推测式推理（drafter-verify 并行）可有效加速扩散式驾驶世界-动作模型，几乎无损保真度，并在边缘车载平台（Orin）上验证了实时性收益，具备实际部署价值。

title: Prune to Expand: Training Prompt Enhancers with Less to Imitate
summary: Prompt enhancement (PE) refines concise user prompts into detailed descriptions to improve the compositional aesthetics of generated images while preserving user intent. A common practice constructs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) pairs by deriving short, user-like prompts from dense captions, implicitly assuming that captions that improve image generation also provide effective supervision. In this paper, however, we uncover a counterintuitive finding: PE models trained on caption pairs with substantial generation gains perform comparably to those trained on pairs with only marginal gains. We argue that dense captions can impose redundant supervision by requiring PE models to reproduce image-specific details weakly related to user intent. Motivated by this discrepancy, we introduce Prune to Expand (P2E), a simple text-only method that refines dense-caption supervision by selectively removing redundant sentences under a per-example deletion bound while preserving explicit user requirements and informative visual structure. Extensive experiments under identical training configurations demonstrate that P2E improves alignment with human preferences and visual quality over conventional dense-caption SFT across diverse image categories and visual generators.

AI.tldr: 训练于高/低生成增益字幕对的Prompt Enhancement模型效果相近，冗余字幕细节构成弱相关监督；提出纯文本方法P2E，按删除上限剪除冗余句子，提升人类偏好对齐与视觉质量。
