AI.motivation: SFT配对构建默认"能提升生成的字幕即有效监督"，但这一假设未经检验；dense caption中与用户意图弱相关的图像特指细节可能迫使PE模型复现冗余信息，削弱监督效率。
AI.method: 反直觉对照实验：按生成增益高低分组构建字幕对训练PE模型并比较。据此提出P2E——纯文本数据侧方法，在每条样本删除句数上限约束下，选择性移除冗余句子，同时保留显式用户要求与有信息量的视觉结构。
AI.result: 在相同训练配置下，跨多样图像类别与多种生成器，P2E相较常规dense-caption SFT在人类偏好对齐与视觉质量上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 监督信号质量而非数量决定PE效果；对数据做删除式精炼是低成本、模型无关的提升途径，提示字幕-生成绩效增益并非可靠的数据筛选代理指标。

title: WINSO: A Large-Size Very-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Dataset for Wind Turbine Detection and Solar Panel Segmentation
summary: Wind and solar energy are central to the global transition toward net-zero emissions and sustainable development. Accurate spatial inventories of wind and solar facilities are essential for future energy planning. Satellite remote sensing provides a practical and efficient means to acquire such geospatial data at scale. However, reliable facility mapping from large-size satellite images remains constrained by the scarcity of carefully annotated datasets and the lack of systematic evaluation protocols. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{WINSO}, a large-scale wind and solar benchmark based on very-high-resolution (VHR) satellite imagery with ground sampling distances (GSDs) of 0.5--0.7\,m. WINSO comprises 10,962 large-size images sampled from diverse geographic locations across the Asia-Pacific region, covering at least 71,600\,$\text{km}^2$ and totaling 286.36 gigapixels, with individual image dimensions reaching 44,032$\times$62,208 pixels. Through manual annotation and expert verification, a total of 166,473 instances are labeled using horizontal bounding boxes (HBBs) for wind turbines and polygon masks for solar panels. To build baselines for clean-energy facility mapping, we evaluate state-of-the-art detection and segmentation models, specialized ultra-high-resolution (UHR) architectures, and vision-language models across different inference strategies. Furthermore, cross-dataset evaluations on two external public datasets illustrate the strong generalization capability of the WINSO. WINSO establishes a standardized benchmark to advance automated clean-energy mapping, paving the way for wide-area monitoring of the clean-energy transition.

AI.tldr: WINSO：基于0.5–0.7 m VHR卫星影像的大规模风电/光伏设施测绘基准，含10,962幅超大尺寸影像（286.36 gigapixels，单图最大44,032×62,208像素），166,473个实例（风机HBB、光伏板polygon），并提供检测/分割/UHR专用架构/VLM多策略基线及跨数据集泛化评测。
AI.motivation: 风/光设施空间清单对净零能源规划至关重要，卫星遥感是大规模获取此类地理数据的可行途径；但大尺寸卫星影像上的设施制图受限于精细标注数据稀缺与缺乏系统评测协议。
AI.method: 构建亚太区域多地理位置的VHR（GSD 0.5–0.7 m）大图数据集；经人工标注与专家核验，风机用HBB、光伏板用polygon mask；在统一协议下评测SOTA检测/分割模型、UHR专用架构与视觉语言模型的多推理策略，并在两个外部公开数据集上做跨数据集泛化评估。
AI.result: WINSO覆盖≥71,600 km²、共286.36 gigapixels、166,473个实例，单图尺寸达44,032×62,208像素；SOTA检测、分割、UHR架构与VLM基线均被系统评测，跨数据集实验显示较强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: WINSO建立了标准化基准以推进自动化清洁能源设施测绘，为广域清洁能源转型监测提供数据与评测基础。

title: Beyond Prompt Imitation: Capability-Aware Video Generation with Smaller Models
summary: Inference-time methods that lift a small open video generator toward a proprietary one are compared through preference scores, which never say how much of the gap to a target video they close. We introduce the oracle control ladder, which hands a fixed student progressively richer information from a target clip and reads the closure of each fidelity metric at each rung as an empirical headroom reference for the methods that must synthesize that information. On 954 clips of the principal student, a dense caption reproduces little of the appearance and almost none of the motion of a target, a first frame closes half of the appearance gap and a tenth of the motion gap, a depth video closes three quarters of the motion gap and leaves color untouched, and the two together close 64 to 94% of every fidelity gap across four teachers, while a second student agrees on the rungs that it accepts. An item response model forecasts which rung closes which clip with held-out AUC of 0.76 to 0.95 on the fidelity criteria and serves as the prior of a budgeted selection policy. When controls are free, a fixed dense-control rung is hard to improve upon, and once controls are priced the policy lies above the fixed-rung frontier at matched cost and survives critics that ruin critic-driven search.

AI.tldr: 提出"oracle control ladder"：用从目标视频中逐步注入的更强控制信息（稠密描述→首帧→深度视频→两者结合）测量各保真度指标的闭合率，为视频生成方法的推理时改进提供经验上限参照，并用IRT模型预测各clip的最优控制档位。
AI.motivation: 推理时方法（如提升小型开源视频生成器逼近闭源模型）只用偏好分数比较，无法说明它们究竟弥补了多少与目标视频之间的差距，缺乏可量化的headroom参照。
AI.method: 在固定学生模型上构建递进式控制阶梯：稠密caption、首帧、深度视频及二者组合；在954个clip上测量外观/运动/颜色等fidelity指标的闭合比例；用item response model预测每档控制在每个clip上的闭合效果，并以此作为预算受限选择策略的先验。
AI.result: 稠密描述几乎无法复现外观与运动；首帧闭合约一半外观差距、十分之一运动差距；深度视频闭合约四分之三运动差距但不改善颜色；两者结合在四位教师模型下闭合64–94%的各fidelity差距；第二学生模型对接受的档位结论一致；IRT在fidelity上留出AUC 0.76–0.95；控制免费时固定稠密档难以超越，计入成本后策略在同等代价下优于固定档前沿，且对破坏性critic搜索具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 以"闭合率"而非偏好分数衡量推理时方法的有效性，提供了可解释的headroom校准框架与成本感知的控制选择策略。

title: AceVLN: Asynchronous Cloud Edge Deployment of VLNs via Latent Scheduling and Compensation
summary: Cloud--edge deployment enables asynchronous dual-system VLN on resource-constrained robots, but inference and communication delays cause latent mismatch and navigation errors. Existing adaptation methods reuse historical guidance but cannot provide updated navigation information when it becomes inadequate. We propose AceVLN, a training-free framework for active latent refresh and edge-side compensation. Our analysis reveals that action-relevant mismatch is concentrated in a compact Critical Subspace and can be tracked through fast-system feature drift. Critical Feature Drift Entropy reflects navigation sensitivity and guides adaptive refresh, while Critical Drift Continuity indicates when recent latent updates can support compensation during latency spikes. AceVLN integrates subspace-decoupled mismatch modeling, entropy-guided refresh scheduling, and continuity-guided compensation. Experiments show that \textit{AceVLN} improves success rates by 1.7--2.4 percentage points over the strongest baselines, while reducing amortized computation time by 2.7--10.0\% and FLOPs by 18.4--22.3\%.

AI.tldr: AceVLN：训练-free 的云-边双系统 VLN 潜空间主动刷新与边缘补偿框架
AI.motivation: 云-边部署的异步双系统 VLN 在资源受限机器人上存在推理与通信延迟，导致慢系统的潜空间特征与快系统观测失配，引发导航错误；现有复用历史引导的适配方法在引导失效时无法提供更新信息。
AI.method: 先分析发现动作相关失配集中于紧致的"关键子空间"，并可由快系统特征漂移追踪；据此定义关键特征漂移熵（衡量导航敏感性，驱动自适应刷新调度）与关键漂移连续性（判断延迟尖峰期近期潜更新能否支撑补偿）；框架由子空间解耦失配建模、熵引导刷新调度、连续性引导补偿三部分组成，无需训练。
AI.result: 成功率较最强基线提升 1.7–2.4 个百分点，同时摊销计算时间减少 2.7–10.0%，FLOPs 减少 18.4–22.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以潜空间失配的结构化分析替代单纯历史复用，可在几乎零训练成本下同时提升异步双系统 VLN 的鲁棒性与效率；摘要未明确说明实机/仿真验证场景，证据强度待正文确认。

title: AELF: Active Terrain-Aware UAV Exploration Using a Lightweight Framework
summary: This paper presents an efficient and robust approach for autonomous aerial exploration in complex environments. Instead of relying on conventional 3D voxel-based maps for exploration, we utilize a lightweight 2.5D map framework that reduces computational overhead while preserving essential topographic information. More importantly, this representation systematically eliminates the blind voxel problem commonly encountered in voxel-based exploration due to occlusions and limited visibility. Unlike previous methods that rely on a fixed altitude scale for exploration, our approach requires no prior height information and actively adapts to terrain elevation changes during exploration. To further enhance exploration efficiency while preserving the generality of 3D exploration, we perform 2D path planning on the 2.5D map framework, which is then lifted to 3D to evaluate the cost between viewpoints by taking into account terrain traversability, thereby reducing frequent altitude changes and enabling smoother exploration. Extensive experiments conducted in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate the effectiveness and advantages of our approach over existing solutions. Our approach demonstrates fast exploration of over 2000~$\text{m}^2$ of cluttered forest and sloped mountainous terrain with elevation changes of up to 10~m, reaching a maximum speed of 5~m/s in real-world tests.

AI.tldr: 提出基于轻量2.5D地图的无人机自主探索方法，系统消除体素盲区问题，无需先验高度且自适应地形起伏，在2.5D上做2D路径规划再提升到3D代价评估，实现复杂森林与山地的高效探索。
AI.motivation: 传统三维体素地图探索计算开销大，且因遮挡与可见性受限产生"盲体素"问题；已有方法依赖固定高度尺度，缺乏对地形高程变化的适应性。
AI.method: 用2.5D轻量地图替代3D体素地图保留地形信息并降低开销；在该表示上显式消除盲体素；在线自适应地形高程、无需先验高度；在2.5D上做2D路径规划，提升到3D并结合地形可通行性评估视点间代价，减少频繁高度变化以获得更平滑的轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真与真实环境实验中优于现有方案；真实场景下在起伏达10 m的杂乱森林与坡地中完成超2000 m²的快速探索，最高速度达5 m/s。
AI.conclusion: 2.5D表示结合2D规划加3D代价提升的范式可在保持3D探索通用性的同时显著提升效率与鲁棒性，适用于复杂地形下的无人机自主探索。

title: EAGLE: Entity-Aware Grounding with Layered Evidence for High-Resolution Image Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle with fine-grained understanding of high-resolution images: attention heads vary in their reliability for grounding target entities and their attributes, while localized details are often disconnected from the broader scene context. We propose EAGLE (Entity-Aware Grounding with Layered Evidence for High-Resolution Image Understanding), a plug-in framework that jointly selects grounding signals and organizes hierarchical visual evidence. EAGLE employs a fine-grained dataset to screen visually-grounded attention heads, followed by entity-aware grounding to extract target-specific regions. It then integrates hierarchical evidence construction and question-guided routing to select optimal view combinations, feeding them into the frozen MLLM to enhance fine-grained visual understanding. Experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3-8B demonstrate that EAGLE consistently improves performance across both backbones and achieves SOTA results on V*, HRBench-4K, and HRBench-8K compared with existing methods using the same backbone.

AI.tldr: EAGLE：面向高分辨率图像理解的插件式框架，通过筛选视觉接地注意力头、实体感知区域提取与分层证据路由，为冻结MLLM提供细粒度证据。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在高分辨率图像细粒度理解上存在两个问题：不同注意力头对目标实体及其属性的接地可靠性差异大；局部细节与全局场景上下文割裂。
AI.method: 构建细粒度数据集用于筛选具备视觉接地的注意力头；实体感知接地提取目标专属区域；分层证据构建 + 问题引导路由选择最优视角组合；送入冻结MLLM推理，无需微调。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B与InternVL3-8B两个骨干上均稳定提升；在V*、HRBench-4K、HRBench-8K上取得同骨干条件下的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过注意力头级接地信号筛选与分层多视角证据组织，可有效增强冻结MLLM的高分辨率细粒度理解能力，具备良好跨骨干可迁移性。

title: PP-CFG: Polarity-Preserving Guidance for Controllable Few-Step Image and Video Generation
summary: Few-step diffusion distillation reduces sampling cost but often weakens adjustable classifier-free guidance (CFG) and runtime negative prompting. We introduce PP-CFG, an architecture that keeps positive and negative text conditions separate and combines their attention responses with opposite signs within a shared visual backbone. Its Scale-Time Polarity Mixer refines each condition using the guidance scale and denoising timestep, allowing prompt influence to vary throughout generation. The student retains a continuous scale input and selectable negative prompts with one visual backbone pass per step. We evaluate PP-CFG on Wan2.1 for video generation with distribution matching distillation (DMD), and on Qwen-Image with both latent consistency model (LCM) distillation and DMD. PP-CFG achieves 81.46 VBench in four steps and lower video teacher-student distances across guidance scales than step-distilled DMD. On NegElement-1K, our benchmark of 1,000 matched image and video prompt cases, it achieves higher target-removal rates than the corresponding teachers. These experiments support the method's generality across attention architectures, generation modalities, and distillation objectives while retaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: PP-CFG 提出正负文本条件分离、在共享视觉骨干中以相反符号融合注意力响应的少步扩散蒸馏架构，通过 Scale-Time Polarity Mixer 随引导尺度与时间步调制条件影响，恢复少步模型的运行时 CFG 与负提示能力。
AI.motivation: 少步扩散蒸馏虽降低采样成本，但常削弱可调 CFG 与运行时负提示能力，使学生模型失去教师的关键可控性。
AI.method: 将正、负文本条件分离编码，在共享视觉骨干内以相反符号组合其注意力响应；引入 Scale-Time Polarity Mixer，依据 CFG 尺度与去噪时间步精炼各条件；学生模型保留连续尺度输入与可选负提示，每步仅一次骨干前向。在 Wan2.1（视频，DMD）与 Qwen-Image（LCM 与 DMD）上验证。
AI.result: 四步采样达 81.46 VBench，在各引导尺度下视频师生距离低于 step-distilled DMD；在自建 NegElement-1K（1000 组图文/视频匹配提示）上目标去除率高于对应教师模型，且保持竞争力生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在注意力架构、生成模态与蒸馏目标上具有通用性，可在少步蒸馏中同时保留可控性与质量。

title: Budgeted Safety Verification for Streaming Video Generation
summary: A streamed video generator releases each chunk the moment that it is produced, so a safety decision that waits for the finished clip arrives after the harm has been seen. We measure a guardrail by exposure, the harmful frames a viewer is shown, and ask where a fixed moderation budget should be spent. The accurate detector reads decoded frames with a video language model and is too expensive for every chunk, so our guard reads hidden states the generator has computed already and spends a cheap score on deciding when to call it. On 599 streams from a distilled causal generator the undefended model shows 46.25 harmful frames of 81. The video model on every chunk leaves 0.91 frames at 80.1 scored per benign stream, and the same model triggered by our guard leaves 2.35 at 5.3. Spending that budget at random leaves 37.20 frames, so the gain is in the ordering, and a frame detector in the same role gives up almost six, so the judging stage must read the chunk as a clip. The ordering is worth more as the stream lengthens, and the guard carries to a second system. An independent guardrail model agrees with our oracle at $\kappa=0.74$, and a blinded audit by 50 participants puts its precision at 96.1% and recall at 82.8%. Warning. This paper contains examples of generated content that some readers may find disturbing or offensive in nature.

AI.tldr: 面向流式视频生成器的实时安全护栏：利用生成器已计算的隐状态做廉价打分，决定何时调用昂贵的视频语言模型检测器，以"曝光帧数"衡量护栏效果。
AI.motivation: 流式生成逐块即时发布，等整段生成完毕再判定安全性为时已晚，有害内容已被观众看到；而每块都调用高精度检测器代价过高，需研究固定审核预算的最优分配。
AI.method: 提出"曝光"（exposure，观众实际看到的有害帧数）作为护栏指标；轻量guard读取生成器内部隐状态给出廉价分数，据此排序并触发（cascade）视频语言模型对解码帧的块级检测；与随机分配预算、以及同角色帧级检测器对比。
AI.result: 在599条流、1-4B蒸馏因果生成器上，无防护46.25/81有害帧；全量调用视频模型降至0.91帧但每良性与流需评分80.1次；guard触发仅2.35帧、评分5.3次；随机分配为37.20帧；同角色帧检测器多泄漏近6帧；流越长收益越大，且可迁移到第二系统。独立护栏模型与oracle一致度κ=0.74；50人盲审精确率96.1%、召回率82.8%。
AI.conclusion: 有序、按需触发的级联护栏可在极小预算下大幅降低有害内容曝光，关键在于隐状态打分排序；判定阶段必须以"片段"而非单帧作为输入单元。

title: MODULE: A Mutual-Promoting Deep Unfolding Framework Towards Degradation-Robust Multi-modal Image Fusion
summary: Multi-modal image fusion is crucial for comprehensive scene representation, yet real-world degradations compromise its efficacy, necessitating degradation-robust fusion paradigms. Existing degradation-robust multi-modal image fusion methods are often hindered by cascaded sub-optimal solution or black-box opacity. To address these challenges, we propose a theory-inspired mutual-promoting deep unfolding framework. It reformulates degradation-robust image fusion as a joint optimization problem, utilizing the degradation model and modality generation mechanism to explicitly model both single-task priors and cross-task dependencies. By decomposing the complex multi-task optimization problem into task-related iterative subproblems, the framework establishes a bidirectional reciprocal information flow between restoration and fusion. This process is further unfolded into a multi-stage deep neural network, where each component explicitly corresponds to a specific mathematical operation. In our framework, the fused cross-modal prior actively regularizes the ill-posed restoration, while the purified modality features continuously refine the fusion output. It ensures a transparent architecture that combines the merits of both model-based and data-driven methodologies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our paradigm achieves state-of-the-art performance while providing superior interpretability. The code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出受理论启发的互相促进深度展开框架，将退化鲁棒多模态图像融合重构为联合优化问题，通过分解为迭代子问题建立复原与融合的双向信息流，并展开为多阶段网络。
AI.motivation: 现有退化鲁棒多模态图像融合方法存在级联次优解与黑箱不可解释两大缺陷，需要同时兼顾性能与透明性的统一范式。
AI.method: 利用退化模型与模态生成机制显式建模单任务先验和跨任务依赖，把复杂多任务优化分解为与任务相关的迭代子问题，形成复原—融合双向互促信息流；再将迭代过程逐层展开为多阶段深度网络，每个模块对应明确数学算子，其中融合的跨模态先验正则化病态复原问题，净化后的模态特征反过来精炼融合结果。
AI.result: 大量实验显示该范式在退化鲁棒融合任务上达到SOTA，同时具备更优的可解释性，且代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 模型驱动与数据驱动结合的展开式架构可有效解决退化条件下的多模态融合，并保持数学可解释性。

title: GAAFormer: Geometry-Anchored Attention Transformer for Joint Point Cloud Denoising and Upsampling
summary: Point cloud denoising and upsampling require samples that accurately recover the underlying surface from noisy or sparse observations. A central challenge in both tasks is preserving surface coverage while refining point locations. We introduce GAAFormer (Geometry-Anchored Attention Transformer), a unified generative octree transformer that performs both tasks with a shared network. Its decoder anchors attention neighborhoods to geometry, providing spatial context for occupancy prediction and point generation. Fixed voxel windows and alternating shifts preserve the grouping of surviving nodes as the output tree changes. The design retains the encoder, positional encoding, prediction heads, and parameter count of a serialized-attention backbone. We establish a deletion-consistency property of the neighborhood rule and evaluate both tasks using the same model. On PUNet, GAAFormer achieves a mean Chamfer distance (CD) of $6.0643\times10^{-5}$, reducing CD and Hausdorff distance by 3.35% and 19.34%, respectively, relative to the serialized backbone. For upsampling, it achieves CD values of $0.8475$, $1.7057$, and $1.0147$ ($\times10^{-5}$) on PU-GAN, PU1K, and Sketchfab, respectively, with improvements in CD, Hausdorff distance, and point-to-surface distance over the same backbone on PU-GAN and Sketchfab. These results establish a single architecture for point cloud denoising and upsampling. Within the shared encoder-decoder, the same geometry-anchored attention module improves both noise removal and dense point generation without task-specific redesign or additional parameters.

AI.tldr: GAAFormer 是一个统一的八叉树生成式 Transformer，用同一套编码器-解码器与"几何锚定注意力"同时完成点云去噪与上采样，在不增加参数的情况下提升倒角距离(CD)与 Hausdorff 距离。
AI.motivation: 点云去噪与上采样都需从噪声或稀疏观测中恢复底层曲面，核心难点是在细化点位的同时保持表面覆盖（避免收缩、空洞或分布不均）。作者希望用单一架构、共享参数同时解决两类任务，避免任务特定重设计。
AI.method: 提出 Geometry-Anchored Attention Transformer（GAAFormer）：在序列化注意力的八叉树骨干上，将解码器注意力邻域锚定到几何（固定体素窗口 + 交替位移），使输出树变化时存活节点的分组保持一致；保留原骨干的编码器、位置编码、预测头与参数量；并证明邻域规则的"删除一致性"（deletion-consistency）性质。
AI.result: PUNet 去噪上平均 CD 达 6.0643e-5，相对串行注意力骨干 CD 降低 3.35%、Hausdorff 距离降低 19.34%；上采样在 PU-GAN、PU1K、Sketchfab 上 CD 分别为 0.8475、1.7057、1.0147（×1e-5），在 PU-GAN 与 Sketchfab 上 CD、Hausdorff 与点到面距离均优于同骨干。
AI.conclusion: 同一架构可同时用于点云去噪与上采样，共享编码器-解码器中的几何锚定注意力模块在无任务特定改造、无额外参数的前提下同时改善去噪与稠密生成。

title: HermiteTwin: Bicubic Hermite Shell Digital Twins for Contact-Rich Deformable Manipulation
summary: While existing methods for reconstructing deformable object manipulation have made impressive progress, they typically represent a thin object with a single particle set that must serve two purposes at once: modeling bending, and resolving contact with the robot. To bridge this gap, we present HermiteTwin, a framework that reconstructs a physical digital twin of a thin deformable object from multiview video of a robot manipulating it. Our key idea is to represent deformation and contact separately, each at its own resolution. The object is simulated as a bicubic Hermite shell, a coarse grid of $C^1$ elements whose nodal positions and derivatives define a smooth surface with Kirchhoff--Love bending, while the gripper acts through dense samples in material space that are captured, clamped, and released, and whose attachment forces reach the shell through the Hermite basis. This decoupling keeps the physical state compact while contact stays fine-grained. We identify effective material and contact parameters with CMA-ES followed by adjoint-based refinement, and drive a reconstructed Gaussian appearance model with the simulated shell. In experiments on real cloth and foam manipulation, HermiteTwin outperforms the state-of-the-art spring--mass twin across reconstruction, resimulation, and future prediction.

AI.tldr: HermiteTwin 从机器人操作柔性薄物体的多视角视频中重建物理数字孪生，将变形表示（粗网格双三次 Hermite 壳单元，含Kirchhoff–Love弯曲）与接触表示（材料空间密集采样点，经Hermite基传递夹持力）解耦，用CMA-ES加伴随法辨识材料与接触参数，并用仿真壳驱动重建的高斯外观模型。
AI.motivation: 现有可变形物体操作重建方法用单一份点集/粒子同时承担弯曲建模与接触解析两项任务，导致分辨率需求冲突：弯曲希望状态紧凑，接触需要细粒度采样。作者希望以不同分辨率分别表示变形与接触来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 表示层：物体用双三次 Hermite 壳（C¹ 单元粗网格，节点位置与导数定义光滑曲面，Kirchhoff–Love 弯曲）+ 材料空间密集接触采样点（抓取/夹持/释放状态），接触力经 Hermite 基函数映射到壳；参数辨识：CMA-ES 全局搜索材料与接触参数，再用伴随（adjoint）梯度精修；外观：将仿真壳与重建的 Gaussian 外观模型耦合渲染。
AI.result: 在真实布料与泡沫操作实验中，HermiteTwin 在重建、再仿真（resimulation）与未来预测三项指标上均优于当前最优的 spring–mass 数字孪生基线。
AI.conclusion: 变形与接触分分辨率建模是一种有效且紧凑的薄可变形物体数字孪生方案，兼顾物理状态紧凑性与细粒度接触，并可与高斯外观重建良好结合；局限在于依赖已知几何/多视角采集与离线参数优化。

title: SIR-Agent: Skill-Augmented Image Restoration Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Agents for Image Restoration (IR) aim to leverage Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to autonomously perceive image degradation and invoke IR tools. However, existing IR agents typically rely on fine-tuning MLLM parameters to adapt to new IR tasks, leading to catastrophic forgetting of IR knowledge. To address this limitation, we propose a skill-augmented IR agent, dubbed SIR-Agent, that maintains IR knowledge in a scalable skill library and uses Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) to facilitate efficient skill-library evolution. Specifically, we design a Chain Feedback-driven Skill Revision (CFSR) to evolve the skill library. The CFSR analyzes restoration chains to identify and revise weak operations in existing skills. The compatibility of a revised skill with known tasks decides if it replaces the original skill or is appended independently. Furthermore, to advance CFSR's skill-library evolution, we present an RSI-driven skill meta-learning mechanism, which identifies CFSR's inefficient operations and autonomously refines its revision strategy. Extensive experiments across 14 IR benchmarks, covering 6 single-degradation and 8 mixed-degradation scenarios, demonstrate SIR-Agent's superior IR performance. Further evaluation on 7 unseen tasks validates SIR-Agent's generalization to new IR tasks.

AI.tldr: SIR-Agent：将图像复原知识存入可扩展技能库，用 Chain Feedback-driven Skill Revision (CFSR) 演化技能，并以 Recursive Self-Improvement 元学习优化修订策略，避免微调 MLLM 导致的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的图像复原（IR）智能体依赖微调参数适配新任务，造成 IR 知识灾难性遗忘，缺乏可扩展、可演化的知识承载方式。
AI.method: 构建技能增强型 IR 智能体：MLLM 感知退化并调用工具；技能库外置存储 IR 知识；CFSR 分析复原链定位并修订薄弱操作，依据与已知任务的兼容性决定替换或独立追加；RSI 驱动的技能元学习识别 CFSR 的低效环节并自主改进其修订策略。
AI.result: 在 14 个 IR 基准（6 单退化、8 混合退化）上取得更优复原性能；在 7 个未见任务上验证了对新 IR 任务的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以技能库替代参数微调可有效保持并演化 IR 知识，RSI 驱动的技能自改进为智能体持续适配提供可行路径。

title: Preserving Pretrained CFG Structure in RL for Diffusion Models with Conditional Contrast Regularization
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important component in the post-training of diffusion models. In practice, however, standard RL often improves the target reward without reliably preserving holistic generation quality, leading to unstable reward-quality trade-offs that we view as a form of reward hacking. Since Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is known to improve visual clarity, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality in generation, we investigate whether its underlying structure can serve as a useful prior during RL. We present a unified geometric view that interprets both CFG and RL as correction vectors in a common prediction space, and identify the projection of the RL-induced correction onto the pretrained CFG correction as a useful diagnostic of quality-related structural preservation. Geometric analysis and rotation intervention further show that the pretrained CFG direction carries information useful for generation quality that reward-driven RL updates do not necessarily preserve. Based on this insight, we propose Conditional Contrast Regularization (CCR), which uses the frozen reference model's conditional contrast as a local structural prior during RL. Experiments across multiple reward settings and backbones show that CCR more consistently preserves generation quality while maintaining competitive reward, yielding a better reward-quality trade-off than standard RL and generic regularization methods.

AI.tldr: 该文将CFG与RL统一为预测空间中的修正向量，发现RL修正与预训练CFG修正的投影可用于诊断生成质量，并提出条件对比正则(CCR)以冻结参考模型的条件对比作为结构先验，实现更优的奖励-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型后训练中的标准RL常只提升目标奖励却破坏整体生成质量，形成奖励劫持式的不稳定权衡；作者希望利用CFG所隐含的质量结构作为先验来约束RL更新。
AI.method: 建立统一几何视角，将CFG与RL均视为共同预测空间中的修正向量，以RL修正向预训练CFG方向的投影作为质量结构保持的诊断量；通过几何分析与旋转干预实验验证CFG方向携带RL不必然保留的质量信息；据此提出CCR，在RL过程中用冻结参考模型的条件对比作为局部结构正则项。
AI.result: 在多种奖励设置与骨干网络上，CCR在保持竞争性奖励的同时更稳定地维持生成质量，奖励-质量权衡优于标准RL与通用正则方法；旋转干预证实CFG方向与质量相关且可分离。
AI.conclusion: 预训练CFG修正方向可作为RL后训练的有效结构先验，基于其的条件对比正则是缓解扩散模型奖励劫持的实用手段。

title: InterBand-EMG: A Cross-Band Foundation Model for Generalizable Hand-Pose Estimation
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) enables continuous hand-pose estimation, but learning representations that generalize across users and movements remains challenging. We introduce InterBand-EMG, which combines band-specific quantization with cross-band reconstruction and structured masked code prediction to learn transferable EMG representations for hand-pose tracking. We also introduce SynapMyo, an eight-channel EMG-to-pose dataset comprising 1,227.74 hand-hours from 499 users across 68 movement categories. Experiments on emg2pose and SynapMyo show that InterBand-EMG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in joint-angle accuracy across all three generalization settings on both datasets. The source code and the SynapMyo dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.

AI.tldr: 提出InterBand-EMG自监督表征方法（波段量化+跨波段重建+结构掩码码本预测），并发布SynapMyo八通道肌电数据集（1227.74手-小时，499用户，68类动作），在emg2pose与SynapMyo上三种泛化设定均优于SOTA关节角精度。
AI.motivation: sEMG可连续估计手部姿态，但学到的表征难以跨用户、跨动作泛化，制约可穿戴手部追踪的实用性。
AI.method: InterBand-EMG：分支带特定量化（band-specific quantization），结合跨波段重建与结构化掩码码预测的自监督预训练；同时构建SynapMyo八通道EMG-姿态数据集。
AI.result: 在emg2pose与SynapMyo两个数据集、三种泛化设定下，关节角精度均超过SOTA基线；数据集规模达1,227.74手-小时、499用户、68类动作。
AI.conclusion: 波段级离散表征与码本预测可有效提升EMG手势表征的跨用户/跨动作泛化能力，配套大规模数据与代码将开源。

title: EgoLAM: Learning Latent Actions from Hand and Head Motion
summary: Latent action models let a robot policy learn from video by turning the change between two frames into a training target. In egocentric video, a cup can move across the image because a hand pushes it or because the wearer turns. Both changes help predict the next frame, but only the first describes manipulation. During training, EgoLAM supervises the action code with measured wrist motion and supplies camera motion separately to the forward model. Even when the wearer turns while pushing a cup, the training target still describes how the hand pushed it. The action encoder pools object slots around each hand, and wrist translation and rotation can be decoded from the code in a common reference frame. Extracting a code then requires only two RGB frames. Alongside LARYBench classification and regression, we measure how much wrist motion a frozen code retains and how strongly it responds to a synthetic view or lighting change. EgoLAM has the highest hand-motion decoding score among eight evaluated models. Across three LIBERO suites, policies pretrained on its codes and fine-tuned on expert demonstrations achieve 79.38% mean success, 28.73 points above expert behavior cloning and 9.76 points above the strongest other latent action model in each suite on average.

AI.tldr: EgoLAM 通过在训练时用实测腕部运动监督隐动作码、并将相机自运动单独喂给前向模型，把第一人称视频中"手在动"与"人在动"解耦，仅用两帧RGB即可提取动作码，在 LIBERO 上以隐动作预训练+专家微调取得 79.38% 平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 第一人称（egocentric）视频中的帧间变化混合了两类来源：手部操作引起的物体运动与佩戴者自身头/身体转动引起的视角变化。两者的改变都能帮助预测下一帧，但只有前者真正描述操作行为。若直接用原始视频做隐动作建模，动作码会被相机运动污染，导致策略学到与操控无关的表征。
AI.method: EgoLAM 采用双通道监督：(1) 动作编码器对每只手周围的对象 slot 做池化，用实测腕部平移与旋转在统一参考系下监督动作码，使码只编码手-物交互；(2) 相机运动作为独立条件输入前向模型，负责解释视角变化。因此即使佩戴者一边转身一边推杯，训练目标仍描述手如何推动杯子。推理时仅需两帧 RGB 即可提取动作码。评测包括 LARYBench 的分类/回归任务、冻结动作码的腕部运动保持度、以及对合成视角/光照变化的响应强度。
AI.result: 在八个对比模型中手部运动解码得分最高；冻结码对视角与光照扰动响应较弱（表示解耦有效）。在三个 LIBERO 套件上，用其动作码预训练再以专家示范微调的策略平均成功率达 79.38%，比专家行为克隆高 28.73 个点，比各套件中最强的其他隐动作模型平均高 9.76 个点。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离腕部运动与相机运动是提升第一人称视频隐动作建模质量的关键，所得到的动作码更具操作性且可迁移，能显著增强下游模仿学习性能。局限在于主要验证于 LIBERO 仿真与腕部运动可测量场景，真实机器人长时序与无腕部标注数据下的适用性仍需进一步验证。

title: A Vision-Based Framework for Manual Assembly Verification and Adaptive Operator Assistance
summary: Manual assembly remains difficult to monitor because operator actions, components, and task progress must be interpreted together. This paper presents a modular framework based on a single overhead red-green-blue (RGB) camera, combining object detection, hand-motion tracking, region-aware interaction detection, finite-state verification, task-specific pose classification, and configurable visual guidance. The system was evaluated during pneumatic-piston assembly and disassembly with eight participants under three assistance conditions: full, mid, and no guidance. Mixed-effects analysis identified an association between assistance condition and a composite measure of motion quality, with lower estimated scores under mid and no guidance relative to full guidance. However, the condition-by-trial interaction was not statistically significant, and the estimated differences in learning trajectories remain descriptive. No condition differences were detected in completion time or failed-stage counts. The study demonstrates the integration of visual perception, procedural verification, and configurable operator feedback in a single-camera workflow. Selecting assistance according to operator expertise remains a design objective for future investigation.

AI.tldr: 基于单个俯视 RGB 相机的模块化装配过程监测框架，融合目标检测、手部运动跟踪、区域感知交互检测、有限状态机校验、任务位姿分类与可配置视觉引导，在气动活塞装拆任务中对 8 名被试、三种引导条件进行用户实验评估。
AI.motivation: 人工装配过程难以监测，因为操作动作、零件状态与任务进度必须联合解释；现有系统常依赖多传感器或缺乏可配置的实时反馈。
AI.method: 单目俯视 RGB 相机流水线：目标检测、手部运动跟踪、区域级人-物交互检测、有限状态机流程校验、任务专属位姿分类，以及依操作员状态触发的可配置视觉引导；采用混合效应模型分析全引导/中引导/无引导三条件下 8 名被试的装配与拆卸表现。
AI.result: 混合效应分析显示引导条件与运动质量综合指标存在关联（中/无引导估计分数低于全引导），但条件×试次交互不显著，学习轨迹差异仅为描述性；完成时间与失败阶段次数无显著条件差异。
AI.conclusion: 演示了视觉感知、流程校验与可配置反馈在单相机流程中的集成，但性能收益证据有限；依操作员熟练度自适应选择引导强度为后续目标。

title: Re-JEPA: Coupling Representation Prediction and Signal Reconstruction for State-Conditioned EMG Tracking
summary: Improving continuous hand tracking from surface electromyography (sEMG) requires generalization across users and motion types while maintaining sensitivity to subtle movements. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn latent representation spaces through contextual prediction, but their effectiveness for tracking depends on which motion-relevant details these representations preserve and how those details are interpreted as the hand state evolves. We introduce Re-JEPA, a tracking framework that couples representation prediction with signal reconstruction and incorporates state-conditioned motion decoding. During pretraining without kinematic labels, Re-JEPA predicts continuous latent targets at multiple levels from visible EMG patches and reconstructs masked amplitude and phase attributes from the fused predictions. Signal reconstruction imposes an additional constraint on the contextual predictor, encouraging its outputs to retain information needed for signal recovery. For downstream tracking, the Gated Persistent Motion (GPM) decoder conditions EMG-token readout on recurrent state tokens and motion history, then generates continuous trajectories through gated state updates and incremental pose prediction. Under the emg2pose tracking protocol, Re-JEPA reduces angular MAE after full fine-tuning by approximately 10.3%, 19.3%, and 14.9% relative to vemg2pose on the cross-user, cross-stage, and joint cross-user-stage splits, respectively.

AI.tldr: Re-JEPA: 将JEPA隐空间预测与sEMG信号重建耦合，并配合门控持久运动解码器，实现跨用户、跨动作的连续手部姿态跟踪。
AI.motivation: sEMG连续手部跟踪面临跨用户、跨动作泛化难且需保持对细微运动的敏感性；JEPA类自监督表示虽能通过上下文预测学习隐空间，但其表征保留哪些运动相关细节、如何被解读为演变的手部状态尚不明确。
AI.method: 预训练阶段无运动学标签：从可见EMG patch预测多层级的连续隐目标，并由融合预测重建被遮蔽信号的幅度与相位属性，以额外约束上下文预测器保留信号恢复所需信息。下游采用Gated Persistent Motion (GPM)解码器，将EMG token读出以循环状态token与运动历史为条件，通过门控状态更新与增量位姿预测输出连续轨迹。
AI.result: 在emg2pose协议下完全微调后，Re-JEPA相对vemg2pose将角度MAE分别降低约10.3%（跨用户）、19.3%（跨阶段）、14.9%（联合跨用户-跨阶段）。
AI.conclusion: 将预测式隐表征学习与信号重建约束结合，并配以状态条件化的循环解码，可有效提升sEMG手部跟踪的跨域泛化与精度。

title: Can Reasoning and Image Description Enhance Yes/No Visual Mathematical Understanding?
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on general visual tasks, yet their ability to understand mathematical images remains limited. This paper investigates whether explicit reasoning and textual image descriptions can enhance VLMs' performance on binary yes/no visual mathematical questions. To achieve this, we curated a paired evaluation set to benchmark prominent open-source VLMs under varying prompt and input conditions. In particular, we leverage Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and use textual descriptions, either replacing or augmenting visual inputs, to isolate and evaluate mathematical comprehension. Our results show that explicit reasoning improves performance, especially in paired consistency accuracy, while textual image descriptions do not consistently help and may degrade performance. These findings suggest that reasoning is important for stable visual mathematical judgement, whereas description-based intermediates require more careful design.

AI.tldr: 论文通过配对评测集研究链式推理（CoT）与文本图像描述对开源VLM在二元视觉数学问答上的影响。
AI.motivation: VLM在通用视觉任务上表现优异，但对数学图像的理解仍有限；作者想验证显式推理与文本化图像描述能否提升此类判断。
AI.method: 构建配对评估集，在多种提示与输入条件下评测主流开源VLM；采用CoT提示，并用文本描述替换或补充视觉输入，以隔离数学理解能力。
AI.result: 显式推理可提升性能，尤其在配对一致性准确率上；文本图像描述并不稳定有益，甚至可能降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 推理对稳定的视觉数学判断很关键，而基于描述的中间表示需更精细的设计。

title: ManipScope: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Instruction Following and Generalization in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Completing a manipulation task does not establish that a robot follows the requested goal rather than a familiar routine. ManipScope is an evaluation-only diagnostic benchmark for robotic instruction following under changed task requirements. Built on RoboTwin 2.0's simulation resources, it specifies 48 held-out scenes across six task families with explicit source-task links; policies are trained on unmodified RoboTwin 2.0 demonstrations, and no demonstrations of the scenes are provided, so success requires reusing skills under a changed request rather than fitting supplied examples. Beyond task success, ManipScope provides a chain of diagnostics in which each step tests one explanation of a failure. For twelve policy checkpoints, 84.6% of failures in 13,200 episodes on eleven selection scenes displace a distractor, and gripper records show that failed episodes usually grasp a non-target. When the target is reassigned among the candidates on identical initial states, ten checkpoints follow every instruction on 3.9% of 1,000 states, below the 16% of an instruction-blind chooser, while a GPT-6 agent run as positive control reaches 88%. The failure recurs on unmodified training tasks and is not explained by missing manipulation skills, so success in these scenes largely reflects instruction-independent preferences; two checkpoints trained on the same data nevertheless follow color instructions. In a feasibility test, letting an agent select the target and the policy execute partly restores instruction following. Case studies with future-video and internal-intervention probes further show that forecasts and execution can agree on the wrong target and that action changes need not transfer the goal. Success, consistency, and sensitivity must each be checked against the requested goal.

AI.tldr: ManipScope 是一个仅用于评测的诊断基准，用 48 个改动任务要求的保留场景检验机器人是否真正遵循指令，而非依赖对熟悉流程的偏好。
AI.motivation: 完成操作任务并不等于机器人遵循了所要求的指令，可能只是执行了熟悉的常规动作。论文希望区分"任务成功"与"指令跟随"，并给出可逐步定位失败原因的诊断框架。
AI.method: 基于 RoboTwin 2.0 仿真资源构建 48 个保留场景，覆盖六个任务族，并显式链接源任务；策略仅在未修改的原始演示上训练，不提供新场景演示。除任务成功率外，还设计链式诊断：干扰物位移统计、抓取记录分析、在相同初始状态下随机重分配目标以测试指令敏感性、以 GPT-6 agent 作阳性对照，并进行未来视频预测与内部干预探针等案例研究。
AI.result: 12 个策略检查点在 11 个筛选场景共 13,200 回合中，84.6% 的失败源于偏移干扰物，失败回合通常抓错非目标物体；目标重分配下 10 个检查点仅在 3.9% 的 1,000 个状态上完全遵循指令，低于指令盲选择器的 16%，而 GPT-6 agent 达到 88%。两个同数据训练的检查点却能遵循颜色指令，说明并非缺技能所致；代理选目标+策略执行的部分组合可部分恢复指令跟随。
AI.conclusion: 仿真场景中的成功率很大程度上反映与指令无关的偏好而非指令跟随；未来预测与实际执行可能在错误目标上一致，动作改变也不必然转移目标，因此成功、一致性与敏感性都需分别对照请求目标检验。

title: Frontier Voltage Boost Laplacian Path Planning
summary: This paper introduces Frontier Voltage Boost Laplacian path planning. The method inherits many of the attractive features of earlier Harmonic Potential Field planning methods, including absence of local minima and smooth paths, while improving the original. The piecewise approach we introduce is able to solve larger maps and handle narrow passages more quickly than earlier Harmonic Potential Field methods. After explaining the algorithm, we experimentally characterize its cor- rectness, performance, and path smoothness as a function of map size. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 分片式 Frontier Voltage Boost Laplacian 路径规划，继承调和势场法无局部极小与路径平滑的优点，并在大尺度地图与窄通道上提速。
AI.motivation: 传统调和势场法（HPF）虽无局部极小、路径平滑，但在大地图求解慢、窄通道通过效率低，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出分片（piecewise）的 Frontier Voltage Boost Laplacian 势场：在保持拉普拉斯调和场性质的基础上引入边界（frontier）电压提升项，并按分块方式求解，以加快大图与窄通道处理。
AI.result: 实验刻画了算法正确性、性能与路径平滑度随地图规模的变化，表明相较早期 HPF 方法在大图与窄通道场景更快且仍保持平滑路径。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保留调和势场无局部极小优势的同时提升了可扩展性与窄通道处理效率，属于经典栅格路径规划层面的改进，与 VLA/世界模型/3D 重建等核心方向关联较弱。

title: BioCL-POS: Biological Completer-aware Learning with Predictive Observation Selection - A Wild Ginseng Study
summary: Growers and traders rely on root morphology to assess wild ginseng, yet breakage can obscure important structural traits. We study point cloud completion to provide geometric references for morphological analysis. Does providing more observed points always improve 3D completion? We test whether selected subsets improve recovery of the original missing region while keeping the pretrained completer fixed. We introduce BioCL-POS, an external selector that predicts how the completer responds to candidate inputs. For each candidate, we predict the displacement and distance from shared spatial locations to the nearest points in its completion. We use these spatial responses to estimate recovery quality and supervise them with measurements from actual completions. At inference, we select an input from the observed geometry and run the completer once. We evaluate four frozen completers on controlled gaps in ginseng and tree data at 5%,10%, and 20% omission, and examine 30% omission on ginseng. At 5--20% omission, we outperform full-input completion and all five alternative selectors on both datasets with all four completers. We achieve lower mean reconstruction error and higher mean F-score and coverage. We thus show that selecting observations can improve geometric recovery without retraining the completer, providing more accurate geometric references for subsequent morphological analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出 BioCL-POS：在冻结的点云补全器前加一个外部选择器，通过预测补全响应（位移与到最近点距离）来挑选观测子集，从而提升缺失区域几何恢复质量。
AI.motivation: 人参等根类药材依赖根形态进行品质判断，但断裂会遮挡关键结构；补全点云可为形态分析提供几何参照。作者质疑"更多观测点必然更好"的直觉，希望在不重训补全器的前提下提升缺失区恢复精度。
AI.method: 设计外部选择器 BioCL-POS：对每个候选输入子集，在共享空间位置上预测补全结果相对原始几何的位移与到最近点距离，用这些空间响应估计恢复质量，并以真实补全结果测量值进行监督。推理时从观测几何中选出一个输入，仅运行一次冻结的补全器。在人参和树木数据上以 5%、10%、20%（人参另含 30%）缺失率，对四个冻结补全器进行评估，并与全输入补全及五种替代选择器比较。
AI.result: 在 5–20% 缺失率下，两个数据集、四个补全器上均优于全输入补全与全部五种基线选择器，平均重建误差更低，平均 F-score 与覆盖率更高；30% 缺失场景亦做了考察。
AI.conclusion: 选择观测子集可在不重训补全器的条件下改善几何恢复，说明"更多点≠更好补全"，为后续根形态分析提供更准确的几何参照。

title: SAVIOR: Sample-efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for OCR Representation
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) pipelines and vision-language models exhibit high accuracy on standard OCR and document-understanding benchmarks, yet they systematically underperform on document patterns that are operationally critical in financial workflows. These patterns include vertical or rotated text, logo-embedded vendor names, fine-print regulatory clauses, degraded scans, and complex multi-column layouts. While underrepresented in public datasets, they constitute a substantial portion of real-world failure cases. We introduce SAVIOR, a sample-efficient data curation methodology that targets such high-impact failure scenarios to adapt vision-language models for robust financial OCR. We further propose PaIRS, a structure-aware evaluation metric that measures layout fidelity by comparing pairwise spatial relationships between tokens. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct with SAVIOR-Train achieves a word recall of 0.93. When the resulting layout-aware OCR output is used as context for document question answering, it attains an F1 score of 0.89, outperforming both open- and closed-source models such as GPT-4o, Mistral-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL, and DeepSeek-OCR.

AI.tldr: SAVIOR 提出面向金融文档高影响失败场景的样本高效数据筛选方法，并提出 PaIRS 结构感知评测指标（基于 token 对空间关系衡量版面保真度）。微调 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 后词召回 0.93，作为文档问答上下文达 F1 0.89，超过 GPT-4o、Mistral-OCR、PaddleOCR-VL、DeepSeek-OCR。
AI.motivation: 现有 OCR 流程与视觉语言模型在标准基准上精度很高，但在金融实务中关键文档模式上系统性失效：竖排/旋转文本、嵌于 logo 的供应商名、小字监管条款、退化扫描件、复杂多栏版面。这些模式在公开数据中稀少，却占真实失败案例的相当比例。
AI.method: SAVIOR：样本高效的数据策展流程，定向采集并筛选上述高影响失败场景样本，构建 SAVIOR-Train 微调 VLM；PaIRS：结构感知指标，通过比较 token 之间成对空间关系来度量版面保真度。
AI.result: 微调 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 后词召回 0.93；以版面感知 OCR 输出作为文档问答上下文，F1 达 0.89，优于 GPT-4o、Mistral-OCR、PaddleOCR-VL、DeepSeek-OCR 等开源与闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: 在数据稀缺的高价值失败模式上做定向数据策展，比通用规模扩张更能提升 VLM 文档 OCR 的鲁棒性；结构感知指标可补足纯文本指标对版面保真度的盲区。

title: Embodied Interaction Policy: A Unified Model for Full-Duplex Human-Robot Interaction
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Real-time human-robot social interaction requires continuous coordination between speech and physical behavior. Existing systems often separate interaction agents from motion generation, complicating coordination as conversational states change. We propose \textbf{Embodied Interaction Policy (EIP)}, a unified streaming framework that couples an Audio-Interaction expert with a motion expert through layer-wise joint attention. This allows motion generation to directly access the evolving interaction context. A chunk-wise causal mask prevents access to future context, while a vocal token encodes speaking state and the semantic emotion of the response. We construct \textbf{Embodied Interaction Dataset (EI-Data)} from co-speech and dyadic interaction data and train our model in two stages to learn state-adaptive and emotion-conditioned behavior. Combined with the frozen interaction expert, EIP supports continuous robot motion during proactive responses and interruption-aware turn-taking. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate improved motion quality over representative gesture-generation baselines. Compared with a representative cascaded system, EIP achieves higher interaction success and reduces warm-start latency by 64\%. Physical deployment and user studies further demonstrate improved motion naturalness and interaction comfort.

AI.tldr: 提出 Embodied Interaction Policy (EIP)：将音频交互专家与动作专家通过逐层联合注意力耦合的统一流式框架，配合分块因果掩码与发声 token，实现对话状态变化下连续的机器人社交动作生成，并构建 EI-Data 数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有社交机器人系统把交互智能体与运动生成分离，采用级联流水线，导致对话状态切换时语音与身体动作难以协调，且存在暖启动延迟；需要让动作生成直接访问不断演化的交互上下文。
AI.method: 统一流式架构：audio-interaction 专家与 motion 专家以 layer-wise joint attention 连接，motion 流可直接读取交互上下文；chunk-wise causal mask 保证流式因果、不窥视未来；vocal token 编码"说话状态"及响应的语义情感；由 co-speech 与 dyadic 交互数据构建 EI-Data；两阶段训练学习状态自适应与情感条件行为；交互专家冻结。
AI.result: 定量评估显示动作质量优于代表性手势生成基线；与典型级联系统相比交互成功率更高，暖启动延迟降低 64%；物理部署与用户研究显示动作自然度与交互舒适度提升；支持主动响应期间的连续运动与可打断的轮次切换。
AI.conclusion: 将交互决策与协同言语动作生成统一为单一流式策略，可有效消除级联延迟并提升中断感知的轮次切换与人机社交交互体验，为实时具身社交交互提供可行范式。

title: Zing-1.0: A Playable World System Built on Controllable Rendering
comment: 34 pages, 17 figures. Authors listed in reverse alphabetical order by surname
summary: We present Zing-1.0, a Playable World System built on Controllable Rendering. An executable engine resolves player actions under the world's rules and produces proxy video from the updated state. A streaming video model synthesizes the player's view from this proxy, and the runtime delivers it to inform subsequent actions. (1) Principle and system. We formulate Controllable Rendering and define the interfaces among world construction, world execution, observation synthesis, and the interaction runtime. To our knowledge, this is the first implementation-independent specification of a Playable World System. (2) AI-native engine. WorldKit provides structured authoring tools and reusable character, camera, and control components for coding agents to construct executable proxy worlds. It supports extensible interactions and precise geometric motion control while separating executable behavior from final visual appearance. (3) Streaming renderer. We adapt MiniMax-H3 for block-causal autoregressive generation and incremental decoding. Proxy video constrains structure and motion, while text and separate scene and subject references specify appearance. We train the generator on diverse tasks and distill it to generate each block in a few denoising steps. The renderer leads the compared streaming editors on OpenVE (3.90) and LongV2VBench (3.44). On StreamEval, Zing-1.0 scores 57.86 on instruction editing and 54.06 on reference editing, exceeding the published baselines on both tracks. (4) Interaction infrastructure. We build an Interaction Runtime that routes player actions to WorldKit while supporting in-play prompt and reference updates. Cross-block joint execution and sparse attention with compressed K/V reduce inference overhead. With the DiT on a single H200 and encoding and decoding on one H100 each, the serving system achieves a steady-state throughput of 23.82 FPS at $832\times480$.

AI.tldr: Zing-1.0 提出"可玩世界系统"（Playable World System）：由可执行的符号化引擎 WorldKit 按世界规则解析玩家动作并生成代理视频（proxy video），再由流式视频生成模型（基于 MiniMax-H3 改造的块因果自回归生成器）合成玩家视角画面并送入运行时闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成世界模型缺乏可控、可执行的世界规则，玩家动作难以精确改变状态；而纯引擎渲染视觉保真度有限。作者希望形式化"可控渲染"接口，把可执行行为与最终视觉外观解耦，实现可交互、实时流式的可玩世界。
AI.method: (1) 形式化 Controllable Rendering，定义世界构建/执行/观测合成/交互运行时四者接口；(2) WorldKit：面向编码 agent 的结构化创作工具与可复用角色、相机、控制组件，支持精确几何运动控制；(3) 流式渲染器：将 MiniMax-H3 改为块因果自回归生成与增量解码，代理视频约束结构与运动，文本与独立场景/主体参考控制外观，多任务训练后蒸馏至少步去噪；(4) Interaction Runtime：动作路由、播放中 prompt/参考更新、跨块联合执行与压缩 K/V 的稀疏注意力降低推理开销。
AI.result: 流式编辑器对比中领先：OpenVE 3.90、LongV2VBench 3.44；StreamEval 指令编辑 57.86、参考编辑 54.06，均超已发表基线。服务端在单张 H200（DiT）+ 两张 H100（编解码）下，832×480 稳态吞吐 23.82 FPS。
AI.conclusion: Zing-1.0 首次给出实现无关的可玩世界系统规范，验证了"符号引擎 + 流式视频生成"闭环的可行性，并达到实时级吞吐，为可交互世界模型提供了工程与接口层面的参考范式。

title: Latent Jacobian Steer: Eliciting Contact-Rich Out-of-Distribution Behaviors from Pretrained Humanoid Controllers
comment: 36 pages. Project page: this https URL
summary: Given a pretrained general latent-conditioned whole-body humanoid controller, say a behavioral foundation model (BFM), how can we elicit complex and contact-rich out-of-distribution behaviors? Raw joint-action exploration enables direct, task-specific adjustments but can disrupt coordination learned by the pretrained controller, whereas latent exploration retains that coordination but is difficult to steer toward desired physical effects. To combine the complementary strengths of these exploration spaces, we propose Latent Jacobian Steer (LJS), which couples sampling in direct joint-action space with the semantics of the learned frozen controller's input latent space. For a task specified through desired physical effects, we sample task-relevant joint-action perturbations and map them through a damped local inverse of the policy Jacobian to obtain candidate latent ($z$) commands. These commands are executed through the frozen pretrained policy, while exploration is directed toward the physical outcomes required by the new task. Candidate outcomes are evaluated in simulation and composed into latent-command sequences that accomplish the task. Ablations show that neither action-space nor latent-space exploration alone provides the same capability as their coupling. Across diverse out-of-distribution tasks, simulation-based searching using this method produces contact-rich behaviors, including hurdling, manipulating articulated objects, and opening doors through non-prehensile contact. Over ten seeds, LJS completes more of each humanoid task than when searching in either space alone. Beyond humanoids, it also steers a goal-conditioned dexterous hand policy through four assembly tasks better than searching in goal space directly.

AI.tldr: 提出 Latent Jacobian Steer (LJS)：将冻结的全身人形控制器的关节动作空间扰动通过阻尼局部雅可比逆映射为潜变量 z 命令，从而在保留预训练协调性的同时实现面向目标物理效果的可控探索，完成任务级接触丰富行为。
AI.motivation: 预训练潜变量条件全身人形控制器（BFM）难以诱导出分布外的复杂接触丰富行为：直接关节动作探索会破坏预训练策略学到的协调性，而潜空间探索虽保留协调性却难以导向所需物理效果。两者互补，需要耦合两种探索空间。
AI.method: 对给定任务指定的期望物理效应，在关节动作空间采样任务相关的扰动，经策略雅可比的阻尼局部逆映射为候选潜变量 z 命令；z 通过冻结的预训练策略执行，使搜索朝向新任务所需的物理结果；在仿真中评估候选结果，并将其组合为潜命令序列以完成任务。消融对比纯动作空间与纯潜空间探索。
AI.result: 消融表明单独动作空间或潜空间探索均无法达到耦合效果；在跨栏、操作铰接物体、非抓取接触开门等多样分布外任务上，十次种子中 LJS 完成度均高于任一单独空间搜索；在目标条件灵巧手策略上，于四个装配任务中优于直接在目标空间搜索。
AI.conclusion: 将动作空间采样与冻结策略潜空间的语义通过局部雅可比逆耦合，是一种有效的"零样本"任务导向行为诱导框架，可推广至人形全身控制器与灵巧手等不同目标条件策略，实现接触丰富的分布外行为搜索。

title: Unimodal Shortcuts and Joint Scene-Intent Dependence in Vision-Language Safety Representations
comment: 39 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables (14 pages main paper, 25 pages supplementary material)
summary: The safety of a request to a vision-language model often depends on the image: asking how to serve a dish is harmless for fresh food and harmful for spoiled food. High accuracy on situational safety benchmarks does not tell us whether a model's safety representation encodes both the scene and the user's intent, because a benchmark can often be solved from one modality alone. Studying frozen vision-language safety representations, we audit five public situational benchmarks and find that each admits a unimodal shortcut: images alone predict the labels, and on same-image prompt pairs a probe that never sees the photograph reaches 0.9645 AUROC. We therefore build a controlled evaluation that crosses safe and hazardous scenes with observation and action requests, so that no single-modality rule can exceed 0.500 group-ranking accuracy. On this control, linear probes on intermediate states of Qwen3-VL-8B and SmolVLM2-2.2B reach 0.958 and 0.930, showing that the scene-intent conjunction is linearly decodable; concatenating separately encoded image and text states already recovers most of this signal, so decodability is not evidence of a fusion mechanism. The same probes screen cheaply but generalize poorly to unseen images and other benchmarks. Reliable multimodal safety evaluation therefore needs controls that rule out unimodal shortcuts before accuracy is read as evidence of joint understanding.

AI.tldr: 该文审计发现五个公开情境安全基准均存在单模态捷径，遂构建图像×请求类型交叉的受控评测，证明Qwen3-VL与SmolVLM2中间层线性探针可线性解码"场景-意图"合取，但该可解码性并非融合机制的证据。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型的安全性常取决于图像与用户意图的联合（如新鲜/变质食物配"如何上菜"），但现有情境安全基准的高准确率可能仅由单一模态（图像或文本）即可达到，因此无法判断模型的安全表征是否真正编码了场景与意图的联合。
AI.method: （1）对冻结视觉语言安全表征进行审计，在五个公开情境安全基准上检验单模态捷径；（2）构建受控评测：将安全/危险场景与观察型/行动型请求交叉配对，使任何单模态规则的分组排序准确率上限为0.500；（3）在Qwen3-VL-8B与SmolVLM2-2.2B的中间层状态上训练线性探针，并对比拼接独立编码的图像与文本状态的基线。
AI.result: 同图提示对上仅见文本的探针达0.9645 AUROC，表明图像单独即可预测标签；受控评测中线性探针分别达0.958与0.930分组排序准确率；但拼接独立编码的图像与文本状态已能恢复大部分信号，且探针对未见图像与其他基准泛化较差。
AI.conclusion: 线性可解码性不等于存在跨模态融合机制；多模态安全评测必须引入排除单模态捷径的对照设计，否则准确率不能被解读为联合理解。该探针可用于低成本筛查但泛化性有限。

title: CoGITAtion: Collaborative Gaze-based Interpretable Task-adaptive Representation for Privacy-sensitive Applications
summary: Gaze-based analysis provides rich behavioural information for privacy-sensitive applications, but deployment is challenged by heterogeneous, scarce, and distributed data. We present CoGITAtion (Collaborative Gaze-based Interpretable Task-Adaptive Representation), a framework for privacy-preserving inference over vertically distributed gaze data. CoGITAtion transforms variable-length gaze recordings into compact, interpretable gaze-transition graphs and descriptors computed locally by each data owner. Task-adaptive models accommodate heterogeneous and missing feature blocks through task and availability gating, avoiding unnecessary private computation. Results show that shared components capture patterns that generalise across tasks, while task-specific components provide capacity without increasing model size. Public availability gating further reduces encrypted computation by removing branches determined by publicly known task and owner availability without altering predictions. Overall, CoGITAtion enables gaze model reuse, efficient privacy-preserving deployment, and robust inference under incomplete owner availability while retaining interpretable gaze representations.

AI.tldr: CoGITAtion: 面向纵向分布式眼动数据的隐私保护协作推理框架，将变长眼动记录转为可解释的眼动转移图与描述子，并用任务门控与可用性门控实现任务自适应与减少加密计算。
AI.motivation: 眼动分析蕴含丰富行为信息，但受限于数据异构、稀缺与分布式（隐私敏感）三方面问题，难以实际部署。
AI.method: 与数据所有者本地计算：将变长注视序列构建为紧凑、可解释的眼动转移图及描述子；采用任务自适应模型，通过任务门控与特征可用性门控处理异构与缺失特征块，避免不必要的私有计算；引入公开可用性门控，剪除由公开已知的任务/所有者可用性决定的加密计算分支，且不改变预测结果。
AI.result: 共享组件可捕获跨任务泛化模式，任务特定组件在不增大模型规模的前提下提供容量；公开可用性门控在保持预测不变的同时减少加密计算量。
AI.conclusion: CoGITAtion 实现了眼动模型复用、高效的隐私保护部署，以及在不完整所有者可用性下的稳健推理，同时保留可解释的眼动表示。

title: ReSA: Preserving Reference-Specified Foreground in In-Context Segmentation
summary: In-context segmentation uses annotated references to specify the target and its extent in a query image. Accurately transferring this reference-specified foreground requires recovering target regions while suppressing irrelevant predictions. We propose ReSA, a reference-guided framework that unifies query adaptation and mask selection through a shared reference kernel. ReSA leverages foreground and background reference prototypes to constrain prediction changes during adaptation and guide foreground selection through reference-weighted reconstruction. This shared guidance promotes consistent use of reference information across prediction refinement and mask formation. ReSA further selects among adapted predictions and aligns boundary refinement with the selected foreground threshold. We establish a theoretical bound connecting reference-response changes during adaptation and soft reconstruction. With a frozen visual encoder and lightweight test-time adaptation, ReSA requires no offline task training. Ablation studies demonstrate improved foreground retention and effective suppression of false-positive regions, while qualitative results show more complete masks with fewer isolated artifacts. Across ten object, part, and cross-domain segmentation benchmarks, ReSA achieves the highest average mIoU among the evaluated methods, reaching 62.6% in 1-shot and 71.8% in 5-shot.

AI.tldr: ReSA: 一个用共享 reference kernel 统一测试时查询适配与掩码选择的参考引导分割框架，冻结编码器、无需离线任务训练，在10个分割基准上取得 1-shot 62.6% / 5-shot 71.8% mIoU。
AI.motivation: In-context segmentation 需要把参考标注指定的前景准确迁移到查询图像，关键在于同时"恢复目标区域"和"抑制无关预测"，而现有方法在适配过程中的前景保持与假阳性抑制上不足。
AI.method: 以共享 reference kernel 为核心：利用前景/背景参考原型约束测试时适配中的预测变化，并通过 reference-weighted reconstruction 指导前景选择；该共享引导贯穿预测精化与掩码生成。进一步在多个适配预测间做选择，并使边界精化与所选前景阈值对齐。在不更新视觉编码器的前提下做轻量 test-time adaptation，无离线任务训练。
AI.result: 建立了适配期间 reference-response 变化与软重建之间的理论界；消融显示前景保持提升、假阳性区域被有效抑制；定性结果显示掩码更完整、孤立伪影更少；在十个物体/部件/跨域分割基准上平均 mIoU 最高（1-shot 62.6%，5-shot 71.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 参考信息在预测精化与掩码形成间的一致使用是提升 in-context 分割的关键，冻结骨干加轻量测试时适配即可以较低代价取得领先性能。

title: Learning Interaction Dynamics via Motion-Region Guidance for Robotic Video World Models
summary: Action-conditioned video world models imagine future observations under candidate robot actions, providing a promising visual tool for robot policy evaluation and interaction simulation. However, existing video world models often optimize global reconstruction errors instead of emphasizing interaction-relevant regions. As a result, they may preserve overall scene appearance but overlook local interaction details, leading to physically implausible outcomes such as hallucinated contact effects and inconsistent robot-object interactions. We introduce MoReWorld, a unified motion-region-guided framework that uses a shared motion region, the part of the environment that moves in response to the robot's actions, to focus dynamics learning and video generation on interaction-relevant regions. The same motion region guides local motion prediction, region-aware supervision, and motion-gated future-feature conditioning. At inference time, the motion region is predicted as a motion probability map from visual history and robot actions, without requiring future observations or ground-truth motion labels. On WorldSimProbe, MoReWorld achieves the highest overall simulator-faithfulness score, with the strongest performance on local consistency, global consistency, and interaction dynamics. These results indicate that motion-region guidance helps the model preserve scene-level consistency while more faithfully predicting action-conditioned interaction dynamics.

AI.tldr: MoReWorld 提出以"运动区域"（随机器人动作发生位移的环境部分）统一引导动作条件视频世界模型的局部运动预测、区域感知监督与运动门控特征条件，推理时无需未来观测或真值运动标签，在 WorldSimProbe 上取得最高模拟器保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频世界模型以全局重建误差为优化目标，不区分交互相关区域，因而虽能保持整体外观，却忽视局部交互细节，出现虚假接触效果、机器人与物体交互不一致等物理不合理结果，削弱其作为策略评估与交互仿真工具的可靠性。
AI.method: 共享的运动区域作为统一枢纽：(1) 引导局部运动预测；(2) 施加区域感知监督；(3) 实现运动门控的未来特征条件注入。推理阶段由视觉历史与机器人动作预测运动概率图，替代真值运动掩码，实现无标签、无未来观测的部署。
AI.result: 在 WorldSimProbe 基准上取得最高的整体模拟器保真度分数，并在局部一致性、全局一致性与交互动力学三项指标上均表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 运动区域引导可在维持场景级一致性的同时更忠实地预测动作条件交互动力学，为交互密集场景下的世界模型训练提供轻量、可迁移的归纳偏置。

title: PAVE: A Harness for Geometrically Consistent Road Network Modeling with Vision-Language Models
summary: Transportation models, whether they simulate traffic or support planning, are only as reliable as the road networks they run on, down to the lanes and turns at each intersection. Practitioners still take such a network from GIS files and supply its junction and movement data by hand, a task that recurs with each new base year and design alternative, or they generate it from open map data. OpenStreetMap's lane tags give the correct layout for only 13 of the 44 approaches we test; open map data are often incomplete or inaccurate. Satellite and street-level imagery, in contrast, cover all 44 and show their lanes as painted. Vision-language models (VLMs) can read such imagery, but asked directly they lose geometric consistency when the same lane must be matched across a satellite crop, street-level photos taken from different poses and an ID-labelled network. We therefore present PAVE (Perceive, Anchor, Verify, Edit), a harness in which code measures what can be measured, traffic engineering knowledge enters as general rules and checks, and the model makes only the open judgements, each anchored to network IDs so that checks catch answers that contradict a measurement, a second reading or a traffic rule. Scored against human labels at signalised intersections, PAVE raises the share of exactly correct lane layouts from 49-64% with a single request to 86-91% for two VLMs, with most of the gain coming from reading one approach at a time on traced lanes. The same division of work edits a real network to a planning brief: the model names the links and nodes of each part of a facility, and code builds the edit from a design template. Of 18 edits, 16 pass every network check, against none when the model writes its own code, and 2 contain a design or coding error, against 7. An analysis shows where VLMs lose geometric consistency and which check catches each failure.

AI.tldr: PAVE是一个"感知—锚定—验证—编辑"框架：由代码测量可测量量、交通工程规则作为通用规则与检查、VLM只做开放式判断，且每个判断锚定到路网ID，从而在卫星/街景图像上恢复车道级交叉口几何，并把人工设计意图落实为对真实路网的编辑。
AI.motivation: 交通仿真与规划依赖车道级、转向级的路网，但实践者需从GIS手工录入交叉口与流向数据（随基准年与设计方案反复重做），或用开放地图数据自动生成。作者测试中OSM车道标签在44个进口中仅13个正确，开放数据常缺失或错误；卫星与街面影像覆盖全部44个进口并直接呈现标线。直接提示VLM读取多源影像（卫星裁片、不同位姿街景、带ID标签的路网）会丢失几何一致性，故需把测量、领域规则与模型判断分离。
AI.method: PAVE将任务分解为可验证步骤：代码负责可量化测量（标线检测、车道追踪等）；交通工程知识以通用规则与一致性检查形式注入；VLM仅承担开放式判断，每个判断附加路网ID锚点，使检查能捕捉与测量值、二次独立读取或交通规则相矛盾的输出。核心增益来自"逐进口、于追踪车道上读取"。同一分工也用于路网编辑：模型只命名设施各部分的link与node，代码按设计模板生成编辑，而非由模型自行写代码。
AI.result: 以信号交叉口人工标注为参照，完全正确的车道布局比例从单次请求的49–64%提升到两种VLM下的86–91%。路网编辑实验中，18处编辑有16处通过全部路网检查（模型自写代码时为0处通过），设计或编码错误2处（对照7处）。分析进一步给出VLM丢失几何一致性的位置以及每种失败由哪项检查捕获。
AI.conclusion: 显式划分"代码测量—领域规则—模型判断"并用ID锚定实现自动校验，是让VLM可靠地产出车道级路网与执行规划编辑的有效范式；瓶颈不在模型读图能力，而在跨视角几何一致性，且该一致性问题可被结构化检查系统性地捕获。

title: Show Me the Answer: Visual Grounding on Dashboards
summary: Natural language interaction has become an increasingly important paradigm for accessing complex visual information systems. In visual data analytics environments, such as dashboards, a key capability is to ground user queries to specific visual elements, enabling systems to identify the visual evidence relevant to the query. However, existing visual grounding research has primarily focused on natural images, while grounding in dashboards remains underexplored due to their complex multi-chart layouts and fine-grained visual elements. In this paper, we study the task of Visual Grounding on Dashboards (VGD): Given a dashboard screenshot and a natural language query, the goal is to localize the visual element corresponding to the query using a bounding box. We propose VGD-Net, a two-stage grounding framework that reflects how users typically locate information in dashboards, by first performing query-aware chart retrieval and then fine-grained in-chart grounding. To systematically evaluate VGD-Net's performance on this task, we construct VGD-Bench, a benchmark specifically designed for VGD, covering three complementary settings: chart retrieval, in-chart grounding, and overall VGD. Experimental results show that our two-stage VGD-Net outperforms strong multimodal baselines on the VGD task, achieving a mean IoU of 57.06 and a success rate of 66.82, while also delivering superior performance over existing methods in both stages of chart retrieval and in-chart grounding. These results highlight the value of stage decomposition for reliable and interpretable VGD, and its potential to support query-driven visual analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出VGD任务（仪表盘视觉定位）与两阶段框架VGD-Net（先查询感知的图表检索，再图内细粒度定位），并构建VGD-Bench基准，平均IoU 57.06、成功率66.82，优于多模态基线。
AI.motivation: 自然语言交互成为访问复杂视觉信息系统的重要范式，仪表盘中需将用户查询 grounding 到具体视觉元素以提供证据；但现有视觉 grounding 研究集中于自然图像，多图表布局与细粒度元素使仪表盘场景尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出VGD-Net两阶段框架，模拟用户定位信息的流程：第一阶段做查询感知的图表检索（chart retrieval），第二阶段在检索到的图表内做细粒度 grounding，输出边界框；同时构建VGD-Bench，涵盖图表检索、图内定位与端到端VGD三种互补设置。
AI.result: 在VGD任务上平均IoU 57.06、成功率66.82，优于强多模态基线；在图表检索与图内定位两个子阶段也均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 阶段分解对可靠、可解释的仪表盘视觉定位有效，可支撑查询驱动的可视分析；但属视觉文档理解方向，与物理AI/具身智能/3D重建等核心领域无直接关联。

title: Borrow the Style, Follow the Prompt: Progressive Reference-Guided Stylization
summary: Reference-guided text-to-image stylization transfers visual appearance to content specified by text, but the reference subjects and backgrounds can interfere with what the generated image depicts. Suppressing this unwanted information can also discard transferable texture and material cues, creating a tension between content control and faithful preservation of the reference style. Accordingly, we propose ProStyle, which learns a content-suppressed style prior through cross-content supervision on same-style pairs with different subjects and backgrounds and injects it with weak conditioning at auxiliary layers to strengthen style expression. Building on this prior, a complementary pathway learns residual corrections from full reference patch features with the content-suppressed style pathway frozen, before both pathways undergo joint refinement under the same objective. For cross-content learning and evaluation, we introduce ReConStyle, which provides 134K training pairs, two test settings, and object-level measures of target-content fidelity and reference-object overlap alongside style similarity and text alignment. ProStyle outperforms all compared SD1.5-based baselines and achieves the best average rank of 1.86 across four automatic and three human-evaluation criteria on ReConStyle-Full. In the user study, it substantially outperforms the baselines in text alignment and combined suitability, with selection rates of 84.36% and 50.90%, respectively. On the external Style-Rank benchmark, it also achieves the highest CLIP-Text and ImageReward scores.

AI.tldr: ProStyle通过跨内容同风格配对学习"内容抑制的风格先验"，并以辅助层弱条件注入；再用一条残差修正通路从完整参考patch特征学习修正，两条通路在统一目标下联合精修，同时提出ReConStyle数据集与评测协议。
AI.motivation: 参考图引导的文生图风格化中，参考里的主体与背景会干扰生成内容；而压制这些信息又会丢掉可迁移的纹理与材质线索，形成内容控制与风格保真之间的张力。
AI.method: 1) 用同风格、不同主体/背景的跨内容配对做监督，学习内容抑制的风格先验；2) 在辅助层以弱条件方式注入该先验以增强风格表达；3) 冻结风格通路，另建残差通路学习完整参考patch特征的修正；4) 两条通路在同一目标下联合精修；5) 构建ReConStyle：134K训练对、两种测试设置，含目标内容保真度、参考物体重叠度、风格相似度与文本对齐的物体级指标。
AI.result: 在ReConStyle-Full上优于所有对比的SD1.5基线，四自动指标+三人工指标平均排名1.86；用户研究中文对齐与综合适宜性选择率分别为84.36%和50.90%；外部Style-Rank基准上取得最高CLIP-Text与ImageReward。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦"内容抑制的风格先验"与"残差内容修正"两通路，是缓解风格化中内容—风格纠缠的可行方案，并配有可量化的跨内容评测基准。

title: NormFlowSDE: Normalizing Flows for Amortized Bayesian State Estimation
summary: Bayesian state estimators, such as Kalman filters, estimate states from noisy observations based on dynamical models. However, obtaining accurate models can be challenging when the system involves effects that are difficult to model faithfully, such as friction, impacts, and deformation in contact-rich manipulation. Uncertainty in system parameters, inputs, and disturbances, together with simplified noise models, can further introduce simulation-to-reality mismatch and degrade estimation accuracy. These limitations motivate learning a distribution over state trajectories conditioned on observations and controls without explicitly specifying the underlying physical models. We introduce NormFlowSDE, an amortized Bayesian state estimator that learns a distribution over state trajectories by combining neural stochastic differential equations with conditional normalizing flows. Its key design choice is to utilize the capability of normalizing flows to learn stochastic behavior of variables, while leveraging the continuous-time dynamics of SDEs to model the evolution of states over time. Once trained, the model draws state paths for new measurement sequences without per-sequence optimization. In addition, we connect NormFlowSDE to stochastic continuous-time dynamics by proving weak convergence of a mean-centered, drift-corrected inference scheme to an Itô diffusion under stated assumptions. Finally, we benchmark NormFlowSDE against direct estimators and learned particle filters based on normalizing flows on partially observed dynamical systems, including simulated systems and real-world robot datasets. The results show that NormFlowSDE attains the lowest estimation error with calibrated uncertainty intervals on both robot datasets and filters four times faster than the fastest particle filter on every dataset.

AI.tldr: NormFlowSDE 将神经随机微分方程与条件归一化流结合，实现无模型、摊销式的贝叶斯状态轨迹分布估计，并证明其推理方案的弱收敛性；在仿真与真实机器人数据集上取得最低估计误差与校准的不确定性，且比最快粒子滤波快4倍。
AI.motivation: 摩擦、碰撞、形变等接触丰富操作中的物理效应难以精确建模，参数/输入/扰动不确定性及简化噪声模型导致仿真-现实失配，使基于模型的卡尔曼类状态估计精度下降。因此希望在不显式指定物理模型的情况下，学习以观测与控制为条件的轨迹分布。
AI.method: NormFlowSDE：以条件归一化流刻画变量的随机特性，以 SDE 的连续时间动力学建模状态随时间的演化，二者结合为摊销式贝叶斯估计器；训练后对新观测序列直接采样状态路径，无需逐序列优化。理论上证明均值中心化、漂移校正的推理方案在给定假设下弱收敛到 Itô 扩散。
AI.result: 在部分可观测动力系统（含仿真系统与真实机器人数据集）上与直接估计器和基于归一化流的学习型粒子滤波对比，NormFlowSDE 估计误差最低，给出校准的不确定性区间，且在全部数据集上比最快的粒子滤波快 4 倍。
AI.conclusion: 无模型、摊销式的连续时间生成式状态估计是替代难以精确建模系统的有效方案，兼顾精度、不确定性校准与计算效率；并具备连续时间扩散极限的理论支撑。

title: GeoSDF-Diff: Geometry-Aware Diffusion Planning for Collision-Free Trajectories
summary: Diffusion models have recently attracted increasing attention in motion planning due to their ability to model high-dimensional and multi-modal trajectory distributions. However, existing diffusion-based planners still struggle to reliably satisfy geometric feasibility in unseen cluttered environments with complex obstacle layouts. To address this challenge, we propose GeoSDF-Diff, a geometry-aware diffusion planner that incorporates multi-scale SDF conditioning into trajectory denoising. The key idea is to provide the denoiser with both route-level geometric context and fine local clearance evidence, enabling generated trajectories to better adapt to unseen complex obstacle layouts. Specifically, a Geometric Encoder extracts multi-scale SDF features and injects them into a DiT-X denoiser through cross-attention. We further introduce a trajectory-level training objective that combines SDF clearance, violation emphasis, smoothness, and path-length regularization, so that local infeasibilities are penalized during training rather than corrected only at inference time. Experiments on held-out cluttered environments show that, without post-hoc trajectory repair or sampling-time guidance, GeoSDF-Diff achieves a 65.2% average success rate across diverse test scenarios, outperforming strong diffusion baselines by 25.4% to 28.5%.

AI.tldr: GeoSDF-Diff将多尺度SDF几何特征通过交叉注意力注入DiT去噪器，并配合含间隙/违规/平滑/路径长度的轨迹级训练目标，实现无需测试时引导或后处理的几何可行运动规划。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式运动规划器在未见过的复杂杂乱环境中难以可靠满足几何可行性，局部不可行往往只能在推理阶段修正。
AI.method: 几何编码器提取多尺度SDF特征（路线级几何上下文+局部间隙证据），经交叉注意力注入DiT-X去噪器；训练目标融合SDF间隙、违规加权、平滑性与路径长度正则。
AI.result: 在留出的杂乱环境中，平均成功率达65.2%，较强扩散基线提升25.4%–28.5%，且不使用轨迹修复或采样时引导。
AI.conclusion: 将几何可行性约束前移到去噪条件与训练目标中，可显著提升扩散规划器对未见复杂障碍布局的泛化。

title: HR-Merge: Model Merging with Headroom-Weighted Residual Refinement
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 16 tables. A short version was accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: Model merging combines experts fine-tuned from a shared backbone, such as LoRA adapters of a large language model, into one multi-task model without further training. Existing methods apply one rule to every task, yet the accuracy they lose is uneven across tasks. We show that the lost accuracy remains recoverable from each task's residual, its task vector minus the merged update, and that a task's validation headroom, the share of its expert validation accuracy the merge loses, indicates where recovery pays off. Residuals from different tasks interfere, so they must be merged rather than summed. We propose HR-Merge, a training-free wrapper around any merging method. It weights each residual by its task's headroom, re-merges the weighted residuals with the base operator, and adds the result back at a strength selected on validation, falling back to the base merge when no strength helps. On six NLI adapters of LLaMA-3 8B, HR-Merge lifts TIES from 93.29 to 94.29 normalized accuracy, above all tested bases, mainly by recovering its weakest task. In vision, on three CLIP backbones, up to 20 tasks, and LoRA merging, it generally improves or preserves base accuracy and yields the best model in every setting.

AI.tldr: HR-Merge：一种免训练的后处理包装器，用"验证余量"加权的任务残差重新合并，可套在任何模型合并方法上，恢复被合并损失的任务精度。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法对所有任务施加统一规则（如TIES、Task Arithmetic），但各任务精度损失并不均匀；作者观察到丢失的精度可从"任务残差"（task vector 减合并更新）中恢复，且任务验证余量（合并损失该专家验证精度的比例）可指示何处恢复收益最大。
AI.method: 定义残差=任务向量-合并更新；不同任务残差相互干扰，故需合并而非直接相加。HR-Merge按各任务headroom加权残差，用原合并算子重新合并加权残差，再以验证集选取的强度加回，若无效则回退到基础合并。训练免费，作为任意合并方法的wrapper。
AI.result: LLaMA-3 8B 六个NLI LoRA适配器：TIES从93.29提升至94.29归一化精度，超过所有测试基础方法，主要靠恢复最弱任务；视觉上三个CLIP骨干、至多20个任务及LoRA合并且普遍提升或保持基座精度，每个设置均取得最佳模型。
AI.conclusion: 任务残差是合并损失精度的可恢复来源，headroom导向的残差再合并是一种通用、免训练、即插即用的提升手段，在NLP与视觉多设置下稳定有效。

title: A Lightweight Method for Validating Simulated LiDAR Configurations Based on Point Density over Distance
comment: Accepted at IEEE ITSC 2026. 7 pages, 4 figures, 1 table
summary: Simulated LiDAR sensors play a crucial role in validating autonomous systems, yet achieving signal-level realism remains challenging due to simplified sensor models and limited configurability in common simulation environments. This paper presents a lightweight, platform-agnostic method to assess one observable aspect of LiDAR simulation fidelity: the range-dependent point density on annotated objects. The method uses only 3D bounding boxes and point clouds and does not require semantic labels, detailed maps, simulator internals, or perception models. To quantify agreement between real and simulated range-dependent point distributions, we formulate the Density Similarity Score (DSS), a bounded similarity representation derived from the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) over discretized distance bins. The method is evaluated against a real-world LiDAR using three CARLA configurations of varying complexity. Results show that naive parameter matching based on sensor datasheets leads to systematic point-density deviations, particularly in the near field, while a custom configuration using the sensor's non-uniform vertical beam angles achieves the highest similarity in the evaluated scenario (DSS: 0.559--0.709). The proposed approach is intended as an early-stage, signal-level consistency check for identifying gross mismatches in simulated LiDAR configurations. It should be interpreted as a complementary validation step rather than a complete measure of simulation quality or downstream perception performance.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用3D框与点云、无需语义标签/地图/仿真器内部的轻量级方法，用DSS（基于MAPE的分距离分箱有界相似度）评估LiDAR仿真中目标点密度的距离依赖保真度；在CARLA三种配置下发现按数据手册朴素匹配会产生近场系统性偏差，而采用传感器非均匀垂直光束角的定制配置相似度最高。
AI.motivation: 仿真LiDAR对自动驾驶系统验证至关重要，但常见仿真环境因传感器模型简化、可配置性有限，难以达到信号级真实感；需要一个平台无关、低成本的手段来检查仿真点云分布是否与真实传感器一致。
AI.method: 以带标注的3D边界框与点云为唯一输入，无需语义标签、高精地图、仿真器内部参数或感知模型；将目标上的点按距离分箱统计点密度，用MAPE度量真实与仿真的距离依赖点分布差异，并转化为有界的Density Similarity Score（DSS）；在真实LiDAR数据与三种复杂度的CARLA配置上对比评估。
AI.result: 依据传感器数据手册的朴素参数匹配会产生系统性点密度偏差，近场尤为明显；采用传感器非均匀垂直光束角的定制配置在评测场景中相似度最高，DSS为0.559–0.709。
AI.conclusion: 该方法定位为早期阶段的信号级一致性检查，用于发现仿真LiDAR配置的明显失配，是互补性验证步骤，而非仿真质量或下游感知性能的完整度量。

title: VMSA: Video Memory Skill Agent for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long-video question answering requires retrieving and integrating relevant evidence from videos spanning hours or even days. Recent agentic approaches organize video information into external memories and iteratively retrieve evidence to answer questions. However, effective retrieval and reasoning remain challenging, as agents must determine what information to search for, which memory sources to access, and how to connect evidence across distant temporal intervals. To address these challenges, we propose Video Memory Skill Agent (VMSA), a framework that jointly designs structured video memories and memory skills for long-video understanding. VMSA constructs three complementary memory components. Segment Caption Memory and Entity Event Memory serve as searchable evidence sources, while Entity-Aware Episode Memory provides broad yet detailed video context to guide evidence retrieval and reasoning. To further support effective memory utilization, VMSA induces memory skills from successful agent trajectories, incrementally refining or extending a compact skill library to guide iterative evidence retrieval, reasoning, and verification. Across seven long-video question-answering benchmarks, VMSA achieves the highest accuracy on all three week-long egocentric benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.4% on Ego-R1 Bench, and the best or competitive performance on four additional benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of all three memory components and memory skills, with memory skills also improving temporal evidence localization.

AI.tldr: VMSA 提出结构化视频记忆与记忆技能协同设计的智能体框架，用于长视频问答，在三个 week-long egocentric 基准上取得最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 长视频 QA 需从数小时乃至数天的视频中检索并整合证据；现有智能体方法依赖外部记忆并迭代检索，但难以确定检索什么、访问哪类记忆源、以及如何跨远距离时间区间连接证据。
AI.method: 构建三类互补记忆：Segment Caption Memory 与 Entity Event Memory 作为可检索证据源，Entity-Aware Episode Memory 提供粗粒度但细节丰富的视频上下文以引导检索与推理；并从成功智能体轨迹中归纳"记忆技能"，增量地精炼/扩展紧凑技能库，指导迭代式证据检索、推理与验证。
AI.result: 在七个长视频 QA 基准上评测，三个 week-long egocentric 基准均达最高准确率，Ego-R1 Bench 上较最强基线最高提升 9.4%，其余四个基准为最佳或具竞争力；消融显示三类记忆组件与记忆技能均有贡献，记忆技能还改善了时序证据定位。
AI.conclusion: 结构化视频记忆与可学习的记忆技能相结合，能有效提升长时程视频智能体的检索与推理能力。

title: PanoUAV-Track: Full-Spherical UAV Visual Tracking in the Wild
summary: Existing UAV tracking benchmarks predominantly rely on perspective cameras with limited fields of view. Omnidirectional cameras enable full-spherical observation, yet tracking from moving UAV platforms remains largely unexplored. Unlike ground-level panoramic tracking, UAV-mounted omnidirectional cameras observe targets across both azimuth and elevation, introducing geometric challenges under equirectangular projection (ERP). To investigate this setting, we capture approximately \textbf{40 hours of real-world 8K panoramic UAV video} and construct \textbf{PanoUAV-Track} through temporal clip extraction, target annotation, and the integration of simulated sequences. The resulting benchmark comprises 1,895 sequences, 507,961 frames, and 2,872 annotated objects, covering real-world daytime and nighttime scenes alongside simulation, and supporting both visual and language-based target specification. Through extensive evaluations, we reveal a clear \textbf{perspective-to-spherical} generalization gap and identify tracking degradation associated with latitude-dependent distortion and ERP seam discontinuity. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{PanoUAV-Tracker (PUTrack)}, a geometry-aware tracking framework combining latitude-adaptive search and seam-aware periodic sampling. PUTrack improves zero-shot and in-domain tracking, particularly for seam-crossing targets. Code and benchmark resources will be available\footnote{\textcolor{tabpink}{ this https URL }}.

AI.tldr: 提出 PanoUAV-Track：首个面向无人机平台全向相机（ERP 投影）目标跟踪的大规模基准，约 40 小时 8K 真实全景 UAV 视频，含 1,895 序列、507,961 帧、2,872 个标注目标，覆盖日/夜与仿真，支持视觉与语言指定目标；并揭示透视→球面泛化差距与纬向畸变、ERP 接缝不连续导致的性能退化，提出几何感知跟踪器 PUTrack。
AI.motivation: 现有 UAV 跟踪基准多基于视角有限的透视相机；全向相机可提供全空域观测，但移动 UAV 平台上的全景跟踪基本未被探索。与地面全景跟踪不同，UAV 载全向相机在方位角与俯仰角同时观测目标，ERP 投影下存在显著的几何畸变与接缝不连续问题，缺乏对应基准与方法。
AI.method: 数据侧：采集约 40 小时 8K 真实全景 UAV 视频，经时间片段抽取、目标标注并融合仿真序列构建 PanoUAV-Track；方法侧提出 PUTrack，一个几何感知跟踪框架，包含随纬度自适应的搜索区域建模（latitude-adaptive search）与接缝感知的周期采样（seam-aware periodic sampling），以缓解 ERP 畸变与接缝断裂带来的匹配误差。
AI.result: 大规模评测显示存在明显的 perspective-to-spherical 泛化差距，且跟踪性能退化与纬度相关畸变、ERP 接缝不连续显著相关；PUTrack 在零样本与域内设置下均提升跟踪性能，尤其改善跨接缝目标。
AI.conclusion: 将全向视觉引入 UAV 跟踪填补了空白，确立了 ERP 几何因素（纬向畸变、接缝）为关键瓶颈，并以轻量几何感知设计验证其有效性；基准与代码将公开，可作为球面域跟踪的评测基座。

title: What Stays in the Picture? From Redundant Instructions to Dependency-Aware Image Editing
summary: We introduce complex redundant-instruction image editing, where a single request specifies multiple objects, their attributes, and spatial relations while revising or canceling earlier editing requirements. Direct editing can fail to recover this intent, while splitting the request into successive steps can preserve obsolete edits and visual errors. Our key insight is to resolve the revision history into a final editing target that jointly guides planning and verification, so that obsolete requests do not become visual edits. Based on this insight, CRIE-Agent learns to consolidate revisions into object-level final intent and executes the retained objects in reference-first blocks, establishing referenced objects before their dependents. Verification then guides complete re-execution from the source image, with conditional layout hints, preventing visual errors from failed attempts from being carried into subsequent ones. We also construct CRIE-S, a benchmark containing 10,000 complex and redundant editing instructions with exact final intent annotations. Across five image-editing backends on CRIE-S, CRIE-Agent raises complete editing success from 0% under direct editing to 27.5--50.0%.

AI.tldr: 提出复杂冗余指令图像编辑任务(CRIE)：单个请求含多对象、属性、空间关系并中途改写/撤销早期要求；提出CRIE-Agent将修订历史归并为"对象级最终意图"作为规划与验证目标，按引用优先分块执行，并从源图条件重执行；构建CRIE-S基准(1万条含精确最终意图标注的指令)，在5个编辑后端上将完整编辑成功率从0%提升至27.5–50.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑方法难以处理带修订/撤销的复杂多对象请求：直接一次性编辑无法还原意图，拆分为多步则会把已废弃编辑和视觉错误累积保留。
AI.method: 关键洞察为将修订历史解析为统一的"最终编辑目标"，同时指导规划与验证，使废弃请求不落地为视觉编辑。CRIE-Agent学习把修订归并为对象级最终意图，按"引用优先"分块执行，先建立被引用对象再处理依赖对象；验证后带条件布局提示从原始图像完整重执行，避免失败尝试的视觉错误向后传播。另构建CRIE-S基准(10,000条复杂冗余编辑指令及精确最终意图标注)。
AI.result: 在CRIE-S上评测五种图像编辑后端，完整编辑成功率从直接编辑的0%提升至27.5–50.0%；但绝对成功率仍偏低，失败模式与后端依赖尚未充分展开。
AI.conclusion: 将指令修订历史显式归并为最终意图并配合引用优先分块与从源图重执行的验证闭环，是处理冗余复杂编辑指令的有效范式；作者同步贡献了带最终意图标注的基准，为后续智能体式图像编辑研究提供评测基础。

title: Beyond What They Say: Cue Acknowledgment and Robustness in Vision-Language Models
summary: Explanations are used to assess whether vision-language models rely on visual evidence or misleading suggestions. A response that explicitly names a cue can still follow it, making disclosure alone an incomplete basis for judging robustness. We ask whether greater cue acknowledgment accompanies greater resistance.
