We compare matched answers and explanations under helpful, misleading, and conflicting visual and textual cues while holding the underlying question and correct answer fixed. A paired comparison shows that a model can select the endorsed wrong answer more often while acknowledging the cues more often. Reduced silence therefore need not indicate improved resistance. Explanations may also mention a textual suggestion while omitting an accompanying visual cue. Requesting evidence and acknowledgment does not consistently improve resistance in the tested settings. Outcomes vary across models and settings, and these comparisons do not isolate a causal effect of acknowledgment. Evaluations should report cue following and acknowledgment on the same instances, distinguishing visual from textual cues.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示视觉语言模型"承认视觉/文本线索"与"抵抗误导线索"并不正相关：模型可更频繁选中被诱导的错误答案，同时更频繁地提及该线索；减少沉默不等于更强鲁棒性。作者主张在同一批样本上同时报告线索跟随率与承认率，并区分视觉与文本线索。
AI.motivation: 解释（explanation）常被用来判断VLM是依赖视觉证据还是误导性提示，但"说出线索名"并不等于"不被线索带偏"，仅凭披露判断鲁棒性不充分。作者因此要检验：更大的线索承认度是否伴随更强的抗干扰能力。
AI.method: 在固定底层问题与正确答案的前提下，构造helpful / misleading / 视觉与文本冲突三类线索设置，配对比较匹配的答案与解释，统计"选中被诱导错答"与"提及线索"的比例；并测试要求模型给出证据与承认线索是否能提升抗干扰。
AI.result: 配对比较显示模型可以在更多情况下选择被默认的错误答案，同时更大比例地承认线索；解释也会提到文本提示而遗漏伴随的视觉线索；要求证据/承认并不能稳定提升抗干扰；结果随模型与设置变化，且未隔离承认的因果效应。
AI.conclusion: 披露/承认并非鲁棒性的可靠代理指标。评测应在同一实例上同时报告"线索跟随"与"线索承认"，并区分视觉线索与文本线索；单靠要求解释或证据不足以保证鲁棒性。

title: AnyBodyCodec: A Shared Native Interface for Body-Model Conversion, Extension, and Humanoid Control
summary: Parametric body models expose incompatible pose and shape controls, tying humanoid policies to particular input formats. AnyBodyCodec learns a shared representation through native conversion, then reuses it for new body models and control with its core frozen. Encoders map MHR, SMPL-X, and SOMA to aligned slots; native decoders recover target controls. The 1.090M-parameter converter covers nine routes and reaches 16.801 mm input-reference MPJPE across six cross routes: the 2.887M Transformer bank reaches 16.390 mm and its parameter-matched version 18.866 mm. Three measured routes take 7.43-7.67 ms on an RTX 4090. Adding ANNY shows that comparable conversion accuracy can accompany different action consistency under one frozen controller. Under a matched PPO budget, aligned slots support 60.78% full-action success across three formats. Separate 160-hour training reaches 66.10% source-weighted validation success, and the controller is deployed qualitatively on a physical G1 through three visual front ends. Together, these results establish reuse through both native geometric fidelity and downstream policy compatibility.

AI.tldr: AnyBodyCodec 用"原生转换"学习 MHR/SMPL-X/SOMA 等参数化人体模型间的共享对齐表示，冻结核心后复用于新模型与控制，转换精度约 16.8 mm 输入参考 MPJPE，并在统一对齐槽位下使 PPO 策略跨三种格式获得 60.78% 全动作成功率。
AI.motivation: 不同参数化人体模型（MHR、SMPL-X、SOMA、ANNY）的姿态与形状控制参数格式互不兼容，导致人形机器人策略被绑定到特定输入格式，难以跨模型、跨前端复用。
AI.method: 提出 AnyBodyCodec：通过"原生转换"（各模型原生解码器监督）学习跨模型共享的对齐槽位表示；编码器将 MHR/SMPL-X/SOMA 映射到对齐槽位，原生解码器再恢复目标控制量。核心冻结后用于新增模型与控制复用。采用 1.090M 参数转换器覆盖九条路线，另设 2.887M Transformer bank 及其参数匹配版本对照；在 RTX 4090 上测时延，并用统一槽位上的 PPO 训练策略，含 160 小时分离训练与实体 G1 三套视觉前端定性部署。
AI.result: 转换器在六条跨模型路线上达到 16.801 mm 输入参考 MPJPE；2.887M Transformer bank 为 16.390 mm，参数匹配版本 18.866 mm。三条实测路线单次耗时 7.43–7.67 ms（RTX 4090）。加入 ANNY 显示在冻结控制器下可获得相近转换精度但不同动作一致性。匹配 PPO 预算下，对齐槽位支持三种格式合计 60.78% 全动作成功率；独立 160 小时训练达 66.10% 源加权验证成功率；控制器经三套视觉前端在实体 G1 上定性部署。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该共享对齐表示同时具备原生几何保真度与下游策略兼容性，实现人体参数化模型与相应控制器之间的双向复用。

title: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
summary: We introduce Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU), extending video object tracking to environments where objects undergo physical assemblies and disassemblies. TTU requires continuously tracking objects through transformations, identifying new entities, maintaining a state graph of their relationships, and assigning semantic labels to transformations. While foundation models (e.g., SAM 2/3) maintain tracklets through appearance changes, they cannot update semantic identities as objects physically evolve. Prior work addresses only disassemblies, relying on expensive searches triggered only when tracking fails. We propose Tracking Instances via Proposals and Overlaps (TIPO), a training-free framework that continuously infers transformations via a generate-evaluate-judge pipeline. TIPO generates split and merge proposals from disjoint mask components, scores them against mask-decoder priors using inner and external overlap, and queries an MLLM on the top proposal for visual verification and semantic labeling. To benchmark TTU, we curate Video Instances, States, and Transformation Annotations (VISTA), a dataset including state graphs with 124 assembly and 132 disassembly events across 50 sequences and over 26,000 frames. TIPO achieves state-of-the-art tracking and state-graph accuracy on VISTA, while operating $6\times$ to $15\times$ faster than prior methods. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU) 任务，将视频目标跟踪扩展到物体发生物理组装/拆解的场景；提出免训练的 TIPO 框架（生成-评估-判别的拆/合提案推断 + MLLM 语义验证），并构建 VISTA 数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型（如 SAM 2/3）能在外观变化下维持 tracklet，但无法在物体物理形态演变后更新语义身份；已有工作只处理拆解任务，且依赖跟踪失败后才触发的昂贵搜索。
AI.method: TIPO：免训练框架，从不相连的掩码组件生成 split/merge 提案，用内部重叠与外接重叠对掩码解码器先验打分，再对最高分提案查询 MLLM 做视觉验证与语义标注；同时构建 VISTA 数据集（50 序列、26k+ 帧、124 次组装与 132 次拆解事件，含状态图）。
AI.result: 在 VISTA 上取得最优的跟踪与状态图准确率，速度比先前方法快 6×–15×。
AI.conclusion: TTU 将视觉跟踪与物理实体语义身份演化统一起来，TIPO 以生成-评估-判别流水线在无训练条件下实现高效的转换检测与语义标注，为物理实体的对象级状态建模提供基准与新范式。

title: BladeR: Scalable, Shape-Guided 3D Reconstruction of Wind Turbine Blades from UAV Imagery
summary: The structural integrity of wind turbine blades is critical for safe, efficient energy production. Accurate 3D reconstruction allows precise localization and quantification of wear and early damage detection. While drone-based inspections are standard, their high-resolution imagery poses challenges such as weak texture, lighting variability, and high computational cost. We present BladeR, a scalable pipeline for high-quality 3D reconstruction from inspection imagery. A hierarchical sparse reconstruction strategy leverages GPS/IMU data and blade shape priors to guide advanced keypoint matchers on full-resolution images. For dense reconstruction, a tiled Gaussian Splatting framework processes 45 MP images at native resolution, isolates the blade from background, and adaptively enhances detail recovery along the leading edge. Validation against commercial and open-source baselines shows significant improvements in model completeness and detail.

AI.tldr: BladeR：结合GPS/IMU与叶片形状先验的分层稀疏重建 + 原生分辨率分块高斯泼溅稠密重建流水线，用于风电叶片巡检影像的高质量3D重建。
AI.motivation: 无人机巡检风电叶片可获得高分辨率影像，但存在弱纹理、光照变化大、计算开销高等问题，导致现有三维重建在完整性与细节上不足；叶片磨损定位与早期损伤检测又依赖精确三维模型。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：(1) 分层稀疏重建——利用GPS/IMU位姿与叶片形状先验引导先进关键点匹配器在全分辨率影像上工作；(2) 稠密重建——分块（tiled）高斯泼溅框架，在原生分辨率下处理45MP影像，将叶片与背景分离，并对前缘区域自适应增强细节恢复。
AI.result: 与商业及开源基线对比，在模型完整性和细节恢复上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 面向工业巡检的原生分辨率分块高斯泼溅方案可有效缓解弱纹理与高分辨率计算瓶颈，为叶片损伤定位提供可用三维几何；但属领域特定应用，泛化性与效率细节披露有限。

title: Projector Time Map Calibration for Event-based Structured Light
comment: accepted to IEICE Transactions on Information and Systems
summary: Existing event-based structured light obtains a dense projector-camera correspondence from the timestamp of an event. It assumes that the projector scans a parallel raster and that the sensor timestamps each pixel independently, and we show that neither assumption holds. We obtain the correspondence from a temporal code that identifies the projector pixel directly and therefore needs no prior calibration, we calibrate the projector time map from the same recording, and we recover the geometry of the system and the offsets between its clocks by a spatio-temporal self-calibration in a preamble of a few seconds that needs no reference object and no second camera.

AI.tldr: 提出基于事件相机结构化光的新框架：抛弃"平行光栅扫描+逐像素独立时间戳"假设，改用可直接标识投影仪像素的时间码获得投影仪-相机稠密对应，无需预标定；从同一段记录中标定投影仪时间映射，并通过数秒前导片段中的时空自标定同时恢复系统几何与各时钟间偏移，无需参考物或第二相机。
AI.motivation: 现有一事件式结构化光方法依赖两个隐含但错误的假设：投影仪进行平行光栅扫描、传感器对每像素独立打时间戳。这两点在真实系统中均不成立，导致对应关系存在系统误差；同时传统标定需要参考物、第二相机和额外预标定，部署成本高。
AI.method: 1) 设计时间码直接编码投影仪像素身份，从事件时间戳解码得到稠密对应，绕开扫描顺序假设；2) 利用同一录制数据自监督标定投影仪时间映射（时间畸变/非线性）；3) 在前导数秒数据上做时空自标定，联合估计投影仪-相机外参/几何与设备时钟偏移；4) 端到端无需参考物、无需第二相机、无需预先标定。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；作者声称对应关系精度与自标定精度不再受平行光栅与独立时间戳假设的限制，仅需数秒前导片段即可完成几何与时钟偏移的联合恢复，并免除了参考物与第二相机的需求。
AI.conclusion: 该工作重新审视线扫描事件结构化光的基本假设，将"对应—时间标定—几何标定"统一为可从单次短录制中自标定的时空问题，为事件式主动深度感知提供了一条低部署成本、免外部标定装置的路线。可读性上偏标定/传感系统方向，与主流具身导航、VLA、前馈三维重建路线相邻但非核心。

title: Pose-based Co-speech Gesture Detection
summary: Co-speech gesture detection identifies the spans in which a speaker gestures (e.g., beat or semantic gestures) in video. As a first step in gesture annotation, it is crucial for studying human communicative behaviour. Despite the availability of automatic tools and models, co-speech gesture detection remains underexplored, and its current state of the art is unclear: existing methods have been evaluated using different datasets, experimental setups, and metrics, making their performance difficult to compare. To address this gap, we benchmark existing detectors using the same cross-validation folds across three datasets (MULTISIMO, GESRes, and CABBS), with evaluation at the frame, gesture-span, and window levels. Our results show that previously reported performance does not consistently transfer to this common evaluation setting. Performance varies substantially across datasets, particularly with gesture frequency, indicating that the task remains far from solved. We further propose a CTR-GCN + BiLSTM model that outperforms the previous best method, MPSL, on CABBS. Our results provide a more consistent basis for comparing existing approaches and highlight key challenges for future research on co-speech gesture detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文在统一交叉验证设置下对MULTISIMO、GESRes、CABBS三个数据集上的协同语音手势检测器进行基准评测（帧级/手势段级/窗口级），并提出CTR-GCN+BiLSTM模型在CABBS上超越MPSL。
AI.motivation: 现有协同语音手势检测方法在数据集、实验设置与指标上各不相同，性能难以比较，领域缺乏一致的评测基准，且任务本身研究不足。
AI.method: 采用相同交叉验证折在三个数据集上统一评测现有检测器，并在帧、手势跨度、窗口三个层级评估；同时提出CTR-GCN（骨骼图卷积）+BiLSTM的时序检测模型。
AI.result: 原有报告的性能无法稳定迁移到统一评测设置；性能随数据集及手势频率显著波动；CTR-GCN+BiLSTM在CABBS上优于此前最佳的MPSL。
AI.conclusion: 协同语音手势检测远未解决；统一评测为方法比较提供更一致的基础，并揭示了未来研究的关键挑战。

title: Beyond Future Views: Exploring Future-State World Models for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through unseen 3D environments, where the target spaces often lie beyond the current observation. Navigation world models address this challenge by predicting future views either as pixels or latent representations, providing valuable look-ahead information for action decision. Both paradigms define the future primarily through what the agent may observe, raising a fundamental question: is predicting future views the ultimate form to represent the future for VLN? Cognitive studies show that the human hippocampus prospectively represents both future goals and intervening locations along planned routes. Inspired by this predictive-map view, we organize the navigation-relevant future around goal-directed spatial states and route structure. We instantiate this perspective with two complementary abstractions: a short-horizon waypoint that specifies the next local state to reach, and a mid-horizon corridor that captures the spatial support of the upcoming route. Based on this design, we propose FS-Nav, a future-state world modeling framework that predicts waypoint-corridor states from spatial memory and language instructions, and communicates them to a VLM navigator through top-down and first-person interfaces. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that FS-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance. This highlights navigation-relevant future-state modeling as a promising direction for representing the future in VLN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FS-Nav，一种"未来状态世界模型"框架，用航点（短时域局部目标状态）与走廊（中时域路径空间支撑）两类空间状态替代像素/隐变量未来视图预测，并由空间记忆与语言指令预测后经俯视与第一人称接口传给 VLM 导航器，在标准 VLN 基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有导航世界模型（预测未来像素或隐表示）都以"智能体将看到什么"来定义未来，缺少对目标状态与路径结构的显式刻画；认知研究中海马体对目标与途经位置的预期性表征提示应从"预测地图"视角组织导航相关未来。
AI.method: 以两种互补抽象表示未来：短时域 waypoint（下一局部可达状态）与中时域 corridor（后续路线的空间支撑）；FS-Nav 从空间记忆与语言指令预测 waypoint-corridor 状态，并通过 top-down 与 first-person 两种接口将其注入 VLM 导航器。
AI.result: 在标准 VLN 基准上达到 SOTA 性能，优于基于像素或隐表示的未来视图预测类导航世界模型（摘要未给出具体数值与真实机器人验证）。
AI.conclusion: 导航相关的未来状态建模（目标导向空间状态 + 路线结构）是 VLN 中表征未来的一种有前景方向，可替代以观测为中心的预测范式。

title: ADEPT: Adaptive Monocular Depth Estimation via Model-In-The-Loop Photometric Tuning with Capture Risk Prediction
summary: Exposure and gain determine the visual evidence available to monocular depth estimation (MDE), particularly when robot motion creates a tradeoff between light collection and motion blur. We present ADEPT, a framework that adapts these settings using learned feedback from a frozen depth model. During training, ground-truth depth identifies the lowest-error reference within a group of physically evaluated camera settings. A compact predictor learns reference-relative disagreement (RRD) between each candidate's depth prediction and the reference prediction using regression and ranking losses. At deployment, it scores observed captures using frozen-model features and camera, motion, and illumination context, without ground truth or reference images. A contextual Gaussian-process controller uses recent scores to select subsequent exposure and gain settings under motion and photometric constraints. We evaluate offline camera selection with relative and metric Depth Anything v2 and demonstrate online control with the affine-invariant variant on a mobile robot. Across nine equally weighted scene-illumination conditions, ADEPT reduces mean scale-and-shift-aligned $\mathrm{Abs}_{\mathrm{rel}}$ by 14.6% relative to built-in auto-exposure and by 10.0% relative to the best-performing evaluated prior controller.

AI.tldr: ADEPT 用冻结深度模型的相对不一致反馈自适应调节曝光与增益，在运动模糊与光收集之间取得平衡，使单目深度估计更稳。
AI.motivation: MDE 的性能直接受曝光与增益影响；机器人运动时“长时间曝光采集更多光”与“避免运动模糊”存在矛盾，固定或传统自动曝光策略无法针对深度任务优化。
AI.method: 训练阶段用真值深度在一组物理可实现的相机设置中挑出误差最小的参考设置，令紧凑预测器以回归+排序损失学习“参考相对分歧”（RRD）。部署阶段仅用冻结模型特征加相机、运动、光照上下文打分，无需真值或参考图像；再由上下文高斯过程控制器在运动与光度约束下选择后续曝光/增益。
AI.result: 离线用 Depth Anything v2 的相对/度量版本评估相机选择，并在移动机器人上以仿射不变版本做在线控制；在 9 类等权场景-光照条件下，尺度与偏移对齐后的平均 Abs_rel 相比内置自动曝光降低 14.6%，相比最佳基线控制器降低 10.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将深度模型自身的不确定性作为闭环反馈来驱动成像参数，是可迁移的感知-控制协同设计；但评测仅限单机器人平台与桌面级场景，泛化与开源细节待验证。

title: TrojanMaxxing: One-shotting VLM Backdoors with Weight-Space Programming
summary: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can reason directly about the weights of other neural networks. Given only a natural-language objective, an LLM can inspect a model's weights, understand what they compute, and edit them directly without gradient-based optimization. This capability, termed weight-space programming (WSP), has been used to improve model performance on math reasoning, medical QA and other benchmarks. We propose TrojanMaxxing, a novel strategy to backdoor vision-language models (VLMs), by reframing it as a WSP task. We use Claude Opus 5.5 and Mythos 5.2 agents to backdoor VLMs without any optimization or training methods. The agents inspect the model weights, apply targeted edits, and co-design an imperceptible visual trigger that activates the backdoor. We then study the agents' strategies and present a thorough evaluation of the trojaned models on various benchmark datasets. TrojanMaxxing achieves attack success rates of 93%-100% on content moderation and 78%-100% on OCR while maintaining clean accuracy. Perhaps most consequentially, we show that injecting backdoors in a training-free manner is possible by simply, "asking an agent to do it".

AI.tldr: 提出 TrojanMaxxing：把视觉-语言模型（VLM）后门注入重新表述为"权重空间编程"（WSP）任务，由 LLM 智能体（Claude Opus 5.5、Mythos 5.2）直接读取并编辑模型权重、协同设计不可察觉的视觉触发器，全程无训练、无梯度优化。
AI.motivation: 现有后门攻击依赖数据投毒与梯度训练，成本高且难以在权重层面直接实施；作者想验证"仅凭自然语言指令让智能体检查并改写权重"即可完成后门植入，从而揭示一种新的低成本安全威胁面。
AI.method: 将后门注入重新定义为 weight-space programming（WSP）：智能体先审查目标 VLM 的权重、理解其计算语义，再做定向权重编辑，使触发器激活特定目标行为；同时联合设计人眼/感知难以察觉的视觉触发器，并与权重改动互相匹配。全流程无优化器、无微调。
AI.result: 内容审核任务攻击成功率 93%–100%，OCR 任务 78%–100%，且干净样本准确率基本保持；同时系统分析了智能体在权重空间中的编辑策略。
AI.conclusion: 表明免训练、纯智能体驱动的权重级后门是现实可行的（"只要让智能体去做"），凸显权重开放发布与智能体工具调用结合后的安全风险，也为权重可解释性与篡改检测提出需求。

title: Neurodegenerative Differential Diagnosis with Knowledge-enhanced Structural Reasoning
summary: Accurate differential diagnosis of neurodegenerative disorders remains challenging due to overlapping clinical manifestations and heterogeneous, often incomplete multimodal observations. Existing multimodal models can integrate imaging and clinical measurements but often overlook disease-specific evidence patterns and pairwise relations among competing diagnoses. We therefore propose Knowledge-enhanced Structural Reasoning (KnowSR), which aligns multimodal patient representations with a literature-grounded knowledge bank of disease prototypes, signed evidence directions, and pairwise diagnostic relations. Specifically, in KnowSR, patient-specific knowledge alignment and target-aware pooling inject structured disease evidence, while anchored relational reasoning reconciles pairwise diagnostic margins over a sparse differential graph, thereby collectively enhancing differential diagnostic capability. Across extensive experiments, KnowSR consistently outperforms 19 baselines on patient-level six-class diagnosis under patient-disjoint five-fold evaluation. This shows that grounding patient evidence in structured medical knowledge enables more effective differential diagnosis than naive multimodal fusion alone.

AI.tldr: KnowSR：将多模态患者表示与文献构建的疾病原型/证据方向/成对诊断关系知识库对齐，用target-aware pooling与锚定关系推理提升神经退行性疾病六分类鉴别诊断。
AI.motivation: 神经退行性疾病临床表型重叠、多模态观测异构且常缺失；现有融合模型忽略疾病特异证据模式与竞争诊断间的成对关系。
AI.method: 知识增强结构推理框架：文献驱动的知识库（疾病原型、带符号证据方向、成对诊断关系）；患者级知识对齐+目标感知池化注入结构化证据；在稀疏鉴别图上做锚定关系推理以校准成对诊断margin。
AI.result: 患者级六分类、患者不交叉五折评估下，稳定优于19个基线。
AI.conclusion: 以结构化医学知识锚定患者证据，比朴素多模态融合更能有效支持鉴别诊断；结论限于医学影像场景，未涉及具身/3D任务。

title: GenPA: Image Generators as Efficient Robot Policies
summary: Pretrained visual generation models have shown great promise in robotic manipulation. However, a representative line of work still treats future visual prediction as the central link between visual generative pretraining and action learning, retaining it as a training objective even when future scenes are no longer generated at inference time. We argue that the instruction-following, spatial understanding, and visual imagination capabilities acquired through image generation pretraining can support control without future visual prediction: image generation models themselves can be directly adapted into powerful action learners. Building on this perspective, we propose GenPA, which fine-tunes an image generation backbone with a lightweight 19M-parameter action regression adapter and reuses its native generative objective for perception co-training. The native image-editing interface accommodates different visual targets without task-specific perception heads, enabling comparisons of current-scene perception, future prediction, and their combinations within a common policy architecture. At deployment, GenPA requires only a single backbone forward pass and action regression, without visual generation or iterative action denoising. Without additional large-scale robot-data pretraining, GenPA demonstrates strong control performance and robustness to perturbations across simulation benchmarks (99.10% success on LIBERO and 83.79% on LIBERO-Plus) and real-world manipulation tasks. Under compiled inference, GenPA takes 20.9 ms per action chunk on a single H100 GPU, achieving 1.7-3.4x speedups over strong VLA and WAM baselines. Our latency analysis further highlights architectural advantages of visual generation backbones for efficient robot control. Ablations across visual tasks and their combinations identify current-depth supervision as a simple, effective training recipe.

AI.tldr: GenPA 将图像生成骨干直接用轻量 19M 动作回归适配器微调成动作学习器，抛弃推理时的未来视觉预测，仅单次前向+动作回归，在 LIBERO 达 99.10%、LIBERO-Plus 83.79%，单 H100 每动作块 20.9 ms。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉生成式操作策略把"未来视觉预测"当作视觉生成预训练与动作学习的核心纽带，即使在推理阶段不再生成未来画面也保留该训练目标，造成不必要的架构与推理开销。作者主张图像生成预训练获得的指令跟随、空间理解与视觉想象能力本身即可支撑控制，无需未来视觉预测。
AI.method: 在图像生成骨干上附加 19M 参数的轻量动作回归适配器进行微调，并复用原生生成目标做感知协同训练；利用原生图像编辑接口承载不同视觉目标（当前场景、未来预测及其组合），无需任务专用感知头，从而在同一策略架构内公平比较。部署时仅需一次骨干前向+动作回归，无视觉生成、无迭代动作去噪。
AI.result: 无额外大规模机器人数据预训练情况下，仿真基准 LIBERO 成功率 99.10%、LIBERO-Plus 83.79%，并在真实世界操作任务上表现稳健；编译推理下单张 H100 每动作块 20.9 ms，相对强 VLA 与 WAM 基线加速 1.7–3.4 倍；延迟分析揭示视觉生成骨干的架构效率优势。消融表明"当前帧深度监督"是简单有效的训练配方。
AI.conclusion: 视觉生成预训练到控制之间存在一条绕过未来视觉预测的更短路径：生成骨干可直接充当动作学习器，兼顾性能、鲁棒性与推理效率，为 VLA/WAM 架构设计提供新的效率导向范式。

title: Mechanism Parity for Simulation-Based Validation of Autonomous-Driving Perception
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Extended version of the authors' papers at IEEE IV 2026 and IEEE ITSC 2026. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Simulation is central to intelligent-vehicle validation, but visual realism or output agreement between a real scene and its synthetic counterpart does not prove that a perception system used the same evidence in both domains. This paper addresses that mechanism-parity gap for paired real-synthetic autonomous-driving perception. It unifies Decisive-Feature Fidelity, which compares decisive evidence maps in a frozen system under test (SUT), with Concept-Decisive Feature Fidelity, which projects decisive evidence into semantic scene concepts for diagnosis. The framework is a validation diagnostic rather than a standalone safety certificate: it asks whether output-consistent simulation also preserves the mechanism by which the perception model reaches that output. The empirical evidence comprises ten retrained diffusion ControlNet generators evaluated on a deterministic exact-geometry KITTI-Virtual KITTI 2 subset. Generated counterparts use a 1248-by-376-pixel padded inference canvas and are cropped back to the exact KITTI dimensions before evaluation. The final benchmark reports target-image, output-consistency, and mechanism metrics recomputed from a single audited output set, then adds metric-disagreement cases, bootstrap uncertainty, threshold sensitivity, and concept/cache integrity audits. Across the benchmark, output and appearance fidelity are at most weakly and inconsistently rank-correlated with decisive-mechanism distance for all three frozen SUTs, and a constructed positive control shows the estimator detects a known planted mechanism that output agreement misses, supporting decisive-evidence diagnostics for intelligent-vehicle simulation validation. All numerical claims are restricted to the declared exact-geometry benchmark, ten generators, and three frozen SUTs.

AI.tldr: 提出"决定性特征保真"(Decisive-Feature Fidelity)及"概念-决定性特征保真"的统一诊断框架，检验仿真与其真实配对场景中冻结感知系统是否使用了相同证据机制，而非仅输出一致。
AI.motivation: 智能驾驶仿真验证通常以视觉真实感或真/合成输出的逐点一致性作为通过标准，但二者均无法说明感知模型在两个域中是否依赖同一证据；存在"输出一致但机制不一致"的机制一致性缺口（mechanism-parity gap）。
AI.method: 在冻结的SUT上计算决定性证据图并比较，形成Decisive-Feature Fidelity；再将其投影到语义场景概念空间，形成Concept-Decisive Feature Fidelity以支持诊断。实验基于KITTI-Virtual KITTI 2的确定性、精确几何对齐子集，十次重训的diffusion ControlNet生成器，推理分辨率1248×376并裁剪回原尺寸；统一口径重算目标图像、输出一致性与机制指标，并补充指标分歧案例、bootstrap不确定性、阈值敏感性、概念/缓存完整性审计，另设植入已知机制的阳性对照。
AI.result: 对三个冻结SUT，输出一致性与外观保真同决定性机制距离之间仅呈弱且不稳定的秩相关；构造的阳性对照表明该估计器能检出输出一致性所遗漏的植入机制。所有数值结论限定于该精确几何基准、十个生成器与三个冻结SUT。
AI.conclusion: 输出一致≠机制一致，仿真验证需引入决定性证据层面的诊断指标；该框架定位为验证诊断工具而非独立安全认证。局限在于基准规模小、仅限精确几何配对与三个SUT。

title: AppCon-Bench: Perception and Misperception of Material Appearance in Vision-Language Models
summary: Identifying the same material across changes in illumination or geometry is a critical ability for robust vision systems. Humans exhibit remarkable material appearance constancy, being able to recognize the intrinsic physical properties of an object's surface material across variations in extrinsic, confounding factors such as the lighting or the shape of such object. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong performance across a wide range of semantic vision tasks, yet their ability to interpret subtle mid-level perceptual attributes remains less understood. We introduce AppCon-Bench, a benchmark comprising five tasks designed to assess material appearance constancy under controlled variations in geometry and illumination, and evaluate representative VLMs alongside human observers, investigating their ability to maintain consistent material judgments across viewing conditions and experimental contexts. After thorough analysis, we identify several key findings that reveal both similarities and systematic differences between human and VLM material appearance perception, highlighting the value of evaluating perceptual successes and failures beyond overall accuracy and informing areas of improvement for current VLMs.

AI.tldr: AppCon-Bench：评估VLM在几何与光照变化下保持材质外观恒常性的五任务基准，并与人类观察者对照分析。
AI.motivation: 人类具备显著的材质外观恒常性，能在外在光照/形状变化下识别表面本征物理属性；而VLM在细微中层感知属性上的能力尚不清楚，缺乏受控评测手段。
AI.method: 构建包含五个任务的基准，在受控的几何与光照变化条件下测试材质外观恒常性；评测代表性VLM并与人类观察者对比，分析跨视角条件与实验情境下判断的一致性。
AI.result: 发现人类与VLM在材质感知上既有相似性也存在系统性差异，揭示仅看总体准确率会掩盖的成败模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作强调超越总体精度的细粒度感知评测价值，并为当前VLM的改进方向提供指引。

title: Ego2Ego: Generative Visual Perspective Taking Across Collaborators
summary: Visual perspective taking, the ability to infer what another person sees from their position, is fundamental to human collaboration. However, prior works reduced perspective taking to state estimation, geometric reconstruction, or discrete question answering, whereas existing cross-view video generation methods either inferred the target view from the input video alone or required an external camera that observes the target person. We introduce generative visual perspective taking: Given an ego person's egocentric video, a scene point cloud, and a collaborator's camera trajectory, the task is to generate the continuous egocentric video from the collaborator's perspective. This task is challenging given extreme viewpoint shifts, dynamic occlusions, and sparse visual overlap. We address these challenges with Ego2Ego -- a set of backbone-agnostic geometric modules that provide a pretrained video diffusion model with the 3D scene geometry shared by both interactants. Ego2Ego renders dense, temporally consistent scene coordinate maps into every view as a shared spatial reference, aligns cross-view tokens in 3D ray space through relative geometric attention, and recovers regions outside the ego person's current view from the ego person's visual memory. Experiments on the CoMind dataset across three video diffusion backbones show that Ego2Ego consistently improves visual quality, Level-2 scene layout accuracy, and collaborator motion, outperforming state-of-the-art cross-view video generation baselines on every backbone. By generating the collaborator's egocentric video more accurately, Ego2Ego brings visual perspective taking to human-robot collaboration, where it can help infer what a human collaborator sees and does, and can turn single-person recordings into synchronised multi-perspective videos for robot learning.

AI.tldr: Ego2Ego: 以自我中心视频+点云+协作者相机轨迹为输入，生成协作者视角的连续第一人称视频（"生成式视觉视角采择"），通过稠密场景坐标图渲染、3D射线空间跨视角注意力对齐与视觉记忆补全实现。
AI.motivation: 此前视角采择被简化为状态估计/几何重建/离散问答，跨视角视频生成要么仅依赖输入视频、要么需外部相机观测目标人物；缺少从协作者自身视角生成连续视频的能力。该能力对人与机器人协作（推断对方所见所做）和将单人录制转为同步多视角机器人学习数据有价值。
AI.method: 提出任务：给定自我中心视频、场景点云与协作者相机轨迹，生成协作者视角连续视频。方法为backbone无关的几何模块集合：1) 向每个视角渲染稠密、时序一致的场景坐标图作为共享空间参照；2) 通过相对几何注意力在3D射线空间对齐跨视角token；3) 用自我中心视觉记忆恢复当前视野外区域。接入预训练视频扩散模型。
AI.result: 在CoMind数据集、三种视频扩散backbone上，Ego2Ego在视觉质量、Level-2场景布局精度和协作者运动上一致优于现有跨视角视频生成baseline。
AI.conclusion: 将视角采择重新表述为生成式跨视角视频生成，可服务人机协作中的伙伴意图/行为推断，并将单人录制转为同步多视角数据用于机器人学习；未提供真实机器人闭环验证。

title: Cecilia: Towards Layout-Inclusive Optical Music Recognition
summary: Reconstructing an editable music score requires musical events, sung text and the instructions that organise them on the page. Existing recognition targets often omit part of this information, while direct MusicXML prediction repeats substantial structural markup. We introduce Cecilia, a compact representation of canonicalised MusicXML that retains musical content, lyric attachments and layout instructions. Cecilia-OMR predicts this representation through metadata and measure-bounded music segments from shared visual memory. A learned count head determines the number of output segments. Across paired complete scores under a common tokeniser, the ratio of mean MusicXML to Cecilia sequence lengths is 27.73. Cecilia-OMR outperforms Legato 2 on Camera String Quartets and both Lieder conditions, with a four-condition OpenScore macro normalised edit distance of 0.2232 against 0.2998. Separate evaluations of lyrics, notation trees and rendered layout reveal complementary aspects of reconstruction and quantify the contribution of layout instructions. Training-stage, reward and candidate-selection studies further examine how recognition changes across model adaptation and decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出 Cecilia：一种保留音符内容、歌词附着与版面指令的规范化 MusicXML 紧凑表示，并提出 Cecilia-OMR，通过元数据与以小节为界的乐段从共享视觉记忆中预测该表示，用可学习计数头决定输出段数。
AI.motivation: 可编辑乐谱重建需同时覆盖音乐事件、歌词与版面组织指令，但现有识别目标常缺失部分信息；而直接预测 MusicXML 需重复大量结构标记，序列冗长。因此需要一个信息完整且紧凑的目标表示。
AI.method: 构建紧凑、规范化的 MusicXML 中间表示 Cecilia；Cecilia-OMR 以共享视觉记忆为骨干，先预测元数据，再按小节划分的乐段并行/分段预测 Cecilia 序列（而非整页 MusicXML）；采用可学习 count head 预测段数；在统一分词器下比较序列长度，并做训练阶段、奖励与候选选择（解码）研究。
AI.result: 相同分词器下，MusicXML 与 Cecilia 平均序列长度比为 27.73；在 Camera String Quartets 与两个 Lieder 条件下优于 Legato 2；OpenScore 四条件宏平均归一化编辑距离 0.2232（对比 0.2998）。歌词、符号树与渲染版面三类分项评测显示重建的不同侧面，并量化版面指令的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑中间表示 + 结构分段的 OMR 范式可显著压缩输出并提升完整乐谱重建质量，且将版面指令纳入目标对可编辑重建有实质增益；解码与训练策略对结果亦有影响。

title: ROSWORLD: When Digital Task Competence Meets Physical Execution
summary: Computer-use agents now solve most desktop tasks through direct software input, but a robot using the same computer must turn GUI knowledge into physical contact with a keyboard and mouse. We introduce ROSWorld, a benchmark that couples a physically simulated robot workstation to a live OSWorld desktop, so that a robot and a desktop agent pursue the same goals under the same official evaluators. The evaluated model receives observations only from the workstation camera views and operates the peripherals through either a single-arm rigid probe or dual-arm dexterous hands. Across five frontier models and 40 tasks in ten applications, models that complete 31-39 tasks on the desktop complete at most 23 with the probe and 28 with the hands. Paired trajectory analysis shows that models adapt their interaction strategies toward keyboard input, yet physical execution frequently fails through missed presses, incorrect targets, and unintended contacts. ROSWorld makes the gap between knowing what to do on a computer and physically doing it measurable.

AI.tldr: ROSWorld 将物理仿真的机器人工作站与实时运行的 OSWorld 桌面环境耦合，让机器人通过单臂刚性探针或双臂灵巧手物理操作键鼠，在相同官方评测器下衡量"知道怎么做"与"物理上做到"之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体已能通过直接软件输入完成多数桌面任务，但真实机器人必须把 GUI 知识转化为对键盘鼠标的物理接触。现有基准无法度量这一"知识—物理执行"落差，缺乏同目标、同评测器的可比较平台。
AI.method: 构建 ROSWorld 基准：物理仿真机器人工作站 + 实时 OSWorld 桌面闭环耦合；模型仅获取工作站相机视角观测，通过单臂刚性探针或双臂灵巧手驱动外设；在 10 个应用、40 个任务上评测 5 个前沿模型，并进行配对轨迹分析以定位失败模式。
AI.result: 桌面端完成 31–39 个任务的模型，使用探针时最多完成 23 个，使用灵巧手时最多 28 个。配对轨迹分析显示模型会主动调整交互策略以适配键盘输入，但物理执行频繁因按压遗漏、目标定位错误和非预期接触而失败。
AI.conclusion: ROSWorld 使"知道在电脑上做什么"与"物理上做成"之间的差距首次可量化，揭示了物理执行层是当前具身计算机使用的主要瓶颈，为后续策略学习与感知-控制改进提供基准。

title: PathOPEN: A pathologist-curated histopathology dataset for visual question answering
comment: 38 pages including supplementary material and appendices, 8 main figures and 1 supplementary figure. Dataset: this https URL
summary: PathOPEN is a histopathology dataset for visual question answering. Two clinical pathologists selected 157 cases with 229 available original images and wrote open-ended, five-option multiple-choice and close-ended (yes/no) questions. They supplied both a correct and a wrong answer for 201 of the 309 open-ended questions. Each case records the organ, pathology category and regional anatomy, and each image records its magnification. The dataset includes 6,870 augmented images and four manifests that select subsets to improve balance by individual metadata field. Five additional pathologists and two vision-language model judges rated items with scoring rubrics, and six models answered questions zero-shot across the three formats. The metadata support subgroup evaluation, and the paired answers can be used to construct preference examples.

AI.tldr: PathOPEN：组织病理学视觉问答数据集，含157例/229张原图、开放式/五选一/是否三类问题，201道开放题配正误成对答案，含病例(器官、病理类别、区域解剖)与图像(放大倍数)元数据，另附6,870张增强图与四份平衡子集清单。
AI.motivation: 现有病理VQA数据多为封闭式或缺乏细粒度元数据与成对偏好标注，难以支持亚组评测与模型偏好对齐。
AI.method: 由两名病理医师标注并撰写多题型问题及正误答案对；记录器官/病理类别/区域解剖/放大倍数元数据；构建增强图像与元数据平衡清单；五名病理医师与两个视觉语言模型评审按评分规则打分；六款模型在三类题型上零样本测试。
AI.result: 提供可进行亚组评测的病理VQA基准，正误答案对可构造偏好样本；给出六款模型的零样本多题型表现与人工/模型评审评分。
AI.conclusion: PathOPEN以元数据分层与成对答案支撑细粒度评测与偏好学习，但作为医学领域基准数据集，与本人关注的VLA/世界模型/3D重建等核心方向无直接方法论关联。

title: Efficient Natural Language to Temporal Logic Translation for Real-Time Physical AI
summary: Robots can be controlled to perform tasks with guaranteed correctness when the task instructions are stated in a formal language. Large language models (LLMs) have been widely used to allow users to provide such instructions in natural language (NL), by translating NL into formal language. When deploying such translators on a robot, however, we face limited computing and energy resources, while offloading computation or data to the cloud may be infeasible or undesirable. Yet an LLM is a general-purpose text generator, whereas a formula in a fixed formal language fragment follows a well-defined syntax. We therefore ask whether text generation is needed at all. For the formal language of linear temporal logic (LTL), we show that this translation can instead be broken down into answering a set of questions with pre-defined answers. We then construct a System-One model, a recent class of NL-based classifier, to provide such answers and enable us to translate a natural language instruction into an LTL instruction. On three benchmarks, our translator matches or exceeds the accuracy of the best local LLMs available, at up to one order of magnitude lower runtime and energy consumption. We show that it generalizes to unseen atomic propositions and temporal patterns.

AI.tldr: 将自然语言指令到LTL公式的翻译重构为回答一组预设问题的分类任务，用System-One分类器替代LLM文本生成，在三个基准上精度持平或超过最佳本地LLM，运行时间与能耗低至十分之一。
AI.motivation: 部署在机器人端时算力与能耗受限，云端卸载不可行；且LTL公式语法固定，LLM通用文本生成能力属于浪费。因此质疑"是否真的需要文本生成"。
AI.method: 把NL→LTL翻译分解为若干带预定义答案的问题，构建System-One风格的自然语言分类器逐题作答，从而不生成自由文本即产出LTL指令。
AI.result: 三个基准上与最强本地LLM精度相当或更高，运行时间与能耗降低最多一个数量级；对未见原子命题与未见时序模式具备泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 端侧NL→形式化语言翻译可由分类范式替代生成范式，为资源受限机器人提供高效、可验证的任务指令接口。

title: Which Dwarf Is This? Doppeldwarf-306 and Near-Identical Instance Retrieval
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures in the main text; includes appendix. Project page: this https URL
summary: Most established instance-retrieval benchmarks emphasise landmarks; small sculptures from visually similar series offer a complementary challenge. We introduce Doppeldwarf-306: 1,691 openly licensed photographs of 306 bronze dwarf statues in Wrocław, Poland, many made in themed series that share one style, with the photographer of each image recorded. With no training, nearest-neighbour search over frozen DINOv2 features names the right statue first for 93.1% of leave-one-out queries, and the best of thirteen backbones from seven pretraining paradigms reaches 94.7%. Accuracy falls slowly as candidates are added: for DINOv2, by about 0.8 points each time their number doubles. A natural design for a phone guide compares a photograph only with statues near the user. In simulation this helps, but less than an equal number of randomly chosen statues does, so random subsampling overstates its value; a permutation test ties the penalty to the real layout (p = 0.005). Used as a weight instead of a filter, location raises DINOv2 from 93.4% to 98.7% for a simulated user 25 m from the statue. With the query's photographer withheld, learned local-feature matching raises DINOv2 accuracy from 81.8% to 85.5% and also improves DINOv3. Comparing the two best candidates cuts DINOv2's false acceptance of unknown statues from 38.3% to 19.6% at 90% known acceptance.

AI.tldr: Doppeldwarf-306：1,691 张开放许可照片、306 尊波兰弗罗茨瓦夫青铜小矮人雕像的实例检索基准，含拍摄者标注。冻结 DINOv2 最近邻无训练即达 93.1%（留一法），13 个骨干中最佳 94.7%；候选增多时精度缓降（每翻倍约 -0.8 点）。按地理位置筛选候选反而劣于等量随机子采样（置换检验 p=0.005），但作为加权时 DINOv2 从 93.4% 升至 98.7%（模拟距离 25 m）。隐去拍摄者后，局部特征匹配将 DINOv2 从 81.8% 提升到 85.5%；双候选对比把未知雕像误接受率从 38.3% 降到 19.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有实例检索基准过度集中于地标类目标，缺少"视觉高度相似的同系列小型雕塑"这一互补性难点；作者希望在无训练条件下探测冻结视觉特征在此类细粒度、强相似实例上的检索能力，并考察手机导览场景中地理位置先验与未知类拒识的真实价值。
AI.method: 构建 Doppeldwarf-306 数据集（306 尊雕像、1,691 张照片、记录拍摄者以支持留一法评估）；零样本最近邻检索，比较 7 种预训练范式共 13 个骨干；用置换检验分离地理位置的真实贡献与随机子采样的虚高；将位置先验以加权而非过滤形式融入；在隐去查询拍摄者的更难设定下测试学习式局部特征匹配；并采用 top-2 候选对比实现未知雕像拒识。
AI.result: DINOv2 冻结特征 top-1 达 93.1%，最佳骨干 94.7%；候选翻倍精度约降 0.8 点。位置过滤劣于等量随机子采样，说明随机基线会高估位置先验收益；位置加权在 25 m 模拟场景下达 98.7%。隐去拍摄者时局部匹配使 DINOv2 81.8%→85.5%，并改善 DINOv3；双候选对比在 90% 已知类接受率下将未知类误接受从 38.3% 降至 19.6%。
AI.conclusion: 冻结基础模型特征即可在细微相似实例上实现高精度无训练检索；地理先验的正确用法是加权而非硬过滤，且评估须避免随机子采样偏差；双候选对比是低成本有效的开放集拒识机制。属于实例检索基准/数据集类工作。结论偏 benchmark 与评估方法学，对具身感知与 3D 重建核心方向参考价值有限。

title: NavRSI: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) have enabled vision-and-language navigation (VLN) through direct closed-loop perception and action. However, navigation performance depends strongly on the harness governing LLM-environment interactions, while existing harnesses largely rely on manually designed navigation tools, memory, and agent roles. We introduce NavRSI, a harness-centric recursive self-improvement framework that optimizes the navigation behavior of frozen LLMs through closed-loop experience. In each round, NavRSI iteratively collects navigation trajectories and failure diagnostics, employs a designer agent to rewrite the harness, and retains the revisions that prove effective, while the designer accumulates experience from previous revisions so that the harness and this experience co-evolve. Privileged simulator diagnostics guide only the designer and remain inaccessible to the navigating LLM, enabling deployment with a single RGB camera and primitive actions, without task-specific model training or additional navigation tools. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements across LLMs from four vendors, with 85.64% success rate on the full R2R-CE val-unseen split with GPT-6-Astra, surpassing the previously reported best by 4.13%. Evaluations on RxR-CE, NavRAG-CE, and a real humanoid robot further demonstrate its generalizability.

AI.tldr: NavRSI 是一种以 harness 为中心的递归自改进框架，通过闭环经验让冻结 LLM 的导航行为持续提升：每轮收集轨迹与失败诊断，由设计者智能体重写 harness 并保留有效修改，设计者经验与 harness 协同演化。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLN 中 LLM 与环境的交互 harness（导航工具、记忆、智能体角色）多为人工设计，性能强依赖 harness 质量，缺乏自动化优化手段。
AI.method: 冻结 LLM 权重，仅优化外部 harness。迭代循环：采样导航轨迹并获取失败诊断 → 设计者智能体基于历史修订经验重写 harness → 保留有效修订并积累设计经验。特权仿真器诊断仅对设计者可见，不泄漏给导航 LLM，从而部署时只需单目 RGB 相机与原始动作，无需任务特定训练或额外导航工具。
AI.result: 在四家厂商的多个 LLM 上取得一致提升；GPT-6-Astra 在 R2R-CE val-unseen 全量划分上达 85.64% 成功率，超出此前最佳 4.13%；在 RxR-CE、NavRAG-CE 及真实人形机器人上验证了泛化性。
AI.conclusion: harness 可作为 LLM 导航能力自改进的核心杠杆，无需模型训练或人工工具设计即可获得显著且可迁移的性能提升。

title: Solar-Conditioned Flow Matching for Multitemporal Aerial Visible-to-Infrared Image Translation
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE GRSL
summary: Aerial visible-to-infrared (V2IR) image translation provides scalable thermal data across the full diurnal cycle. However, existing methods predominantly learn a static mapping within narrow acquisition windows. As the thermal state evolves throughout the day, a single visible image may correspond to multiple plausible IR appearances, making V2IR translation an inherently multitemporal task. This letter proposes solar-conditioned latent flow matching (Solar-Flow), which upgrades aerial V2IR translation from static mapping to multitemporal generation. First, we design three computable physical factors, namely the solar elevation, the thermal phase clock (TPC), and the flight altitude. The TPC counts the elapsed heating and cooling hours on a continuous 24-hour axis anchored at sunrise, so the thermal state stays well defined even at hours without training samples. Second, we inject the condition into every Transformer block of a pretrained flow matching generator through adaptive layer normalization. This design preserves translation fidelity and enables multitemporal generation. Finally, we construct a paired aerial V2IR dataset covering 14 hour groups. Solar-Flow achieves multitemporal generation on this dataset, where a single visible image is translated into plausible IR images at multiple times of day, even at hours that were never seen in training.

AI.tldr: Solar-Flow通过太阳条件（太阳高度角、热相位时钟TPC、飞行高度）注入预训练流匹配生成器的每个Transformer块，将航空可见光到红外（V2IR）翻译从静态映射升级为多时段生成，单张可见光图可生成一天中多个时刻的合理红外图像。
AI.motivation: 现有航空V2IR翻译方法仅在狭窄采集窗口内学习静态映射，而热状态随昼夜演化，同一可见光图像可能对应多种合理红外外观，因此V2IR本质上是多时段（multitemporal）任务，需要时间条件建模。
AI.method: 1) 设计三个可计算物理因子作为条件：太阳高度角、热相位时钟TPC（以日出为锚点、连续24小时轴上统计加热/冷却小时数，使无训练样本时刻的热状态仍有定义）、飞行高度；2) 通过自适应层归一化（AdaLN）将条件注入预训练流匹配生成器的每个Transformer块，兼顾翻译保真度与多时段生成能力；3) 构建覆盖14个小时组的成对航空V2IR数据集。
AI.result: 在新数据集上实现多时段生成：单张可见光图像可被翻译为一天中多个时段（包括训练中未出现的小时）的合理红外图像；物理因子条件化在保持翻译保真度的同时支持多时段生成。
AI.conclusion: 以物理可解释的太阳条件驱动流匹配生成的航空V2IR翻译可有效实现跨时段、跨未见时刻的热红外图像生成，为全昼夜热数据获取提供可扩展途径。

title: Self-Supervised Continuous-Time Depth Learning and Ego-Motion Estimation from Asynchronous Events
summary: Event cameras register brightness changes pixel by pixel with microsecond precision, whereas the dense depth that could supervise them is costly to acquire and exists only at isolated instants. Condensing the stream into frames eases learning, but at the expense of the very timing that sets event sensing apart. We propose a self-supervised approach in which each event is assigned its own depth in continuous time, and the camera motion is recovered from the same observations. Supervision arises from geometry: lifted into 3D by its predicted depth and displaced by the camera motion at the instant it fired, an event should coincide with others produced by the same edge, so any misalignment exposes an error in depth or motion. Differentiable rendering then turns these per-event estimates into dense depth maps at target times within each window, faithful to the events behind them. On MVSEC, the approach outperforms prior event-only self-supervised methods in most sequences and depth ranges, with the widest margins at night, and recovers camera rotation more accurately than an earlier unsupervised event-based method. Ablations isolate the roles of local spatiotemporal context, the temporal backbone, and the alignment objective. These results position motion-compensated event alignment as a principled source of supervision for continuous-time depth and ego-motion estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督连续时间事件相机深度与自运动估计方法：为每个事件赋予独立深度，利用运动补偿后同一边缘事件在3D空间中应对齐的几何约束作监督，可微渲染生成目标时刻稠密深度图。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率，但稠密深度监督获取昂贵且仅在离散时刻可得；将事件流打包成帧便于学习却牺牲了事件感知的核心优势——精确时间信息。
AI.method: 逐事件深度预测 + 同时从同一观测中恢复相机运动（连续时间轨迹）；将事件按其深度提升至3D并按触发瞬时相机位姿位移，要求同一边缘产生的事件相互重合，错位即反映深度或运动误差，构成几何自监督；再用可微渲染在窗口内任意目标时刻生成稠密深度图。消融分析局部时空上下文、时序骨干网络与对齐损失各自作用。
AI.result: 在MVSEC上多数序列与深度范围内优于既有仅事件的自监督方法，夜间场景提升最明显；相机旋转估计精度优于早前无监督事件方法。
AI.conclusion: 运动补偿的事件对齐可作为连续时间深度与自运动估计的原则性监督来源。

title: PGS-PCQA: Perceptually Gated Synthetic Supervision for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment
comment: 15 pages (including supplementary material), 4 figures, 16 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Existing no-reference point cloud quality assessment (NR-PCQA) methods perform well within individual datasets but generalize poorly across datasets. We identify insufficient distortion coverage in training data as a key cause: on unseen distortion types, models rank severity levels near chance or even in reverse. We propose perceptually gated synthetic supervision for no-reference point cloud quality assessment (PGS-PCQA), an NR-PCQA model trained with synthetic distortion ranking. It builds a synthetic distortion bank from source reference point clouds and uses within-type severity ranking as supervision in addition to the source mean opinion scores (MOS), requiring no subjective scores for the synthetic samples. Since higher severity does not always mean lower perceived quality, a perceptual gate softens the ranking targets of pairs with small perceptual differences in rendered views. The synthetic supervision is used only during training and needs no target-domain data. In a single training run on SJTU-PCQA, PGS-PCQA achieves Spearman rank correlation coefficients (SRCCs) of 0.709 on WPC and 0.751 on BASICS. The corresponding published DSP-PCQA scores are 0.595 and 0.723. Under reference-disjoint cross-validation, PGS-PCQA achieves SRCCs of 0.955 on SJTU-PCQA, 0.934 on WPC, 0.906 on BASICS, and 0.791 on LS-PCQA Part I. In the exclusion experiment, the reported scores for the reduced synthetic bank represent 58-65% of the full-bank SRCC gain relative to training without the bank. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PGS-PCQA通过合成失真库与感知门控的严重度排序监督，提升无参考点云质量评估的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有NR-PCQA方法在单一数据集内表现良好但跨数据集泛化差，作者归因于训练数据失真类型覆盖不足：面对未见失真类型时，模型对严重度排序接近随机甚至反向。
AI.method: 构建合成失真库：以源参考点云生成多类型、多严重度的合成失真样本；以同类型内的严重度排序作为附加监督，无需合成样本的主观分数；设计感知门控，对渲染视图下感知差异较小的样本对软化排序目标（因严重度更高不必然意味着感知质量更低）。合成监督仅用于训练，不需目标域数据。
AI.result: 在SJTU-PCQA单次训练：WPC上SRCC 0.709、BASICS上0.751（DSP-PCQA分别为0.595/0.723）；参考不相交交叉验证下，SRCC达SJTU-PCQA 0.955、WPC 0.934、BASICS 0.906、LS-PCQA Part I 0.791。消融显示缩减合成库仅保留全库相对无库训练的SRCC增益的58–65%。
AI.conclusion: 以低成本合成失真排序监督结合感知门控，可显著改善NR-PCQA的跨数据集与跨失真泛化，且不依赖目标域标注。

title: Ego4Gen: Generating Geometry-Grounded Motion Tokens as a World-Action Interface
summary: We present Ego4Gen (Egocentric 4D Future Generation), a world model for 4D future generation in robotic manipu lation. Given a single egocentric image and a text prompt, Ego4Gen jointly generates temporally aligned RGB frames, dense point maps, and dense scene flow, explicitly pre dicting the evolution of scene appearance, spatial struc ture, and motion. Built on Cosmos3-Nano, Ego4Gen ex tends the pretrained generative backbone through modality routed LoRA and asymmetric attention, using geometric pseudo-labels from MotionCrafter to learn to predict future geometry and motion latents. These latents can either be decoded into explicit 3D structure and motion or mapped to robot actions. To this end, we also introduce FlowIn verse, a lightweight inverse dynamics network trained in two stages to translate predicted 4D latents into robot ac tions. Experiments show that these geometry and motion latents outperform the evaluated latent-action and video latent baselines in out-of-distribution settings. Closed loop policy evaluations further demonstrate their utility for translating predicted 4D futures into robot control. To gether, these results support geometry-grounded motion to kens as a world-action interface, connecting 4D future gen eration with robotic manipulation and suggesting a path to ward reduced reliance on action-labeled data.

AI.tldr: Ego4Gen：基于 Cosmos3-Nano 的自中心 4D 未来世界模型，从单张第一视角图像+文本联合生成时序对齐的 RGB、稠密点图与稠密场景流，并将 4D 隐变量经 FlowInverse 逆动力学网络映射为机器人动作。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型多只生成 RGB，缺乏显式几何与运动监督，导致其隐变量作为"世界-动作接口"时泛化与可控性不足；同时机器人动作标注数据昂贵，需要能减少对动作标签依赖的表征。
AI.method: 在 Cosmos3-Nano 生成骨干上引入模态路由 LoRA 与非对称注意力，支持 RGB/点图/场景流三模态联合生成；用 MotionCrafter 生成的几何伪标签监督未来几何与运动隐变量学习；隐变量可解码为显式 3D 结构与运动，或经两阶段训练的轻量逆动力学网络 FlowInverse 转为机器人动作。
AI.result: 几何-运动隐变量在分布外设定下优于对比的 latent-action 与 video-latent 基线；闭环策略评测显示可把预测的 4D 未来转化为有效机器人控制。
AI.conclusion: 提出"几何锚定的运动 token 作为世界-动作接口"，把 4D 未来生成与机器人操作打通，指向降低对动作标注数据依赖的路径。

title: Beyond a Single Human Demonstration: Learning from Scored Trajectory Alternatives for End-to-End Driving
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: this https URL
summary: Human driving logs record only one trajectory per scene, leaving other feasible driving choices without explicit trajectory targets or quality labels. This limits supervision for end-to-end planners that generate and refine multiple candidate trajectories. Meanwhile, conditioning refinement on a large vision-language model adds substantial online inference cost. We propose DriveSTA, which extends autoregressive proposal generation and proposal-conditioned residual flow refinement with scored trajectory alternatives. For each training scene, we generate alternatives offline through smooth deformations of the recorded trajectory and evaluate their simulated execution against logged traffic. Diverse, high-quality alternatives supervise distinct proposals and define residual targets for quality-guided denoising, while candidates spanning the full score range train a scorer to assess driving quality. A shared joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), adapted through masked video-feature prediction, encodes observed frames once and provides temporal context for both refinement and scoring. On NAVSIM v1 Navtest, DriveSTA ranks first among the compared planners trained on NAVSIM data alone. With expanded training data, DriveSTA-Scale achieves state-of-the-art results among the compared methods on Navtest and closed-loop HUGSIM, while reducing mean planner forward-pass latency by 73% relative to ChainFlow-VLA in matched evaluations.

AI.tldr: DriveSTA 用离线生成的平滑变形轨迹替代方案为端到端规划器提供多轨迹监督：高质量多样替代方案监督提案生成、定义残差流匹配去噪目标，并用全分数区间候选训练质量打分器；共享 JEPA 编码器一次编码观测帧。NAVSIM v1 Navtest 单数据集训练第一，扩展数据后 Navtest 与闭环 HUGSIM 均 SOTA，前向延迟较 ChainFlow-VLA 降低 73%。
AI.motivation: 人类驾驶日志每场景仅一条轨迹，缺乏多候选轨迹的显式目标与质量标签，限制端到端多模态规划器的监督；同时用大型 VLM 做轨迹精炼的在线推理成本过高。
AI.method: 离线对日志轨迹做平滑变形并基于记录交通做仿真执行评估，生成覆盖全分数区间的多样替代轨迹；高质量替代方案分别监督不同提案并作为质量引导去噪的残差目标；用全分数范围候选训练质量打分器；以掩码视频特征预测适配的共享 JEPA 一次编码观测帧，为精炼与打分提供时序上下文；整体为自回归提案生成 + 提案条件的残差 flow 精炼。
AI.result: NAVSIM v1 Navtest 上仅用 NAVSIM 数据训练的对比方法中排名第一；扩大训练数据后，DriveSTA-Scale 在 Navtest 与闭环 HUGSIM 上均达对比方法 SOTA，相同评测下相对 ChainFlow-VLA 平均规划前向延迟降低 73%。
AI.conclusion: 用离线轨迹变形与仿真评分构造多候选监督，可在不引入在线大模型推理开销的前提下提升多轨迹端到端规划的生成质量与效率；数据规模扩展进一步带来收益。

title: PhiJEPA: Denoising Latent Predictions for Visual Representation Learning
summary: Can a predictor trained to infer hidden image regions still help a world model plan when part of an object disappears from view and the visible context is blurred? We introduce PhiJEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that adapts PhiNet's two-stage prediction to masked Transformers. From sparse, photometrically corrupted context, a Transformer block predicts hidden tokens of an independently corrupted teacher view. A token-wise MLP then maps these predictions to clean teacher tokens. Controlled ablations show that the combined objective improves dense features over the tested one-stage alternatives. Pre-trained on ImageNet-1K with $5.6\times10^{19}$ training FLOPs, PhiJEPA achieves 69.3 mIoU on linear PASCAL VOC segmentation, exceeding the evaluated I-JEPA and DSeq-JEPA checkpoints in segmentation accuracy, with 25\% fewer training FLOPs than I-JEPA. It also improves hidden-region segmentation over Simple I-JEPA (49.1 vs.\ 44.3 mIoU). As an application, we use the frozen encoder in DINO-WM on PushT, and reuse the pre-training predictor, which JEPAs usually discard, to complete occluded tokens without fine-tuning. In open-loop planning with simultaneous object occlusion and Gaussian blur ($\sigma=2$ pixels), predictor completion raises success from 33\% to 65\%, compared with 25\% for Simple I-JEPA with its predictor and 40\% for iBOT with pixel inpainting. Together, these results support two-stage latent prediction as an efficient approach to learning visual representations that remain useful under photometric degradation and support completion under partial observation.

AI.tldr: PhiJEPA 将 PhiNet 两阶段预测迁移到 masked Transformer，先在潜空间预测被遮挡 token，再用逐 token MLP 映射到干净教师特征；冻结编码器用于 DINO-WM 开环规划，并复用预训练预测器补全遮挡，遮挡+高斯模糊下成功率由 33% 升至 65%。
AI.motivation: 现有 JEPA 类自监督方法多为一阶段潜空间预测，且预训练预测器在微调/下游阶段通常被丢弃；作者希望验证"两阶段潜预测"能否学到对光度退化与部分观测更鲁棒的表示，并把预测器本身当作遮挡补全工具用于世界模型规划。
AI.method: 在 masked Transformer 上实现两阶段 JEPA：(1) Transformer 块从稀疏、光度受损的可见上下文预测独立受损教师视图的隐藏 token；(2) 逐 token MLP 将潜预测映射到干净教师 token。ImageNet-1K 预训练，5.6e19 FLOPs，配合消融对比一阶段变体；下游用线性 PASCAL VOC 分割、隐藏区域分割；应用端将冻结编码器接入 DINO-WM 在 PushT 上做开环规划。
AI.result: 线性 PASCAL VOC 分割 69.3 mIoU，优于所评测的 I-JEPA 与 DSeq-JEPA 检查点，训练 FLOPs 比 I-JEPA 少 25%；隐藏区域分割 49.1 vs Simple I-JEPA 44.3 mIoU；PushT 开环规划（物体遮挡+σ=2 高斯模糊）成功率 65%，对比无补全 33%、Simple I-JEPA 25%、iBOT+像素修补 40%。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段潜预测是高效学习视觉表示的有效方式，表示在光度退化下仍可用，并能以零微调方式完成部分观测下的 token 补全、提升世界模型规划成功率；但证据限于单一 PushT 仿真任务与 ImageNet-1K 规模，未见真机或大规模具身验证。

title: EchoAlign: Echocardiography foundation model with multilevel report alignment
comment: 33 pages, 3 figures, 6 extended data figures, 4 extended data tables. Code and model weights: this https URL
summary: Echocardiography assesses the structure and function of the heart. Cardiologists read each study across several standard views and report the findings visible in those views by cardiac structure. AI foundation models can learn to analyze these studies from clinical reports, reducing annotation burden and supporting clinical interpretation. However, existing models are trained by pairing each video with the full clinical report, including structures and findings its view does not show. This mismatch lets a model associate a finding with incidental or spurious signals rather than its visual evidence, which limits accuracy, anatomical grounding and clinical trust. Here we introduce EchoAlign, a vision-language foundation model developed on 2.87 million echocardiographic videos and images from 159 clinical centers. EchoAlign aligns each cardiac structure, video and study with its report text, and a visibility matrix restricts supervision to the views that actually depict each structure. We compare it with five public foundation models on 0.47 million test videos across ten unseen external datasets from more than 25 clinical centers. EchoAlign achieves the highest mean AUROC of 0.890 (95% CI, 0.881 to 0.897) for classification and the highest mean quadratic weighted kappa of 0.530 (95% CI, 0.511 to 0.544) for severity grading. Across 62 clinical findings, EchoAlign provides one model that detects findings, grades their severity, estimates measurements and segments cardiac structures.

AI.tldr: EchoAlign：基于287万超声心动图视频/图像、159家中心的视觉-语言基础模型，通过结构-视频-检查-报告的分层对齐与可见性矩阵约束监督，实现单模型完成62项临床发现的检测、分级、测量与分割。
AI.motivation: 现有超声心动图基础模型将整段视频与完整临床报告配对，导致某视图的报告内容中包含该视图不可见的解剖结构与发现，模型因而把发现关联到偶然或虚假视觉信号，损害准确性、解剖接地性与临床可信度。
AI.method: 提出EchoAlign：(1) 将每个心脏结构、视频与检查分别与其报告文本对齐，构建多粒度视觉-语言对齐；(2) 引入可见性矩阵，将监督信号限制在真正呈现该结构的视图上，抑制跨视图伪相关；(3) 单一模型统一支持发现检测、严重度分级、测量估计与结构分割。
AI.result: 在来自25家以上临床中心的10个未见外部数据集、47万测试视频上评测：分类平均AUROC达0.890（95% CI 0.881–0.897），严重度分级平均二次加权kappa 0.530（95% CI 0.511–0.544），均优于5个公开基础模型；覆盖62项临床发现。
AI.conclusion: 通过与视图可见性一致的细粒度对齐，可显著提升医学影像基础模型的准确性与解剖接地性，并以单模型替代多任务专用模型，降低标注依赖并支持临床解读。

title: PaMuk-Bench: A Parallel Multilingual Multitask Benchmark for Vision-Language Tasks
summary: While vision-language models (VLMs) currently obtain notable results for highly-studied languages, e.g. English, they exhibit significant performance drops in certain low-resource languages, especially due to the lack of annotated datasets. To this end, we propose PaMuk-Bench, a novel parallel multilingual multitask benchmark for vision-language tasks. Our benchmark includes a set of over 10K curated English prompts that are translated into six languages: Arabic, Danish, French, Hindi, Italian, Romanian. Parallel translations, which are obtained via a semi-automatic process, along with accompanying generated and retrieved images enable the comparative development and evaluation of VLMs across a wide range of tasks: text-to-image generation, image captioning, content-based image retrieval, image generation difficulty estimation, image retrieval difficulty estimation. We empirically show that zero-shot English and multilingual pre-trained VLMs compare consistently worse than their fine-tuned counterparts, confirming that PaMuk-Bench is a valuable resource that can drastically reduce the language gap across a variety of VLM architectures and tasks. PaMuk-Bench is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 PaMuk-Bench：一个面向视觉-语言任务的并行多语言多任务基准，含1万余条英文提示，经半自动流程翻译为阿拉伯语、丹麦语、法语、印地语、意大利语、罗马尼亚语，并配套生成与检索图像，覆盖文生图、图像描述、基于内容的图像检索、图像生成难度估计、图像检索难度估计五类任务。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在英语等高资源语言上表现优异，但在缺乏标注数据的低资源语言上性能显著下降；缺少可跨语言、跨任务对比评估的并行多语言资源。
AI.method: 构建并行翻译的多语言多任务基准：以超10K精选英文提示为源，通过半自动流程获得六种语言的平行译文，并生成/检索对应图像；在零样本与多语言预训练VLM、微调VLM之间做实证对比评估。
AI.result: 实验表明英文与多语言预训练的零样本VLM在各类任务与架构上一致性劣于微调版本，说明该基准可有效暴露并衡量语言差距。
AI.conclusion: PaMuk-Bench可作为缩减VLM跨语言性能差距的评估与开发资源，已公开。

title: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation
summary: Scene graph generation (SGG) aims to detect objects in an image and predict the relationships between them. The standard PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet settings show how much performance drops without ground-truth boxes and labels, but not where or why a model fails. Knowing this would allow fixing a model where it fails, without retraining. We propose RoHa-SGG (Root-cause-guided Harness optimization for SGG), which extends agentic harness optimization to SGG. It optimizes the harness, the inference code around a frozen SGG model. RoHa-SGG has two main LLM agents. A root-cause analysis (RCA) agent finds the components where the model fails and diagnoses why, and a proposer agent searches for a harness that fixes these causes. We evaluate RoHa-SGG on Visual Genome and PSG with representative two-stage, one-stage, and multimodal-LLM SGG models. The analysis shows that the components where ground-truth triplets are lost differ across models and datasets. RoHa-SGG improves every metric on all five model-dataset combinations. Graph-constrained R@100 and mR@100 rise by up to 15.8 and 26.4 points for the multimodal LLM and by up to 3.6 and 10.1 points for the two-stage and one-stage models. With root-cause guidance, the harness search reaches the final score of an unguided search up to three times faster.

AI.tldr: RoHa-SGG 用两个 LLM agent（根因分析+harness 提案）在冻结的 SGG 模型外围做推理代码（harness）优化，定位并修复关系三元组丢失的组件，在 Visual Genome/PSG 五个模型-数据集组合上全面提升指标。
AI.motivation: 标准 PredCls/SGCls/SGDet 评测只给出性能下降幅度，无法说明模型在哪一环、因何失败，导致只能重训练而不能定点修复。
AI.method: 将 agentic harness optimization 迁移到 SGG：RCA agent 定位失败组件并诊断原因，proposer agent 在冻结模型外搜索新的推理 harness；跨两阶段、单阶段、多模态 LLM 三类模型在 Visual Genome、PSG 上评测。
AI.result: 各模型/数据集上真值三元组丢失的组件不同；五个组合全部指标提升，Graph-constrained R@100/mR@100 对多模态 LLM 最高 +15.8/+26.4，对两阶段与单阶段模型最高 +3.6/+10.1；有根因引导时搜索达到无引导搜索终值最多快 3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 根因引导的外围 harness 优化是无需重训练的 SGG 修复路径，且显著加速搜索。

title: Joint Optimization of Fleet Size, Localization Infrastructure, and Trajectories for Multi-AUV Persistent Monitoring
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted version of the paper published in OCEANS 2026 Sanya (IEEE)
summary: Persistent monitoring of large-scale subsea infrastructure, such as offshore wind farm foundations, export cables, and inspection corridors, remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous underwater systems. The problem is not solely spatial coverage, but rather temporal coverage: ensuring that all relevant regions of interest are revisited within bounded time intervals under limited sensing, navigation uncertainty, and constrained vehicle resources. We compare three classes of trajectory strategies: (1) deterministic lane-based coverage (lawnmower patterns), (2) stochastic exploration (biased random walk with boundary constraints), and (3) coordinated partition-based strategies (Voronoi tessellation). Rather than seeking a universally superior method, we evaluate how varying levels of localization accuracy impact temporal coverage across two distinct operational profiles: persistent monitoring of the entire operational workspace versus targeted inspection of critical infrastructure. We present a simulation-based, quantitatively grounded study of temporal coverage in multi-AUV persistent monitoring, disentangling three interacting design dimensions: (i) trajectory generation strategy, (ii) fleet size, and (iii) localization accuracy provided by fixed acoustic beacon infrastructure. We introduce a cost-aware evaluation framework combining fleet size, number of beacons, and mission energy expenditure into a unified cost function. Results demonstrate that beyond a certain accuracy threshold, improvements in localization yield diminishing returns compared to coordinated trajectory design, an effect often obscured in integrated navigation-planning approaches. Coordinated-partition trajectories enable a reduced fleet size to achieve superior temporal coverage at a 39-46% lower overall life-cycle cost than rigid deterministic paths unoptimized for the localization infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 比较三种多AUV轨迹策略（平行线覆盖、带边界约束的偏置随机游走、Voronoi分区协同）在不同定位精度与舰队规模下的时间覆盖性能，并提出融合舰队规模、信标数量与能耗的统一成本评估框架。
AI.motivation: 大型海底基础设施（海上风电基座、输出电缆、巡检走廊）的持续监测核心难点不在空间覆盖而在时间覆盖：需在有限感知、导航不确定性与受限载具资源下保证各关注区域在有界时间间隔内被复访。既有集成式导航-规划研究难以分离各设计维度的影响。
AI.method: 基于仿真的定量研究，解耦三个交互设计维度：(i) 轨迹生成策略、(ii) 舰队规模、(iii) 由固定声学信标基础设施提供的定位精度。在两类作业模式下（全工作域持续监测 vs 关键设施定点巡检）对比三类策略，并构建将舰队规模、信标数与任务能耗合并的代价感知评估函数。
AI.result: 超过某一精度阈值后，定位精度的提升收益递减，其重要性低于协同轨迹设计——这一效应在集成式导航-规划方法中常被掩盖；Voronoi分区协同轨迹可使更小舰队获得更优时间覆盖，全生命周期成本比未针对定位基础设施优化的刚性确定性路径低39-46%。
AI.conclusion: 多AUV持续监测的最优投资方向是协同轨迹设计而非单纯提升定位精度；面向定位基础设施的轨迹优化可在缩减舰队规模的同时显著降低总成本，为海底巡检系统设计提供量化依据。

title: Where Delay Compensation Belongs in a Decentralized Mean-Field-Game Swarm with a Control-Barrier Safety Filter
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 8th International Workshop on Multi-Agent Path Finding (WoMAPF) at AAAI-27 (non-archival workshop)
summary: Large robot teams are often run as a plan-then-execute stack. We study a decentralized instance for drone swarms, a mean-field-game (MFG) routing field with a per-agent control-barrier-function (CBF) safety filter, when communication is limited by a shared TDMA channel. Neighbors are known only through noisy range and bearing measurements exchanged in round-robin slots, so the frame, and with it the age of every estimate, grows with swarm size. In simulation this delay reaches both layers but breaks only the safety layer. Without delay, swarms of up to 100 agents do not collide, even with each measurement's noise held for a whole frame; with it, stale estimates at the CBF cause collisions beyond a frame period of 125 to 175 ms, or 75 to 100 ms at 100 agents with held noise, and swarm size sets where that limit lies and how steeply collisions rise. At the MFG, staleness makes the local density noisier without biasing it, and throughput drops by at most a tenth. We then compensate with lightweight on-board predictors, from constant-velocity fits to a small learned network, that estimate each neighbor's position from its last broadcasts. A layer-split experiment shows where prediction is needed: at the CBF it restores safety and extends the tolerated frame period by 1.4 to 1.7 times with an untrained constant-velocity fit and about 2.3 with the learned network when the noise is redrawn each step; with noise held for a frame the two extend it about equally, while at the MFG it only refines the congestion correction. A constant wider safety margin, the simplest alternative, makes collisions more frequent in a bottleneck. With the routing solved offline, that layer is robust to the delay because it sees neighbors only through a crowd average; compensation belongs in the safety filter, switched on only above the uncompensated limit, since below it the predictor's own error adds collisions.

AI.tldr: 在大规模无人机集群的"先规划后执行"架构中，研究了TDMA受限通信下策略延迟对平均场博弈(MFG)路由层与逐智能体CBF安全滤波层的影响：延迟只破坏安全层(CBF)，并通过机载轻量预测器(匀速拟合/小型学习网络)在安全层补偿，可将容忍帧周期扩大1.4–1.7倍(学习网络约2.3倍)。
AI.motivation: 大规模集群依赖共享TDMA信道，帧长随集群规模增长导致邻居估计老化；需要弄清这种陈旧信息究竟损害哪一层栈组件，并给出轻量、可靠的分层补偿方案。
AI.method: 去中心化MFG路由场 + 逐智能体CBF安全滤波器；邻居仅通过轮询时隙的噪声距离/方位测量获得。仿真扫描帧周期(纯延迟 vs 延迟+整帧保持噪声)，并做分层(layer-split)实验；提出机载预测器(匀速拟合→小型学习网络)从最近广播估计邻居位置；与"恒定加宽安全裕度"基线比较；路由离线求解。
AI.result: 无延迟时100个智能体也不碰撞；有延迟时CBF在帧周期>125–175 ms(100体、噪声保持时75–100 ms)开始碰撞，上限依赖集群规模。MFG层仅密度变噪、吞吐下降≤10%。预测器在CBF处把容忍帧周期提升1.4–1.7倍(未训练CV)或约2.3倍(学习网络，噪声逐步重采样时)；噪声整帧保持时两者相当；恒定加大安全裕度在瓶颈处反而加剧碰撞。且在未补偿极限以下启用预测会因自身误差增加碰撞。
AI.conclusion: "先规划后执行"栈中，离线求解的路由层对通信延迟天然鲁棒(仅见群体平均)，延迟风险集中于安全层；预测补偿应放在CBF中，并以未补偿极限为阈值条件启用。

title: From Tokens to Pixels: Training-Free Guided Upsampling of Frozen CARL Features for Hyperspectral Imaging
comment: 17 pages, 16 figures, 5 tables. Code and result tables: this https URL
summary: Camera-agnostic foundation models such as CARL map spectral images from arbitrary sensors into a shared feature space, but deliver their features only on a token grid at one eighth of the input resolution. The usual bilinear interpolation blurs material boundaries over about one token and rounds off corners. We investigate how much spatial accuracy image-guided upsampling recovers for frozen CARL features without training the encoder or the upsampler. We compare joint bilateral upsampling (JBU), a guided filter and the pretrained AnyUp, each with the hyperspectral image or an RGB rendering as the guide. A hyperspectral ColorChecker dataset acquired specifically for this study, with model-independent reference geometry measured to sub-pixel precision, serves as the evaluation benchmark. JBU with the hyperspectral guide raises the Boundary IoU from 13 to 67 % and reduces the effective edge width of the features from 38 to 4 px, close to the resolution of the raw spectra. The effect occurs in all 24 patches of the ColorChecker and replicates on an additional recording. On placenta and oral cavity images, the feature edges also become markedly qualitatively sharper. For sharp, high-contrast boundaries, JBU is the most accurate and most economical method. On tissue with softer transitions, the pretrained AnyUp yields qualitatively sharper contours. An analysis of 78 simulated band configurations shows that the gain persists in every configuration as long as the head matches the configuration. Image-guided upsampling is thus a simple, training-free step for applications that use CARL frozen with linear heads.

AI.tldr: 冻结的CARL光谱基础模型特征仅在1/8分辨率token网格上输出，本文免训练地用图像引导上采样（JBU、引导滤波、AnyUp）恢复特征空间精度，JBU把Boundary IoU从13%升至67%，特征边缘宽度从38px降至4px。
AI.motivation: CARL等相机无关光谱基础模型的特征分辨率仅为输入的1/8，双线性插值会把材质边界模糊约一个token并磨圆角点，损害下游线性头对几何与材质边界的定位精度；作者希望在不训练编码器与上采样的前提下量化图像引导上采样能找回多少空间精度。
AI.method: 以冻结CARL特征为输入，比较关节双边上采样（JBU）、引导滤波和预训练AnyUp三种免训练上采样器，分别用高光谱图像或RGB渲染作为引导；自建高光谱ColorChecker数据集，并提供亚像素精度的模型无关参考几何作为评测基准；附加在胎盘与口腔影像上的定性验证，以及78种模拟波段配置的鲁棒性分析。
AI.result: 高光谱引导的JBU将Boundary IoU从13%提升到67%，特征有效边缘宽度从38px降至4px，接近原始光谱分辨率；效果在ColorChecker全部24个patch上一致、并在另一段采集中复现；胎盘与口腔影像上特征边缘定性显著变锐；高对比边界场景JBU最准且最省算力，软组织这类软过渡场景预训练AnyUp轮廓更锐；78种波段配置下只要线性头匹配配置，增益均保持。
AI.conclusion: 图像引导上采样是使用CARL冻结特征加线性头时一个简单、免训练、低成本的即插即用步骤，可显著提升特征的空间定位精度；硬边界优先选JBU，软过渡选AnyUp，且方法对波段配置不敏感。

title: When Visually Rich Documents Meet Multi-Vector Retrieval for Region-level Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Visually rich documents (VRDs) convey knowledge through textual, visual, and layout information that text-centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Text-RAG) struggles to fully exploit. Recent Vision-RAG approaches enable retrieval and generation directly from document images, retaining this multimodal information. However, earlier Vision-RAG methods commonly adopt coarse retrieval representations and full-page visual contexts, which can obscure local evidence and introduce substantial redundancy and computational overhead. To address these challenges, we propose MV-VisRAG, a region-level Vision-RAG framework that uses semantically complete regions for both document representation and visual augmentation. Specifically, MV-VisRAG first constructs these regions through a ContentAdaptive Regionalization module. It then encodes them into local region vectors and a page-level global vector using a VLM-based retriever trained through multimodal reconstruction pretraining and retrieval fine-tuning. With this compact multi-vector representation, MV-VisRAG performs late-interaction retrieval and estimates region contributions from the resulting matching scores. These contributions guide the selection of relevant regions, which are then rearranged into a compact visual context for generation. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate retrieval and generation gains over corresponding baselines, while region-level augmentation substantially reduces visual tokens and computational cost. Our code will be made publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MV-VisRAG：以语义完整区域（而非整页图像）作为文档表示与视觉增强单元的区域级Vision-RAG框架，通过内容自适应区域化 + VLM多向量检索器 + 晚期交互检索筛选区域，生成时仅输入紧凑区域视觉上下文。
AI.motivation: Text-RAG难以利用视觉丰富文档（VRD）的视觉与版面信息；Vision-RAG直接检索文档图像但采用粗粒度表示与整页视觉上下文，易淹没局部证据并带来冗余与算力开销。
AI.method: (1) Content-Adaptive Regionalization模块构造语义完整区域；(2) VLM-based retriever经多模态重构预训练+检索微调，将区域编码为局部向量并生成页级全局向量；(3) 基于多向量表示做晚期交互检索，用匹配分数估计区域贡献度以筛选相关区域；(4) 将选中区域重排为紧凑视觉上下文供生成。
AI.result: 五个基准上检索与生成指标均优于对应基线，且区域级增强显著减少视觉token数量与计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 区域级多向量表示与贡献度引导的视觉上下文压缩是Vision-RAG兼顾精度与效率的有效路径，代码将开源。

title: GameScrub: Learning HUD Removal from Real Gameplay with Recovered Targets
summary: Gameplay videos are a rich source of experience for learning virtual-world dynamics, yet their frames contain heads-up displays (HUDs) that follow interface rules rather than scene dynamics. Removing HUDs would make this footage directly usable for learning world dynamics. However, training a removal model requires paired clips with and without HUDs, whereas real recordings contain only HUD-overlaid footage. Existing work synthesizes pairs by compositing HUD graphics onto HUD-free footage, requiring a separately curated clean corpus and producing HUDs that only approximate real ones. Models trained on such pairs leave 40 to 50% of real HUD elements untouched. We instead recover pseudo-clean targets directly from real recordings by inpainting HUD regions with a pretrained video diffusion model. Preventing HUD traces from leaking into recovered targets is challenging because latent video autoencoders mix information across mask boundaries. Our training-free recovery pipeline, GameScrub-Data, pre-fills HUD regions with flow-guided background estimates before encoding, excludes HUDs from scene conditioning, and confines restoration to masked regions through pixel-space compositing. The resulting pairs train GameScrub, a video diffusion removal model that handles diverse HUDs without inference-time masks or clean reference images. On the in-the-wild Game2World benchmark, GameScrub achieves an artifact-adjusted removal score of 71.95, compared with 57.86 for the strongest reference-free GameCleaner configuration, and removes 90.06% of annotated HUD elements versus 59.07%. These results demonstrate that real recordings with recovered targets can support effective HUD removal, advancing HUD-free gameplay data for world models and controllable video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 GameScrub-Data 训练无关流程，从真实带 HUD 的游戏录像中通过视频扩散模型修复 HUD 区域得到伪干净目标，配对抗训练视频扩散去除模型 GameScrub，无需推理时掩码或干净参考图。
AI.motivation: 游戏视频是学习虚拟世界动态的丰富数据源，但帧中 HUD 遵循界面规则而非场景动态。移除 HUD 需成对（有/无 HUD）数据，真实录制只有含 HUD 版本；已有合成配对方案需单独整理干净语料，且合成 HUD 与真实 HUD 差异大，模型在真实数据上仍残留 40–50% HUD 元素。
AI.method: 直接从真实录像中构造伪干净目标：用预训练视频扩散模型修复 HUD 区域。为抑制 HUD 痕迹泄漏（潜空间 VAE 跨掩码边界混信息），采用三点设计：编码前用光流引导的背景估计预填充 HUD 区域、场景条件中排除 HUD、通过像素空间合成将修复限制在掩码区域。再由所得配对训练 GameScrub 视频扩散去除模型。
AI.result: 在真实场景 Game2World 基准上，GameScrub artifact-adjusted 去除得分 71.95，最强无参考 GameCleaner 配置为 57.86；标注 HUD 元素去除率 90.06% vs 59.07%。
AI.conclusion: 真实录像加伪干净目标恢复可支撑有效的 HUD 去除，为世界模型与可控视频生成提供 HUD-free 游戏数据；方法属数据清洗工具链，非世界模型本体。

title: S-BFM: A Behavioral Foundation Model for Humanoid Control from Sparse Spatiotemporal Goals
summary: General-purpose whole-body trackers can execute diverse humanoid motions, but they require dense reference trajectories. However, tasks usually specify only where, in which posture, and when the robot should arrive, leaving the motion in between to a separate planner. Inspired by human motor coordination, our key idea is that a low-level controller can organize the intervening motion and its pace by itself from sparse goals with arrival times. In this paper, we propose S-BFM, a novel behavioral foundation model superior in its autonomy: it generates whole-body transitions from target postures, poses, and arrival times alone. Specifically, we first introduce Spatial Grounding, which adds world-frame position and heading to a forward-backward behavior representation through spatial reconstruction. Then, Time-Conditioned Distillation is designed to learn transitions and pace from real motion through closed-loop imitation of a dense-reference teacher. Lastly, Generative Fine-Tuning is introduced to broaden the covered distances and arrival times with a distilled motion generator. In simulation, S-BFM lowers global joint-position error by over 32% relative to the best baseline under fixed and mixed horizons, and raises fixed-goal reach from 43.5% to 74.6% while cutting terminal position error from 1.67 to 0.26 m. We further deploy S-BFM on the full-size AGIBOT A3 humanoid. Sparse spatiotemporal goals thus suffice for natural, well-timed whole-body motion.

AI.tldr: S-BFM: 一个行为基础模型，仅凭目标姿态、位置和到达时间等稀疏时空目标，即可自主生成全身过渡运动与节奏，并在仿真与全尺寸人形机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: 通用全身跟踪器需稠密参考轨迹，而任务通常只给出"在哪、什么姿态、何时到达"，中间运动依赖单独规划器，缺乏自主组织中间运动与节奏的能力。
AI.method: 三阶段：1) Spatial Grounding——通过空间重建把世界坐标系位置与朝向注入前向-后向行为表示；2) Time-Conditioned Distillation——闭环模仿稠密参考教师，学习过渡与节奏；3) Generative Fine-Tuning——用蒸馏的运动生成器扩展覆盖距离与到达时间。
AI.result: 仿真中固定与混合时域下全局关节位置误差降低超32%；固定目标到达率从43.5%升至74.6%，末端位置误差从1.67 m降至0.26 m；已在全尺寸 AGIBOT A3 人形机器人上部署。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏时空目标足以驱动自然、时序合理的全身运动，低层控制器可自主组织中间轨迹，减少对上游规划器的依赖。

title: Adesktop learning factory for smart and resilient manufacturing based on digital twin and AI
summary: Learning factories have been increasingly applied in engineering research and education. In this paper, we develop a small-scale, low-cost, fully open-sourced learning factory that leverages AI and digital twins to demonstrate smart and resilient manufacturing. The learning factory consists of an AGV, three robots, two conveyors and their digital twins. Three typical use cases are designed to demonstrate the capabilities of the learning factory, i.e., material sorting through computer vision-based robot control, coordinating AGV, robots and conveyors for assembly, and digital twin-driven predictive maintenance. The results show that the developed learning factory can adequately support the teaching and research activities on digital twins and AI on manufacturing. Its fully open-source architecture and relatively low deployment cost make it an ideal solution for universities and research institutions.

AI.tldr: A small-scale, low-cost, fully open-source learning factory with AGV, three robots, two conveyors and their digital twins, validated on three use cases: vision-based robot sorting, multi-device coordinated assembly, and digital twin predictive maintenance.
AI.motivation: Learning factories are increasingly used in engineering research and education, but existing setups are often costly and closed, limiting accessibility for universities and research institutions that want to teach and study digital twins and AI in manufacturing.
AI.method: Build a low-cost, fully open-sourced miniature manufacturing line (1 AGV, 3 robots, 2 conveyors) with paired digital twins; implement three demonstrations: CV-driven robotic material sorting, coordinated AGV-robot-conveyor assembly, and digital twin predictive maintenance.
AI.result: The platform adequately supports teaching and research on digital twins and AI in manufacturing; the fully open-source architecture and low deployment cost make it suitable for universities and research institutions.
AI.conclusion: An affordable, reproducible open-source learning factory can serve as a practical educational and research testbed for smart and resilient manufacturing with AI and digital twins.

title: Leakage-Free Is Not Confounder-Free: What a Patient-Level Split Cannot Certify About a Medical Imaging Benchmark
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 18 tables. Code, configurations and aggregate results: this https URL
summary: Patient-level splitting is the standard safeguard against subject leakage in medical imaging evaluation, but it cannot remove a confounder that every fold inherits: an acquisition variable aligned with the diagnosis across the whole cohort. We present a five-question audit of a candidate confounder: how well it predicts the diagnosis, whether it can be decoded from the images, whether diagnostic scores depend on it, whether the image adds predictive value beyond it and how much discrimination survives once it is controlled. We apply it to DMR-IR, the public dataset on which most machine-learning results in breast thermography rest. On 236 patients under a strict patient-disjoint protocol, the acquisition date alone predicts malignancy at AUROC 0.980, above the best of nine imaging arms (0.949), because benign and malignant patients were recruited in different years. The acquisition year is decodable from the pixels among patients who share a diagnosis, largely through a global thermal offset outside the breast, yet only one arm, the one pooling every frame of a visit, demonstrably carries it into its diagnostic score. No arm improves on the date on paired folds, and once the date is controlled, discrimination either collapses or survives only on comparisons the benchmark cannot attribute. The dataset contains only eight cross-label same-date pairs, from ten patients, which limits reliable evaluation within recorded acquisition-date groups. A second, independently acquired cohort, whose dominant channel is patient age, returns the same audit outcome from a different confounder. Mitigation may suppress such a confounder, but without cross-label acquisition support no evaluation on the benchmark can certify that what remains is pathology.

AI.tldr: 该文提出“五问审计”框架用于识别数据集级采集变量混杂（如采集日期），并在乳腺热成像 DMR-IR 上验证：采集日期单独预测恶性 AUROC 0.980，高于九个影像模型最优的 0.949，控制后判别力崩溃或仅存于难以归因的比较中。
AI.motivation: 患者级划分只能防止受试者泄漏，却无法消除所有折共享的采集变量与诊断标签在全队列上的对齐（如良恶性患者在不同年份招募）。作者希望提供一套可操作流程，量化此类混杂对医学影像基准结论的威胁。
AI.method: 提出五问审计：(1) 混杂变量对诊断的预测力；(2) 能否从像素中解码该变量；(3) 诊断分数是否依赖该变量；(4) 图像是否在混杂之外提供增量预测价值；(5) 控制混杂后剩余判别力。在 DMR-IR 上按严格患者不交叉协议（236 例）运行九个影像模型，并做配对折比较、像素级年份解码与全局热偏移分析；另用独立队列做外部复核。
AI.result: 采集日期单变量 AUROC 0.980，优于最佳影像模型 0.949；采集年份可在同诊断患者中由像素解码，主要来自乳腺外全局热偏移；仅“整次就诊全帧池化”一支可证明将该信号带入诊断分数；无模型在配对折上优于日期基线；控制日期后判别力崩溃或仅依赖基准不可归因的比较（跨标签同日期配对仅 8 对、来自 10 名患者）。第二队列的主导混杂为患者年龄，给出相同审计结论。
AI.conclusion: 患者级划分不足以保障医学影像基准的有效性；缓解手段或可抑制混杂，但缺乏跨标签采集条件的支持下，任何基于该基准的评估都无法证明剩余信号来自病理。该审计流程可作为数据集可用性的前置检查清单。

title: Planar Formation Control with Minimal Sensing and No Common Orientation: An Almost-Global Result
summary: Formation control based on geometric constraints often requires either rigid interaction graphs or a common orientation reference. This paper investigates whether a prescribed planar formation can instead be achieved using only $N-1$ pairwise interactions while preserving global rotational freedom. To this end, a guiding-vector-field-inspired framework is developed in which each selected distance relation is represented by a parameterized circular manifold and the remaining geometric freedom is coordinated through relative virtual phases, based on which, a distributed controller is then constructed. The closed-loop system is shown to possess only the desired equilibrium set and a degenerate undesired equilibrium set corresponding to collapse of the central edge. The latter is proved to form a saddle-type equilibrium manifold with a measure-zero stable set, yielding almost-global convergence to the desired formation. In addition, the controller admits an implementation under mutually misaligned local frames using locally expressed relative measurements and scalar phase information.
