AI.tldr: 仅用 N−1 条成对相互作用实现保持全局旋转自由度的平面队形控制：以参数化圆流形表示选定距离约束，用相对虚拟相位协调剩余自由度。
AI.motivation: 几何约束型编队控制通常需要刚性交互图或统一方向参考，限制了通信量与旋转自由度；本文探究能否用最少的 N−1 条成对交互在保持全局旋转自由的情况下达成指定平面队形。
AI.method: 借鉴引导向量场思想，将每条选定距离关系表示为一个参数化圆形流形，通过相对虚拟相位协调剩余的几何自由度；在此基础上构造分布式控制器，并分析闭环平衡集：理想平衡集与中心边退化（塌缩）的不期望平衡集。
AI.result: 不期望平衡集被证明为鞍型平衡流形，其稳定集为零测度，因此系统获得几乎全局收敛到期望队形；控制器可在互相不对齐的局部坐标系下，仅用局部表达的相对测量与标量相位信息实现。
AI.conclusion: 以最小交互数（N−1）实现了保持旋转自由的平面编队控制，并给出几乎全局收敛性与弱坐标系假设下的可实现性，适用于缺乏公共朝向参考的分布式多机器人系统。

title: Synthesizing Expressive Human-Object Interactions via Test-time Latent Adaptation
summary: When interacting with objects of unknown physical properties, humans sometimes probe, over-exert, stagger, and adjust through iterative adaptation instead of succeeding immediately. We argue that this process is an expressive but largely overlooked aspect of human-object interaction in motion synthesis. Both kinematic data-driven methods and physics-based controllers tend to produce flawlessly executed motions: the former lack sufficient data for learning fine-grained adaptation, while the latter use reinforcement learning (RL) and privileged object dynamics to learn robust, deterministic behaviors. We propose ExpHOI (Expressive Human-Object Interaction), a test-time latent adaptation framework built on an RL-trained physics-based control policy. During policy training, we encode diverse object dynamics contexts into a structured latent space. At test time, Advantage-Weighted Regression (AWR) iteratively optimizes the latent code for an object with unknown physical properties. Temporary mismatches between this code and the true object dynamics produce an expressive progression from tentative, error-prone trials to proficient interaction. Adaptation behaviors inevitably come with occasional failures, so a high-level planner is introduced to handle failed cases to maintain full, consistent animations. We demonstrate our framework's effectiveness on a large-object transportation task, where such adaptation is especially pronounced. To train our framework, we introduce a mass-diverse object dataset with rich physical-property annotations. Across carrying and push-pull, our method pairs over 90% success with markedly higher posture diversity, and is rated the most lifelike in our user study on animation liveliness.

AI.tldr: 提出ExpHOI：在RL训练的物理控制策略上，通过测试时迭代优化物体动力学隐码（AWR），生成从试探、失误到熟练的类人适应过程。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动运动合成缺少细粒度适应数据，RL物理控制器又依赖特权动力学参数、行为确定性，均产出"完美执行"动作，忽略了人类面对未知物理属性时探测、过度用力、踉跄、迭代适应的表达性过程。
AI.method: 训练阶段将多样物体动力学上下文编码为结构化隐空间；测试阶段对物理属性未知的物体用Advantage-Weighted Regression迭代优化隐码，利用隐码与真实动力学之间的临时失配自然产生适应式运动进程；另设高层规划器处理适应过程中的偶发失败，保证动画完整连贯。并构建带丰富物理属性标注的多质量物体数据集。
AI.result: 在大物体搬运任务（携带与推拉）上，成功率超过90%，姿态多样性显著更高，用户研究中被评为最生动的动画。
AI.conclusion: 将"适应过程"显式建模为运动合成目标，通过测试时隐空间优化+物理策略即可获得兼具成功率与表达性的人-物交互动画，对角色动画与角色-物体交互生成有启发意义。

title: Sketch2TikZ: Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning for Converting Hand-Drawn Sketches to Executable TikZ
summary: Automatic digitization of hand-drawn sketches into editable formats is crucial for modern document workflows and LaTeX integration. Converting sketches into executable TikZ code provides a structured representation of diagrams, but remains challenging due to noisy and ambiguous inputs, which hinder reliable interpretation and limit the effectiveness of token-level supervision for ensuring global diagram validity. To address these challenges, we propose Sketch2TikZ, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes sketch-to-code generation via a sequential multi-reward strategy, combining Code-Structure ($\mathcal{R}_{cs}$), OCR ($\mathcal{R}_{ocr}$), CleanDIFT ($\mathcal{R}_{cd}$), and Self-Similarity ($\mathcal{R}_{ss}$) rewards to enforce textual, visual and structural correctness. We evaluate Sketch2TikZ on the SkeTikZ and FlowChart-3B benchmarks using metrics including compilation success rate (CSR), image similarity, code similarity, and character similarity. Our method achieves near-perfect compilation success and improves visual and textual alignment over strong open-source baselines, while remaining competitive with proprietary GPT-based vision-language models. Extensive ablations demonstrate that curriculum-based reward scheduling is critical for reducing reward interference, stabilizing training and mitigating proxy over-optimization. Overall, our results highlight the effectiveness of reference-aware, multi-objective reinforcement learning for structured diagram generation from noisy sketches.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sketch2TikZ，用强化学习将手绘草图转换为可编译 TikZ 代码，采用代码结构、OCR、CleanDIFT、自相似四类奖励的顺序多奖励策略，并结合课程式奖励调度。
AI.motivation: 草图输入噪声大、歧义多，token 级监督难以保证生成图表的全局正确性（可编译性、视觉一致性与文本正确性）。
AI.method: RL 框架，序列化多目标奖励：R_cs（代码结构）、R_ocr（文本/字符识别）、R_cd（CleanDIFT 视觉特征相似）、R_ss（自相似性），并采用 curriculum-based 奖励调度来缓解奖励干扰与代理指标过优化。
AI.result: 在 SkeTikZ 与 FlowChart-3B 上编译成功率接近 100%，视觉与文本对齐优于强开源基线，接近专有 GPT 类 VLM；消融显示课程式奖励调度对训练稳定性至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 参考感知的多目标强化学习可有效实现从噪声草图到结构化图表代码的生成，奖励调度设计是关键。

title: Automating Multi-View Quality Assessment of 3D Annotation Layouts
summary: Text labels provide descriptive information about elements in visual scenes. In 3D visualization, the arrangement of these labels and their connections to target locations forms an annotation layout. Assessing layout quality supports comparisons between alternative layouts. However, existing quality measures often focus on specific layout properties and may not fully reflect human judgments of overall quality. Moreover, a layout may appear clear from one viewpoint but suffer from occlusion or clutter from another. To address these issues, we propose a multi-view quality assessment method based on a multimodal large language model (MLLM). We fine-tune a compact MLLM using structured supervision from human ratings to predict a rating for each quality dimension in each view. These ratings are aggregated into view-level and sample-level quality scores. To support training and evaluation, we construct the Annotation Layouts with Quality Assessment (ALQA) dataset, containing 3,216 layout samples from 1,072 3D objects across 13 categories. Each layout is rendered from 5 predefined viewpoints, and each view is independently rated by 3 human raters across 5 quality dimensions. On ALQA, our method agrees more closely with human reference scores than the evaluated MLLM baselines, and a user study demonstrates strong agreement with human preferences in layout ranking.

AI.tldr: 提出基于多模态大模型（MLLM）的多视角标注布局质量评估方法，构建ALQA数据集（1,072个3D物体、3,216个布局样本、5视角、3位标注者、5个质量维度），微调小型MLLM预测各视角各维度评分并聚合为视角级与样本级质量分。
AI.motivation: 3D可视化中文本标签布局质量缺乏能反映整体人感知的度量：现有指标只关注特定布局属性，且单一视角的清晰度无法反映其他视角下的遮挡与杂乱问题。
AI.method: 构建ALQA数据集（13类、1,072个3D物体、3,216个布局样本、每个渲染5个预设视角、每视角3名评分者×5个质量维度）；以人类评分的结构化监督微调紧凑型MLLM，逐视角逐维度预测评分，再聚合为视角级与样本级质量得分。
AI.result: 在ALQA上，方法与人参考分数的一致性优于所比较的MLLM基线；用户研究显示其布局排序结果与人类偏好高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 多视角+MLLM的评分框架可更贴近人类对标注布局整体质量的判断，为布局比较与选择提供可扩展的自动化质量度量。

title: Points, Not Pixels: Keypoints, Masks and Oblique Geometry for Floating-Roof Tank Fill Estimation from Overhead Imagery
comment: Accepted to Workshop on Computer Vision for Earth Observation Applications at WACV 2027
summary: The floating roof of an oil storage tank rests on the stored liquid, so its depth below the rim measures how full the tank is. In optical overhead imagery, this depth appears only as the crescent shadow the rim casts on the roof, often a few pixels wide. Thin shadows are difficult to measure at overhead-image resolution, and nadir-based height conversions introduce errors in oblique views. Under a local affine camera, roof depth determines the rim-to-shadow displacement through the sun and camera geometry. We regress the boundaries as sub-pixel keypoints and invert this relation with a closed-form estimator that models oblique views. Available public tank datasets do not label roof position, so we introduce SynTank-25k, 24,987 physically based renders with exact roof, shadow and camera geometry. Using the oblique estimator, the keypoint pipeline reduces fill error by $22\%$ relative to the segmentation baseline on SynTank-25k. On shadows narrower than $6\text{ px}$, its error is also lower than that obtained by converting true binary masks. Our oblique estimator reduces the error of the nadir formula elevenfold at the steepest views. On 6,558 real NAIP tank crops defined by bounding boxes, about half of the fill estimates pass internal consistency checks; NAIP has no fill labels. Data and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 从单张俯拍光学影像中测量浮顶油罐油位：将罐缘与阴影边界回归为亚像素关键点，并用局部仿射相机下的闭式斜视估计器反演油位深度，同时发布20万级物理渲染数据集SynTank-25k。
AI.motivation: 浮顶罐液位在俯拍影像中仅表现为罐缘投在浮顶上的数像素宽月牙形阴影，分辨率下极细阴影难以测量；传统基于正下视（nadir）的高度换算在斜视条件下误差大，且公开油罐数据集不含浮顶位置标注，缺乏训练与评测基准。
AI.method: （1）合成SynTank-25k：24,987张基于物理渲染的图像，含精确的浮顶、阴影与相机几何真值；（2）将罐缘与阴影边界作为亚像素关键点回归，构建关键点流水线；（3）在局部仿射相机模型下，由太阳与相机几何推导罐缘—阴影位移与浮顶深度的关系，提出建模斜视的闭式反演估计器；（4）在NAIP真实影像6,558个罐体裁剪图上做无标签内部一致性校验。
AI.result: 在SynTank-25k上，斜视估计器配合关键点流水线使油位误差较分割基线降低22%；当阴影宽度小于6 px时，误差低于直接由真值二值掩膜换算的结果；在最陡斜视角下，斜视估计器相较nadir公式误差降低约11倍；6,558个真实NAIP样本中约半数通过内部一致性检查。
AI.conclusion: 将细结构测量转化为亚像素关键点回归并对相机几何做显式建模，可在低分辨率俯拍图上实现高精度液位反演；物理渲染合成数据可弥补真实标注缺失。局限在于真实数据无油位真值，仅能依赖一致性自检，绝对精度尚未在真实场景中验证。

title: Segment Everything, Materialize Nothing: Exact Streaming Inference for Many-Class 3D Segmentation
summary: Whole-body segmentation tools such as TotalSegmentator and MOOSE split more than 100 classes across five or six networks. The reason is memory. Standard 3D inference, as implemented in nnU-Net and MONAI, holds a logit for every class and voxel, on the working grid and again on the scanner's grid. For a median whole-body CT at 125 classes, that is 76 GB. We show that this memory wall lies in what inference materializes, not in the task, and remove it without approximation. Every step after the network is local along one axis, so its outputs can be streamed through a ring one patch thick. The classification head commutes with blending and resampling, so the ring carries the network's features instead of the class logits. Memory thus no longer grows with classes times volume, and the label map on the scanner's grid stays exact. This holds for any model with a pointwise affine head, without retraining. Many-class models, previously impractical, become deployable. One model trained on all classes matches or slightly exceeds the toolkits' five or six specialists in segmentation quality and runs 5.8-15x faster end to end, with 3.2-7.6x less RAM and under 8 GB of VRAM. We provide the method as a drop-in for nnU-Net, TotalSegmentator and MOOSE. The code is part of nnU-Net ( this https URL ), and unified models for both toolkits will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出基于环形流式（ring streaming）的精确低内存推理方案：将分类头与融合/重采样交换次序，使显存不随"类别数×体素数"增长，并作为nnU-Net/TotalSegmentator/MOOSE的即插即用模块。
AI.motivation: 全身分割工具（TotalSegmentator、MOOSE）因显存限制被迫把100+类拆成5–6个网络分别推理；nnU-Net/MONAI标准3D推理需在每个体素×每个类别上保存logit（工作网格与扫描仪网格各一份），125类中位全身CT约需76 GB显存。
AI.method: 观察到网络之后的所有步骤（融合、重采样、argmax）沿某一轴是局部操作，因此可用一个patch厚的环形缓冲区流式处理；又因点式仿射分类头与融合、重采样可交换，环中传递网络特征而非类别logit，从而精确（无近似）地避免物化全量logit张量。适用于任意带pointwise affine head的模型，无需重训练。
AI.result: 单一全类别模型在分割质量上与工具包的5–6个专家模型持平或略优，端到端速度提升5.8–15倍，RAM降低3.2–7.6倍，显存低于8 GB；扫描仪网格上的标签图保持精确。
AI.conclusion: 大类别数分割的瓶颈在于推理物化方式而非任务本身；该流式方案无需近似与重训练即可部署多类别统一模型，已集成进nnU-Net并作为TotalSegmentator/MOOSE的drop-in替代。

title: Instant-LIVO: Efficient LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry with Compact Geometry and a Bounded Single-Reference-Frame Map
summary: LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) is a fundamental technology for autonomous systems; however, deployment on resource-constrained platforms remains challenging due to physical limitations. This paper presents Instant-LIVO, a tightly coupled, high-speed, real-time LIVO system. The system introduces a compact geometric map based on spatial-hashed OctVox and accelerates local-neighborhood retrieval and plane fitting through cache-assisted heuristic staged K-nearest-neighbor searches. It also employs a bounded single-reference-frame visual map that adaptively updates the reference frame according to the tracking status, while using Schmidt-type uncertainty-aware photometric fusion to maintain the correlation between the reference pose and the current state. The system performs multisensor fusion through a sequential process consisting of IMU prediction, LiDAR geometric correction, and visual photometric correction. It was evaluated on 32 public benchmarks and custom datasets. While maintaining competitive accuracy on both X86 and ARM platforms, Instant-LIVO achieves average processing-speed improvements of approximately 2.3x and 2.1x, respectively, and reduces peak memory usage to approximately 1/20 and 1/13, respectively. The results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing LIO and LIVO baselines in both accuracy and computational this http URL implementation is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: Instant-LIVO：基于空间哈希OctVox紧凑几何地图与缓存加速分层KNN的紧耦合高速实时LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计，配合有界单参考帧视觉地图与Schmidt不确定性感知光度融合，在X86/ARM上分别实现约2.3x/2.1x加速并将峰值内存降至约1/20与1/13。
AI.motivation: LIVO是自主系统的基础技术，但在资源受限平台上受物理条件制约难以部署，现有系统在计算效率与内存占用上不足。
AI.method: (1) 基于空间哈希OctVox的紧凑几何地图；(2) 缓存辅助的启发式分阶段KNN搜索，加速局部邻域检索与平面拟合；(3) 有界单参考帧视觉地图，按跟踪状态自适应更新参考帧；(4) Schmidt型不确定性感知光度融合，保持参考位姿与当前状态的相关性；(5) 顺序式多传感器融合流程：IMU预测→LiDAR几何校正→视觉光度校正。
AI.result: 在32个公开基准与自建数据集上评估；X86与ARM平台上精度与现有基线相当或更优，平均处理速度提升约2.3x和2.1x，峰值内存降至约1/20和1/13，整体优于现有LIO与LIVO基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过地图表示、检索加速与不确定性一致融合的协同设计，实现了可在边缘/资源受限平台实时运行的LIVO，兼顾精度与算力/内存效率；代码已开源。

title: Seeing Is Not Steering: Where Verifiable Reasoning Can Enter an End-to-End Driving Planner
summary: Driving models that reason may describe a hazard correctly while choosing their path for other reasons. We study where scene reasoning can enter an end-to-end planner so its influence can be checked. We freeze Drive-JEPA and use a fine-tuned vision-language model to state scene facts. Although fine-tuning improves fact accuracy, the two learned components we test show no detectable benefit from reading them. A rule-based fact check instead rejects or shortens paths that contradict the facts, linking each intervention to a stated fact. On the frozen planner alone, it gains 2.4 EPDMS points on navhard. Its 2.0-point margin over a control that changes the same frames without consulting facts remains statistically uncertain. A diagnostic using exact facts from maps and annotations yields a 3.6-point margin over its corresponding control, with a 95% confidence interval above zero. Separately, a path scorer and plan memory that read no stated facts raise navhard from 41.2 to 51.8. Bounding travel distance using the reasoner's facts adds 0.3 there and reduces navtest by 2.0. The fact check makes each intervention auditable, while the driving value of the reasoner's facts remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 冻结Drive-JEPA端到端规划器，用微调VLM陈述场景事实，并检验"读取事实"对规划的影响：学习组件无可测收益，而基于规则的事实校验可拒绝/裁剪矛盾路径，在navhard上提升2.4 EPDMS，但相对同帧控制的2.0点增益不显著。
AI.motivation: 驾驶模型可能"正确描述危险"却因其他原因选路，因此推理与决策脱耦，需要明确场景推理在何处进入端到端规划器，并使每次干预可追溯、可审计。
AI.method: 冻结Drive-JEPA主干；微调VLM输出场景事实；对比两类"读取事实"的学习组件（事实读取路径打分器/记忆）与一组不读事实的路径打分器+plan memory基线；再引入规则式事实校验，对与事实矛盾的轨迹做拒绝或截断，并用地图/标注精确事实做诊断实验、以同帧改动的控制组做消融；另在推理器事实上加行驶距离上界约束。
AI.result: 仅冻结规划器+事实校验在navhard上+2.4 EPDMS；相对同帧控制的2.0点差距统计不确定；精确事实诊断组相对其控制+3.6点（95%CI>0）；不读事实的路径打分器+plan memory将navhard从41.2升至51.8；距离上界在navhard仅+0.3、navtest -2.0。
AI.conclusion: 事实校验使干预可审计，但推理器事实的驾驶价值仍未确定；显式读取事实的可学习组件无检测到收益，表明收益可能主要来自轨迹筛选机制而非事实语义本身。

title: SOAR: Training-Free Rank-Consistent Rollout Compression for Latent World Model Planning
comment: 16 pages, including supplementary material. Anqi Li and Kai Liu contributed equally
summary: Latent world models plan by rolling out hundreds of candidate action sequences through a transformer predictor, so a single decision can take tens of seconds. Existing accelerations prune spatial tokens as in vision-language models, yet a sampling-based planner uses predicted costs only to rank candidates, so a rollout can be compressed freely as long as the ranking survives. We propose SOAR, a training-free method that adapts rollout compression to each planning decision. At every decision, SOAR probes a few candidates under several token budgets and keeps the smallest budget that preserves their ranking, so it compresses as far as the current decision allows, without task labels. A closed-loop study of more than 80,000 episodes fixes the rest of the rollout: the first step, which alone reads a real observation, stays exact, and the context frame is cached rather than recomputed. On seven navigation and manipulation tasks with frozen checkpoints, SOAR matches dense-level planning success at 2.3x speedup and retains 98% at 2.5x. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SOAR：面向潜空间世界模型规划的免训练 rollout 压缩方法，按每个决策自适应选择最小 token 预算，保持候选排序不变，实现 2.3x 加速且性能对齐稠密规划。
AI.motivation: 潜空间世界模型需用 transformer 预测器展开数百条候选动作序列，单次决策耗时可达数十秒。现有加速沿用 VLM 的空间 token 剪枝，但基于采样的规划器只用预测代价对候选排序，rollout 只需保住排序即可大幅压缩，现有方法未利用这一特性。
AI.method: 免训练方法：每次决策时用少量候选在若干 token 预算下探测，取能保持候选排序的最小预算；闭环 8 万+ episode 研究确定其余 rollout 设置的固定策略——首步（唯一读取真实观测的步骤）保持精确，上下文帧缓存复用而非重算。
AI.result: 在 7 个导航与操作任务、冻结 checkpoint 下，2.3x 加速达到稠密规划成功率，2.5x 加速保留 98%；更大规模闭环实验（>80,000 episodes）验证设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 将压缩目标从"预测精度"转为"候选排序保真"，配合按决策自适应预算，可在不训练、不用任务标签的情况下显著降低世界模型规划延迟，做法简单且可直接叠加于冻结模型，代码开源。

title: Beyond Resolution: Inference-Time Parameterized Temporal Consistency in Generative Regional Climate Downscaling
summary: GCM-to-RCM downscaling emulation is dominated by generative diffusion models, but most existing work evaluates skill only per timestep, treating each field as an independent snapshot. This leaves open whether generated sequences are temporally coherent or merely independently plausible, a gap that matters increasingly for sub-daily resolutions since downstream impacts depend on accumulation and persistence, not just on isolated states. This study asks whether autoregressive conditioning can deliver coherent rollouts without error accumulation and ensemble-spread collapse, and whether a single model can expose the resulting coherence-diversity trade-off as a controllable inference choice rather than a fixed design commitment. We introduce a noise-conditioned teacher-forcing training scheme conditioning a diffusion U-Net downscaling model on a noised previous high-resolution state, so the trained model interpolates continuously between autoregressive (AR) and per-timestep independent (PTI) sampling via one noise parameter. We apply the scheme to an hourly, European-domain historical simulation downscaling AWI-CM1 (1$^\circ$) with ICON (0.11$^\circ$, regridded to 0.25$^\circ$) for precipitation and 2-meter temperature. The noise parameter traces a smooth interpolation between ICON's autocorrelation and PTI generation. AR rollouts of up to six months show no progressive degradation, with ensemble spread contracting only slightly within the first 24 hours. In contrast, the same architecture trained on noise-free previous states diverges. For precipitation PTI underestimates maxima by up to 2x in daily aggregations, while AR tracks ICON's maxima closely. For temperature, differences between modes are negligible. These results show that in diffusion downscaling temporal consistency can be achieved architecture-agnostically and offered as a controllable, not fixed, inference choice.

AI.tldr: 提出噪声条件教师强迫训练方案，使扩散降尺度模型通过单一噪声参数在自回归采样与时步独立采样间连续插值，从而将时间连贯性-多样性权衡变为可控推理选择。
AI.motivation: 现有GCM-to-RCM扩散降尺度仅按时步评估，无法判断生成序列是否时间连贯；亚日尺度下游影响依赖累积与持续性，需要解决自回归滚动中的误差累积与集合离散度塌缩。
AI.method: 以加噪的上一时刻高分辨率状态作为条件训练扩散U-Net（噪声条件教师强迫），一个噪声参数连续插值于自回归（AR）与逐时步独立（PTI）采样之间；在小时级欧洲域上对AWI-CM1→ICON的降水与2米气温做历史模拟降尺度。
AI.result: 噪声参数平滑追踪ICON自相关；AR六个月的rollout无渐进退化，前24小时集合离散度仅轻微收缩；而无噪声条件训练的同一架构会发散。降水日聚合中PTI低估极值达2倍，AR贴合ICON极值；气温两模式差异可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 扩散降尺度中的时间一致性可架构无关地实现，并作为可控推理选项而非固定设计选择提供。

title: MoHA: Model-Conditioned Harness Adaptation for Long-Video Agents
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Long-video understanding increasingly relies on agentic systems that actively acquire evidence rather than process fixed video representations. Their execution harnesses must coordinate language-level planning with video-level observation and evidence acquisition, yet are typically fixed across model stacks. We therefore introduce MoHA, a framework for model-conditioned harness adaptation that adapts a common initial execution harness to the specific planner and observer models it hosts. MoHA treats the harness itself as a model-conditioned optimization object: under the same task distribution and initialization, different planner-observer stacks can benefit from different executable harnesses. Starting from a common initial harness, MoHA analyzes failed calibration traces to diagnose model-harness mismatches and adapts both planner-side reasoning support, such as overview, memory, and verification, and observer-side capability assignments, including OCR and ASR specialists. After structural adaptation, MoHA separately calibrates observer execution configurations for the hosted model stack. Across three frozen planner stacks, MoHA improves Video-MME Full accuracy by 6.2-27.1 percentage points and Video-Holmes accuracy by 3.1-20.1 points over the fixed initial harness. Cross-model transfer further shows that the adapted harnesses generalize only partially to other models, highlighting the harness as a model-conditioned optimization layer for long-video understanding. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MoHA 将长视频理解的执行框架（harness）视为以模型为条件的优化对象，通过失败轨迹诊断模型与框架的错配，结构性地调整规划器侧支持（概览、记忆、验证）与观察器侧能力分配（OCR/ASR 专家），再单独校准观察器执行配置。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解转向主动取证式 agent 系统，其执行框架需协调语言级规划与视频级观测，但现有框架通常固定跨模型栈，忽视不同 planner-observer 组合的适配需求。
AI.method: 以同一初始 harness 与任务分布为起点，分析校准失败的轨迹以定位模型-框架错配；据此适配规划器侧推理支持与观察器侧 specialists 分配，形成新的可执行 harness；随后对托管模型栈单独校准观察器执行配置。对三个冻结 planner 栈分别适配并评估，并做跨模型迁移实验。
AI.result: Video-MME Full 准确率提升 6.2–27.1 个百分点，Video-Holmes 提升 3.1–20.1 个百分点（相对固定初始 harness）；跨模型迁移仅部分泛化，说明 harness 是模型条件化的优化层。
AI.conclusion: 执行框架应作为模型条件化的优化层而非固定组件；模型栈专属适配带来显著增益，但适配结果迁移性有限，需按模型分别校准。

title: Trust What Repeats: Capped World-Model Policy Gradients for Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Training a humanoid motion tracker by backpropagating imagined returns through a learned world model is fast, because the model gives a first-order policy gradient. We ask how much of that gradient holds in the simulator. On a tracker for the Unitree G1, the $0.5\%$ of imagined rollouts with the largest gradients carry $22\%$ of the summed gradient norm, yet neither a second rollout from the same state nor the simulator confirms them. When the actions are moved along the model's gradient, the simulator returns 94% of the predicted change in return where the gradient norm is below the batch median, 48% between 3 and 10 times the median, and 1% above 30 times; the part of a gradient that either check confirms stops growing at a few times the median. We therefore cap each rollout's action-gradient norm at 10 times the batch median, draw imagination starts in proportion to their predicted gradient norm so that the cap removes less, and reset episodes where the world model and critic predict the lowest return. Trained on 223 hours of motion and tested on 353 motions that no actor performed in training, the method raises the normalized return of SuperMimic, the baseline it builds on, from 0.953 to 0.967 and the lowest $1\%$ of test clips from 0.65 to 0.76, halves the test clips that fall persistently, from 15--18 to 7--10, and reaches the baseline's final return in 40% of the baseline's iterations and half its training time. On LAFAN1, trained and evaluated on the same clips as prior work, it reaches 0.935 against 0.906.

AI.tldr: 论文检验人形运动跟踪器中"世界模型一阶策略梯度"的可靠性，发现大梯度样本不被仿真器确证，据此加入梯度范数截断、按预测梯度范数采样起点与低回报处重置，在Unitree G1上提升SuperMimic并加速训练。
AI.motivation: 通过世界模型回传"想象回报"来训练人形运动跟踪器速度快（因可获得一阶策略梯度），但该梯度在真实仿真器中是否成立尚不清楚，需要量化其可信度并据此修正训练过程。
AI.method: 三项诊断：同一状态二次rollout与仿真器验证模型梯度（按梯度范数分档统计预测变化被仿真器兑现的比例）。三项干预：(1) 将每条rollout的动作梯度范数截断至批次中位数的10倍；(2) 按预测梯度范数比例采样想象起点，降低截断损失；(3) 在世界模型与critic预测回报最低处重置episode。基线为SuperMimic，Unitree G1跟踪器，训练223小时运动数据。
AI.result: 梯度最大的0.5% rollouts 占梯度范数总和的22%，但均不被二次rollout或仿真器确认；仿真器兑现的回报变化比例随梯度范数从中位数以下94%降至3–10倍中位数48%、>30倍仅1%，被确证部分在数倍中位数后停止增长。归一化回报0.953→0.967，最差1%片段0.65→0.76，持续跌倒片段由15–18降至7–10，达到基线最终回报仅需其40%迭代数与一半训练时间；LAFAN1 0.935 vs 0.906。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的一阶梯度在仿真器中呈显著重尾/不可靠，大梯度多为想象伪影；基于梯度范数的截断与采样修正可在保持速度优势前提下提升跟踪成功率与鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Sample Hardness: Adaptive Data Selection through Learning Dynamics
summary: Data selection has emerged as an effective approach to reducing the model training costs. However, most existing methods often rely heavily on sample hardness, which may overlook differences in sample learning dynamics and lead to suboptimal sample selection. In this paper, we propose LeDAS, an end-to-end Learning Dynamics-Aware Selection framework for dynamic data selection, which jointly characterizes sample importance through hardness, learning progress, and deterioration, enabling adaptive sample prioritization throughout training with marginal additional computational overhead. Specifically, we track per-sample loss dynamics using exponential moving averages (EMA) to obtain three complementary signals that capture current learning difficulty, ongoing learning improvements, and potential degradation. To accommodate evolving training dynamics, we introduce Adaptive Metric Fusion, a contextual bandit-based mechanism that dynamically adjusts the relative importance of these signals based on training feedback. Furthermore, a bounded staleness compensation mechanism accounts for historical selection patterns by increasing the selection priority of samples that have not been selected for extended periods. Extensive experiments across diverse vision and language tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of LeDAS. Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, LeDAS consistently achieves superior performance, matching or surpassing full-dataset training at a 50\% selection ratio on ImageNet-1K and in LLM supervised fine-tuning. Moreover, its modular and task-agnostic design enables the integration of complementary selection signals, demonstrating strong robustness to noisy and corrupted datasets.

AI.tldr: LeDAS：端到端的学习动态感知数据选择框架，用EMA追踪每样本损失的难度、学习进展与退化三信号，并以上下文多臂老虎机自适应融合权重，配合有界陈旧性补偿，在ImageNet-1K与LLM SFT上以50%选择率追平或超越全量训练。
AI.motivation: 现有数据选择方法过度依赖样本硬度（hardness），忽略样本学习动态的差异，导致选择次优；且需在训练全程自适应调整选择策略。
AI.method: 用指数移动平均（EMA）追踪逐样本损失动态，导出硬度、学习进展、退化三种互补信号；提出自适应度量融合（Adaptive Metric Fusion），以基于上下文多臂老虎机的机制按训练反馈动态调节各信号权重；引入有界陈旧性补偿（bounded staleness compensation），对长期未被选中的样本提升优先级；整体为任务无关的模块化端到端框架，额外计算开销很小。
AI.result: 在多种视觉与语言任务上验证有效性；相比SOTA基线持续更优，在ImageNet-1K与LLM监督微调中以50%选择率追平或超过全量数据训练；对噪声与损坏数据集表现稳健，可集成互补选择信号。
AI.conclusion: 融合多维度学习动态信号并自适应加权，是比单一硬度更有效的动态数据选择范式，且具任务无关性与低开销。

title: GeoScaffold: From Latent to Realized Geometry in Collaborative Detection
summary: Most collaborative 3D detectors fuse bird's-eye-view (BEV) features from connected vehicles and roadside infrastructure to aggregate complementary observations. Although modern communication, alignment, and fusion pipelines encode rich latent geometry in the fused BEV features, the standard readout pipeline inherited from single-agent detectors, i.e., anchor scoring, box decoding, and non-maximum suppression (NMS), does not fully exploit these geometric cues. We empirically identify and quantify this gap on UrbanIng-V2X. Collaboration improves localization at about two-thirds of positive anchors, yet when NMS resolves two overlapping collaborative boxes of one object, it keeps the better-localized box less than half of the time. A key cause is a supervision mismatch: classification scores are trained only for foreground-background discrimination, so nothing in training requires them to rank boxes by localization quality. To address this limitation, we introduce GeoScaffold, a lightweight training-only auxiliary objective. It predicts a foreground mask at each positive anchor, i.e., the cells of a grid over the anchor that lie inside the ground-truth box, to supply the dense spatial supervision that the seven-dimensional box code leaves implicit. Its loss, added to the detection loss, updates the encoder and fusion modules through the fused BEV and trains the detector toward a better-localized box at every positive anchor, including the top-scored one. The auxiliary head is removed at inference, preserving the original detector architecture, communication logic, and inference cost. GeoScaffold raises AP@0.5 and AP@0.7 by 0.98 and 0.55 points on average across all 11 fusion methods on the UrbanIng-V2X validation split, with gains extending to most methods on an unseen intersection and to all ten methods that produce detections on V2V4Real.

AI.tldr: GeoScaffold 是一个训练期辅助目标：在每个正样本锚点预测前景掩码（锚点网格中落入 GT 框的单元），为融合 BEV 特征提供密集空间监督，缓解分类分数与定位质量不匹配导致的 NMS 保留框次优问题，且推理时移除辅助头、零额外开销。
AI.motivation: 协同 3D 检测（车-路 BEV 融合）沿用单智能体检测的读取流程（锚点打分、框解码、NMS），未能充分利用融合 BEV 中的几何线索。作者在 UrbanIng-V2X 上量化了这一差距：约 2/3 的正锚点定位因协同而改善，但 NMS 处理同一目标的两个重叠协同框时，保留定位更优框的比例不足一半。根因是监督错配——分类分数只训练前景/背景判别，未被约束按定位质量排序。
AI.method: 引入 GeoScaffold：轻量、仅训练用的辅助目标。在每个正锚点上预测前景掩码（锚点覆盖网格中位于 GT 框内的单元），补充 7 维框编码所隐含但未显式监督的稠密空间信息；其损失与检测损失相加，经融合 BEV 反向传导更新编码器与融合模块，从而在每个正锚点（含最高分锚点）训练出定位更好的框；推理时移除辅助头，保持原检测器架构、通信逻辑与推理开销不变。
AI.result: 在 UrbanIng-V2X 验证集上，对全部 11 种融合方法平均提升 AP@0.5 与 AP@0.7 分别 0.98 和 0.55 个百分点；在未见过的交叉路口场景中多数方法仍有增益；在 V2V4Real 上所有 10 个能产生检测结果的方法均获提升。
AI.conclusion: 分类分数缺乏定位质量监督是协同 BEV 检测读取环节的关键瓶颈；用稠密前景掩码作为训练期脚手架可系统性改善 NMS 前的框质量排序，且以零推理代价、即插即用的方式跨多种融合方法泛化，并迁移到新场景与另一数据集。

title: CanopyFormer: Attention-Guided SegFormer for Explainable Forest Cover Segmentation
summary: In transformer segmentation models, attention is usually visualized after training rather than supervised. Although attention supervision has been explored for natural images and driving scenes, aerial forest segmentation typically uses attention only as an architectural component and evaluates interpretability qualitatively. We present CanopyFormer, an attention-guided SegFormer-B0 that uses an Attention Consistency Loss to align attention with the ground-truth forest mask, encouraging attention to focus on canopy regions. Since SegFormer uses spatial-reduction attention, we adapt Gradient-weighted Attention Rollout by restricting it to the final encoder stage, where the attention matrix is square. We introduce Average Attention-Mask Overlap (AAMO) to measure attention alignment and incorporate a deletion test to evaluate faithfulness. On 5108 images, our method increases AAMO from 0.0334 to 0.7476, approximately 22 times the vanilla SegFormer-B0 result, with a modest decrease in Dice score from 0.8743 to 0.8577. The deletion test reveals that improved alignment does not necessarily translate into improved faithfulness: removing the most-attended 25% of patches reduces the forest score by 12.1%, compared with 33.0% when removing random patches. Attention supervision introduces no additional inference cost, although double backpropagation makes each training step 2.6 to 2.8 times slower. The attention alignment improvement also generalizes to a second dataset, LoveDA. Additionally, a Boundary Refinement Module provides no consistent Dice improvement and reduces AAMO, while mean squared error substantially outperforms Kullback-Leibler divergence as the attention loss.

AI.tldr: CanopyFormer 在 SegFormer-B0 上加入注意力一致性损失，使注意力与森林掩码对齐，并提出 AAMO 指标和删除测试评估忠实度。
AI.motivation: 航空森林分割中注意力仅作为结构组件使用且可解释性多为定性评估，缺少对注意力与目标区域对齐的监督与定量度量。
AI.method: 将空间缩减注意力的 Gradient-weighted Attention Rollout 限制在注意力矩阵为方阵的最后一个编码器阶段；提出 Average Attention-Mask Overlap (AAMO) 度量注意力-掩码对齐；用 Attention Consistency Loss 监督注意力；并加入删除测试评估忠实性，同时对比边界精化模块与 MSE/KL 损失。
AI.result: 5108 张图像上 AAMO 从 0.0334 升至 0.7476（约 22 倍），Dice 由 0.8743 轻微降至 0.8577；删除最高注意力 25% 图块仅使森林分数下降 12.1%，而随机删除下降 33.0%，说明对齐改善不必然带来忠实性提升；推理无额外开销，训练每步慢 2.6–2.8 倍；在 LoveDA 上对齐提升可泛化；边界精化模块无一致 Dice 收益且降低 AAMO；MSE 显著优于 KL。
AI.conclusion: 注意力监督可显著提升注意力对齐且不增加推理成本，但注意力忠实性与分割精度存在权衡，需用删除测试等忠实性指标补充评估。

title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embodied-Harness in generalization under environmental variations, spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and memory-dependent manipulation. Our method achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on the three benchmarks, respectively. Real-world evaluation further yields an average success rate of 96.7% across three manipulation tasks. These results highlight the potential of Embodied-Harness to improve robotic manipulation through experience-driven harness self-improvement.

AI.tldr: Embodied-Harness：双智能体（Actor+Reflector）框架，通过分层记忆与递归"harness"自我改进在不更新VLM参数的情况下提升机器人操作成功率。
AI.motivation: VLM-based 机器人智能体受限于记忆组织混乱、失败归因不确定、执行经验复用不足，且希望避免昂贵的参数微调。
AI.method: Actor 经机器人控制接口与环境交互；Reflector 将执行证据（observed interactions）转化为可复用操作指导；分层记忆架构维护短期执行上下文与长期经验知识；证据驱动的经验反思做失败诊断；递归式 harness 自我改进在多次尝试中迭代精炼指导，全程不更新模型参数。
AI.result: RoboTwin 2.0 / RoboSPA / RMBench 成功率 82.4% / 76.7% / 94.4%；真实世界三个操作任务平均 96.7%。
AI.conclusion: 经验驱动、免训练的执行层自我改进可有效提升 VLM 智能体的泛化、空间推理、长时规划与记忆依赖操作能力，具较强实用潜力。

title: When Are Images Needed in Multimodal Machine Translation? Text-Only Routing for On-Demand Visual Context
summary: Image-guided multimodal machine translation (MMT) leverages visual context to resolve translation-relevant uncertainty. However, prevailing systems either process images unconditionally or apply gating only after visual encoding, leaving redundant visual computation unavoidable. To mitigate this computational overhead, routing decisions must rely on a pre-visual source signal. Crucially, surface-level ambiguity does not equate to visual dependence, as intra-sentence textual context often suffices for disambiguation. We therefore formulate visual invocation as source-text sufficiency prediction: determining exclusively from the source text whether translation-relevant uncertainty remains unresolved. To support this formulation, we construct a visual-dependency dataset with three fine-grained labels (no_ambiguity, text_resolved, and vision_needed) and verify discriminative visual evidence for vision_needed instances. We further propose PreVIR, a lightweight, backend-agnostic text-only router that selects between text-only and multimodal branches before computing visual features. Experiments on English-to-Chinese MMT demonstrate that PreVIR achieves a favorable COMET-budget trade-off relative to strong routing baselines. At its default operating point, it substantially reduces visual calls while maintaining translation quality comparable to always-on multimodal inference. Label-wise and case analyses show that this trade-off stems from distinguishing genuine visual dependency from contextually resolved ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreVIR：仅用源文本预测是否真正需要视觉，从而在计算视觉特征前路由到纯文本或多模态分支，构建三分类视觉依赖数据集，英中翻译上以更少视觉调用换取相近质量。
AI.motivation: 现有图像引导多模态机器翻译要么无条件处理图像，要么在视觉编码之后才做门控，冗余视觉计算不可避免；且表层歧义不等于视觉依赖，句内文本上下文往往已足以消歧，因此路由决策需要仅依赖视觉前的源文本信号。
AI.method: 将视觉调用形式化为"源文本充分性预测"，只从源文本判断是否仍存在未解决的翻译相关不确定性；构建含 no_ambiguity / text_resolved / vision_needed 三细粒度标签的视觉依赖数据集，并验证 vision_needed 样本存在可判别视觉证据；提出 PreVIR——轻量、后端无关的纯文本路由器，在计算视觉特征前选择文本分支或多模态分支。
AI.result: 英中 MMT 实验中，PreVIR 相对强路由基线取得更优的 COMET-预算折中；默认工作点大幅减少视觉调用，翻译质量与始终开启多模态推理相当；标签级与案例分析表明收益来自区分真实视觉依赖与已被上下文消解的歧义。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息应按需调用；以纯文本充分性预测作为前置路由可有效降低多模态翻译计算开销，为预算受限 MMT 提供可插拔方案。

title: VeilGS: Solving Darkness as a Veil of 2D Basis Maps over Retinex 3DGS
summary: In a dark capture, the darkness is not uniform. How much light reaches a surface depends on where it lies relative to the few light sources, and the camera compresses what remains with a tone curve. Most low-light 3D reconstruction methods either apply one curve to every pixel of a view, so a dark object beside a lamp and a bright one in an unlit corner receive the same correction, or store the darkness in the 3D representation, where it can absorb scene detail. We present VeilGS, a 3D Gaussian Splatting method for low-light novel view synthesis that treats the degradation as a veil drawn over a clear scene. Each Gaussian carries an albedo and a shading latent instead of spherical harmonics, separating surface colour from illumination. Each view is darkened by a spatially varying gain followed by a global tone curve, and rendering without this veil gives the restored scene. A small network predicts a coarse basis for the gain from the observation, and its coefficients are solved for each view rather than learned. Training through this solve discourages the Gaussians from absorbing what the veil can explain. VeilGS needs no paired normal-light supervision and stores no per-view parameters. On Gaussian-DK, its restored renders score best on no-reference NIQE and CLIP-IQA and are rated highest in a blind user study with 55 participants. On LOM, it achieves results competitive with the state of the art.

AI.tldr: VeilGS 将低光退化建模为叠加在清晰场景上的“光幕”：每个高斯用 albedo + shading latent 替代球谐，每帧用空间变化增益 × 全局色调曲线，渲染时去掉光幕即得复原图像。
AI.motivation: 低光 3D 重建现有方法要么对整幅视图用同一条色调曲线（忽略光照的空间非均匀性），要么把暗化信息编码进 3D 表示中，从而吸收掉本属于场景的细节。
AI.method: 基于 3D Gaussian Splatting；每个高斯携带 albedo 与 shading latent 分离材质与光照；视图级退化 = 空间变化增益（由小型网络预测粗基，系数按视图求解而非学习）加全局 tone curve；通过该求解过程反向传播，抑制高斯吸收可由光幕解释的成分；无需成对正常光监督，也不存储逐视图参数。
AI.result: 在 Gaussian-DK 上，复原渲染在无参考 NIQE 和 CLIP-IQA 上最优，55 人盲测评分最高；在 LOM 上达到与 SOTA 竞争的水平。
AI.conclusion: 显式的“退化-场景”解耦（光幕模型）是低光新视角合成的有效归纳偏置，能在无配对监督下取得更好复原质量与跨数据集泛化。

title: PAWS: A Parametric Model of Canine Pose and Shape
summary: We introduce PAWS, a parametric model of canine shape and pose, learned from 3D scans of real dogs. Capturing the full diversity of dogs is challenging, as different breeds vary in size, proportion, and body shape. To capture this range, we scanned 31 dogs across multiple breeds and sizes performing a range of natural movements. From this dataset, we build a parametric model that combines an anatomically faithful skeleton with a linear shape space learned from the 3D scans. Unlike previous models, our model is learned from real dogs in varying poses, allowing for realistic modelling of canine pose and shape. We demonstrate that building on PAWS provides a robust framework for downstream tasks, such as surface reconstruction and image regression. In particular, we show that a limited number of anatomically valid degrees of freedom is sufficient to accurately estimate dog pose and shape.

AI.tldr: PAWS: 从31只不同品种、体型真实犬只的3D扫描中学习参数化犬类形状与姿态模型，将解剖学骨架与线性形状空间结合，支持表面重建与图像回归等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 犬类品种间体型、比例、形态差异巨大，且缺乏像人体SMPL那样由真实多姿态数据学习的参数化模型；已有犬类模型多基于单一姿态或人工构建，难以真实刻画姿态-形状耦合。
AI.method: 采集31只多品种犬只在自然运动下的3D扫描；构建解剖学一致的骨架（关节/自由度约束）与从扫描中学习的线性形状空间，形成参数化形状+姿态模型；以有限个解剖有效自由度进行姿态与形状估计。
AI.result: 在表面重建与单图回归任务上验证了框架有效性；表明少量解剖有效自由度即可较准确估计犬的姿态与形状。
AI.conclusion: PAWS提供了首个（或较早的）基于真实多姿态犬只扫描学习的参数化模型，可作为下游任务的通用基础框架；但数据规模（31只）有限，跨品种泛化与规模化仍有待验证。

title: Quantitative Measurement of Pavement Distress based on Vehicle Camera and Perspective Correction
summary: Using image data is becoming an important method for highway agencies to automatically evaluate pavement conditions. However, most studies focus on improving detection accuracy rather than obtaining quantitative measurements, such as the length or area of pavement distress. Although field camera calibration can provide such measurements, it is impractical for large volumes of onboard images collected from different vehicles. This study develops a method to quantitatively measure pavement distress directly from in-vehicle camera images without on-site camera calibration. A quadrilateral region of interest is first identified based on lane detection and used to construct a perspective transformation matrix for image correction. Size correction is then performed using the proportions of road markings in the image and a specified scale, which also enables estimation of the actual width of the selected region. The corrected images are subsequently processed using object detection algorithms to obtain quantitative distress measurements. The proposed method can efficiently perform perspective correction for images collected by the same vehicle camera with minimal manual effort. The measured pavement patch lengths show a trend consistent with pavement friction data. By calibrating vehicle cameras using only image information, this study enables quantitative pavement distress detection without additional field experiments. The approach provides a practical solution for processing large volumes of vehicle-camera data, particularly as connected vehicles generate increasing amounts of uncalibrated roadway imagery.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需现场标定的车载图像路面病害定量测量方法：基于车道检测确定四边形感兴趣区域并构建透视变换矩阵进行图像校正，再利用道路标线比例与给定尺度完成尺寸校正，随后用目标检测算法输出病害长度/面积等定量指标。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦检测精度提升，缺少长度、面积等定量测量；而现场相机标定对大规模多车车载图像不可行，因此需要仅凭图像信息完成标定与定量测量的可落地方法。
AI.method: 1) 车道检测确定四边形ROI；2) 基于该ROI构建透视变换矩阵做图像校正；3) 利用图中道路标线比例和指定尺度进行尺寸校正，并可估计所选区域实际宽度；4) 对校正后图像运行目标检测算法获得定量病害测量。同一车辆相机采集的图像可复用校正参数，人工干预极少。
AI.result: 方法能以极少人工成本对同一车载相机图像高效完成透视校正；实测路面补丁长度与路面摩擦数据呈现一致趋势，验证了测量的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖图像信息即可完成车相机标定，实现无需额外现场实验的定量路面病害检测，为海量车载（含网联车）未标定道路图像的处理提供实用方案。

title: RoSci: Exploring Robustness in Science VLMs
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable significant progress in scientific tasks. However, these models are generally assumed to be presented with complete and accurate information, overlooking the challenges of erroneous/missing information in wild scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce the concept of Scientific Model Robustness, which defines a model's ability to detect anomalies, assess solvability, and perform self-calibration when faced with Information Error (inconsistencies) or Information Loss (insufficiency). Specifically, we present RoSci-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,220 samples using a seed-variant strategy across six degradation types. To address VLM fragility, we further propose RoSci-Agent, a framework that employs a Parse-Verify-Decide pipeline to vet premises before reasoning. The evaluated VLMs sometimes answer questions whose premises are invalid or incomplete. RoSci-Agent achieves a higher Overall Robustness Score than the evaluated standalone VLMs. RoSci-Bench gives the multimodal reasoning community a common test of when models answer, request clarification, or reject a scientific question.

AI.tldr: 提出"科学模型鲁棒性"概念与RoSci-Bench诊断基准（1220样本，6种退化类型），并给出Parse-Verify-Decide的RoSci-Agent框架。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在科学任务中默认输入信息完整正确，忽视真实场景中的信息错误（不一致）与信息缺失（不充分），模型倾向于对无效前提照常作答。
AI.method: 以seeds-variant策略构造六类退化（信息不一致/不充分）的1,220样本多模态基准；提出RoSci-Agent，在推理前通过解析-验证-决策流水线审查前提，输出作答、请求澄清或拒绝。
AI.result: 被测VLM常在前提无效或不完整时仍给出答案；RoSci-Agent在总体鲁棒性分数上优于独立VLM；基准提供统一的"作答/澄清/拒答"评测。
AI.conclusion: 将前提校验外化为智能体流水线可显著提升VLM在信息退化科学问题上的鲁棒性，并为多模态推理社区提供标准诊断测试。

title: SUPERVISE: A Unified Framework for Standardized and Reproducible Superpixel Evaluation
summary: Image segmentation into superpixels is a widely used technique in computer vision, with a large body of work developed over the years. Yet, its evaluation remains poorly standardized, as methods are compared under heterogeneous protocols, across inconsistent scale ranges, and with redundant or misaligned metric subsets. In this work, we introduce SUPERVISE (SUperpixel PERformance VISualization and Evaluation), a unified and reproducible benchmark that addresses these longstanding inconsistencies. Built on a scale-normalized protocol based on interpolation over the actual number of generated superpixels, SUPERVISE enables fair and consistent cross-method comparisons. We leverage this standardized framework to conduct the first large-scale statistical analysis of 20 evaluation metrics across 7 datasets and 31 methods, revealing strong inter-metric correlations and significant redundancy that challenge common evaluation practices. These findings provide empirical support for reporting a compact set of representative metrics. SUPERVISE is released as a lightweight, modular framework built on precomputed shared label maps, making large-scale reproducible evaluation accessible to the community. All code, label maps, and evaluation results are publicly available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: SUPERVISE 是一个统一的超像素分割评测基准，采用基于实际生成超像素数的尺度归一化协议，并对 7 数据集、31 方法、20 项指标进行大规模统计分析，揭示指标间强相关与冗余。
AI.motivation: 超像素分割领域评测缺乏标准化：各方法在异构协议、不一致尺度范围与冗余/错配指标子集下比较，导致跨方法对比不公平、不可复现。
AI.method: 构建轻量模块化框架 SUPERVISE，基于预计算共享标签图；提出在生成超像素实际数量上做插值的尺度归一化协议，实现一致跨尺度比较；并在此框架下对 20 项评测指标、7 个数据集、31 种方法开展统计相关性分析。
AI.result: 量化揭示指标间强相关与显著冗余，为只报告少量代表性指标提供实证依据；框架支持大规模可复现评测，代码、标签图与结果全部开源。
AI.conclusion: SUPERVISE 为超像素评测建立了统一可复现的标准，但其贡献属基准/评测工具层面，未涉及具身智能核心方法。

title: Ref-YOLO-World: Decoupling Text-Side Computation for Efficient Referring Expression Comprehension on Edge Devices
summary: Many high-accuracy referring expression comprehension (REC) methods produce image-dependent multimodal representations. These representations must be recomputed for every video frame, even when the referring expression remains unchanged. Fast open-vocabulary detectors such as YOLO-World instead pre-encode text once and reuse it throughout the stream. However, encoding each referring expression as a single embedding prevents explicit token-level correspondence. We propose Ref-YOLO-World, which separates text-side computation that depends only on the referring expression from image processing and reuses its outputs across frames. Two lightweight modules inject cached per-token text features into YOLO-World's detection path. Ref-YOLO-World achieves 81.29% Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg val, the highest among REC models with a decoupled text branch, and consistently outperforms a fine-tuned YOLO-World. Precomputation reduces per-image inference time by 18.5%, yielding 47.0 FPS. A Core ML version runs at 15.73 FPS on an iPhone 15 Pro, demonstrating efficient on-device REC. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Ref-YOLO-World 将只依赖指代表达的文本侧计算与图像处理解耦，预计算并缓存逐 token 文本特征，通过两个轻量模块注入 YOLO-World 检测路径，实现跨帧复用，在 RefCOCOg val 达 81.29% Acc@0.5，单图推理提速 18.5%（47.0 FPS），iPhone 15 Pro 上 Core ML 版 15.73 FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有高精度 REC 方法产生图像相关的多模态表示，每个视频帧都需重算，即便指代表达未变，计算冗余大；而 YOLO-World 类开放词汇检测器虽可一次编码文本，但将指代表达压成单一嵌入，缺乏显式 token 级对应，限制精度。
AI.method: 解耦文本分支与图像分支：预计算仅依赖指代表达的逐 token 文本特征并跨帧缓存复用；设计两个轻量模块将缓存的 per-token 文本特征注入 YOLO-World 检测路径，恢复 token 级对应；并提供 Core ML 端侧实现。
AI.result: RefCOCOg val 上 81.29% Acc@0.5，为具有解耦文本分支的 REC 模型中最优，并稳定优于微调的 YOLO-World；预计算使单图推理时间降低 18.5%，达 47.0 FPS；iPhone 15 Pro 上 Core ML 版 15.73 FPS；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 文本侧预计算 + token 级特征注入可在保持高 REC 精度的同时显著降低流式推理开销，证明端侧实时指代理解可行；但实验限于 RefCOCOg 等标准数据集，缺少真实机器人或视频流场景验证。

title: Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
summary: Multimodal search agents answer knowledge intensive visual questions by grounding them in retrieved evidence, and recent recipes train them on multi hop tasks that are synthesized from knowledge graphs and grown online to keep pace with the agent. These recipes, however, treat the searchable world as fixed: a new question can be well formed and verifiable while its evidence is absent from the retrieval backend, so the agent issues the right query, retrieves nothing, and is penalized as if its policy were at fault. Such unreachable negatives accumulate with every round of growth. We propose Search-RSI, a recursive self improvement framework that expands the search world along the agent's capability frontier. In each round, the current policy diagnoses its partially mastered regions of a task space spanned by hop depth, relation rarity, and distractor density; new tasks there are grown together with their evidence; and the same policy decides how they are used: candidates on which its probes disagree feed reinforcement learning, while those beyond its reach become hint guided demonstrations of its own. Keeping the policy inside this loop matters: an improver frozen at the start of training loses 3.2 points. On nine multimodal search benchmarks, Search-RSI keeps improving where static task growth saturates, raising the average accuracy of the recipe it builds on by 9.8 and 9.5 points at 9B and 27B, of which 7.0 points are out of reach for a world that is merely made consistent. The loop uses no external model and only privileged task structure that is removed before training, at 1.27x the compute of static growth.

AI.tldr: Search-RSI：递归自我改进框架，按能力前沿扩张"可检索世界"，使合成任务与其证据同步生长；候选按策略探测分歧分配为RL样本或提示式示范。九个多模态搜索基准上9B/27B分别提升9.8/9.5点，仅1.27x算力。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳多模态搜索智能体训练把可检索世界视为固定：新合成问题结构合法但证据不在检索后端，智能体给出正确查询却检索为空，被当作策略错误惩罚，形成"不可达负样本"并随每轮生长累积。
AI.method: 每轮由当前策略在"跳数深度×关系稀有度×干扰密度"构成的任务空间中诊断其部分掌握区域；在该区域生成新任务并同步构建其证据；同一策略决定样本用途——探测结果分歧的候选用于强化学习，超出当前能力的候选转为自身提示引导示范；循环中不引入外部模型，仅用训练前移除的特权任务结构。
AI.result: 9个多模态搜索基准上，静态任务增长饱和时Search-RSI仍持续提升；相较所基于的配方平均准确率提升9.8点（9B）与9.5点（27B），其中7.0点仅靠"世界一致性修正"无法获得；冻结改进器损失3.2点；算力为静态增长的1.27倍。
AI.conclusion: 任务难度增长必须与证据世界扩张耦合，且改进器须与策略同步共演化，才能避免不可达负样本导致的训练饱和。

title: An Autonomous Adaptive Learning System for Robotic Grasping in the Circular Factory
summary: Linear manufacturing typically operates in highly structured settings with standardized objects, allowing robots to execute pre-programmed motions based on precise models. In contrast, circular manufacturing involves dynamic and less controlled environments, where product components can vary due to appearance and physical changes across different product generations. In this context, uncertainty arises from both the unknown or partially observed states of components (e.g., damaged surfaces, altered shapes) and the unstructured disassembly environment, often characterized by heavy clutter, occlusions, and limited sensing viewpoints. This demands a flexible and adaptable robotic grasping system that can cope with unexpected object changes. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an autonomous grasp learning framework designed for highly uncertain and variable conditions. The framework explicitly distinguishes between uncertainty due to noisy or incomplete sensory observations (aleatoric uncertainty) and uncertainty due to limited knowledge and distribution shift (epistemic uncertainty). Moreover, the framework employs an active perception strategy to reduce visual ambiguity: semantic and spatial scene understanding is achieved using vision language models (VLMs), while view planning enables the robot to adjust its viewpoint to improve observability. In addition, the approach leverages large-scale human demonstration data to learn interaction patterns, which are then transferred to robotic end-effectors, enabling robust manipulation in these variable settings. Quantitative validation, including the utility of active vision on disassembled components in practice, is expected to form an important part of future work.

AI.tldr: 提出面向循环制造（拆解）高不确定环境的自主抓取学习框架，显式区分偶然不确定性（噪声/不完整观测）与认知不确定性（知识不足/分布漂移），结合VLM语义空间理解、主动视角规划与人-机演示迁移以提升抓取鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 线性制造环境结构化、物体标准化，可依赖精确模型做预编程动作；而循环制造涉及跨代产品的外观/形变差异、破损表面、杂乱堆叠、遮挡与视角受限，导致组件状态未知及环境非结构化，传统预设方案难以适用。
AI.method: 框架层面区分aleatoric与epistemic不确定性；采用主动感知策略：用视觉语言模型（VLM）实现语义与空间场景理解，并通过视角规划调整相机位姿以降低视觉歧义；同时利用大规模人类演示数据学习交互模式并迁移至机器人末端执行器。
AI.result: 摘要以框架与方法描述为主，定量验证（含主动视觉在实际拆解组件上的效用）被明确列为后续工作，尚未给出实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种不确定性感知+主动视觉+演示迁移的拆解抓取学习范式，方向契合循环制造需求，但缺少实证支撑，需等待定量评估以判断实用性。

title: When Does Looking Closer Pay Off? Simple Foveated ViTs for Fine-Grained Recognition
summary: Fine-grained recognition benefits from high resolution, but not every image region needs it. We study a foveated Vision Transformer (FoVT) that uses last-block class attention from a 224-pixel glance to select regions for refinement. Fine patches from the 448-pixel image replace the selected coarse cells, and the same backbone classifies the mixed-resolution input. We evaluate FoVT on five benchmarks with two seeds and 26 configurations per dataset. Attention beats random selection on all five benchmarks, by up to 2.45 percentage points overall and 4.18 points on the smallest objects. At equal transformer cost, Holm-corrected tests detect no FoVT deficit relative to a port of the official CF-ViT, but no dataset shows a corrected FoVT advantage in both seeds. FoVT requires no feature reuse, distillation loss, or selection schedule. Reusing coarse features shows no significant benefit and costs 1 to 3 points when the reuse module is trained at the head learning rate. Skipping refinement for the most confident 19 to 24 percent of images leaves accuracy unchanged to two decimal places. At the transformer cost of uniform 336-pixel inference, gated FoVT improves accuracy on four benchmarks, with the largest gains on NABirds and FGVC-Aircraft and no significant gain on Stanford Dogs. Foveation primarily saves computation: relative to a uniform 448-pixel model trained with the same auxiliary glance loss, ungated FoVT uses 44 percent fewer transformer operations, with no significant accuracy difference on four benchmarks and a 0.53-point deficit on FGVC-Aircraft. Wall-clock savings are smaller than the reduction in transformer operations.

AI.tldr: FoVT uses last-block class attention from a 224px "glance" to select cells refined with 448px patches, classifying mixed-resolution input with one backbone; foveation mainly saves compute rather than improving accuracy.
AI.motivation: Fine-grained recognition benefits from high resolution, yet not all image regions need it; the goal is to spend high-resolution computation only where it matters.
AI.method: A foveated ViT: coarse 224px pass, last-block class-attention scores select cells, selected cells replaced by 448px fine patches, same backbone classifies the mixed-resolution token set. Ablations include attention vs. random selection, feature reuse, gated variant, early exit for confident images, and config/seed sweeps (26 configs, 2 seeds, 5 benchmarks) with Holm-corrected comparisons against CF-ViT.
AI.result: Attention selection beats random on all 5 benchmarks (up to +2.45 pts overall, +4.18 on smallest objects). No Holm-corrected deficit vs. ported CF-ViT at equal transformer cost, but no corrected advantage in both seeds. Feature reuse gives no significant gain (−1 to −3 pts with head-LR training). Skipping refinement for the 19–24% most confident images leaves accuracy unchanged. Gated FoVT at 336px-level cost improves 4 benchmarks (largest on NABirds, FGVC-Aircraft; no significant gain on Stanford Dogs). Ungated FoVT uses 44% fewer transformer ops than uniform 448px with same glance loss, no significant accuracy difference except −0.53 pts on FGVC-Aircraft; wall-clock savings smaller than op savings.
AI.conclusion: Foveation's value is computational efficiency at near-uniform-448 accuracy, not accuracy gains; simple attention-based selection needs no feature reuse, distillation, or selection schedule.

title: Feasibility of Multifrequency Neural Network-Based Wave Inversion in Ultrasound Time-Harmonic Elastography
summary: Ultrasound time-harmonic elastography (THE) is a non-invasive imaging technique that measures soft-tissue stiffness. Relying on the same principle of time-harmonic shear wave excitation as established magnetic resonance elastography (MRE), THE offers full field-of-view stiffness mapping at short acquisition times and sub-second temporal resolution across organs. However, reconstruction of shear wave speed maps from acquired tissue wavefields remains challenging due to speckle noise and sparse spatial coverage of the lateral component. Deep learning methods have shown promising results for image reconstruction in transient-based ultrasound elastography modalities but remain unexplored in THE. In MRE, MF-ElastoNet, a 2D multifrequency neural network-based wave reconstruction method trained on synthetic physics-based wave data, has shown high generalizability across dynamic ranges and resolutions. We investigated the potential of a multifrequency neural network-based wave inversion for THE, by performing a first feasibility analysis. To this end, we adapted the processing pipeline of MF-ElastoNet from MRE to THE. We tested our approach on THE acquired phantom data from the algorithms for mapping elastic modulus Challenge, as well as on in vivo liver THE in 4 healthy volunteers and 14 patients with focal liver lesions, including benign focal nodular hyperplasia, and malignant hepatocellular carcinoma and adenocarcinoma. MF-ElastoNet was successfully adapted to THE with in vivo liver testing. Compared with k-MDEV, the state-of-the-art wave inversion method for THE, Bland-Altman analysis showed a mean bias of -0.02 m/s (95% limits of agreement: -0.36 to 0.33 m/s).

AI.tldr: 将MRE的多频神经网络波反演方法MF-ElastoNet的流程迁移到超声时谐弹性成像（THE），在体模与18例在体肝脏数据上与k-MDEV对比，平均偏差仅-0.02 m/s。
AI.motivation: THE可在短时间内获得全视场刚度图，但从含斑点噪声、横向分量稀疏的组织波场重建剪切波速度图仍很困难；深度学习反演在瞬态超声弹性成像中已有成效，但在THE中尚未探索，而MF-ElastoNet在MRE中表现出良好的泛化性。
AI.method: 将MF-ElastoNet（基于物理合成波数据训练的二维多频神经网络波重建方法）的处理管线从MRE适配到THE；在Challenge体模数据以及4名健康志愿者和14名局灶性肝病变患者的在体肝脏THE数据上测试，并与THE最新反演方法k-MDEV进行Bland-Altman一致性分析。
AI.result: MF-ElastoNet成功适配THE并完成在体肝脏验证；与k-MDEV相比，平均偏差-0.02 m/s，95%一致性界限-0.36~0.33 m/s，显示出良好一致性。
AI.conclusion: 多频神经网络波反演在超声时谐弹性成像中具备可行性，可作为传统k-MDEV的替代/补充；但本研究为初步可行性分析，样本量有限（18例），未来需更大规模与多器官验证。

title: $\varepsilon$-SegFormer: Multi-Resolution Vision Transformers for Sparsely Supervised Segmentation in Electron Microscopy
summary: Segmenting organelles in electron microscopy (EM) volumes requires dense annotations that take experts months to produce, and every gain in imaging resolution adds to this cost. Sparsely supervised methods reduce this cost to a small fraction of labeled pixels, but the convolutional networks they build on see a limited neighborhood around each pixel, while the identity of an organelle often depends on context far beyond it. We introduce $\varepsilon$-SegFormer, a multi-resolution Vision Transformer for sparsely supervised semantic segmentation, which builds on the architecture of MuViT and extends the training method of $\varepsilon$-Seg. For each labeled pixel, $\varepsilon$-SegFormer samples views at three physical resolutions centered on it, embeds their patches into a single token sequence, and encodes every token's position in image coordinates, so that attention relates all views in one shared frame. A segmentation head classifies the pixel from the tokens around it; during training, the pixel's own token is hidden, so the label must be predicted from context rather than local appearance. The model is trained in a single stage, without pretraining, with an auxiliary reconstruction loss. On the BetaSeg FIB-SEM dataset, $\varepsilon$-SegFormer learns from about 10,000 labeled pixels among the 670 million voxels inside three cells, and, given the cell mask, segments nuclei, mitochondria and insulin granules in a slice of a fourth, unseen cell with an average Dice of 0.89 (0.91 after post-processing). Ablations show that coarser views improve accuracy and that a compact head on local tokens works best, with the wider context entering through attention in the encoder.

AI.tldr: 提出 ε-SegFormer，一种多分辨率 Vision Transformer，用于稀疏监督的 EM 体数据语义分割：对每个标注像素在三种物理分辨率上采样视图，将各视图 patch 嵌入为单一 token 序列并编码图像坐标位置，通过注意力在共享坐标系中关联多尺度上下文；训练时遮蔽该像素自身 token，强制由上下文预测标签。
AI.motivation: EM 体数据密集标注成本极高（专家数月），成像分辨率提升进一步加剧成本；稀疏监督可降低成本，但卷积网络受感受野限制，而细胞器身份往往依赖远距离上下文。
AI.method: 基于 MuViT 架构、扩展 ε-Seg 训练范式：每个标注像素为中心采样三个物理分辨率视图，patch 嵌入拼接为单 token 序列，token 带图像坐标位置编码，使注意力在统一坐标系中融合所有视图；分割头从周围 token 分类该像素；训练时隐藏像素自身 token 以防止局部外观泄漏；单阶段训练、无需预训练，配辅助重建损失。
AI.result: 在 BetaSeg FIB-SEM 数据集上，三个细胞内 6.7 亿体素中仅用约 1 万标注像素训练，给定细胞掩码，在第四个未见细胞切片上分割细胞核、线粒体和胰岛素颗粒，平均 Dice 0.89（后处理 0.91）。消融显示更粗尺度的视图提升精度，局部 token 上的紧凑分割头最佳，更广上下文通过编码器注意力引入。
AI.conclusion: 多分辨率 ViT + 像素 token 遮蔽的稀疏监督范式有效利用远距离上下文，显著降低 EM 分割标注成本并具备跨细胞泛化能力；尺度融合应置于编码器注意力而非分割头。

title: EvoTER: Evolving Embodied Agents via Tool-Use Experience and Reflection
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks require agents to ground instructions in changing observations, coordinate heterogeneous tools, and recover from failures that can propagate through downstream operations. Although existing LLM-based agents retain experience and refine reusable skills, successful local repairs do not by themselves establish complete-task gains over the current shared procedure library. We present EvoTER, an experience-driven framework that enables embodied agents to self-evolve tool-use skills without updating model parameters. EvoTER operates through a three-role evolution loop: Explorer records tool-use trajectories; Diagnoser distills successful and failed executions into skills for tool selection, parameter computation, postcondition checks, and recovery; and Validator retains candidate revisions only when they improve complete-task success in fresh sessions. In simulation, EvoTER improves overall task success from a pre-evolution baseline of 53.60% to 80.40%. In real-world experiments, simulation initialization reduces the attempts required to acquire short-horizon skills, while continued real-world evolution improves long-horizon success from 20% to 80%-100% across tasks and enables the evolving skill library to incorporate new tool functionality introduced after simulation development. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: EvoTER：无需更新模型参数的经验驱动具身智能体工具使用技能自进化框架，通过 Explorer–Diagnoser–Validator 三角色循环演化工序库，仿真任务成功率 53.60%→80.40%，真机长时序任务 20%→80-100%。
AI.motivation: 长时序具身任务要求智能体将指令落地到动态观测中、协调异构工具并从会向下游传播的错误中恢复；现有 LLM 智能体虽能积累经验并精炼可复用技能，但局部修复成功未必带来相对当前共享工序库的完整任务增益，且需避免昂贵的参数微调。
AI.method: 三阶段进化闭环：(1) Explorer 采集工具使用轨迹；(2) Diagnoser 将成功/失败执行蒸馏为技能，覆盖工具选择、参数计算、后置条件检查与错误恢复；(3) Validator 仅在全新会话中提升完整任务成功率时保留候选修订。技能库以共享工序库形式迭代更新，冻结模型参数。
AI.result: 仿真环境中整体任务成功率由进化前基线 53.60% 提升至 80.40%；真机实验中，仿真初始化降低了短时序技能获取所需尝试次数，持续真机进化使长时序任务成功率从 20% 提升至各任务 80%–100%，且进化后的技能库能吸收仿真开发之后新增的工具功能。
AI.conclusion: 以完整任务成功率作为验证门槛的技能库进化，可在不更新参数的前提下实现具身工具使用能力的可迁移、可扩展自提升；仿真技能可作为真机冷启动，真机持续进化则补足长时序能力并保持对新工具的适应性。

title: Generalist Action Critic: Harnessing Frontier Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: Frontier models have demonstrated remarkable general-purpose reasoning capabilities, opening new possibilities for intelligent decision making in the physical world. In autonomous driving, many recent approaches seek to leverage these capabilities through additional adaptation for action output, particularly in scenarios where existing models underperform. We introduce Generalist Action Critic (GAC), a zero-shot framework that combines frontier models' general-purpose reasoning with the planning competence of specialized driving models through an inference-time harness. In GAC, specialized planners generate multiple candidate trajectories and make an initial selection, while a frozen frontier model serves as an action critic that assesses the selected trajectory against scene evidence and either retains it or reselects from the available candidates. The harness combines camera images with spatial overlays, provides driving context and reasoning principles through textual instructions, and regulates the information available at each stage to support trajectory assessment and reselection. On HUGSIM, GAC raises DrivoR's HD-Score to 43.2, achieving state-of-the-art performance among methods trained without additional simulation data. GAC also consistently improves closed-loop driving safety across three planners, with relative HD-Score gains of up to 32.1%. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 further reveal how GAC improves planning performance by correcting up to 52.13% of eligible unsafe trajectory selections while introducing new failures in only 0.67% of originally high-quality selections. These results demonstrate the potential of harnessing frontier models to improve driving safety through inference-time cooperation with specialized planners.

AI.tldr: GAC 是一个零样本推理时框架：由专用驾驶规划器生成多条候选轨迹并初选，冻结的前沿模型作为"动作批评家"基于带空间叠加的相机图像与文本指令评估该轨迹，决定保留或改选候选，在 HUGSIM 上把 DrivoR 的 HD-Score 提升到 43.2（无额外仿真数据训练方法中的 SOTA），NAVSIM v1 上纠正最多 52.13% 的不安全选择而仅引入 0.67% 新失效。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型具备通用推理能力，但在自动驾驶动作输出上直接适配成本高且不可靠；而已有专用规划器在其表现不佳的场景容易出错。作者希望在不训练/微调前沿模型的前提下，利用其推理能力对专用规划器的轨迹选择做推理时校正。
AI.method: 推理期 harness（零样本、模型冻结）：(1) 专用规划器生成多条候选轨迹并做初始选择；(2) 冻结的前沿模型作为 action critic，在结合相机图像与空间叠加（spatial overlays）的多模态输入、以及文本形式给出的驾驶上下文与推理原则下，评估被选轨迹是否符合场景证据；(3) 输出保留原选择或从候选中重新选择；(4) 通过分阶段调控可见信息量来支撑评估与改选，避免信息过载或泄题式偏差。
AI.result: HUGSIM 上 DrivoR 的 HD-Score 提升至 43.2，为未使用额外仿真数据训练方法中的 SOTA；在三种规划器上闭环安全性一致提升，HD-Score 相对增益最高 32.1%；NAVSIM v1 上纠正最多 52.13% 的可纠正不安全轨迹选择，仅在 0.67% 原本高质量选择上引入新失败。
AI.conclusion: 将前沿模型与专用规划器以推理时协同（critic + 候选重选）方式组合，可在不训练、不改动驾驶模型的情况下稳定提升安全性与规划指标，且误伤率低，说明"通用推理 + 专用先验"的组合优于单独任一方。

title: Refrain: Learning Multi-Shot Consistency from Inconsistent References for A$^2$O Video Generation
summary: A comic-book character, a photorealistic cityscape, an oil-painted coffee cup -- such stylistically diverse references provide visual guidance across shots and frames, yet generating a coherent multi-shot video that unifies their visual styles while preserving subject identities and scene content remains challenging. Existing methods maintain cross-shot continuity through additional attention control or memory processing. However, they struggle to resolve disparate per-shot styles or handle reference-target duration mismatches within a single framework. We introduce Refrain, a unified model that learns cross-shot consistency through a self-supervised reconstruction task. Reference clips from the same original video are deliberately perturbed with distinct visual edits, and the model recovers the unedited source footage under a shared style prompt. The resulting pipeline yields DurMix-300K, which pairs independently edited references of varying durations with their original videos. Operating on the A$^2$O principle (Any Reference, Any Duration, One Timeline), Refrain maps image and video references onto a shared temporal canvas without auxiliary conditioning modules. For evaluation, experiments show that standard CLIP or DINO metrics frequently overlook stylistic clashes or misinterpret intended narrative cuts as inconsistency. We propose Shot-Debiased Consistency (SDC), which uses an extensive real-video bank to establish a baseline for style variation associated with content changes within shots. By discounting this baseline divergence, SDC evaluates cross-shot style shifts against real-world distributions, where smaller residual differences indicate higher stylistic continuity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Refrain achieves state-of-the-art performance in cross-shot consistency, while excelling at shot timing, reference adherence, and text alignment.

AI.tldr: Refrain：以自监督重建任务（对同源参考片段施加不同风格扰动，再在统一风格提示下恢复原视频）学习跨镜头一致性，支持任意参考、任意时长、单时间线；并提出Shot-Debiased Consistency（SDC）评测指标。
AI.motivation: 多镜头视频生成中，各镜头引用风格迥异（漫画、写实、油画等），现有基于额外注意力控制或记忆处理的方法难以在单一框架内同时解决逐镜头风格不一致与参考-目标时长不匹配问题。
AI.method: 自监督式重建训练：对同一原始视频的参考片段施加不同的视觉编辑扰动，模型需在共享风格提示下重建未编辑源视频，从而内生地学到跨镜头一致性与主体身份保持；由此构建DurMix-300K数据集（不同时长的独立编辑参考与原视频配对）。模型遵循A²O原则，将图像与视频参考映射到共享时间画布，无需辅助条件模块。评测上提出SDC，用大规模真实视频库建立"镜头内内容变化引起的风格差异"基线，扣除该基线后在真实分布下衡量跨镜头风格漂移。
AI.result: 实验表明标准CLIP/DINO指标常忽略风格冲突、或把有意的叙事切镜误判为不一致；Refrain在跨镜头一致性上达到SOTA，并在镜头时序、参考遵循度与文本对齐方面表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 统一的参考条件多镜头视频生成可通过自监督重建范式实现，且一致性评测需引入去偏的真实分布基线；该方法对视频生成与评测均有参考价值，但与视觉/机器人基础模型核心议题关联较间接。

title: Redesigning Neural Networks to Not be Confidently Wrong even to Strong Adversarial Attacks
summary: Early deep learning models attempted to simulate visual perception using a neural hierarchy that alternated between two types of layer: one modelled on cortical simple cells (that was designed to increase selectivity), and one modelled on cortical complex cells (that aimed to increase tolerance). We show that such a neural network (NN) architecture, when implemented with novel components that are better able to learn selective and tolerant representations, is capable of accurate and robust image classification and improved alignment between the behaviour of the model and the perceptual abilities of humans. Firstly, the proposed models are shallow, fewer than ten layer-pairs, which is more consistent with the rapid feedforward object categorisation performed by the biological visual system. Secondly, they are far less prone to producing classification predictions with high confidence for samples from unknown classes or for image consisting of pure noise, and hence, like humans are not easily fooled into perceiving objects that are not present in the image. Thirdly, for the proposed NNs adversarial samples cause predictions with low confidence, enabling them to be accurately identified. In contrast to humans, our networks still do not correctly classify adversarial samples. However, the behaviour of our networks is a significant step towards human-like behaviour compared to standard DNNs that produce highly confident, but incorrect, classification predictions for adversarial samples. The increased robustness to adversarial and unknown samples is achieved while maintaining competitive performance in terms of generalisation to novel samples from the training categories. This enables models of this type to be competitive with state-of-the-art DNNs across multiple different evaluation metrics and benchmark tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种浅层（<10 层对）"简单细胞/复杂细胞"交替的类皮层神经网络，用新组件学习选择性与容错性表征，在保持泛化性能的同时显著提升对噪声、未知类与对抗样本的置信度校准与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 早期深度学习用简单细胞层（提升选择性）与复杂细胞层（提升容错性）交替的层级模拟视觉感知。作者希望验证：若用更强的学习组件实现该结构，能否同时获得准确、鲁棒且更贴近人类感知行为的模型——尤其是浅层前馈结构、不被噪声/未知类"欺骗"、对对抗样本给出低置信度。
AI.method: 构建浅层（少于十个"简单-复杂"层对）的层级网络，取代标准深度 CNN 的深层堆叠；每对层分别侧重增强选择性与容错性表征。在多个基准任务上评估：分类精度与泛化、对纯噪声与未知类样本的置信度分布、对抗样本下的置信度与可检测性，并与标准 DNN 及人类感知特性对照。
AI.result: 所提网络在以下方面优于标准 DNN：（1）层数少，符合生物视觉快速前馈物体识别的特点；（2）对未知类别样本与纯噪声图像极少给出高置信度错误预测；（3）对抗样本仅引发低置信度预测，从而可被准确识别（但仍不能正确分类对抗样本）；（4）在训练类新样本上的泛化性能与 SOTA 相当，因而在多指标、多基准上具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以生物启发的浅层简单/复杂细胞层级替代深层标准网络，可在不牺牲泛化精度的前提下改善置信度校准与对抗/异常样本鲁棒性，使模型行为更接近人类感知；但其对对抗样本的正确分类仍未解决，属于朝类人鲁棒性迈出的重要一步。

title: BRINA: Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE, a Sonar SLAM for Autonomous Marine Vehicles
summary: Forward-looking sonar (FLS) provides reliable underwater perception where optical sensing is limited, but its use for navigation is hindered by the unobserved elevation of each return. As a result, motion estimated directly from sonar images suffers from an unknown metric scale that is commonly resolved using a Doppler velocity log (DVL). We present BRINA (Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE), a sonar-inertial SLAM system for marine vehicles that uses the FLS as its only exteroceptive sensor. BRINA estimates the sonar altitude from the first seabed return in each beam and uses it to project matched features onto the seabed, providing metric odometry without a DVL. We further derive a bound relating the remaining scale error to seabed tilt and slope variability. The method is evaluated in simulation with an autonomous underwater vehicle, and in field experiments with uncrewed surface vehicles over ten missions, using two FLS systems under different operating conditions.

AI.tldr: BRINA是一个仅用前视声呐(FLS)作为外部传感器的声呐-惯导SLAM系统，通过每个波束首个海底回波估计声呐高度，将匹配特征投影到海底以获得无需DVL的米制里程计，并推导了残余尺度误差与海底倾斜/坡度变化的误差界。
AI.motivation: FLS在水下光照受限环境下感知可靠，但每次回波的高程未知，导致从声呐图像直接估计的运动存在未知米制尺度，通常需依赖DVL解算，增加了硬件成本与依赖。
AI.method: 以FLS为唯一外部传感器构建声呐-惯性SLAM：从每束首个海底回波估计声呐对海底高度，将匹配特征反投影到海底平面，结合惯性预积分实现米制尺度可观测的里程计；并给出残余尺度误差与海底倾角、坡度变异性的解析误差界。评估包括AUV仿真与两套FLS、十次无人水面艇实海试验。
AI.result: 在仿真(AUV)与多任务实海试验(USV、两套FLS、不同工况)中验证了在无DVL条件下获得米制尺度里程计/定位的能力，并量化了尺度误差受海底几何条件约束的关系。
AI.conclusion: 利用海底底回波几何可将FLS的尺度不可观问题转化为可解的约束，实现不依赖DVL的水下声呐-惯性SLAM，适用于结构化海底环境下的水下航行器导航。

title: Underwater Spectral Recovery via Multi-View Hyperspectral Imaging
comment: Preprint. Code and data can be shared upon publication. 27 pages (15 main, 12 appendix), 12 figures
summary: Underwater imaging suffers from wavelength-dependent absorption and scattering that distort scenes and obscure spectral signatures. While RGB restoration improves visual clarity, the outputs remain broadband and tied to the sensor's color space. We introduce a physically grounded framework that lifts underwater restoration to continuous spectral radiance using multi-view hyperspectral imaging. By representing continuous spectra via low-rank basis functions and leveraging multi-distance observations, our framework jointly constrains scene radiance and water parameters. We employ a robust sparse-to-dense pipeline: water parameters are estimated from consistent multi-view matches and then applied globally to invert the light transport model across the full images. Validated on physics-based synthetic data rendered via the Mitsuba 3 spectral path tracer, our method recovers physically meaningful radiance spectra and, as a downstream application, outperforms standard image restoration baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出基于多视角高光谱成像的水下连续光谱辐射恢复框架：用低秩基函数表示连续光谱，结合多距离观测联合约束场景辐射与水介质参数，采用稀疏到稠密流程先估计水体参数再全局反演光传输模型。
AI.motivation: RGB水下复原仅提升视觉清晰度，输出仍为宽波段且绑定传感器色彩空间，无法恢复被波长相关吸收与散射扭曲的光谱特征。
AI.method: 低秩基函数连续光谱表示 + 多距离/多视角观测联合约束；稀疏-稠密pipeline：由一致多视角匹配估计水体参数，再全局反演光传输模型作用于全图。
AI.result: 在Mitsuba 3光谱路径追踪器渲染的物理合成数据上验证，可恢复物理意义明确的辐射光谱，下游图像复原任务优于标准基线。
AI.conclusion: 将水下复原提升至连续光谱辐射层面，但仅在合成数据上验证，缺乏真实水下采集实验。

title: Humanoid robots for safety-critical electrical switching: A perception-informed runtime constraint filter
summary: Humanoid robots can reduce personnel exposure in electrical switching, but safe control is challenging because the tool must reach a target switch next to similar devices, where an imprecise operator command can contact a non-target switch. This study proposes a runtime safety filter that checks each operator command during virtual-reality teleoperation of a humanoid robot. The filter integrates a scene model estimated from the robot head camera and a target-conditioned control barrier function quadratic program that keeps the tool away from the non-target switch while passing safe commands unchanged. In real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, with six rounds at each of two standing positions, target operations succeed in all ten rounds with an unchanged target and no non-target actuation. A simulation study achieves 9/9 safe completions, compared with 5/9 for raw teleoperation, demonstrating the feasibility of the method for humanoid switching operations.

AI.tldr: 提出运行时安全滤波器，结合头相机场景模型与目标条件控制障碍函数QP，约束人形机器人在VR遥操作中工具远离非目标开关。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人用于电气倒闸可减少人员暴露，但目标开关旁存在相似设备，操作者的不精确指令可能误触非目标开关，需要运行时安全保障。
AI.method: 基于机器人头部相机估计场景模型，构建目标条件控制障碍函数二次规划（CBF-QP）安全滤波器，在VR遥操作中逐条校验指令，安全指令保持不变放行，危险指令被修正以保持工具与非目标开关的安全距离。
AI.result: Unitree G1实机两站姿各六轮实验：目标操作全部成功，无任何非目标开关被误动；仿真中9/9安全完成，而原始遥操作为5/9。
AI.conclusion: 验证了CBF-QP安全滤波在人形机器人开关操作中的可行性，可作为结构化高风险场景下遥操作安全层。

title: DGC-Net: A Depth-Geometric Conditioning Network for Projection-Supervised OCTA Segmentation
summary: OCTA segmentation is commonly formulated as a projection supervised task: models observe 3D volumetric scans but are supervised by 2D en-face semantic maps. Existing 2D and 3D-to-2D methods either discard axial information or compress depth responses into latent projections, leaving vessel crossings, diffuse capillary regions, and FAZ boundaries vulnerable to projection-induced ambiguity. We propose DGC-Net, a Depth-Geometric Conditioning Network that recasts 3D-to-2D OCTA segmentation as depth-geometrically conditioned prediction, where projected features are decoded with compact descriptors of axial vascular evidence. DGC-Net preserves local depth geometry through Depth-Moment Conditioning (DM), which injects axial localization and dispersion cues into the projection stream, and captures global depth layout through Holistic Depth-Geometry Modulation (HDM), which derives a raw-volume axial prior for final 2D decoding. Experiments on the OCTA-500 6mm and 3mm subsets show that DGC-Net achieves 83.58% and 88.62% mIoU, respectively, reaching state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: DGC-Net将3D-to-2D OCTA分割重构为"深度几何条件化预测"，通过Depth-Moment Conditioning注入轴向定位与离散度线索、Holistic Depth-Geometry Modulation提供全局轴向先验，在OCTA-500上达83.58%/88.62% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有OCTA分割采用投影监督范式，2D方法丢弃轴向信息，3D-to-2D方法将深度响应压缩为隐式投影，导致血管交叉、弥散毛细血管区与FAZ边界出现投影歧义。作者希望显式保留轴向血管证据的几何描述以消除歧义。
AI.method: 提出Depth-Geometric Conditioning Network（DGC-Net）：(1) Depth-Moment Conditioning (DM) 将轴向定位与离散度统计量注入投影特征流，保留局部深度几何；(2) Holistic Depth-Geometry Modulation (HDM) 从原始体数据导出全局轴向先验，用于最终2D解码调制。整体为3D体扫描输入→深度几何条件化→2D en-face语义输出。
AI.result: 在OCTA-500 6mm与3mm子集上分别取得83.58%与88.62% mIoU，达到当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 用紧凑的轴向血管证据描述符替代隐式深度压缩，可有效缓解投影诱导歧义，验证了深度几何条件化在3D-to-2D投影监督任务中的有效性；但属医学影像专用分割，缺乏与通用3D表征/具身智能的衔接证据。

title: Anchors That Move Without Collapsing: Exclusive-Region Anchor Routing for Vision Transformers
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Anchor tokens let a vision transformer exchange global information through a few summaries, but nothing forces different anchors to summarise different things. On one shared backbone we show that a Perceiver-style pathway and an AnchorFormer pathway collapse to a single summary, the latter despite its mass normalisation (pooling-map similarity 0.99), while other soft pathways, including Representative Attention, stay partly redundant (0.59-0.79). These results concern the routing modules inside our block, not the full published models. An exclusive partition of the patch grid cannot collapse by construction, and matched component by component it is 2.4-3.6 points more accurate than Representative Attention on CIFAR-100. We then propose focus anchors, which place most anchors at the peaks of a learned importance map while all anchors keep one exclusive Voronoi partition. Focus anchors beat a fixed partition on a cluttered canvas (+1.5 points, 95% CI [0.5, 2.6]) but not on full-HD traffic-sign recognition. There, both variants match dense attention with local windows at about a fifth of its FLOPs, and the fixed partition also trains 1.5x faster per step than dense attention with FlashAttention, though both use more memory; a ViT on a downsampled input loses half its mean average precision. Hard exclusive assignment is the only region assignment we tested that is both stable and most accurate: softmax and Sinkhorn relaxations diverge, and Gumbel-softmax trains but is less accurate. We also report the limits: a ResNet-18 is more accurate on every task we trained it on in this from-scratch regime, and anchors train faster than FlashAttention only from about 1536x1536 pixels and never use less memory.

AI.tldr: 该文系统分析了视觉 Transformer 中 anchor token 路由模块的冗余问题：Perceiver 式与 AnchorFormer 通路会崩塌为单一摘要，而硬性互斥 Voronoi 分区不会崩塌且更准确；进而提出 focus anchors（在学习到的显著性峰值放置锚点、共享互斥分区），在杂乱场景上优于固定分区，但在真实交通标志识别上无提升，且仅约 1536×1536 以上像素才比 FlashAttention 训练更快。
AI.motivation: Anchor token 让 ViT 通过少量摘要交换全局信息，但无机制约束不同 anchor 总结不同内容，存在路由冗余/崩塌风险；作者希望量化该崩塌现象并找到稳定、准确且高效的区域分配方案替代稠密注意力的高 FLOPs。
AI.method: 在共享骨干上对比多种 soft 路由（Perceiver通路、AnchorFormer、Representative Attention）的池化图相似度；提出 exclusive Voronoi 硬分区（构造上不可崩塌），并进一步提出 focus anchors：在学习到的 importance map 峰值处放置多数锚点，所有锚点保持同一互斥 Voronoi 分区；逐组件 matched 对比 Representative Attention；将 hard assignment 与 softmax、Sinkhorn、Gumbel-softmax 松弛对比；在 CIFAR-100、杂乱画布检测、全高清交通标志识别任务上测量精度、FLOPs、训练速度与显存。
