AI.result: Perceiver 与 AnchorFormer 崩塌为单一摘要（池化图相似度 0.99），Representative Attention 仍部分冗余（0.59–0.79）。固定互斥分区在 CIFAR-100 上逐组件对齐后比 Representative Attention 高 2.4–3.6 点。Focus anchors 在杂乱画布上比固定分区 +1.5 点（95% CI [0.5, 2.6]），但在全高清交通标志识别上无优势；该任务上两种变体以约 1/5 FLOPs 追平带局部窗口的稠密注意力，固定分区每步训练比 FlashAttention 快 1.5×（但显存占用更高）；下采样输入的 ViT mAP 下降一半。Hard assignment 是唯一既稳定又最准确的方案，softmax/Sinkhorn 发散，Gumbel-softmax 可训练但精度较低。局限：ResNet-18 在同一从零训练设定下各任务均更准；锚点仅在约 1536×1536 以上像素时训练快于 FlashAttention，且从不省显存。
AI.conclusion: 硬性互斥区域分配是实现稳定且准确保留 anchor 路由的关键；focus anchors 在杂乱场景有增益但非普适（真实交通标志任务无收益）。该效率/精度优势在非常大分辨率下才成立，且从头训练时不及 ResNet-18，适用性受限。

title: ENC-QA: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Electronic Navigational Charts
summary: Nautical charts encode safety-critical maritime information through standardized symbols, attributes, text, and heterogeneous geometries. Interpreting these charts and assessing the navigational significance of successive chart updates requires recognizing nautical features, determining their spatial relationships, and applying navigational knowledge. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising approach to nautical-chart interpretation, yet systematic evaluation of their fine-grained nautical feature recognition, chart-based spatial reasoning, and application of navigational knowledge to assessing chart changes remains limited. We introduce ENC-QA, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 77,312 questions derived from 6,612 National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Electronic Navigational Charts (ENCs). The benchmark evaluates four complementary capabilities: ENC Perception, Spatial Reasoning, Joint Perception and Spatial Reasoning, and Application. Of these, 8,227 questions form a progressive subset that decomposes selected chart-change cases into linked questions progressing from change detection to criticality assessment, enabling case-level analysis of how models use perceptual and spatial evidence to determine the navigational significance of chart changes. Evaluations of 10 open-weight VLMs reveal substantial limitations in fine-grained nautical feature recognition and feature-grounded spatial reasoning. Controlled evidence interventions show that relevant perceptual and spatial information improves change-criticality accuracy. Our findings establish ENC-QA as a diagnostic resource for nautical-chart understanding and safety-critical navigational decisions. We will release the benchmark and evaluation code upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出 ENC-QA，一个基于 6,612 张 NOAA 电子海图构建的 77,312 题诊断性基准，系统评测视觉语言模型在海图要素识别、空间推理、联合推理与航海知识应用四方面的能力，并设计 8,227 题的渐进子集解析"变更检测→关键性评估"的证据链。
AI.motivation: 海图以标准化符号、属性、文本与异构几何编码安全关键信息，模型需识别要素、判断空间关系并施加航海知识；现有 VLM 在海图细粒度识别、图内空间推理与海图变更航海意义评估上缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 从官方 ENC 数据自动构建多层级 QA：按 ENC Perception、Spatial Reasoning、Joint、Application 四类能力划分；对部分海图变更案例构建"变更检测→关键性判定"的链式渐进问题；对 10 个开源权重 VLM 进行评测，并通过受控证据干预（提供相关感知/空间证据）分析模型对证据的利用方式。
AI.result: 10 个开放权重 VLM 在细粒度航海要素识别与基于要素的空间推理上表现显著不足；受控证据注入可提升变更关键性判断准确率，说明模型主要受限于感知与空间证据获取而非知识缺失。
AI.conclusion: ENC-QA 为海图理解与安全关键航海决策提供诊断资源，揭示当前 VLM 在专业符号化地图上的能力边界；属基准/评测类工作，方法学贡献在于任务分解与证据干预设计，未涉及机器人、3D 重建或世界模型等核心方向的算法创新。

title: OpenAHBU: Open-sourced Automatic Human Behaviour Understanding Toolkit Through Facial Behaviour Analysis
summary: Automatic facial behaviour understanding (AFBU) is fundamental to various human-centred applications, yet existing academically available toolkits offer limited functionality, closed training pipelines, and weak generalisation. This paper presents OpenAHBU, a fully open-sourced, generalisable toolkit integrating 11 AFBU functions across three semantic levels: (i) short-term external facial attributes, including landmarks, blendshapes, Action Units, and expressions; (ii) short-term facial behaviour-related human psychological states, including valence/arousal and pain; and (iii) long-term facial behaviour-related psychological traits, including depression and personality. Particularly, we re-developed eight functions, where at least four deep learning models covering different computational complexities are developed for each function, providing flexible deployment on resource-constrained and high-throughput computing scenarios. More importantly, models of most functions are trained on a comprehensive corpus aggregating multiple academically available datasets, ensuring robust cross-dataset this http URL addition, we include a Synergistic Multi-task Enhancement (SMTE) module to efficiently and adaptively enhance each OpenAHBU function by leveraging the complementary cues contained in its most-related support function's this http URL evaluations demonstrate that our OpenAHBU outperformed existing open-source toolkits not only in functional coverage but also the predictive performances, while providing superior deployment flexibility across diverse computational this http URL fully publicly available training and inference scripts, pre-trained weights, user-friendly GUI, Python library, and cross-platform compatibility, our OpenAHBU provides a reproducible, scalable and extensible toolkit at this https URL .

AI.tldr: OpenAHBU：全开源、可泛化的面部行为理解工具包，整合11项功能（地标/Blendshape/AU/表情/VA效价唤醒/疼痛/抑郁/人格等），重开发8项功能、每项≥4个不同复杂度模型，并用多数据集聚合语料训练+SMTE多任务增强模块。
AI.motivation: 现有学术可用的AFBU工具包功能有限、训练流程封闭、跨数据集泛化弱，缺乏可复现、可扩展、可灵活部署的统一方案。
AI.method: 按三个语义层级组织11项功能：短期外部面部属性、短时心理状态、长期心理特质；对8个功能重新开发，每个功能提供至少4个不同计算复杂度的深度学习模型以适应边缘与高吞吐场景；多数模型在多个公开数据集聚合语料上训练以提升跨数据集鲁棒性；引入协同多任务增强（SMTE）模块，利用最相关支持功能（support function）的互补线索自适应增强各功能。
AI.result: 评测显示在功能覆盖度、预测性能与部署灵活性上均优于现有开源工具包；提供全公开训练/推理脚本、预训练权重、GUI、Python库及跨平台兼容。
AI.conclusion: OpenAHBU为面部行为理解提供一个开源、可复现、可扩展的统一工具链，便于学术与工程应用落地。

title: LesionAgent: Training-Free Agentic Tumor Tracking and Response Assessment in Longitudinal CT
summary: Every few months, a cancer patient's CT scans decide whether treatment continues. 3D foundation models can now detect, segment, register and track lesions, yet none of them reads the scans as a radiologist does. A radiologist decides which findings are lesions, which are the same lesion months later and whether a new spot means progression, and checks each decision against the extensive rules of a clinical guideline. We introduce LesionAgent, an LLM agent that performs this read end to end without task-specific training. It operates frozen 3D models as tools, acts in 3D through coordinate-labelled views, remembers every lesion across visits in a registry, verifies every model output it relies on, and leaves every number to a deterministic guideline engine. On four public longitudinal CT datasets, LesionAgent tracks more lesions and measures them more accurately than every automatic baseline, and where the same 3D models chained by fixed rules call progression falsely at 33 of 56 follow-ups, it does so twice. On clinical follow-up CTs, it agrees with the radiologists' response at 20 of 23 follow-ups, including every change in response, and without training on DeepLesion, it retrieves more of its lesions than every tracker trained on it (89.0% vs. 87.4%). Its harness, not its LLM, makes the difference: given the same LLM and 3D models but not the harness, Claude Code reaches a detection F1 of 41% and LesionAgent 78%, and an open-weight LLM that can run inside the hospital rises from 6% to 73%. LesionAgent and a napari reading app for any LLM are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LesionAgent 是一个无需任务级训练、由 LLM 驱动的智能体，将冻结的 3D 医学模型作为工具，通过坐标标注视图在三维空间操作、用登记表跨访次记忆病灶、核验模型输出，并将所有数值判定交给确定性指南引擎，端到端复现放射科医生的纵向 CT 阅片流程。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 基础模型虽能检测、分割、配准与追踪病灶，但缺少放射科医生式的整体判读：判定哪些是病灶、跨月是否同一病灶、新发是否代表进展，并逐条对照临床指南规则。固定规则串联模型时假阳性进展判定极多，且放射科医生的读片逻辑（工具编排、跨访次记忆、输出核验、指南合规）未被建模。
AI.method: LesionAgent：不训练任何模块，以冻结的 3D 模型为工具，LLM 通过带坐标标注的视图实现三维空间动作；建立跨访次病灶登记表以维持病灶身份一致性；对每一个依赖的模型输出执行核验（verification）；所有定量与进展判定交由确定性指南引擎计算，避免 LLM 直接给数值。提供 napari 读片应用，可与任意 LLM 组合使用。
AI.result: 在 4 个公开纵向 CT 数据集上，追踪病灶数量更多、测量更准，优于所有自动基线；固定规则串联同批 3D 模型在 56 个随访中 33 次误报进展，而 LesionAgent 仅 2 次。临床随访 CT 上与放射科医生应答在 23 个随访中一致 20 个，且覆盖全部应答变化；未在 DeepLesion 上训练，病灶召回仍超过所有在该数据集训练的追踪器（89.0% vs 87.4%）。消融显示性能提升来自 harness 而非 LLM：同一 LLM 与 3D 模型下，Claude Code 检测 F1 为 41%，LesionAgent 为 78%；可院内本地部署的开源权重 LLM 从 6% 提升到 73%。
AI.conclusion: 结论是纵向医学影像判读的关键在于智能体层面（工具编排、三维空间动作表示、跨访次病灶记忆、输出核验、确定性指南引擎），而非更强的 LLM 或更强的 3D 模型本身；该 harness 可显著提升弱 LLM 的可部署性，为医院本地化运行提供路径。但其贡献主要集中于医学影像智能体工程，与机器人操作、VLA、世界模型、三维重建等核心方向仅有方法论层面的弱关联。

title: Interpretable Tissue Architecture Complements Pathology Foundation Models
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
summary: Tissue architecture provides important information for histopathological assessment, yet its complementary predictive value alongside pathology foundation-model representations remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates whether interpretable measurements of cellular and multicellular tissue organization provide additional predictive information beyond learned representations. We introduce a 139-dimensional cellular-to-community representation comprising nine feature groups characterizing nuclear morphology, cellular composition, spatial connectivity, community organization, and cell-cell interactions. Their predictive contributions are systematically evaluated independently and through feature-level fusion with CTransPath and PLIP embeddings using multiple-instance learning (MIL). On the BCNB dataset, estrogen receptor (ER) and progesterone receptor (PR) classification is evaluated across four MIL architectures using five-fold patient-disjoint cross-validation. Selected CTransPath fusion configurations achieved mean ROC-AUC values of 0.9144 (ER) and 0.8360 (PR), while PLIP fusion achieved 0.8791 and 0.8015, respectively. Patient-level analyses identified ER-associated differences in nuclear morphology, graph connectivity, cellular communities, and cell-cell interactions. On LungHist700, selected fusion configurations achieved higher mean ROC-AUC across four classification tasks, including adenocarcinoma versus squamous cell carcinoma (0.7967 versus 0.7137 for CTransPath alone). Overall, these findings suggest that interpretable tissue-architecture descriptors can complement foundation-model representations while providing measurable insights into histopathological organization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个139维的“细胞到群落”组织架构表示（含核形态、细胞组成、空间连通性、群落组织、细胞间相互作用等9组特征），并与CTransPath/PLIP病理基础模型嵌入在MIL框架下做特征级融合，在BCNB（ER/PR分类）与LungHist700（4个分类任务）上验证其互补预测价值。
AI.motivation: 组织架构对组织病理学评估很重要，但其与病理基础模型表征之间的互补预测价值尚不清楚；作者希望探究可解释的细胞/多细胞组织结构测量是否能提供超出学习表征的额外预测信息。
AI.method: 构建139维细胞到群落表示，涵盖核形态、细胞组成、空间连通性、群落组织与细胞间相互作用共9组特征；以独立使用及与CTransPath、PLIP嵌入做特征级融合两种方式，在四种多示例学习（MIL）架构下以五折患者不相交交叉验证评估；并在BCNB（ER/PR）与LungHist700（腺癌vs鳞癌等四任务）上验证，结合患者级分析定位ER相关差异特征。
AI.result: BCNB上，CTransPath融合配置平均ROC-AUC达ER 0.9144、PR 0.8360；PLIP融合为0.8791与0.8015。患者级分析显示ER相关差异体现在核形态、图连通性、细胞群落及细胞间相互作用。LungHist700上融合配置在四项任务上平均ROC-AUC更高，如腺癌vs鳞癌0.7967对比CTransPath单独的0.7137。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的组织架构描述子在基础模型表征之外提供互补预测价值，同时给出可度量的组织病理学组织化洞察，为病理AI的特征融合与可解释性提供了一条低成本、可解释的方向。

title: QuantStream3D: Geometry-Aligned Low-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers
summary: Streaming visual geometry transformers retain historical key-value (KV) states as cross-view geometric memory, but growing caches constrain long-sequence inference. We systematically characterize KV quantization in streaming geometry and uncover two linked challenges: Nonuniform Geometric Sensitivity and Cache-Geometry Mismatch. Quantization sensitivity varies across precision choices and cache locations, while perturbed retrieval changes geometry-head inputs and propagates through subsequent predictions and KV writes. Guided by these findings, we propose QuantStream3D, to our knowledge the first dedicated KV quantization framework for streaming visual geometry transformers. Geometry-Guided Mixed-Precision KV Quantization protects sensitive cross-view evidence, while Geometry-Aligned Quantization-Aware Distillation jointly adapts transformer blocks and geometry heads on student-generated quantized history. Across five benchmarks and two backbones, QuantStream3D achieves near-lossless geometric accuracy in most settings with predominantly 2-bit KV caches, and many configurations surpass unquantized inference. Compared with LLM-oriented KV quantizers, it reduces TUM absolute trajectory error and NeuralRGBD completeness error by up to 57.4% and 69.7%, respectively. Integration with existing native cache-pruning methods further pushes compression while improving reconstruction quality on NeuralRGBD. Our optimized StreamVGGT backend achieves $5.05\times$ physical KV compression and 23.1% lower latency at batch size one. Under a fixed memory budget on the same GPU, it supports $5.4\times$ the maximum batch size and up to $1.67\times$ the peak throughput of unquantized inference. Code and pretrained checkpoints will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: QuantStream3D 是首个面向流式视觉几何 transformer 的 KV 量化框架，通过几何引导混合精度量化与几何对齐量化感知蒸馏，在多数设置下用 2-bit KV 缓存实现近无损甚至更优的几何精度，并带来 5.05× 压缩与 23.1% 延迟下降。
AI.motivation: 流式视觉几何 transformer 将历史 KV 状态作为跨视角几何记忆，但不断增长的缓存严重制约长序列推理。作者系统刻画了该场景下 KV 量化的两个特有问题：非均匀几何敏感性与缓存-几何失配。
AI.method: 1) 分析量化敏感度随精度选择与缓存位置的变化，以及量化检索如何扰动几何头输入并沿后续预测与 KV 写入传播；2) Geometry-Guided Mixed-Precision KV Quantization：对敏感的跨视角证据分配更高精度；3) Geometry-Aligned Quantization-Aware Distillation：在学生生成的量化历史上联合适配 transformer 块与几何头。
AI.result: 五个基准、两个 backbone 上多数配置以 2-bit KV 缓存达到近无损几何精度，部分配置超过未量化推理；相比面向 LLM 的 KV 量化器，TUM 绝对轨迹误差与 NeuralRGBD 完整度误差分别最多降低 57.4% 和 69.7%；与原生缓存剪枝结合可进一步压缩并提升重建质量；优化后 StreamVGGT 后端实现 5.05× 物理 KV 压缩、batch=1 下延迟降低 23.1%，同显存预算下支持 5.4× 最大 batch 与最高 1.67× 峰值吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 面向流式几何的专用 KV 量化显著优于通用 LLM 量化器，具备实用级加速与显存收益，并对下游重建/定位质量近乎无损。

title: AnimalFarm: Auditing the Generation and Detection of Hateful Images Featuring Anthropomorphic Characters
summary: Anthropomorphic non-human characters have long been used to convey hateful messages targeting human groups, from Nazi-era propaganda to recent AI-generated imagery on social media. However, the safety risks posed by such imagery remain largely unexplored. We thus conduct the first systematic study of hateful image generation and detection involving anthropomorphic non-human characters. We construct a benchmark from conservatively screened source scenes, covering five character types and three image generation tasks: text-to-image generation, image editing, and conversational image generation. Across 14,250 scheduled queries, image generation systems produce images for 92.1\% of queries, of which 95.9\% contain hateful content. We further collect 4,370 hateful images and evaluate five popular hateful-content detectors. Even the strongest detector, GPT-5.5, identifies only 73.9\% of hateful images, while most detect fewer than 58\%. Our analysis reveals that existing detectors often misclassify hateful images as benign when their main subjects are non-human characters. We explore two effective mitigation approaches: a training-free pipeline that maps non-human characters back to human representations before classification and a detector fine-tuned for this type of hateful content. These approaches achieve F1 scores of 0.962 and 0.979, respectively. Our findings expose significant safety gaps in both image generation and hateful-content detection. Disclaimer: This paper contains hateful text and imagery.

AI.tldr: 首个系统性研究：以拟人化非人角色（如卡通动物）为载体的仇恨图像生成与检测基准，揭示生成系统与检测器的重大安全缺口，并提出两种有效缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 拟人化非人角色长期被用于传播针对特定人群的仇恨信息（从宣传海报到近期社交媒体上的AI生成图像），但此类图像带来的安全风险几乎未被研究。现有仇恨内容检测器大多基于人类主体训练，面对非人角色是否失效尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建保守筛选源场景的基准，覆盖5类角色、3种生成任务（文生图、图像编辑、对话式图像生成），共14,250条计划查询；收集4,370张仇恨图像，评测5个主流检测器（含GPT-5.5）。提出两种缓解方案：(1) 免训练流水线——先把非人角色映射回人类表征再分类；(2) 针对该类型内容微调的检测器。
AI.result: 生成系统对92.1%的查询成功产出图像，其中95.9%含仇恨内容；最强检测器GPT-5.5仅识别73.9%，多数检测器低于58%。检测器主要失效原因是主体为非人角色时被误判为良性。两种缓解方法F1分别达0.962与0.979。
AI.conclusion: 图像生成与仇恨内容检测两侧均存在显著安全缺口；"非人主体→人类表征映射"与领域微调均能有效修复检测失效，提示检测器需覆盖非人角色语义空间。

title: Star Panoptic Quality: Selectively Evaluating Split and Merged Instances
summary: Detecting individual instances is crucial for many segmentation problems. However, expert instance annotations are often unavailable, so instances are approximated heuristically (e.g., as connected components of semantic maps), which can merge touching objects or split fragmented ones. Even when expert annotations exist, expert disagreement or structural delineation biases can yield split or merged reference instances, corresponding to over- or under-segmentation, respectively. Panoptic Quality (PQ) and related metrics capture both segmentation and detection quality while weighting all instances equally, regardless of size. Yet when the references are biased, these metrics can neither detect split or merged instances nor distinguish valid from invalid overor under-segmentation. We present Star Panoptic Quality (StarPQ), a novel evaluation ramework, which closes this gap in two steps: First, we construct a so-called star forest in the bipartite graph whose clean, merge, and split stars isolate different failure modes. Second, we calculate the final metric by individually weighting each failure mode, allowing practitioners to account for instance delineation biases. Across various experiments, we demonstrate that StarPQ not only enables targeted penalization or eniency towards specific failure modes, but also serves as a diagnostic tool to reveal their prevalence.

AI.tldr: 提出 StarPQ 评估框架，通过二分图中的星形森林把实例分割的 clean/merge/split 三种失效模式分离，并允许对各失效模式单独加权，以应对参考标注偏置导致的过/欠分割。
AI.motivation: PQ 等指标对所有实例等权聚合，当参考实例本身因标注者分歧或结构性偏置而被拆分/合并时，无法区分“有效”与“无效”的过分割与欠分割，也无法检测拆分或合并实例，评价结果失真。
AI.method: 在预测—参考实例的二分图上构建 star forest，将 clean star、merge star、split star 分别对应正确匹配、合并与拆分失效模式；在星结构上单独计算各失效模式的度量，再按可调权重加权得到最终 StarPQ 指标。
AI.result: 多组实验表明 StarPQ 能对特定失效模式进行有针对性的惩罚或宽容，并可作为一种诊断工具揭示数据集中各失效模式的普遍程度。
AI.conclusion: StarPQ 提供了更细粒度、可配置的实例分割评价方式，弥补 PQ 系列指标在参考标注存在偏置时的空白，兼具评价与诊断双重用途。

title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can learn transferable 3D representations directly from calibrated binocular observations. To this end, we introduce StereoVLM, the first geometry-aware binocular VLM for metric 3D spatial reasoning. StereoVLM follows a hierarchical learning paradigm spanning from cross-view correspondence and disparity estimation to calibration-conditioned metric depth perception and semantic spatial reasoning. We further find that disparity supervision generalizes substantially better than direct binocular depth supervision on unseen environments. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Stereo3D-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark across three levels, from point-level geometry to object-level spatial reasoning. StereoVLM-8B achieves 95.17% depth accuracy ($\delta_1$) and a 66.98 average object-level score on Stereo3D-Bench. Intervention results further indicate that the model's performance on Stereo3D-Bench benefits from valid cross-view geometry and cannot be explained solely by additional visual tokens or semantic priors. Hierarchical geometric supervision also yields average gains of 3.54 points across five spatial benchmarks and 4.3 percentage points in RoboCasa manipulation success.

AI.tldr: 提出 StereoVLM，首个几何感知双目 VLM，采用从跨视图对应/视差估计到标定条件化度量深度再到语义空间推理的分层学习范式，并构建 Stereo3D-Bench 三层基准。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 语义理解强但缺乏物理世界度量 3D 空间推理能力；单目或多视图无标定输入下度量 3D 推断本质歧义，难以判断预测是否真正基于视觉证据还是语义先验。标定双目提供显式跨视图几何，可消解歧义。
AI.method: StereoVLM：分层几何监督管线——跨视图对应、视差估计、标定条件化度量深度预测、语义空间推理；并发现视差监督在未见环境上的泛化显著优于直接双目深度监督。配套构建 Stereo3D-Bench（点级几何→物体级空间推理三级评测），并做干预实验（额外视觉 token、语义先验对照）。
AI.result: StereoVLM-8B 在 Stereo3D-Bench 达 95.17% δ1 深度精度、物体级平均分 66.98；干预实验表明性能依赖有效跨视图几何而非单纯额外 token 或语义先验；分层几何监督在五个空间基准平均提升 3.54 分，RoboCasa 操作成功率提升 4.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式标定几何 + 分层视差监督是 VLM 获取可迁移度量 3D 表征的有效路径，且对下游具身操作有实际收益。

title: Augmentation of cardiovascular flow measurements with generative diffusion models
summary: Cardiovascular imaging offers several ways to measure blood flow, but each provides an incomplete, resolution-limited, or noisy view of the underlying dynamics. Reconstructing the missing information is inherently ambiguous because several flow fields may be compatible with the same observation. Here, we investigate generative diffusion models as tools for cardiovascular-flow generation and reconstruction using a fully controlled state-of-the-art dataset from a digital twin of a healthy human left heart. First, we show how unconditional samples reproduce the changing anatomy and the highly fluctuating statistical properties of the flow throughout the cardiac cycle. Second, we test the conditional inference of our generative model by reconstructing an entire 2D planar section of geometry and flow configurations from a limited portion. Repeated reconstructions allow us to represent a range of plausible completions, going beyond a single deterministic estimate, while their mean retains the principal features of the reference flow. Comparison with a Gaussian process regression baseline on the same reduced domain highlights the main advantage of diffusion models: their reconstructed ensembles capture a broader range of velocity and gradient fluctuations, better encompassing ground-truth features that the baseline distributions can miss. Our results provide a quantitative proof of concept for probabilistic reconstruction of incomplete cardiovascular-flow measurements and demonstrate the potential for groundbreaking applications to the augmentation of in-vivo cardiovascular imaging data.

AI.tldr: 利用人体左心数字孪生数据集，验证扩散生成模型可无条���生成心动周期内血流场、并能从局部观测概率性地重建完整2D血流平面，超越高斯过程回归基线。
AI.motivation: 心血管成像对血流的测量在分辨率、噪声和覆盖范围上均有缺陷，缺失信息的高度欠定（多个流场兼容同一观测）使确定性重建不足，需概率化生成方法。
AI.method: 以最先进数字孪生（健康人左心）的完全可控数据集为基础，训练扩散生成模型；先做无条件采样验证心理解剖与血流统计涨落的再现，再做条件推断，从有限区域重建整个2D平面几何与流场，用多次采样构成集成分布，并与同域高斯过程回归基线对比。
AI.result: 无条件样本能复现心动周期中变化的解剖与高度波动的统计特性；条件重建的均值保留参考流的主要特征，集成样本覆盖更宽的流速与梯度涨落范围，比GP基线更好地涵盖真值特征。
AI.conclusion: 为心血管血流测量的概率重建提供了定量概念验证，展示了增强在体心血管影像数据的潜在应用价值。

title: ESSI: Computationally Efficient Semantic Search for Sparse Autoencoder Concepts
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose diffusion model activations into interpretable features, but steering a model with them requires identifying which features map to a given semantic concept, if any. Existing methods for this concept to feature task are expensive, relying on grid searches or repeated passes through the frozen UNet. We propose Efficient Semantic Sparse Identification (ESSI). Using segmentation masks to label SDXL activations as concept or non-concept, ESSI ranks SAE features and binary-searches for the smallest set on which a linear classifier still separates positive from negative samples while not falling below a performance threshold, then reuses that classifier to calibrate the steering strength. We evaluate the same selected features on both concept insertion and object unlearning. Compared with prior work, ESSI is as cheap or cheaper, and performs well on both insertion and removal.

AI.tldr: ESSI用分割掩码为SDXL激活打标签，通过二分搜索找到最小SAE特征集使线性分类器仍能分离概念/非概念样本，并复用该分类器校准引导强度，实现概念插入与物体遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有"概念到特征"任务依赖网格搜索或反复前向冻结UNet，成本高；需要一种高效的特征选择方法，同时支持概念的注入与移除。
AI.method: 用分割掩码将SDXL激活标注为概念/非概念样本，对SAE特征排序，二分搜索最小特征子集，使线性分类器在性能阈值以上仍可分离正负样本；随后复用该分类器校准引导强度；在同一特征集上评估概念插入与物体遗忘两类任务。
AI.result: 摘要称ESSI成本与已有方法相当或更低，并在概念插入和概念移除两类任务上均表现良好（未给出量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 基于SAE特征的排序+二分搜索+分类器复用，为扩散模型提供低成本的概念定位与引导强度校准框架，可同时服务于生成控制与安全遗忘。

title: DiTraR: Diverse Scorers and Transcript-Guided Re-ranking for Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
summary: Video corpus moment retrieval asks a system to find, in a large collection of untrimmed videos with subtitles, the video and the time interval that a natural-language query describes. We find that most top-ranked errors of a strong corpus-level scorer come from choosing the wrong video, not from imprecise boundaries, and that re-weighting the evidence the scorer already uses does not fix them. We present DiTraR, which addresses video selection from two complementary directions. A witness-interval scorer decomposes the query into probes and scores every candidate interval of every corpus video exactly; a multi-scorer energy ensemble averages the energies of independently trained scorers before one exhaustive search; and a transcript verifier, a frozen language model that reads the time-stamped dialogue of the highest-ranked videos, re-orders the moments without changing their boundaries. With all settings frozen on development data and a single evaluation, DiTraR reaches 24.36 and 13.55 R@1 at IoU 0.5 and 0.7 on the TVR validation split. The ensemble improves queries about visual content, the verifier improves queries about dialogue, and their gains largely add up.

AI.tldr: DiTraR通过witness-interval精确打分、多打分器能量集成与冻结语言模型转录校验三路互补手段，将视频语料级时刻检索的瓶颈从边界精化转为视频挑选，在TVR上取得24.36/13.55 R@1@IoU0.5/0.7。
AI.motivation: 作者观察到强语料级检索器的top错误主要源自选错视频而非边界不精确，且对已有证据重新加权无法解决该问题，因此专门针对视频选择环节设计方法。
AI.method: (1) witness-interval scorer：将查询分解为探针，对每个语料视频的每个候选区间做精确打分；(2) 多打分器能量集成：在一次穷举搜索前平均多个独立训练打分器的能量；(3) transcript verifier：用冻结语言模型读取最高排名视频的时间戳对话，在不改变边界的前提下重排时刻。所有超参在dev集冻结，仅一次评测。
AI.result: TVR验证集上IoU 0.5/0.7的R@1分别为24.36和13.55；集成提升视觉内容类查询，校验器提升对话类查询，二者增益基本可加。
AI.conclusion: 将语料级检索的误差归因于视频选择并用互补模块（精确区间打分、能量集成、文本校验）可有效改善视频级定位，且不同模态查询受益于不同模块。

title: Interactive Semi-Parametric On-Track Learning for Vehicle Dynamics in Autonomous Racing
summary: Autonomous racing requires an accurate vehicle dynamics model near the limits of handling, yet a mismatch between the nominal and actual dynamics inevitably remains. To reduce this mismatch, existing methods learn from on-track data, i.e., data collected while the vehicle drives on the track under racing conditions, by adapting the physical parameters of the nominal model or by learning a residual that captures the remaining mismatch. However, these on-track learning methods typically handle either the physical parameters or the residual separately, which restricts their ability to resolve the mismatch. To address this limitation, we propose an interactive semi-parametric learning framework that learns both the physical parameters and the residual under a single shared prediction-error objective. Since updating one changes the learning target of the other, they are recursively updated in turn, each guided by the other's latest update. Each update is then accepted only if it does not increase the shared objective, so that the objective is guaranteed to be non-increasing and convergent over the recursion. Numerical simulations and hardware experiments show that the proposed framework outperforms the baselines. Compared with the nominal model, it reduces the one-step prediction errors of lateral velocity and yaw rate by 90.0% and 81.6% in simulation and by 54.0% and 59.4% on hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出交互式半参数学习框架，在统一的预测误差目标下同时学习车辆动力学名义模型的物理参数与残差模型，二者交替递归更新且每步更新需保证目标不增，从而保证收敛；仿真与实车实验显示优于基线。
AI.motivation: 自主赛车需要极限工况下精确的车辆动力学模型，但名义模型与实际动力学之间必然存在偏差。现有基于赛道数据的方法通常只分别处理物理参数自适应或残差学习，割裂了两者，限制了偏差补偿能力。
AI.method: 构建半参数模型：名义物理模型（参数可调）+ 残差网络。二者共享同一个一步预测误差目标；由于更新一方会改变另一方的学习目标，采用递归交替更新，各自以对方最新结果为指导；每次更新仅在共享目标不增加时才被接受，保证目标非增且收敛。
AI.result: 仿真中横向速度与横摆角速度一步预测误差较名义模型降低90.0%和81.6%；实车实验分别降低54.0%和59.4%，均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习物理参数与残差并以共享目标+单调接受准则约束的交互式半参数框架，能有效缩小名义-实际动力学差距，为极限工况下的自主赛车控制提供更精确模型。

title: What Must a Model Tell a Planner? Outcome Interfaces for Risk-Aware Planning After Robot Damage
summary: When a robot is damaged, it must decide which routes it can still afford, and the amount of risk it may accept can change from one mission to the next. We argue that whether a learned model helps such a robot depends on its decision interface, that is, on what the model hands to the planner. A decision policy tells the planner what to do, whereas an outcome model, a kind of world model, predicts the consequences of each route. We study simulated Unitree Go2 quadrupeds and H1 humanoids with weakened motors, added payloads, or reduced foot friction. We compare four interfaces. The first is a decision policy, and the second is the same policy trained with fixed penalties for infeasible routes. The third is an outcome model that predicts the feasibility and travel time of each route. The fourth, which we call a capability contract, is an outcome model that predicts the chance of success and the travel time of the robot on each terrain and composes them along a route. All share the same collected experience, matched tuning and risk calibration, and an uncertainty guard. Two comparatively low-risk probes let the capability contract rank hazardous terrains about as well as four new trials on every hazard. At a calibrated 5% limit on selecting empirically infeasible routes, outcome models cut declined missions from about 32% to 7-8% on Go2 and from 57% to 35-36% on H1 compared with the plain policy. Fixed penalties narrow this gap, but the best penalty changes with the risk target. Predicting outcomes lets the planner preserve missions by changing routes as risk requirements tighten.

AI.tldr: 研究"决策接口"如何影响受损机器人路径规划：对比决策策略、固定惩罚策略、结果模型与"能力契约"四种接口。结果模型在5%风险约束下把放弃任务率从32%降至7-8%（Go2）、57%降至35-36%（H1）。
AI.motivation: 机器人受损后其可承受风险随任务变化，需要有条件地选择可行路线。作者主张学习模型是否有用取决于其"决策接口"，即模型把什么交给规划器，而非单纯比较模型精度，故系统性地对比不同接口形式。
AI.method: 在仿真的Unitree Go2四足与H1人形上制造损伤（电机减弱、加载荷、降低足底摩擦）。统一收集经验、匹配调参与风险校准，并加不确定性保护。对比四种接口：纯决策策略；带固定不可行惩罚的策略；逐路径预测可行性与耗时的结果模型；"能力契约"——逐地形预测成功概率与耗时并沿路径组合。
AI.result: 两个低风险探针即可让能力契约对危险地形的排序接近每种危险地形四次新试验的水平。在5%经验不可行路线选择的校准上限下，结果模型相对纯策略将放弃任务率从约32%降至7-8%（Go2），57%降至35-36%（H1）。固定惩罚可缩小差距，但最优惩罚值随风险目标漂移。
AI.conclusion: 预测"结果"而非"动作"的接口能让规划器在风险约束收紧时通过改路而非弃单来保留任务；能力契约可用极少探针实现有效的危险地形排序，说明决策接口设计是损伤机器人鲁棒规划的关键变量。

title: Real-time neuromorphic audio and vision perception for autonomous robotic applications: Integration and experimental evaluation on a rover platform
summary: Neuromorphic sensing and computing offer a promising alternative to conventional deep learning pipelines for mobile robots, where perception must run continuously under tight latency and energy constraints. However, most neuromorphic solutions are still evaluated offline or on isolated benchmarks, and their integration into complete robotic systems remains largely unexplored. In this technical report, a four-wheel rover platform is presented that combines three real-time perception pipelines: a classical audio tagging pipeline based on Pretrained Audio Neural Networks (PANNs) running on an NVIDIA Jetson GPU, a neuromorphic audio pipeline in which a spiking neural network (SNN) is deployed on the SynSense Xylo Audio~2 chip, and a neuromorphic vision pipeline in which events from an event-based camera are processed by the SpikeYOLO spiking detector for traffic cone detection. On the Xylo chip, the whole processing chain---from the microphone signal to the classification of low- and high-pitched sounds---is performed on-chip, while the host only configures the device and reads the output neurons. All models are deployed as containerised services and integrated through ROS~2, and a configurable action dispatcher maps the detected classes to robot behaviours, closing the loop between perception and actuation. The platform is demonstrated in a proof-of-concept scenario in which the robot reacts to sound classes detected by both audio pipelines and detects traffic cones with the event camera, showing the feasibility of integrating neuromorphic hardware into a multimodal robotic platform operating in real time.

AI.tldr: 集成SNN音频(Xylo Audio 2片上全链路)、SpikeYOLO事件相机视觉与经典PANNs音频三路实时感知的四轮机器人平台，经ROS 2容器化部署，实现感知到动作闭环。
AI.motivation: 神经形态感知多在离线或孤立基准上评测，缺少完整机器人系统级集成验证。作者希望展示神经形态硬件在移动机器人上实时多模态闭环运行的可行性。
AI.method: 四轮rover平台：PANNs音频标签经Jetson GPU推理；SNN音频部署于SynSense Xylo Audio 2，麦克风信号到低/高音分类全流程片上完成，主机仅做配置与读取输出神经元；事件相机+SpikeYOLO检测锥桶。所有模型容器化并通过ROS 2集成，可配置action dispatcher将类别映射为机器人行为。
AI.result: 概念验证场景中机器人对两路音频检测类别作出反应并用事件相机检测交通锥，证明神经形态硬件可实时嵌入多模态机器人平台；技术报告未给出量化延迟/能耗对比。
AI.conclusion: 神经形态+经典感知可统一集成到ROS 2机器人系统并形成闭环，为后续系统级评测与基准化奠定平台基础；属可行性演示，缺少定量性能与扩展性分析。

title: Non-penetrating World Models
comment: 20 pages, 13 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 NoPeBench 基准揭示交互式视频世界模型普遍存在物体穿插（平均 74% 违规率），并发现冻结 DiT 隐状态可用于预测动作安全性；据此提出轻量 NoPeWorld，在冻结 DiT 隐状态上训练小预测头判别动作是否安全，并将不安全动作替换为最保留原意图的安全动作，将违规率降至 16%。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型在候选动作导致物体穿越障碍时缺乏可靠的物理约束，开源模型无一能稳定避免此类物理违规，亟需检测与预防机制。
AI.method: 构建 NoPeBench 评测世界模型对物理障碍的响应；利用冻结 DiT 隐状态已隐含的穿透可预测性，在其上训练轻量预测头判别候选动作安全性；对不安全动作执行"意图保持"的安全动作替换，无需微调主干模型。
AI.result: 在六个视频世界模型上平均将物理违规率从 74% 降至 16%；零样本泛化到开放域图像、第三人称视角与移动障碍。开源代码、基准与权重。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的物理连贯性可由其内部表征直接读取并低成本干预，为交互式世界模型的物理约束提供了简单有效的即插即用方案。

title: Task2Hand: A Contact-Grounded Skill for Parametric Dexterous-Hand Morphology Design
summary: Dexterous hand design demands repeated expert work across geometry, robot-description code, collision debugging, grasp initialization, and policy training. We present Task2Hand, a Skill: a specification package that turns a functional manipulation brief into a parameterized hand model and routes every candidate through cost-ordered contact, dynamics, and learning gates. Each gate returns a status and an evidence record; on failure, the Skill records the earliest blocker, revises one bounded parameter group, and reruns the cheaper gates. The agent generates, validates, and trains autonomously within declared bounds, and escalates trade-offs, plateaus, and conflicting evidence to a human who sets the next design direction. An evidence-driven design trajectory for bidirectional in-hand manipulation yielded SAGE Hand (Skill-Aware Generative Embodiment): four fingers, 16 actuated DoF, an integrated guiding palm, compact roots, cylindrical tips, and a collision-cleared opposable thumb. Under a matched training protocol, SAGE Hand reaches 45.6% task success on a hexagonal prism against 37.3% for the LEAP hand, and 70.8% on a bicolor cylinder against 51.6%. Dense simulated tactile input more than halves the cylinder drop rate. In a controlled iteration study, the Skill path preserves capture at 164/165 trials while the path without the Skill degrades to 14/165, confirming that the gates act as a regression guard during refinement. Accepted candidates pack with URDF/MJCF, metrics, checkpoints, and a provenance manifest.

AI.tldr: Task2Hand 将操作任务需求文档转化为参数化灵巧手设计，通过成本排序的接触/动力学/学习"门控"迭代验证，产出 SAGE Hand（4指16自由度），在六棱柱与双色圆柱抓取任务上优于 LEAP 手。
AI.motivation: 灵巧手设计需在几何、URDF/MJCF 代码、碰撞调试、抓取初始化、策略训练间反复人工迭代，成本高、易回归；作者希望用智能体驱动的 Skill 把这一流程自动化并加装回归保护。
AI.method: 提出 Task2Hand"Skill"规格包：输入功能操作简报→生成参数化手模型→候选依次通过按代价排序的接触门、动力学门、学习门；每门返回状态与证据记录；失败时记录最早阻断点、只修订一个有界参数组并重跑较廉价门；在声明边界内自主生成/验证/训练，遇到权衡、平台期、证据冲突时升级给人类定方向。最终候选打包 URDF/MJCF、指标、checkpoint 与溯源清单。
AI.result: SAGE Hand 为4指16驱动自由度，带集成引导掌、紧凑根、圆柱指尖、无碰撞对置拇指。同等训练协议下六棱柱任务成功率 45.6% vs LEAP 37.3%，双色圆柱 70.8% vs 51.6%；稠密仿真触觉输入使圆柱掉落率减半以上；消融迭代研究中带 Skill 保留 164/165 次捕获，无 Skill 降至 14/165。
AI.conclusion: 分层代价门控 + 单参数组有界修订构成有效的设计回归护栏，人机协同的技能化流程可自主产出具竞争力的灵巧手；证据显示设计搜索与验证可部分自动化，但主要在仿真中评估。
